title: Staff Product Manager
description:
About Coursera

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, creating one of the world's most comprehensive skills development platforms for the AI era. This strengthens our ability to accelerate AI-powered innovation and shape how the world discovers and builds skills at a pivotal moment of change. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Coursera was launched in 2012 by Andrew Ng and Daphne Koller with a mission to provide universal access to worldclass learning. Coursera partners with leading university and industry partners to offer a broad catalog of content and credentials, including courses, Specializations, Professional Certificates, and degrees. Coursera’s platform innovations — including AI-powered personalized guide and features, like Role Play and Course Builder, and role-based solutions like Skills Tracks — enable instructors, partners, and companies to deliver scalable, personalized, and verified learning. Institutions worldwide rely on Coursera to upskill and reskill their employees, students, and citizens in high-demand fields such as GenAI, data science, technology, and business, while learners globally turn to Coursera to master the skills they need to advance their careers. Coursera is a Delaware public benefit corporation and a B Corp. Coursera recently combined with Udemy to create one of the world’s most comprehensive skills development platforms.

Why Join Us

At Coursera, we’re looking for inventors, innovators, and lifelong learners ready to shape the future of education. You’ll help build global programs and tools that power online learning for millions turning bold ideas into real impact. People who thrive here are customer-first builders who move fast, simplify ruthlessly, and iterate relentlessly on the metrics that matter.

We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to do their best work together. Our virtual hiring and onboarding experience makes it easy to join us and start making an impact from anywhere. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

Team Overview:

Coursera’s Product Management team drives our mission of providing universal access to world-class learning and skills development. Senior and Staff PMs lead high-impact product initiatives, balancing strategic vision with hands-on problem solving to create integrated learner, partner, and enterprise-level experiences. They partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, and Business stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions in an evolving, AI-driven education landscape.

Job Overview:

As a Staff Product Manager, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Coursera’s product vision, delivering exceptional learner and partner experiences, and driving measurable business impact. You will operate at the intersection of strategic thinking and hands-on execution, navigating ambiguity while influencing cross-functional teams.

  • Creator-Centric UX Thinking: You think in experiences, not just features. You have a strong point of view on what good authoring and creation tools feel like — and the patience to pressure-test that instinct with real creators until the product earns trust. You can speak fluently with design partners and push back when something that works technically doesn't work humanly.
  • Revenue Awareness: You understand how the products you build connect to the business. Whether it's creator retention, content quality driving learner outcomes, or new monetization surfaces — you can draw a line from product decisions to commercial impact, and you use that line to prioritize.
  • Customer-Centric Curiosity: Exhibit deep curiosity to understand customers and all elements influencing their experience, offering comprehensive, integrated solutions that address real needs.
  • Thriving in Ambiguity: Operate effectively in uncertain, fast-changing environments, as often found in startup-like situations.
  • Balanced Skills vs. Domain Experience: While domain expertise is beneficial, strong intellectual capacity, curiosity, proactiveness, and solid foundational product skills enable quick adaptation even without prior domain exposure.
  • Strategic & Tactical Agility: Seamlessly switch between defining long-term vision and deep-diving into execution details when required.
  • IC Excellence: As an individual contributor, comfortably navigate between strategy and execution to deliver impact.
  • Integrated Experience Design: A track record of designing end-to-end integrated experiences is a strong plus.
  • Tool Familiarity: Familiarity with tools in the PM space, such as Jira, Figma or generative AI tools, though tool-specific experience is less crucial. A capable PM with strong core skills will learn quickly.
  • Speed of Innovation: Demonstrates the ability to rapidly prototype, test, and iterate solutions to keep pace with evolving customer needs and emerging technologies. Balances speed with rigor to deliver impactful outcomes quickly.

Responsibilities:

  • As a Staff Product Manager, you will define and drive product strategy and own the roadmap for a high priority area of the Coursera platform, such as mobile, AI-powered assessment or agentic enterprise integration.
  • Own the end-to-end content creation experience for Udemy & Coursera from how instructors and creators author content, to how AI assists and adapts that content for learners — defining what "great" looks like at every step of that journey.
  • Make independent product calls in a fast-moving environment, bringing cross-functional partners along through clear reasoning and well-structured communication rather than consensus-by-committee.
  • Translate customer insights and market trends into integrated solutions that can scale to serve millions of learners and customers around the world.
  • Lead execution from ideation and analysis through development and launch, delivering measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with Engineering, Design, and Data teams to deliver AI-powered product features and experiences.
  • Leverage data and customer feedback to inform decisions and continuously improve.
  • Mentor peers and contribute to building a high-performing product organisation.

Basic Qualifications:

  • You have experience building, using, or experimenting with AI-driven products, particularly in the areas of workflow automation, conversational AI, decision support, or agentic AI, and transitioning from traditional UI to AI-driven or AI-first product.
  • You have taken a product from zero to launch in an environment where the path wasn't clear. You had to define the problem, make the bet, build the team's confidence, and ship it. You can point to what worked, what didn't, and what you'd do differently.
  • You have a high bar across the board - from your own contributions to the people you work with, to the products you work on.

Preferred Qualification:

  • You are the product leader who inspires colleagues to think bigger, look beyond safe bets and tackle challenges with conviction. You are a builder, not an optimizer.
  • You have a strong aesthetic sensibility and deep respect for craft in UX. You've worked closely with designers — not just as a stakeholder, but as a genuine creative partner — and your products show it.
  • You understand creator psychology. Whether it's course authors, instructional designers, or subject-matter experts, you know what makes creation tools feel enabling rather than obstructive, and you've shipped products that creators actually want to use.
  • You are commercially literate. You can connect product choices to revenue outcomes without reducing every decision to a business case. You know when to push for a quality call that doesn't have an immediate ROI, and when that's actually the wrong call.
  • You are energized about solving hard problems and navigating ambiguity and rapid technology change.
  • You are deeply curious about customers and the positive impact your product could have on their lives. You dive deep into data and feedback to ground your understanding of their needs and experience using your products.
  • You feel a sense of responsibility and urgency to invent the future of AI as a force for unlocking human potential and expanding opportunity.

At Coursera, we are committed to building a globally diverse team and are thrilled to extend employment opportunities to individuals in any country where we have a legal entity. We require candidates to possess eligible working rights and have a compatible timezone overlap with their team to facilitate seamless collaboration.

Coursera has a commitment to enabling flexibility and workspace choices for employees. Our interviews and onboarding are entirely virtual, providing a smooth and efficient experience for our candidates. As an employee, we enable you to select your main way of working, whether it's from home, one of our offices or hubs, or a co-working space near you.

Keep Learning

If this opportunity interests you, you might like these courses on Coursera:

  • Learning How To Learn
  • Gen AI for Product Managers

Compensation

US Zone 2 - 4

$212,000 – $265,000 USD

The range(s) listed above is the expected annual base salary for this role, subject to change.

Salary is just one component of Coursera’s total rewards package. All regular employees are also eligible for a bonus program and equity in the form of RSU’s.

A number of factors are taken into account when determining pay, which includes: job level, location, training/education, business need, skill set and internal equity.

title: Analyst, RMBS Mumbai
description:
Morningstar DBRS is a leading provider of independent rating services and opinions for corporate and sovereign entities, financial institutions, and structured finance instruments globally. Currently with 700 employees in eight offices globally. Formed through the July 2019 acquisition of DBRS by Morningstar, Inc., the ratings business is the fourth-largest provider of credit ratings in the world.


Morningstar DBRS is committed to empowering investor success, serving the market through leading-edge technology and raising the bar for the industry. Morningstar DBRS is a market leader in Canada, the U.S. and Europe in multiple asset classes.


Morningstar DBRS rates more than 4,000 issuers and 60,000 securities worldwide and is driven to bringing more clarity, diversity of opinion, and responsiveness to the ratings process. Morningstar DBRS approach and size provide the agility to respond to customers’ needs, while being large enough to provide the necessary expertise and resources.

Visit: to learn more.


About the Role

As a member of the Structured Finance team, you will conduct thorough quantitative and qualitative research on the underlying loans and/or properties that collateralize Asset or Mortgage Backed Securities transactions. In addition, you will assist the onshore team with setting up templates and reports; assist with special projects/initiatives, as needed. With some seasoning, you will be expected to have thorough understanding of the asset class and support on various other task across the ratings value chain. This position is based in our Navi Mumbai office.


Responsibilities:

  • Analyze the credit risk in Structured Finance securities by performing tasks that include reviewing deal documents, analyzing periodic data and setting up templates.

  • Collect, organize and analyze data from internal and external sources for use in criteria development, ratings and research reports.

  • Accurate and timely retrieval, analysis, research and reporting of pool level and/or property level performance, including:

    • Identifying and analyzing risky assets based upon qualitative and quantitative factors

    • Identifying macro and micro risk factors to determine and measure exposure within the securitized pools.

  • Monitoring, analysis, and reporting on Structured Finance transactions, including an investigation of potential default or loss scenarios for underlying collateral.

  • Compile and prepare periodic portfolio reports for use by senior staff and identify material changes for research causes.

  • Maintain regular and open communication with the operations team and technology team about assigned tasks, priorities and ensure applications under development meet the defined requirements and pass the user acceptance testing prior to its release.

  • Understand the domain and implement quick fix solutions to align the development activities with dynamic business needs

  • Take ownership of the tasks with focus on quality and accuracy of the deliverables

  • Demonstrate strong learning curve and eagerness to move up the rating value chain

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and company policies and procedures


Requirements:

  • Postgraduate in Finance or CA or CFA charter holder or such equivalent qualification

  • 2 to 3 years of experience in a credit research domain, with Structured Finance knowledge, experience at a rating agency is a plus.

  • Fluent in English, with good verbal and written communication skills

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy

  • Highly motivated, self-starter who is keen to learn, has a positive attitude and a strong work ethic

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks at the same time and deliver results in a timely manner

  • Good inter-personal skills and ability to participate/ contribute as a team player


Morningstar DBRS is an equal opportunity employer.

About Us

Morningstar DBRS is a leading provider of independent rating services and opinions for corporate and sovereign entities, financial institutions, and project and structured finance instruments globally. Rating more than 4,000 issuers and 60,000 securities, it is one of the top four credit rating agencies in the world.

Morningstar DBRS empowers investor success by bringing more transparency and a much-needed diversity of opinion in the credit rating industry. Our approach and size allow us to be nimble enough to respond to customers' needs in their local markets, but large enough to provide the necessary expertise and resources they require. Market innovators choose to work with us because of our agility, tech-forward approach, and exceptional customer service.

Morningstar DBRS is the next generation of credit ratings.

If you receive and accept an offer from us, we require that personal and any related investments be disclosed confidentiality to our Compliance team (days vary by region). These investments will be reviewed to ensure they meet Code of Ethics requirements. If any conflicts of interest are identified, then you will be required to liquidate those holdings immediately. In addition, dependent on your department and location of work certain employee accounts must be held with an approved broker (for example all, U.S. employee accounts). If this applies and your account(s) are not with an approved broker, you will be required to move your holdings to an approved broker.

Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues.

title: Senior Insider and Data Risk Analyst
description:
Sr. Insider & Data Risk Analyst

Team: Analyst

Location: Italy

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Insider & Data Risk Analyst based in Italy.

This is a senior individual contributor role focused on protecting sensitive information, systems, and people from insider and data-loss risks. You will own complex investigations from initial triage through resolution while helping mature insider risk management and Data Loss Prevention capabilities. The role sits at the intersection of cybersecurity, data protection, privacy, and regulated financial services. You will work closely with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security teams on highly sensitive cases requiring discretion and sound judgment. The position also offers an opportunity to strengthen risk processes, automate investigations, and apply AI to emerging security challenges. Success requires a highly organized professional who can translate complex findings into clear recommendations for both technical teams and leadership.

Accountabilities

    • Own insider risk investigations from initial triage through closure, including establishing case timelines, coordinating containment and escalation, documenting determinations, and capturing lessons learned.
    • Mature the Insider Risk Management Program by developing scalable case-management processes, risk-tiering methodologies, investigation standards, and repeatable workflows.
    • Operate, monitor, and tune Data Loss Prevention capabilities across SaaS applications, endpoints, and other environments, improving detection quality while reducing false positives.
    • Investigate potential data exfiltration, misuse, policy violations, and inappropriate access involving source code, cloud platforms, collaboration tools, third-party applications, and critical business or trading systems.
    • Strengthen data classification and governance practices while aligning DLP controls with information sensitivity and business risk.
    • Assess risks associated with unauthorized AI and agentic tooling, including potential exposure of sensitive or proprietary information through approved and unsanctioned AI applications.
    • Use workflow automation, AI, and security orchestration capabilities to improve alert triage, investigation efficiency, and the overall maturity of insider risk processes.
    • Lead insider risk and data protection assessments, maintain risk registers, and track remediation activities and emerging threats.
    • Partner with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security on sensitive personnel cases, departures, policy violations, and data-handling concerns with a high level of discretion and care.
    • Support internal and external audits, regulatory requirements, and security assurance activities related to insider risk, data protection, privacy, and information security.
    • Contribute insider risk and secure data-handling content to security awareness and employee training programs.
    • Serve as a senior escalation point for insider risk cases and mentor colleagues on investigation methodologies, case management, and effective risk analysis.
    • Monitor developments in insider risk, data protection, privacy, cybersecurity, and financial services regulation to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

      • Requirements:

      • 4+ years of professional experience in insider risk, Data Loss Prevention, digital forensics, security investigations, or a closely related discipline.
      • Demonstrated hands-on experience leading sensitive investigations and managing cases involving personnel matters, data misuse, policy violations, or potential exfiltration.
      • Practical experience operating and tuning DLP solutions across SaaS and endpoint environments, with an understanding of detection quality and false-positive reduction.
      • Experience with workflow automation, AI, or SOAR platforms for alert triage, investigation support, and case orchestration.
      • Strong understanding of data classification, data governance, data protection, and information security principles.
      • Working knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis, such as Elastic/ELK or Splunk, to support investigations and establish evidence-based conclusions.
      • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks including NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and privacy regulations such as GDPR and APPI.
      • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear investigation reports, case documentation, risk assessments, and executive summaries.
      • Exceptional integrity, discretion, and judgment when handling confidential personnel, customer, business, and security information.
      • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple sensitive investigations in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
      • Ability to collaborate effectively with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security stakeholders.

title: Network and Cybersecurity Lead Engineer, Offshore Solution, EHouse (JB)
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Automation Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as the technical lead for all Network & Cybersecurity engineering activities in assignments. Each day, you will ensure that the design, implementation, and securing of the 800xA-based ICSS and PMS network architecture are executed in an efficient and cost-effective manner- from FEED through FAT, installation, and commissioning.

You will also showcase your expertise by working within a multidisciplinary team of automation, safety, telecom, and PMS engineers, playing a critical role in defining and delivering network and cybersecurity solutions in compliance with OT cybersecurity standards across the full operational lifecycle of ICSS and PMS.


The work model for the role is: Onsite #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Offshore Solutions Business within the Automation Energy Industries EHouse Business and is based in Johor Bahru, Malaysia.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Designing and configuring the OT/control system network architecture for 800xA ICSS and PMS incorporating full redundancy, VLAN segmentation, firewall/DMZ architecture, IP addressing, network time synchronization architecture, in compliance with industry standards and project specifications.

  • Developing and maintaining the Cybersecurity Design Specification and related documentation in accordance with IEC 62443, incorporating defense-in-depth, security zones and conduits, RBAC, secure remote access, Windows hardening, antimalware, application whitelisting, and patch management across the OT infrastructure.

  • Producing and maintaining supporting cybersecurity deliverables including network architecture diagrams, security philosophy documents, risk registers, patch management plans, backup/restore procedures, and system hardening guidelines.

  • Deploying and integrating OT Intrusion Detection and continuous threat monitoring solutions viz. Claroty and Nozomi or equivalent - to provide passive network monitoring, asset inventory, anomaly detection, and security event visibility across the OT network.

  • Ensuring the ICSS & PMS network architecture and cybersecurity design comply with maritime cyber resilience requirements including IACS UR E26, UR E27, and UR E22, in coordination with the assigned classification society (DNV, ABS, Bureau Veritas, ClassNK, or Lloyd's Register).

  • Participating in FAT and SAT activities, including network validation, cybersecurity verification testing, and troubleshooting of network and security-related issues.


Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or Computer Engineering.

  • Min. 8 years of experience in industrial network engineering and/or OT cybersecurity, with exposure to DCS/ICSS platforms with in Offshore, marine or FPSO projects is strongly preferred.

  • Solid understanding of OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks: IEC 62443, NIST CSF, ISA99, and familiarity with cybersecurity specifications used in Oil & Gas projects.

  • Relevant certifications are a plus: CCNA/CCNP, GICSP, ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Certificate, CISSP, or similar.

  • Working knowledge of industrial protocols (Modbus TCP/RTU, OPC/OPC UA, PROFIBUS, PROFINET, Ethernet/IP), and virtualization technologies are advantageous.

  • Hands-on experience with industrial network design (Belden / Cisco switches, routers, firewalls) in an ICSS/PMS environment.

  • Familiarity with maritime cybersecurity requirements applicable to FPSOs: IACS UR E26/E27/E22, and classification society cybersecurity notations (DNV Cyber Secure, ABS CS, BV Cyber Security, ClassNK, or Lloyd's Register equivalents) is a strong advantage.


What's in it for you?

Drive meaningful change in global energy operations. This role offers the opportunity to lead strategic, high-impact projects within a purpose-driven organization dedicated to customer success, supported by an inclusive and safety-driven workplace culture.


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Attractive remuneration along with incentives based on performance

  • Comprehensive medical and insurance coverage

  • Learning, development programs

  • hybrid/flexible work practices

  • Inclusive and safety-driven work culture


More about us

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

title: Social – og sundhedsassistent Øre-, Næse-, og halsafdelingen søges - Vil du være den, der får hverdagen til at hænge sammen i et travlt ØNH-ambulatorium?
description:
På Øre- Næse- og Hals kirurgiskafdeling, har vi en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt, ledig pr. 1. oktober. Du bliver en del af vores personale team i Øre- Næse- og Hals afdelingen, som dækker vores operationsafdeling, ambulatorium og søvncenter, samt et hørerinstitut på Havrevangen. Vi er 40 sygeplejersker og en SOSU-assistent, som samarbejder tværfagligt med læger, lægesekretærer, audiologiassistenter, og anæstesi, i et velfungerende samarbejde omkring det enkelte patientforløb.

I ambulatoriet arbejder læge og sygeplejerske i et team, som sammen varetager dagsprogrammet på en tilknyttet ambulatoriestue. Patienterne kommer til udredning og behandling af problematikker, der knytter sig til øre-næse og hals specialet. Patientkategorien spænder fra børn til voksne, og patientforløbene i ambulatoriet kan både være elektive og akutte. Arbejdstiden i ambulatoriet og operationsafsnittet er på hverdage i tidsrummet fra kl. 07.45-16.00.

Om Stilling

På Øre-, Næse-, hals kirurgiskafdeling søger vi en engageret social- og sundhedsassistent, der trives med ansvar, koordinering og praktiske opgaver. Du bliver en nøgleperson i den daglige drift med ansvar for vores skyllerum, vare forsyning og logistik, så læger og sygeplejersker kan koncentrere sig om patientbehandlingen.

Vi har allerede en social- og sundhedsassistent og søger nu en kollega, som sammen med hende vil være med til at udvikle og sikre de daglige arbejdsgange.

Du bliver ansvarlig for en række centrale drifts-, logistik- og serviceopgaver, der understøtter den daglige drift i afdelingen. Opgaverne omfatter blandt andet håndtering af instrumenter, rengøring og vedligeholdelse af skoper og andet medicoteknisk udstyr, lagerstyring og varebestilling, koordinering med interne og eksterne samarbejdspartnere samt sikring af, at nødvendige instrumenter, materialer og forbrugsvarer altid er tilgængelige. Derudover indgår kvalitetskontrol, dokumentation, opfølgning på procedurer og understøttelse af den daglige koordinering af afdelingens aktiviteter. Funktionen indebærer også medansvar for at sikre velfungerende arbejdsgange og bidrage til et smidigt patientforløb gennem tæt samarbejde med afdelingens øvrige medarbejd

Vi søger en kollega, der

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent.

  • Arbejder systematisk og har sans for orden og struktur.

  • Trives med logistiske og koordinerende opgaver.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig indgå i et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde.

  • Har blik for kvalitet, hygiejne og patientsikkerhed.

  • Er initiativrig og ser muligheder for at optimere arbejdsgange.

  • Har en positiv tilgang og bidrager til et godt arbejdsmiljø.



Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor betydning for afdelingens daglige drift.

  • En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og et godt tværfagligt samarbejde.

  • Mulighed for at præge og udvikle arbejdsgange i en afdeling, der fortsat er ved at finde sin form efter flytningen til HBY.

  • Grundig oplæring og tæt samarbejde med afdelingens øvrige social- og sundhedsassistent samt sygeplejersker og koordinatorer.

  • Et arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har fokus på kvalitet og udvikling.



Hos os bliver du en vigtig del af maskinrummet. Din indsats er afgørende for, at patientforløbene glider effektivt, og at afdelingen fungerer optimalt – hver eneste dag.

Vi glæder os til at byde en ny kollega velkommen, som har lyst til at tage ansvar for en funktion, der er helt central for driften af ØNH-afdelingen.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst for social- og sundhedspersonale indgået med FOA

title: Tech Lead / Solution Architect - Backend
description:
Tech Lead / Solution Architect – Backend, Workflow Engine, SSO, Observability, QA

Team: IT

Location: Ireland

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Tech Lead / Solution Architect – Backend, Workflow Engine, SSO, Observability, QA based in Ireland.

This is a senior technical leadership opportunity focused on designing and delivering the backend foundation of a new Legal OS MVP.
You will own architecture decisions across backend services, workflow orchestration, security, observability, and quality engineering.
The role combines hands-on engineering with solution architecture, requiring you to turn complex requirements into reliable, production-ready systems.
You will design resilient workflows with strong guarantees around retries, idempotency, consistency, auditability, and failure recovery.
You will also establish secure SSO and permissions models while building comprehensive observability and automated QA practices.
The environment is highly autonomous, project-based, and focused on delivering a pragmatic MVP with a strong emphasis on reliability and security.
This role is ideal for a senior backend engineer or architect who enjoys owning technical direction and building robust systems from the ground up.

Accountabilities

    • Own backend architecture and technical direction, translating product goals into scalable and maintainable production solutions.
    • Define the architecture boundaries and minimal service contracts, including APIs and event-driven interfaces required for the MVP.
    • Design the core data model, including Matter IDs, mapping rules, and idempotency keys to ensure reliable and consistent processing.
    • Build and define the workflow layer with retry and backoff strategies, dead-letter handling, replay capabilities, deduplication, and resilient failure recovery.
    • Establish security architecture covering SSO, role-based permissions, access controls, and secure secrets management.
    • Implement comprehensive audit trails that clearly capture who performed an action, what occurred, when it happened, and why, supported by correlation IDs and distributed tracing.
    • Design and implement observability practices covering structured logging, metrics, tracing, system health, and operational troubleshooting.
    • Establish robust QA gates covering integration, end-to-end, and regression testing for critical workflows such as document delivery, deadlines, and audit functionality.
    • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to make pragmatic architectural decisions and ensure solutions are ready for production.
    • Contribute hands-on code and technical implementation while maintaining a strong focus on reliability, security, maintainability, and operational excellence.

      • Requirements

      • Senior-level experience in backend engineering and solution architecture, with a proven track record of shipping production systems.
      • Strong understanding of distributed systems and failure modes, including retries, idempotency, consistency, race conditions, deduplication, and recovery strategies.
      • Hands-on experience designing and implementing backend services, ideally using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI.
      • Strong knowledge of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL.
      • Experience with queues and event-driven architectures using technologies such as NATS, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or comparable platforms.
      • Strong understanding of APIs and integrations with external platforms and services.
      • Experience implementing OIDC, SSO, authentication, authorization, roles, permissions, and secrets management.
      • Practical knowledge of observability and monitoring technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, ELK, or similar platforms.
      • Strong experience with integration, end-to-end, and regression testing, including integrating automated QA into CI pipelines.
      • Familiarity with Docker and modern software delivery practices.
      • Ability to independently make architecture decisions, define technical contracts, and translate ambiguous requirements into actionable solutions.
      • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying reliability, security, and scalability risks.
      • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
      • Comfortable working autonomously in a project-based environment and taking ownership from architecture through implementation and delivery.

        • Benefits

        • 100% remote working arrangement, with a preference for candidates working within European/CET time zones.
        • Full-time or part-time engagement options.
        • Freelance/project-based working arrangement.
        • Opportunity to shape the architecture of a new Legal OS MVP from the ground up.
        • High level of technical ownership and autonomy.
        • Hands-on work across backend engineering, workflow automation, security, observability, and QA.
        • Opportunity to build reliable, security-focused systems designed for real-world legal workflows.

title: Projectleider Vastgoed (36 uur per week)
description:
Met jouw inzet verbeteren we de zorg van morgen: door projecten goed te organiseren, processen te optimaliseren en samenwerking tussen disciplines te versterken.

Dit is jouw baan:

Deze functie kenmerkt zich door de afwisselende rollen die je binnen deze functie bekleedt . Bij projecten met een duidelijke en afgebakende omvang neem jij de rol van projectleider op je. Je bent dan van A tot Z verantwoordelijk voor het projectresultaat: van planvorming tot oplevering.

Bij grotere en complexere projecten werk je samen met een senior projectleider of programmaleider. In die situaties vervul jij een cruciale rol als werkvoorbereider en verbinder: je brengt structuur aan, zorgt voor inhoudelijke voorbereiding en verbindt techniek, uitvoering en organisatie. Jij bent degene die ervoor zorgt dat plannen uitvoerbaar worden en dat alle betrokken partijen effectief samenwerken. Juist deze combinatie maakt de functie veelzijdig: je schakelt tussen sturen en ondersteunen, tussen regie nemen en faciliteren.

De projecten hebben vaak een multidisciplinair karakter en raken zowel techniek, zorgprocessen als organisatie. Je bent vanaf de start betrokken: je denkt mee over de aanpak, stelt projectplannen op en vertaalt ideeën naar concrete en haalbare plannen. Vervolgens neem je de regie in de uitvoering en zorg je dat projecten binnen de afgesproken tijd, kwaliteit en budget worden gerealiseerd. Dankzij jouw voorbereiding, afstemming en technisch inzicht realiseer jij projecten samen met zorgafdelingen en externe partners zonder de continuïteit van zorg te verstoren.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Adviseren over de opzet, inhoud en aanpak van projecten.

  • Opstellen van projectplannen (doel, planning, organisatie, kosten en communicatie).

  • Inrichten en aansturen van projectorganisaties en werkgroepen.

  • Leiden van projecten met interne en externe stakeholders.

  • Coördineren van voortgang en bewaken van planning, budget en kwaliteit.

  • Signaleren van risico’s, knelpunten en afwijkingen en hier actief op sturen.

  • Verzorgen van heldere communicatie en rapportages richting opdrachtgever en management.

  • Organiseren en voorzitten van project- en stuurgroepen.

  • Vertalen van projectresultaten naar beleid en implementatie binnen de organisatie.

Kortom, dit ben jij:

  • Je voelt je comfortabel in een rol waarin je schakelt tussen trekken (projectleiding) en ondersteunen (werkvoorbereiding).

  • Je hebt het vermogen om overzicht te houden én de diepte in te gaan op inhoud en techniek.

  • Je krijgt energie van samenwerken en het verbinden van verschillende disciplines.

  • Je hebt een hbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Je hebt ervaring met projectmanagement en het leiden / begeleiden van projecten.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met vastgoed, techniek en/of de zorgomgeving.

  • Je beschikt over sterk organisatie- en analytisch vermogen.

  • Je bent zelfstandig, neemt initiatief en werkt resultaatgericht.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en weet verschillende belangen te verbinden.

  • Je kunt goed omgaan met dynamiek, weerstand en tegengestelde belangen.

  • Aanvullende kennis van projectmethodieken (bijv. Prince2) en inzicht in organisatieprocessen is een pré.

Dit is jouw team:

Je maakt deel uit van de afdeling Vastgoed, een ervaren team van circa 20 collega’s: projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, beheerders en technici. Samen zorgen we voor een veilige, betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige omgeving voor patiënten en medewerkers.

Het doel van de afdeling Vastgoed is een toekomstbestendige vastgoedportefeuille realiseren, onderhouden en beheren, die aansluit bij de strategische koers van het ziekenhuis en voldoet aan wet- en regelgeving, duurzaamheidseisen en gebruikerswensen.

Wij bieden jou:

  • CompanyPass: Profiteer van exclusieve kortingen bij lokale winkels en restaurants tot wellnessresorts, attractieparken en bioscopen.

  • Ontwikkeling en doorstroming: bij ons krijg je ruimte om te groeien en jezelf te ontwikkelen.

  • Personeelsvereniging: Actieve vereniging met kortingen voor uitjes en twee keer per jaar een groot zomer- en winterfeest.

Veiligheid en betrouwbaarheid

title: Technical Architect _3248
description:

We are looking for experienced Camunda BPM Engineers who can design and implement BPMN workflows, DMN decision models, and end-to-end process orchestration. The role involves developing Java-based delegates (mostly in Kotlin framework), connectors, job workers, and integrating workflows with microservices, REST APIs, and enterprise systems.

You will work on configuring Camunda Cockpit/Tasklist/Operate, optimizing workflow performance, and ensuring smooth production operations. Strong hands on skills in Java, Spring Boot, BPMN 2.0, OData/REST integrations, and messaging platforms like Kafka/JMS are essential.

Experience with Zeebe (Camunda 8), DevOps tools (Git, Maven/Gradle, CI/CD), Docker/Kubernetes, and distributed system concepts is highly preferred.

The ideal candidate can troubleshoot workflow issues, collaborate in Agile teams, and deliver scalable, resilient automation solutions.

Duties and responsibilities

  • Work with Team Lead/Product Manager to understand business requirements
  • Develop functionality/modules with a focus on usability, reliability and supportability
  • Adhere to architectural goals and principles
  • Document technical design, process flow and support plans
  • Consult with various implementation and quality-assurance teams to create and execute unit tests for all code developed
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and process endpoints.
  • Model end-to-end processes using BPMN, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
  • Implement process orchestration logic to drive both choreographed and orchestrated workflows.
  • Leverage Camunda to create robust process orchestrations in headless manner.
  • Continuously enhance process models based on data-driven insights.
  • Configure workflow engines, define process instances, and manage execution paths.
  • Integrate with microservices and external systems using Camunda connectors.
  • Coordinate communication and data flow between microservices.
  • Manage daily technical challenges and communicate with management if there are any risks or issues.
  • Optimize performance, resilience, and fault tolerance.
  • Configuration of state store for HA and Failover scenarios
  • Configure the product for security

Qualification, Experience, Technical and Functional Skills

Must Have:

  • Experience working on large-scale IT projects involving multiple stakeholders; strong communication skills required.
  • Overall 6+ years of experience in IT.
  • Having 4+ years of BPM experience along with 3+ year of hands-on experience in Camunda process orchestration and workflow automation.

title: Pastelero A
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

Se tú

Como Pastelero A apoyará en la preparación de platillos de manera activa durante el servicio, junto con el resto de la brigada de cocina llevará a cabo la sanitización, recepción, acomodo, limpieza, preparación y producción de alimentos y todas sus actividades colaterales.

Fecha estimada de contratación: Octubre 2026

Conocimientos y Habilidades

  • Experiencia requerida en el puesto mínimo de 1 año

  • Experiencia en hotelería de lujo

  • Habilidad para hablar, escribir y leer el idioma Español.

  • Máximo nivel de integridad y transparencia

  • Habilidades para resolver problemas, tomar decisiones y resolver conflictos

  • Trabajar de manera segura, prudente y organizada

* Esta posición requiere que los candidatos cuenten con autorización vigente para trabajar en México.

Domina tu oficio

  • Garantizar la higiene y acomodo del área de trabajo, materiales e insumos previos a toda manipulación de alimentos.

  • Dar apoyo en la preparación (misen place) asignadas.

  • Apoyo en la realización de las recetas/proceso de manera cabal y disciplinada en caso de existir dudas solicitar asistencia.

  • Apoyar de manera activa al acomodo de todos los espacios de almacenamiento de alimentos.

  • Revisar que los insumos se encuentren en óptimas condiciones.

  • Tener de forma anticipada y con la calidad requerida su misen place previo al servicio de alimentos.

Lo que Ofrecemos y lo que Puedes Esperar

  • Formar parte de un equipo colaborativo con un genuino espíritu de familia, donde tu talento será valorado y reconocido.

  • Salarios altamente competitivos, con un atractivo plan de incentivos anual para puestos gerenciales y de Jefatura de Departamento.

  • Servicio de transporte desde San Lucas y San José del Cabo hasta el resort.

  • Servicio de lavandería de uniformes, garantizando comodidad y una imagen profesional.

  • Programas de capacitación y talleres internos que apoyan tu desarrollo profesional.

  • Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico, diverso y desafiante, con interacción cercana con el equipo de liderazgo.

  • Programas de reconocimiento que celebran tus logros, incluyendo reconocimientos por años de servicio, Empleado del Mes y Empleado del Año.

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO como "Las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE desde 1998 y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

Cultura de servicio

Actualmente operando 120 hoteles y resorts, y 45 propiedades residenciales en los principales centros de las ciudades y destinos turísticos en 47 países, y con más de 50 proyectos en planificación o desarrollo, Four Seasons se ubica constantemente entre los mejores hoteles del mundo y las marcas más prestigiosas en las encuestas de lectores, críticas de viajeros y premios de la industria. Nuestro mayor activo, y la clave de nuestro éxito, es nuestra gente. Creemos que cada uno de nosotros necesita un sentido de dignidad, orgullo y satisfacción en lo que hacemos.

¿Cómo es trabajar para Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts?

En Four Seasons, guiamos todas nuestras acciones por la regla de oro: “Trata a los demás como te gustaría ser tratado”. Aquí, podrá trabajar en un equipo que se basa en el respeto mutuo, la colaboración, el excelente servicio y la pasión por el servicio. Como marca de lujo, su trabajo también se guiará por estándares muy estrictos para garantizar un alto nivel de calidad y servicio en todo momento. Espere trabajar duro pero diviértase y aprenda en el camino, llevando su carrera, experiencia y habilidades al siguiente nivel. Como beneficio adicional, trabajar con Four Seasons le brinda la oportunidad de trabajar para una empresa internacional y viajar por todo el mundo mientras se hospeda en propiedades increíbles de forma gratuita.

This is a hands-on, cloud-native database engineering role at the center of a large-scale, event-driven data ecosystem.
You will own PostgreSQL operations on AWS Aurora while helping ensure data moves reliably across applications, event brokers, caches, and complementary data stores.
The role combines database administration, performance engineering, automation, cloud infrastructure, and reliability.
You will work closely with DevOps, application engineering, networking, and architecture teams to solve complex distributed-system challenges.
A strong focus on automation, observability, high availability, disaster recovery, and security will make your work critical to dependable production services.
You will have the opportunity to modernize database operations through infrastructure as code, CI/CD, scripting, and emerging AI-assisted engineering practices.
This is an ideal opportunity for a reliability-minded database professional who wants to think beyond the database and influence the broader data platform.

Accountabilities:

    • Manage daily operations of PostgreSQL running on AWS Aurora across multiple accounts, environments, and production workloads.
    • Own database configuration, provisioning, parameter tuning, deployments, upgrades, patches, and version migrations using cloud-native strategies such as blue-green and rolling deployments.
    • Monitor database health, capacity, availability, and performance using tools such as AWS CloudWatch, Performance Insights, AppDynamics, and Grafana.
    • Operate PostgreSQL as a system of record within an event-driven architecture and collaborate with engineering teams on data flows involving Kafka, Kinesis, RabbitMQ, and other event brokers.
    • Support persistence patterns involving Redis or ElastiCache, read replicas, logical replication, streaming replication, and change data capture for downstream analytics, search, and reporting.
    • Tune PostgreSQL and Aurora for OLTP, read-heavy reporting, and mixed workloads by optimizing queries, indexes, execution plans, connection pooling, and parameter groups.
    • Use tools such as EXPLAIN ANALYZE, pg_stat_statements, Performance Insights, and CloudWatch metrics to investigate performance issues and conduct root-cause analysis.
    • Review SQL, data models, and database access patterns with development teams to identify performance, scalability, and reliability concerns before production deployment.
    • Apply AWS services including RDS, CloudWatch, Systems Manager, Lambda, S3, IAM, and Secrets Manager to support secure and efficient database operations.
    • Build Python and shell automation for provisioning, backup verification, environment refreshes, alerting, compliance reporting, and other recurring operational activities.
    • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for database schema changes and infrastructure deployments, using infrastructure as code such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
    • Design, test, and document backup, recovery, high-availability, and disaster-recovery strategies that meet demanding RTO and RPO objectives.
    • Configure and maintain Multi-AZ deployments, read replicas, automated backups, point-in-time recovery, and other resilience capabilities.
    • Conduct regular disaster recovery exercises and maintain clear runbooks for failure scenarios and production incidents.
    • Provide technical troubleshooting and production support for database and data-flow issues, including participation in an on-call rotation.
    • Collaborate with DevOps, NetOps, application engineering, and architecture teams to design and operate integrated cloud-native solutions.
    • Maintain technical documentation covering configurations, procedures, troubleshooting processes, architectural decisions, and operational standards.
    • Identify repetitive manual activities and proactively replace them with reliable, scalable automation.

      • Requirements:

      • 4–7 years of hands-on experience as a PostgreSQL Database Administrator, preferably in cloud-based production environments.
      • Strong production experience with AWS Aurora PostgreSQL and Amazon RDS.
      • Proven expertise in PostgreSQL performance tuning, query optimization, database troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis.
      • Strong understanding of backup and recovery strategies, including point-in-time recovery, high availability, replication, and disaster recovery.
      • Experience with database security, user administration, access controls, IAM integration, and secure credential management.
      • Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of relational database design and data modeling.
      • Programming and automation experience using Python and shell scripting.
      • Working knowledge of AWS services such as CloudWatch, Lambda, S3, Systems Manager, IAM, and Secrets Manager.
      • Understanding of modern persistence architectures and event-driven data flows, including message brokers such as Kafka, Kinesis, or RabbitMQ and caching technologies such as Redis or ElastiCache.
      • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to diagnose complex issues across distributed systems.
      • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams.
      • Experience with PostgreSQL logical replication, streaming replication, or change data capture technologies such as Debezium is preferred.
      • Production experience with Kafka, Kinesis, or other event-streaming platforms is a plus.
      • Experience using Redis or ElastiCache as a caching layer in front of PostgreSQL is advantageous.
      • Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or CloudFormation and CI/CD experience with tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline are preferred.
      • Exposure to additional data technologies such as DynamoDB, Redshift, OpenSearch, or MongoDB is beneficial.
      • Experience in healthcare technology or another regulated industry is a plus.
      • AWS or PostgreSQL certifications, including AWS Solutions Architect or Database Specialty certifications, are desirable.
      • Familiarity with AI development tools such as Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT, or Cursor for scripting, troubleshooting, and documentation is preferred.
      • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and participate in production on-call support.
      • Ability to meet the physical requirements of the position, which is primarily desk-based, with occasional travel for client sites, conferences, or internal meetings.

title: Program Manager III - Gynecologic Oncology
description:
Reporting to the Chief of the Division of Gynecologic Oncology and the Administrative Director, the Program Manager provides operational, administrative, and project support for the Gynecologic Oncology Program and related cancer initiatives. The role works closely with faculty, research leaders, clinical trials teams, finance, philanthropy, patient advocates, and administrative partners to support daily operations, strategic projects, and special initiatives, and may oversee interns and temporary staff. Responsibilities include coordinating disease-focused and research working groups, scheduling meetings, preparing agendas and materials, tracking follow-up items, planning retreats, supporting leadership meetings, developing donor and program materials, and managing digital communications and social media. The Program Manager also supports research and institutional priorities by coordinating grant activities, organizing program meetings, tracking deadlines and deliverables, contributing to reporting and grant development, assisting with manuscripts, reviewing scientific updates, and supporting educational events and other divisional projects.

The Program Manager III is responsible for the execution and leadership of complex programs that have a significant impact on departmental or organizational goals. This role involves managing multiple high-priority projects, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring program success through effective stakeholder engagement. The Program Manager will drive strategic initiatives and foster a culture of continuous improvement. Focuses on strategic program outcomes and goals.

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Scope and Complexity: Lead complex programs with significant organizational impact, involving multiple high-priority projects and cross-functional teams.
  • Decision Making: Exercise significant decision-making authority in program planning, execution, and resource management, with a focus on strategic outcomes.

title: Test Engineer - Maternity Cover
description:
Save the Children International has an exciting opportunity for a Test Engineer to join our global team.

Team and Role Purpose

The IT function enables Save the Children International to achieve its mission through the delivery, support and continuous improvement of technology products, platforms and services used globally across country offices, regional offices and centres. The team provides reliable, secure and scalable digital solutions that support programme delivery, fundraising, operational excellence and organisational effectiveness.

Role purpose

This role will be responsible for the quality assurance of application releases through thorough execution of integration, functional and regression testing of SCI’s core business applications minimizing bugs, issues and failures being identified post release. You will be responsible for maintaining and improving multiple test frameworks, the creation of manual and automated test cases, performance testing and integration testing.

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Product development, you will be responsible for communicating all test progress and outlining any improvements to process. Although you will have no direct line reports, the role will incorporate the mentoring of local and global peers, promoting a testing culture, transparency and the importance of good practices.

This role must expect hands-on defining, generating and executing test scripts as required to fulfil the testing requirements.

  • Job Title: Test Engineer
  • Reports To: Senior Manager, Product Development
  • Work Pattern: Hybrid/Remote with flexible working options available
  • Location: Any approved Save the Children International office location. For a full list of locations that Save the Children International can hire in, please visit: SCI Careers
  • Required Time Zone: Any
  • Contract Length: Fixed Term Contract (14 months maternity leave cover)
  • Right to Work: The successful candidate must have the right to work in the country where the role is based, for the duration of employment.
  • Language Requirements: English
  • International Travel: up to 5%
  • Remit: Global

Principal Accountabilities

  • Partner with Project Managers, Developers, and Solution Architects to ensure test deliverables meet quality standards, project requirements, and agreed timelines.
  • Define, document, and maintain testing strategies, plans, scenarios, test cases, and test scripts to support comprehensive test coverage across projects and releases.
  • Lead the execution of functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing using both manual and automated testing approaches to ensure release readiness.
  • Analyse test results and provide quality assessments and release recommendations, enabling informed go/no-go decisions for production deployments.
  • Manage and coordinate testing resources and activities, including virtual and third-party testing teams, to ensure effective and timely delivery of testing objectives.
  • Oversee test cycle execution, defect management, and status reporting through JIRA, ensuring visibility of quality metrics, risks, and progress.
  • Monitor production releases and post-release issues, driving root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring defects.
  • Produce and communicate quality dashboards and test metrics, providing stakeholders with regular insights into testing performance and release quality.
  • Champion a culture of quality across the organisation by promoting testing best practices, ensuring compliance with quality standards, and proactively reducing user-reported defects.

Experience and Skills

Essential

  1. Proven experience as a Test Engineer or similar role, with a strong track record of developing, executing, and managing test plans across both manual and automated testing environments.
  2. Comprehensive knowledge of the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), including Unit, Functional, Integration, Regression, System, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) within Agile and Waterfall delivery frameworks.
  3. Experience implementing test strategies and frameworks that support Integration Testing, Continuous Integration (CI), and Continuous Delivery (CD) in Agile environments.
  4. Hands-on experience with manual, automated, and performance testing tools, ensuring robust and efficient test coverage across applications and platforms.
  5. Strong proficiency in Jira and associated testing and reporting plugins, including defect management, test execution, and quality reporting.
  6. Ability to analyse user stories, business requirements, and functional specifications and translate them into effective test scenarios, test cases, and test scripts.
  7. Demonstrated experience managing defects and issue-tracking processes, including prioritisation, root cause analysis, and release readiness assessment.
  8. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, supported by exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
  9. Outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills in English, with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  10. Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with experience working successfully across cross-functional teams, including developers, product owners, business users, and offshore delivery teams.

Desirable

  • Knowledge and practical application of Test-Driven Development (TDD) and Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) methodologies.
  • Passion for continuous learning and staying current with emerging testing technologies, frameworks, standards, and industry best practices.
  • Experience researching, evaluating, and experimenting with new testing tools and approaches to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Attendance or participation in software testing conferences, industry meetups, professional communities, or knowledge-sharing forums.
  • Demonstrated commitment to knowledge sharing, mentoring, and contributing to a culture of continuous improvement within testing teams.

Education and Qualifications

Essential

  • Relevant degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or equivalent experience.

Desirable

  • ISTQB Advanced Certification.
  • Agile Testing Certification.
  • Certified Scrum or Agile Practitioner qualification.
  • Performance or Automation Testing certification.

Working at Save the Children International

Save the Children is the world's leading organisation for children, employing ~25,000 staff. We save children's lives. We fight for their rights. We help them fulfil their potential. Through our work in 116 countries, we put the most deprived and marginalised children first.

We know that great people make a great organisation, and that our employees play a crucial role in helping us achieve our ambitions for children. We value our people and offer a meaningful and rewarding career, along with a collaborative and inclusive environment where ambition, creativity, and integrity are highly valued.

The work here is challenging but is also immensely rewarding. At Save the Children, you will be in good company, working with talented, like-minded individuals who are determined to ensure that all children survive, learn, and are protected. Your contribution will help ensure children's voices are heard at the highest levels, and that we achieve our global strategy, Ambition for Children 2030, and reach every last child.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion and Equal Opportunities

DEI is core to our vision, values and global strategy. Save the Children is committed to creating a truly diverse, equitable and inclusive organisation, and one which will support us in our vision to ensure every child attains the right to survival, protection, development, and participation.

We are committed to equal employment opportunities, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, colour, ethnic origin, nationality, disability, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, pregnancy and maternity, caring or parental responsibilities, age, or beliefs and religion. We are committed to diversifying our staff to better represent the communities we serve and actively welcome underrepresented groups to apply.

Reasonable adjustments will be made should any candidate invited to interview require this.

Application Information

Please attach a copy of your CV and cover letter with your application. A full copy of the role profile can be found at SCI Careers. It is recommended that you save a copy of the role profile as it will no longer be available after the advert closes.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and the job advert may be closed earlier than advertised subject to the volume of suitable applicants. Please submit your application at your earliest convenience to avoid disappointment.

Due to the high volume of applications we receive, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Candidates who are successfully shortlisted should expect to hear from us within 2 weeks of the advert deadline.

Our Recruitment Process

  1. Application review by our recruiting team based on your CV and cover letter
  2. Two-stage competency-based interviews with the hiring team
  3. Some recruitment may include an additional assessment or case study stage, or a third stage interview
  4. If successful, you will receive a conditional offer of employment, followed by your contract subject to passing background checks

We need to keep children and adults safe so our selection process includes rigorous background checks and reflects our commitment to the protection of children and adults from abuse. All employees are expected to carry out their duties in accordance with our Code of Conduct and all policies and procedures relating to Anti-Harassment, Health and Safety, Safeguarding, and DEI and Equal Opportunities.

Save the Children does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process.

The Voyage Global Leadership Development Program

Voyage: Training tomorrow’s leaders today
Marriott International welcomes recent university graduates to experience the career development adventure of a lifetime and a world of leadership opportunities. Our global leadership development program, Voyage, propels participants on a mentored, learning-inspired journey to prepare you for a successful career. Voyage is a full-time, paid development program. As an associate and trainee, you’ll build upon the skills you developed in school by participating in real world assignments.

About the journey
Voyage is an elite, award-winning program that provides a combination of hands-on, discipline-specific training and a leadership-focused curriculum. The program takes place at a Marriott International managed hotel, not a classroom, and is offered in over 50 countries. Voyage is available in the following disciplines:

• Culinary

You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. Each individual’s Voyage journey is unique, spanning 12-18 months dependent upon your career interests, passions, goals, and location. You’ll immediately be immersed in our rich culture and portfolio of global brands to learn how Marriott sets the standard of industry excellence.

The experience you’ll gain
Voyage participants learn by doing! You’ll be fully immersed in the day-to-day operations of a hotel. If accepted into this elite program, you will:

• Cultivate customer relationships

• Be a champion for innovation within the organization

• Get exposure to managing projects & people

• Improve processes & pitch new initiatives through your Voyage project

• Take on special projects that will draw upon all your training

You’ll participate in management meetings and collaborate with Voyage participants worldwide. You’ll be expected to solve challenges, as well as offer ideas and innovative solutions. You will also have an opportunity to provide feedback on your curriculum and have an impact on future Voyage hires’ experiences. After graduation, you’ll be well-prepared to pursue your passion and take on new challenges. Many program graduates are ready to step into a Marriott supervisory or entry-level management role right away, because the program has provided a foundation for future leadership.

Become a part of our caring community

May assist with security tooling selection, security testing, process automation, and configuration of existing Humana tools, applications, and systems. This role owns the technical direction, architecture strategy, and roadmap for enterprise DevSecOps application platforms, with a primary focus on secure software engineering, application security posture, developer experience, and CI/CD security orchestration.

The Lead, DevSecOps Application Architecture serves as a technical authority for the DevSecOps Engineering team and partners with Enterprise Information Protection, architecture, engineering, platform, and application development stakeholders to define security requirements and embed security controls into current and future application architectures.

This role requires strong software engineering expertise, architecture leadership, and hands-on experience designing secure, scalable, cloud-native application platforms. Location: Canada

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer based in Canada.

Join a growing AI/ML organization operating at the intersection of geospatial intelligence and environmental technology. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you will take ownership of cloud infrastructure and help strengthen reliability, observability, and operational excellence across engineering and product teams. You will design and evolve scalable infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform while enabling developers through automation and self-service tooling. Your work will directly influence system availability, incident response, deployment performance, and cloud efficiency.     • Strengthen the observability platform across metrics, logging, distributed tracing, and monitoring to improve system visibility and reduce mean time to recovery.

    • Define and champion reliability practices including Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), error budgets, and DORA metrics.
    • Lead incident management activities, coordinate response efforts, facilitate post-incident reviews, and drive meaningful improvements based on incident learnings.

      • Proven experience managing Kubernetes clusters and workloads in production environments.
      • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or Google Cloud Deployment Manager.
      • Strong scripting and automation capabilities using Python, Bash, Go, or comparable languages.
      • Extensive experience with observability technologies such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, centralized logging, and distributed tracing.

      • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across distributed Product and Engineering teams.
      • Candidates must be authorized to work in their country of residence; visa sponsorship is not available.

description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

Be You

The Room Service Coordinator offers the F&B service by making suggestions to guide our guests within the menu and its concept, taking orders or requests from our clients, always offering options or alternative solutions, with an excellent service attitude, achieving the results established by Four Seasons. for your department, providing unique and memorable experiences to our clients, you will contribute to teamwork, having effective communication between colleagues, always seeking complete satisfaction of the expectations of our guests and customers, creating epic experiences.

Target Hire Date – October 2026

Skills and Abilities:

  • Minimum experience of 2 years in ultra-luxury hotels.

  • Knowledge of high service standards.

  • Knowledge of spirits, cocktails and wines.

  • Mastery in stressful situations and maintaining high-level service quality.

  • High ability to communicate with others.

  • Reading, writing and oral proficiency in both Spanish and English language

  • Strong skills in multi-management of computer systems

  • Strong presentation skills.

  • Highly developed problem-solving skills.

  • Able to work effectively under pressure and with a high volume of business.

  • Able to multitask and prioritize workload and projects simultaneously and efficiently.

  • Schedule availability

*This position requires applicants to have valid work authorization in Mexico

Master Your Craft

  • Comply with the standards of attending your work shift on time.

  • Complete assigned daily tasks.

  • Has knowledge of internal safety protocols in emergency situations.

  • Knows and executes the safety and hygiene guidelines.

  • Have knowledge of the F&B menus, ingredients, preparation methods, allergens, preparation times, etc.

  • Ensure you always have clean and presentable menus.

  • Always keep the work area clean and tidy.

  • Keep the OT profiles of our guests and clients updated.

  • Anticipate the needs of our guests and colleagues.

  • Will keep the information necessary for the operation of IRD & My Bar up to date.

  • Keep communication channels updated and working (Opera, Messenger, Hotsos, Email, Teams).

What We Offer and What You Can Expect

  • You will become part of a supportive team with a genuine family spirit, where your talent will be valued and recognized.

  • Highly competitive salaries, with an attractive annual incentive plan for management and Department Head positions.

  • Transportation service from San Lucas and San José del Cabo to the resort.

  • Uniform laundry service, ensuring comfort and a professional appearance.

  • Training programs and in-house workshops to support your professional development.

  • A dynamic, diverse, and challenging work environment with close interaction with the leadership team.

  • Recognition programs that celebrate your achievements, including awards for years of service, Employee of the Month, and Employee of the Year.

About Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts opened its first hotel in 1961, and its history has been one of continuous innovation, remarkable growth, and an unwavering commitment to the highest standards. For nearly 50 years, Four Seasons has transformed the hospitality industry by combining genuine care and efficiency with the finest traditions of international hospitality.     • Investigate potential data exfiltration, misuse, policy violations, and inappropriate access involving source code, cloud platforms, collaboration tools, third-party applications, and critical business or trading systems.

    • Contribute insider risk and secure data-handling content to security awareness and employee training programs.

      • Practical experience operating and tuning DLP solutions across SaaS and endpoint environments, with an understanding of detection quality and false-positive reduction.
      • Experience with workflow automation, AI, or SOAR platforms for alert triage, investigation support, and case orchestration.
      • Strong understanding of data classification, data governance, data protection, and information security principles.
      • Working knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis, such as Elastic/ELK or Splunk, to support investigations and establish evidence-based conclusions.
      • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks including NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and privacy regulations such as GDPR and APPI.
      • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear investigation reports, case documentation, risk assessments, and executive summaries.
      • Exceptional integrity, discretion, and judgment when handling confidential personnel, customer, business, and security information.
      • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple sensitive investigations in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
      • Ability to collaborate effectively with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security stakeholders.
      • Experience with digital forensics, eDiscovery, UEBA, insider risk platforms, security operations, or incident response is an advantage.
