      • Experience with major cloud platforms and familiarity with supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or regulatory audits is beneficial.
      • Exposure to fintech, financial services, trading platforms, or regulated environments is strongly valued.
      • Relevant certifications such as GCFA, GCFE, CISSP, CISM, CIPP, CFE, or equivalent are considered a plus.
      • Familiarity with financial services regulatory expectations and multi-jurisdiction privacy requirements is advantageous.

Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

Se tú

El Surtidor de Blancos es el encargado de mantener surtidas las roperías del área asignada, está al pendiente de cumplir las peticiones y requerimientos especiales de los huéspedes, también apoyará a las Camaristas en diferentes tareas que aseguren los más altos estándares de limpieza; así como de asegurarse que la estancia de los huéspedes sea confortable, cumpliendo los estándares Four Seasons.

Fecha estimada de contratación: Octubre 2026

Conocimientos y Habilidades

Experiencia:

  • Experiencia requerida en el puesto mínimo de 6 meses

  • Experiencia en hotelería de lujo

  • Habilidad para hablar, escribir y leer el idioma Español.

*Este trabajo requiere que los candidatos cuenten con autorización vigente para trabajar en México

Domina tu oficio

  • Inventarios; debe ser encargados de realizar diferentes inventarios de acuerdo a las necesidades y a lo establecido previamente (Químicos, aguas, Linen, Terry)

  • Se hará cargo de retirar la basura de las habitaciones y la colocará en los botes/áreas de deshechos reciclables que le corresponda, localizados en las áreas de servicio.

  • Reportar inmediatamente a su Supervisor, cualquier daño o reparaciones que deba realizar Mantenimiento.

  • Reportar inmediatamente a Seguridad y a su Supervisor, los artículos de valor encontrados dentro de las habitaciones y/o los olvidados en las áreas públicas o habitaciones vacías.

  • Apoyará a sus compañeras(os) Camaristas(os) en algunas tareas que impliquen limpiar partes altas (fuera del alcance) y/o cargar algún objeto mayor a 5 kilos, máximo 10 kilos.

  • Limpiará los cristales y marcos de las terrazas.

Lo que Ofrecemos y lo que Puedes Esperar

  • Formar parte de un equipo colaborativo con un genuino espíritu de familia, donde tu talento será valorado y reconocido.

  • Salarios altamente competitivos, con un atractivo plan de incentivos anual para puestos gerenciales y de Jefatura de Departamento.

  • Servicio de transporte desde San Lucas y San José del Cabo hasta el resort.

  • Servicio de lavandería de uniformes, garantizando comodidad y una imagen profesional.

  • Programas de capacitación y talleres internos que apoyan tu desarrollo profesional.

  • Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico, diverso y desafiante, con interacción cercana con el equipo de liderazgo.

  • Programas de reconocimiento que celebran tus logros, incluyendo reconocimientos por años de servicio, Empleado del Mes y Empleado del Año.

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO como "Las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE desde 1998 y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

Cultura de servicio

Actualmente operando 120 hoteles y resorts, y 45 propiedades residenciales en los principales centros de las ciudades y destinos turísticos en 47 países, y con más de 50 proyectos en planificación o desarrollo, Four Seasons se ubica constantemente entre los mejores hoteles del mundo y las marcas más prestigiosas en las encuestas de lectores, críticas de viajeros y premios de la industria. Nuestro mayor activo, y la clave de nuestro éxito, es nuestra gente. Creemos que cada uno de nosotros necesita un sentido de dignidad, orgullo y satisfacción en lo que hacemos.

¿Cómo es trabajar para Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts?

En Four Seasons, guiamos todas nuestras acciones por la regla de oro: “Trata a los demás como te gustaría ser tratado”. Aquí, podrá trabajar en un equipo que se basa en el respeto mutuo, la colaboración, el excelente servicio y la pasión por el servicio. Como marca de lujo, su trabajo también se guiará por estándares muy estrictos para garantizar un alto nivel de calidad y servicio en todo momento. Espere trabajar duro pero diviértase y aprenda en el camino, llevando su carrera, experiencia y habilidades al siguiente nivel. Como beneficio adicional, trabajar con Four Seasons le brinda la oportunidad de trabajar para una empresa internacional y viajar por todo el mundo mientras se hospeda en propiedades increíbles de forma gratuita.

title: Senior AI Platform Engineer
description:
Senior AI Platform Engineer

Team: IT

Location: Canada

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior AI Platform Engineer based in Canada.

This is a senior individual contributor opportunity focused on building the platform foundations behind production-grade AI solutions.
You’ll design and own critical capabilities across AI orchestration, retrieval, evaluation, observability, and inference.
Your work will support conversational AI agents and large-scale document processing workflows used in complex legal environments.
You’ll tackle challenges involving millions of documents, distributed systems, performance, reliability, security, and cost optimization.
The role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, giving you significant ownership over architectural decisions and platform direction.
You’ll collaborate with product, domain, and engineering teams across Canada, the United States, and India while mentoring other engineers.
This is an opportunity to shape scalable AI infrastructure where quality, governance, and defensible outcomes are essential.

Accountabilities:

    • Design, build, and own platform capabilities supporting AI agents, including orchestration, retrieval, model routing, tool integration, and reliability.
    • Architect retrieval systems capable of operating across large-scale document collections and complex information environments.
    • Develop shared platform services for prompt management, caching, rate limiting, cost attribution, and other reusable AI capabilities.
    • Define stable APIs, interfaces, and data contracts that enable product teams to build consistently on the platform.
    • Build evaluation frameworks measuring accuracy, grounding, citation quality, and overall AI system performance.
    • Develop observability, tracing, and replay capabilities to support troubleshooting, performance analysis, and continuous improvement.
    • Establish quality gates and production monitoring to detect regressions before they impact users.
    • Optimize latency, throughput, scalability, and cost across interactive and batch AI workloads.
    • Make informed decisions regarding model selection, inference strategies, caching, routing, and other performance-critical areas.
    • Build reliable production systems through monitoring, alerting, incident response, and operational excellence practices.
    • Implement governance, auditability, and human-in-the-loop controls appropriate for legal and regulated workflows.
    • Ensure solutions meet applicable security, privacy, and data residency requirements.
    • Lead consequential technical decisions through architecture documentation, design documents, and Architecture Decision Records (ADRs).
    • Raise engineering standards through code reviews, technical pairing, mentoring, and knowledge sharing.
    • Partner with product managers, legal domain specialists, and operations teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into well-defined, shippable solutions.

      • Requirements

      • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
      • 7+ years of professional experience building production software, with demonstrated ownership of systems and components end to end.
      • Proven experience developing production AI/LLM systems, particularly retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agentic workflows.
      • Strong proficiency in Python and the ability to work comfortably within TypeScript codebases.
      • Solid understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous and event-driven architectures, and large-scale batch data processing.
      • Demonstrated experience owning production reliability, including instrumentation, monitoring, on-call practices, incident response, and data-driven performance optimization.
      • Strong architectural and systems-thinking capabilities, with the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs and make sound engineering decisions.
      • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders.
      • Ability to work independently, take ownership of significant technical areas, and influence engineering direction without direct management responsibility.
      • Experience mentoring engineers and raising technical standards through design reviews, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving.

        • Preferred qualifications:

        • Experience with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, or MCP.
        • Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling, including Langfuse or OpenTelemetry-based tracing.
        • Knowledge of vector databases, search infrastructure, and information retrieval fundamentals.
        • Experience with hallucination detection, grounding verification, benchmarking, and AI quality evaluation methodologies.
        • Experience with model fine-tuning, quantization, or inference optimization.
        • React and modern frontend development experience, particularly for internal evaluation and debugging tools.
        • Background in legal technology, eDiscovery, compliance, investigations, or document review.
        • Experience building multi-tenant SaaS platforms with strict data isolation requirements.
        • Experience working with PostgreSQL.

          • Benefits

          • Competitive salary range of CAD $126,000–$175,000 per year, depending on location, experience, skills, and overall alignment with the role.
          • Eligibility for an annual discretionary bonus.
          • Hybrid work model with part-time office presence in Toronto, Ontario.
          • Opportunity to work on high-impact AI platforms supporting complex, global workflows.
          • Significant technical ownership and the opportunity to influence architecture and engineering standards.
          • Collaboration with international engineering teams across Canada, the United States, and India.

          • Inclusive and collaborative work environment focused on teamwork and continuous improvement.
          • Reasonable accommodations available throughout the hiring process for candidates who require them.

title: Business Controller
description:
De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als Business Controller

In deze rol werk je midden in de strategische- en financiële sturing van de afdeling Strategisch Resource Management (SRM). Je bent een gewaardeerde sparringpartner voor management en directie en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar heldere inzichten en concrete handelingsperspectieven. Je brengt structuur in een omgeving waar capaciteit, prioritering en realisatie continu in beweging zijn. Daarbij maak jij het verschil door inzicht te creëren en richting te geven. Tegelijkertijd krijg je volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen in een rol met veel zichtbaarheid, inhoudelijke diepgang en strategische impact. Je werkt nauw samen met collega’s binnen en buiten SRM en draagt bij aan sterke besluitvorming én duurzame samenwerking. Het energienet van de toekomst maken we voor iedereen, mét iedereen. En als business controller werk jij hieraan mee. Zo ben jij bezig met:

  • Het opzetten, verbeteren en door ontwikkelen van de planning & control-cyclus binnen SRM, zodat het management beschikt over het juiste financiële inzicht.

  • Meedenken over strategie en beleid: bijdragen aan het businessplan ter ondersteuning van een effectieve bedrijfsvoering.

  • Het bijdragen aan complexe en omvangrijke aanbestedingstrajecten.

  • Het meewerken aan het Alliander-brede planproces en aan sturing over de gehele keten (E2E).

  • Het versterken van samenwerking tussen finance en de operatie, zodat keuzes beter aansluiten op de praktijk

  • Het optreden als sparringpartner en copiloot van het management.

Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander

Wist je dat Alliander bestaat uit verschillende bedrijven die samen werken aan een betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig energienet? Met een grote club vakmensen ontwikkelen en beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners en ondernemers in Nederland. Alles wat we doen, doen we met oog voor de mensen die op ons rekenen: onze klanten. En dankzij onze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken we de energietransitie mogelijk, voor en mét onze klanten.

En jij gaat dat doen bij ons bedrijfsonderdeel Strategisch Resource Management. Hier werk je samen met je collega’s aan het grootschalig uitbreiden van ons energienet. Strategisch Resource Management (SRM) is cruciaal voor het realiseren van de energietransitie. Hier komen strategie, capaciteit en uitvoering samen. SRM zorgt ervoor dat mensen, materialen en middelen op het juiste moment beschikbaar zijn.

Voor jou betekent dit een rol met:

  • Veel dynamiek en maatschappelijke relevantie

  • Directe invloed op de slagkracht van de organisatie

  • Intensieve samenwerking met uiteenlopende stakeholders

Binnen SRM vallen de afdelingen Sourcing Aannemerij, Sourcing Materialen, Logistiek, Strategische- en tactische planning en Visie & Ontwerp: verschillende afdelingen met elk hun eigen dynamiek. Je komt terecht in een team van vijf collega’s binnen een organisatieonderdeel dat volop in ontwikkeling is. Dat biedt jou de kans om mee te bouwen én te verbeteren.

Je krijgt daarbij:

  • Ruimte voor eigen inbreng en initiatief

  • Mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen en te verdiepen

  • Een omgeving waarin samenwerking, kennisdeling en elkaar versterken centraal staan

Je werkt intensief samen met collega-controllers, managers en andere stakeholders en leert daardoor snel hoe de organisatie werkt en waar jij het verschil kunt maken. Ook voor je eigen ontwikkeling is er volop ruimte door bijvoorbeeld door te groeien in je rol, nieuwe thema’s op te pakken en je verder te verdiepen in de dynamiek van SRM en de energietransitie.

Jij maakt het net energieker

Jij voelt je thuis in een complexe omgeving waarin strategie, operatie en finance samenkomen. Je brengt scherpte, rust en overtuigingskracht mee en weet met jouw analyses en advies richting te geven aan besluitvorming. Je schakelt gemakkelijk op management- en directieniveau en krijgt energie van een rol waarin je zowel inhoudelijk als strategisch het verschil maakt. Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • WO werk- en denkniveau.

  • Je brengt stevigheid én sensitiviteit mee en weet (zelfstandig) richting te geven in een complexe en veranderende omgeving.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie.

  • Ervaring met planning & control, prestatiesturing en scenario-analyse in een complexe organisatie.

  • Je bent een echte teamspeler en verbinder, die resultaatgericht werkt en tegelijkertijd het collectieve belang centraal stelt.

Kennis van inkoopprocessen en aanbestedingen is een pluspunt.

Voor jou net beter geregeld

Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 40-urige werkweek:

  • een salaris van € 6.438,11 tot € 9.197,30 bruto per maand (schaal 11).

  • jaarlijks een individueel keuze budget (IKB) van 18% (fulltime) of 12,8% (parttime) van je bruto jaarsalaris. Dit is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag. Je kunt dit bedrag uit laten betalen, maar je kunt er bijvoorbeeld ook extra vrije dagen voor kopen. Jij kiest wat bij jou past.

  • 24,5 vakantiedagen per jaar, ruim aan te vullen vanuit je IKB.

  • een eindejaarsuitkering in december van 6% van je jaarsalaris.

  • elk jaar een DI-budget van € 700,- voor jouw duurzame inzetbaarheid. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een vergoeding van jouw sport of hobby, verduurzaming en vergroening van je huis, of het verlichten van je studieschuld bij DUO. Jij bepaalt waar jouw budget naartoe gaat.

  • Blijven leren en ontwikkelen. Jij staat op de eerste plek. Bij Alliander vinden we jouw ontwikkeling topprioriteit. Je leert door te doen, samen te werken en opleidingen en trainingen te volgen die passen bij jouw rol.


Natuurlijk hebben we nog veel meer! Lees meer over al jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Voor jou net wat meer informatie

Samen maken we het net beter. Voor iedereen, met iedereen. En daar hoor jij bij! Solliciteer via de sollicitatiebutton op deze vacature. Vanwege de vakantieperiode zal een eerste terugkoppeling plaats vinden in de week van 17 augustus.

Een assessment of screening kan onderdeel uitmaken van jouw sollicitatieprocedure. In onze screeningsvoorwaarden je meer informatie.

This strategic role is responsible for evaluating potential new sites, developing conceptual facility solutions, preparing budgetary cost estimates, and identifying technical, operational, financial, and regulatory risks prior to project execution. The ideal candidate combines expertise in facility assessments, construction estimating, conceptual design coordination, AHJ engagement, permitting strategy, and capital planning. This individual will work closely with Real Estate, Facilities, Operations, Design, Engineering, and Project Delivery stakeholders to support informed decision-making and successful project execution across a rapidly growing portfolio.

Pay: $101,000 - $159,000

The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant's education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data.

You may be eligible to participate in a Company incentive or bonus program.

Benefit Information: ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM 2026 Employee Benefits | Staff & Management

1. Site Assessment & Due Diligence
  • Site Evaluations: Lead comprehensive site assessments and property inspections to evaluate existing conditions, infrastructure capacity, building systems, and operational readiness.
  • Rapid Property Analysis: Perform fast-turn assessments of existing buildings, lease opportunities, and new construction shells to support accelerated real estate decisions.
  • Risk Identification: Identify facility risks including code compliance issues, life safety concerns, environmental considerations, deferred maintenance, and capital improvement requirements.
  • Facilities Suitability Analysis: Assess the ability of facilities to support Waymo's operational requirements, including power capacity, EV charging infrastructure, security systems, fleet operations, and maintenance functions.
  • AHJ & Regulatory Due Diligence: Engage with local Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), including building departments, fire marshals, planning agencies, utility providers, and permitting authorities, to evaluate zoning requirements, permitting pathways, occupancy classifications, code compliance obligations, utility constraints, and potential regulatory risks that may impact project feasibility, schedule, or cost.
  • Feasibility Reviews: Evaluate site constraints, utility availability, constructability considerations, and operational impacts to support informed real estate decisions.
  • OpEx/CapEx Forecasting: Develop preliminary capital expenditure and operating expense forecasts to support site selection and investment decisions.
2. Design & Preconstruction Management
  • Conceptual Design Coordination: Collaborate with internal stakeholders, engineers, architects, and consultants to develop conceptual designs and site improvement strategies.
  • Design Review: Review existing drawings, surveys, utility information, and facility documentation to identify design requirements, constraints, risks, and opportunities.
  • Scope Development: Define project scope, technical requirements, and design criteria for facility upgrades, renovations, tenant improvements, infrastructure projects, and new construction initiatives.
  • Value Engineering: Identify opportunities to optimize project costs, schedules, constructability, and operational performance while maintaining quality and program objectives.
  • Preconstruction Planning: Establish project assumptions, logistics plans, permit considerations, procurement strategies, and execution approaches to support successful project delivery.
  • Permitting Strategy Development: Coordinate with design consultants and AHJs to establish permitting requirements, approval timelines, inspection protocols, and jurisdiction-specific design considerations early in the preconstruction process.
  • Consultant Management: Coordinate architects, engineers, surveyors, environmental specialists, and other consultants to support project planning and due diligence activities.
3. Estimating & Budget Development
  • Conceptual Estimating: Prepare conceptual, schematic, and budget-level cost estimates for facility improvements, infrastructure upgrades, equipment installations, tenant improvements, and new construction projects.
  • Budget Validation: Analyze estimates, vendor proposals, and market pricing to ensure accuracy and alignment with project objectives.
  • Cost Modeling: Develop detailed CapEx models, cash flow projections, contingencies, and project budgets to support investment decisions.
  • Procurement Support: Coordinate pricing and proposals from subcontractors, vendors, suppliers, and consultants to develop comprehensive cost evaluations.
  • Financial Risk Analysis: Quantify financial risks and cost impacts associated with site conditions, regulatory requirements, design alternatives, schedule constraints, and operational requirements.
  • Budget Reconciliation: Compare project budgets against evolving design requirements and update forecasts to ensure alignment with business objectives and funding approvals.
4. Reporting & Stakeholder Coordination
  • Preconstruction Reporting: Develop and present executive-level reports summarizing due diligence findings, design recommendations, project risks, AHJ feedback, and budget analyses.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with Waymo's Real Estate, Facilities, Operations, Legal, Construction, and Project Delivery teams throughout the evaluation and planning process.
  • Data Management: Coordinate with project drafting and design resources to ensure documentation, surveys, drawings, reports, and site information are properly maintained and accessible.
  • Decision Support: Provide strategic recommendations and Go/No-Go assessments based on technical, financial, operational, regulatory, and schedule considerations.
  • Regulatory Risk Reporting: Document and communicate AHJ requirements, permitting risks, code upgrade requirements, entitlement issues, and jurisdictional constraints to project stakeholders to support informed decision-making during site selection and project planning.
  • Executive Communication: Present project findings, budget recommendations, and strategic guidance to senior leadership and client stakeholders.
5. Project Handoff & Transition
  • Execution Readiness: Develop comprehensive Statements of Work (SOWs), project charters, assumptions logs, and turnover packages for execution teams.
  • Budget Alignment: Ensure preconstruction budgets and assumptions are effectively transitioned into project execution budgets.
  • Risk Transfer: Document key project risks, assumptions, design requirements, permitting considerations, and mitigation strategies to support seamless project delivery.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Facilitate handoff from preconstruction to project management, ensuring alignment on scope, schedule, budget, quality expectations, and operational objectives.
  • Project Launch Support: Provide ongoing support during project kickoff to ensure continuity between planning and execution phases.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil), Architecture, Construction Management, Facilities Management, or a related technical discipline.
  • Professional certifications such as PE, PMP, CCM, CFM, DBIA, LEED, or equivalent are preferred.
  • Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in preconstruction, estimating, technical due diligence, facilities assessments, construction management, capital planning, commercial real estate development, or related disciplines.
  • Experience developing conceptual designs, project scopes, and budgetary cost estimates for commercial, industrial, mission-critical, automotive, technology, manufacturing, or infrastructure projects.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs), including building departments, fire marshals, planning agencies, and utility providers, with strong working knowledge of permitting processes, zoning regulations, building codes, and entitlement requirements.
  • Strong knowledge of commercial building systems, including HVAC, electrical distribution, fire/life safety, building automation systems, structural systems, utility infrastructure, and site development.
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical risks, develop financial analyses, and communicate recommendations to executive and non-technical stakeholders.

title: 🌿 Pædagog søges til tidsbegrænset stilling - Specialdagtilbud Skovbrynet, Afdeling Skovhøj
description:
🌿 Pædagog søges til tidsbegrænset stilling i Specialdagtilbud Skovbrynet, Afdeling Skovhøj

🗓 Periode: 01. oktober 2026 – 30. juni 2027.

Om jobbet:

Afdeling Skovhøj er et specialiseret tilbud til 29 børn i alderen 0–6 år. Målgruppen omfatter:

  • Børn med autismespektrumforstyrrelser
  • Børn med intellektuel funktionsnedsættelse og autismespektrumforstyrrelser
  • Børn med fysiske og/eller psykiske funktionsnedsættelser.

Vi arbejder målrettet med at skabe de bedste rammer for trivsel, udvikling og læring gennem individuelt tilrettelagte indsatser i et trygt og skærmet miljø.

Vores pædagogiske tilgang bygger på

✔ Forudsigelighed
✔ Struktur
✔ Visualisering

Formålet er at give børnene et trygt børneliv og de bedste muligheder for at udfolde deres potentiale.

Derudover tilbyder vi behandling i form af

  • fysioterapi
  • ergoterapi
  • musikterapi.

Afdelingen består af fem børnegrupper med hver 3–4 pædagoger.
Du bliver en del af et stærkt teamsamarbejde – både i din gruppe, på tværs af huset og med vores terapeuter.

Vi søger en engageret pædagog med interesse for – og gerne erfaring med – vores målgruppe.

Du bliver tilknyttet en gruppe med aktuelt fire børn med fysiske og psykiske funktionsnedsættelser. Børnene profiterer af en autismelignende pædagogik og befinder sig på et tidligt udviklingsniveau.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være at

  • bidrage til den pædagogiske praksis og udvikling.
  • indgå aktivt i teamsamarbejdet.
  • medvirke til et godt og trygt arbejdsmiljø.

🕒 Arbejdstid

  • Mellem kl. 06.30 – 17.00
  • Med både åbne- og lukkevagter samt aftenmøder.

Din profil:
Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • er uddannet pædagog.
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for specialpædagogik.
  • er initiativrig, fleksibel og positiv.
  • møder børn, forældre og kolleger med anerkendelse, åbenhed og nysgerrighed.
  • trives i et stærkt fagligt fællesskab.

Du kan skabe overblik, arbejde struktureret og kommunikere klart – både mundtligt og skriftligt.

Faglige kompetencer

  • Pædagogisk uddannelse
  • Erfaring med eller kendskab til målgruppen
  • Erfaring med eller kendskab til børn med autisme på et tidligt kognitivt niveau
  • Evne til at planlægge, prioritere og strukturere
  • Har blik for relationsdannelse
  • Kan organisere aktiviteter og fælles forløb
  • Har blik for samarbejde med forældre
  • Kan anvende IT og iPads i det pædagogiske arbejde.

Personlige styrker

  • Omsorgsfuld og empatisk
  • Psykisk robust og rolig i pressede situationer
  • Reflekterende og fagligt nysgerrig
  • Tålmodig og vedholdende
  • Kan glædes over de små fremskridt
  • En god sparringspartner for kolleger
  • Stærke samarbejdsevner.

Derfor skal du vælge os:
I Skovhøj bliver du en del af en arbejdsplads med:

✨ Engagerede og fagligt stærke kolleger
✨ Et tæt og udviklende teamsamarbejde
✨ Fokus på videndeling og faglig udvikling
✨ Fokus på Bredere Børnefællesskaber i dagligdagen
✨ En personalegruppe, der kan lide at være sammen
✨ Mulighed for både fag- og teamsupervision
✨ Stor opmærksomhed på at styrke børnenes trivsel, udvikling og læring.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

  • 30 timer om ugen.
  • Løn og ansættelsesvilkår vil være i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem BUPL og Aarhus Kommune.
  • Tiltrædelse den 01. oktober 2026.

Der vil blive indhentet børne- og straffeattest og ansættelse sker under forudsætning af, at attesterne ikke viser, at du er uegnet/uværdig til stillingen. Du kan læse mere om, hvordan vi behandler dine oplysninger her.

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Kontakt pædagogisk leder

Marianne Nordvig
📞 2892 5952

Ansøgning
Vi afholder samtaler den 26. august 2026.

👉 Ansøg via linket ved at klikke på “Ansøg” senest den 24. august 2026.
(Husk at udfylde alle felter markeret med *)

Du modtager en kvittering på mail, når vi har modtaget din ansøgning.

Om os
Skovbrynet er Aarhus Kommunes specialdagtilbud for børn med betydelig og varig nedsat fysisk og/eller psykisk funktionsevne.

Vi har plads til 92 børn, fordelt på fem afdelinger:
Skovbo, Stenhøj, Nygårdsvej, Troldhøj og Skovhøj – alle med forskellige målgrupper.

Om Aarhus Kommune
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus for en god by for alle.

Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Early Childhood Instructional Coach (26 -27 SY)
description:
Organizational Overview

For 25 years, KIPP DC has partnered with students, families, and the community to create joyful, academically excellent schools across the nation’s capital. Today, our network of 22 schools educate more than 7,500 students in grades PreK3-12, supported by 1,500 dedicated teachers, leaders, and staff.

Our work is grounded in five pillars–Academic Excellence, Joy & Sense of Belonging, Highly Effective Teachers and Leaders, Safe, Structured, and Nurturing Learning Environments, and Commitment to College Readiness–which ensure every student is equipped with the knowledge, skills, and confidence to pursue success in college, careers, and beyond. Our schools combine high expectations with joyful, affirming environments that nurture academic success and personal growth for students and staff alike.

As part of the national KIPP network, we share best practices and innovations while maintaining deep roots in Washington, D.C. Together, we strive toward a future without limits for our students, alumni, and community.

Instructional Coach Job Summary

The Instructional Coach’s job is to support Discover Academy in developing and following in strong teaching and instructional systems in order to drive strong experiences and academic outcomes for all students. Instructional Coaches build strong relationships with staff, students and families and have a deep understanding of both the purpose and structures for academic systems, curriculum, standards, and assessments. Instructional Coaches rely on both these relationships and systems to plan for and respond to student academic needs.

Instructional Coaches directly manage teachers and/or staff, and are responsible for setting the standard for belief in student growth and achievement, knowing and upholding a high bar for content and pedagogical best practices, integrating culturally and linguistically responsive approaches to teaching and learning, and developing and following in systems related to students making academic growth and achievement.

This specific role will be supporting our kindergarten team (teachers, students, and families). This is an exempt role, reporting to the principal, Sheila Lewis and serving on the school leadership team. This is a full-time, in-person role.

Key Responsibilities

Vision and Goals
  • Support development of school leader’s school-wide vision and takes an active role in investing and mobilizing teachers to achieve the collective goals of the school; owns the implementation of school wide systems regarding early childhood instruction
  • Alongside school leader, support the planning, goal setting, and progress monitoring for their teams and teachers and ensure alignment with school-wide goals
  • Support identification and action towards equity challenges within the school, especially as it may relate to issues of curriculum, student outcomes, and pedagogical approaches
  • Articulate how their actions and body of work connect to KIPP DC's goal of becoming an anti-racist organization
Plan and Prioritize
  • Collaborate with principal and leadership team in determining implementing systems and initiatives around school and team priorities, especially in regards to instruction
  • Prioritize and manage own time to deliver on short and long-term goals or priorities
  • Support teachers in planning and prioritizing their time
School Culture
  • Supports teachers in leading classrooms with high-quality Tier 1 student learning and engagement and develops and supports in lesson development and implementation for intervention
  • Work with staff and families to build an inclusive school environment for special populations (i.e. students with IEPs, students with 504s, ELL students, new students, students with HCYP status, etc.)
  • Reliably lead and support daily school operations (e.g. arrival/dismissal, lunch, passing period, recess)
  • Builds intentional and meaningful relationships with students, their families, and school communities
  • Maintain calm and poise in unpredictable, potentially stressful, situations
Instructional Leadership
  • Invest teachers and staff in a clear, inclusive instructional vision for all students; follow through on all commitments
  • Establish and communicate ambitious experiential and academic goals for all students
  • Understand and explain team/s' curriculum, assessments, pedagogical practices, standards, lessons, and each one's purpose
  • Be a frequent, regular presence in all classrooms and spaces you support
  • Establish regular cadence for analyzing and responding to academic data (with coaches, LT, et al.) in a timely fashion
  • Actively participate in ongoing learning (i.e. new research, professional texts, regional meetings, peer external PD, etc.)
  • Support teachers and hold them accountable to deep intellectual prep while simultaneously growing teacher understanding of curriculum and pedagogy
  • Establish predictable cadence and work alongside coaches to ensure the facilitation of engaging and effective adult learning
  • Have multiple points to measure performance against goals and expectations and then adjust approach
  • Support a culture where teachers are invested in and prepared for whole staff adult learning; work with Leadership Team to facilitate engaging, effective, relevant meetings
  • Collaborate with Special Educators to understand and meet the needs (i.e. academic, behavioral, etc.) of unique learners.
Talent
  • Build trusting, strong relationships with teachers and school staff
  • Identifies high-leverage coaching focuses ground in student impact and transferability
  • Identify a gap across a grade level or department and develop and execute a plan that results in improved student experiences and outcomes
  • Actively and regularly communicate with principal about progress, strengths, areas of growth, and potential trajectories of individual team members
  • Understand and practice fair and legal employment practices
  • Effectively manages and develops educators of a wide range of skill and experience level by defining responsibilities, setting goals and providing ongoing feedback and support
​​​​​​​Operations Management
  • Support the leadership team in executing school operational systems such as arrival and dismissal, mealtimes and attendance
  • Demonstrate strong fiscal stewardship and judgment

Competencies

Student Focus: Builds strong relationships and holds high expectations for students, holds students’ best interests in mind, keeps owns commitments to students and makes sure others do the same and builds a culture of respect for all students

Results Driven: Communicates that delivering excellent outcomes, in student experience and academics, is a guiding priority, sets challenging goals for self and others, takes initiative to go above and beyond to to achieve results, follows through on commitments, demonstrates resilience and flexibility

Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving: Demonstrates strong judgment and data-based, timely decision-making, gathers information from multiple sources, sorts out complexity, anticipates problems, values and encourages creative and innovative ideas, thinks expansively and avoids either/or thinking

Self-Awareness: Demonstrates understanding of own identity, privilege and power, understands strengths and weaknesses and the impact on others’ perceptions, seeks feedback and self-development, proactively asks for and willingly accepts assistance from others in a variety of roles

Equitable Practices: Believes that equity is something that can constantly drive one’s approach, rather than a lens that can be used sometimes, defines and communicates beliefs around racial and educational equity and leans into conversations about this, creates an inclusive environment that promotes a genuine sense of belonging for school community members across lines of difference

Impact and Influence: Is as clear on the purpose of actions as action themselves; effectively and reliably communicates "the why" to many stakeholders, adapts leadership style to influence others, takes the lead when there's a need; demonstrates growth mindset and learns from mistakes when they inevitably happen

Empowering Others: Actively listen to other school community members; seeks to understand others’ views and needs, intentionally builds trust within and across teams of people to promote collaboration and opportunities for shared ownership, consistently demonstrates respect and appreciation for others by empathizing, valuing their time and contributions, and being available and responsive to their needs

QUALIFICATIONS

KIPP DC is looking for candidates who are committed to KIPP DC’s mission that all students can learn and achieve at high levels when given the opportunity, have a strong teaching background, a commitment to creating identity-affirming learning experiences, and are looking to develop the leadership skills necessary to lead great schools. Specifically, candidates should have:

  • Bachelor’s degree (required)
  • Minimum of five years of lead teaching?(required)
  • Experience leading adults (e.g. grade level chair, department chair, committee chair, events lead, etc.) (required)
  • Demonstrated academic results (required)
  • Demonstrated judgment around student safety (required)
  • Strong attendance record (required)
  • Record of strong interpersonal interactions with families and staff (required)
  • Experience coaching and developing teachers (preferred)
  • Experience leading professional development (preferred)
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace apps (preferred)

Compensation & Benefits

  • When it comes to compensation, at KIPP DC we strive for clarity, equity, and to be highly competitive. We look at compensation benchmarks in schools across DC. Please see the salary scale here. Instructional Coaches can earn up to $5,000 in renewal add-ons to their base salary each year they return to KIPP DC.
  • KIPP DC offers a robust benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurances; various voluntary benefits; and employer paid benefits such as short term disability, long term disability, life insurance, and a membership to One Medical.
  • KIPP DC also offers a 403(b) retirement account with a 3% employer contribution and a 3% match with vesting after three years.
  • You will have a paid Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, Summer Break, and an additional 12 paid holidays. You will have up to 3 personal days and 7 sick days for the 2026-27 school year. KIPP DC complies with all sick leave standards set by District of Columbia law.

Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

KIPP DC Public Schools does not discriminate against, or tolerate discrimination against, employees or applicants for employment on any legally-recognized basis or protected class including, but not limited to, actual or perceived race, color, national origin, immigration status (except as necessary to comply with federal, DC, state, or local law), religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, lactation and related medical conditions), age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender (including gender identity or expression), marital status (including domestic partnership status), genetic information, political affiliation, pregnancy, family responsibilities, personal appearance, veteran status, uniform service member status, status of being unemployed, status of victim a survivor of domestic violence, sexual offense or stalking, matriculation or any other protected class under federal, state, DC, or local law.

title: Bliv en del af aftenholdet i Æblehaven på Vintersbølle Plejecenter
description:
Brænder du for høj faglighed, rehabilitering, og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab? Har du lyst til at blive en del af et plejecenter i positiv udvikling, hvor du får mulighed for at bidrage nytænkende til hverdagen? Så er det måske dig vi søger.

Vi tilbyder:
Vi er et hus i forandring med fokus på udvikling, kvalitet og samarbejde. Med ny ledelse og en klar ambition om, at styrke både faglighed og arbejdsglæde, arbejder vi målrettet med implementeringen af den nye ældrelov, og et øget fokus på rehabiliterende indsatser, der understøtter borgernes selvstændighed og livskvalitet.

Vi er Vordingborgs største plejecenter, med plads til 80 borgere.

Hos os bliver du en del af en engageret personalegruppe, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, deler viden og arbejder ud fra en fælles ambition, om at skabe den bedst mulige hverdag for beboerne, og den bedst mulige arbejdsplads for hinanden.

Vi søger en social- og sundhedsassistent, som:
- Er fagligt velfunderet, og arbejder med borgeren i centrum.
- Har lyst til at bidrage aktivt til udviklingen af vores praksis.
- Trives i tværfagligt samarbejde, og ser værdien i at spille kolleger gode.
- Har interesse for rehabilitering, og ønsker aktivt at deltage i forsat udvikling.
- Møder både beboere, pårørende og kolleger med respekt, nærvær og positiv energi.

Arbejdstid:
Stillingen er i fast aftenvagt med arbejdstid kl. 15.00–23.00 efter følgende rul:
Lige uger: Onsdag og torsdag.
Ulige uger: Onsdag til og med søndag.

Vi tilbyder dig:
- En arbejdsplads med høje faglige ambitioner og plads til udvikling.
- Mulighed for at være med til at forme en ny kultur præget af engagement, nytænkning og samarbejde.
- Fokus på kompetenceudvikling, og implementering af nye arbejdsgange.
- Dygtige og hjælpsomme kolleger, der løfter i fællesskab.
- En ledelse, der er synlig, lyttende og optaget af at skabe de bedste rammer for både medarbejdere og beboere.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig. Vi søger dig der vil være med til at skabe et plejecenter, hvor faglighed, rehabilitering og trivsel går hånd i hånd.

Hvis du ønsker at høre mere om den ledige stilling, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Teamleder: Charlotte Thomsen på tlf. 23 45 17 64.

Der vil være løbende samtaler og ansættelse, med tiltrædelse efter aftale - ansøgningfristen er den 8.9.2026.

Vordingborg Kommune

Vordingborg Kommune er en attraktiv og moderne arbejdsplads beliggende i Danmarks vildeste natur. Her langs Danmarks længste kystlinje mellem historiske købstæder og stærke fællesskaber er vi omtrent 4000 ansatte, der arbejder for at gøre vores kommune til et endnu mere grønt og attraktivt sted at bo og leve.

Vi har fokus på, at hverdagen skal hænge sammen og tilbyder rammerne om et liv i balance. Her får du mange kvadratmeter for færre penge, du kommer tæt på kysten, i spektakulær natur – med et meningsfuldt job. Så kom og vær med!

title: Staff Engineer
description:
Staff Engineer - Client Experience

Team: IT

Location: Germany

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Staff Engineer - Client Experience based in Germany.

This is a senior technical leadership role focused on building robust, scalable systems that support global commerce and complex payment experiences.
You will tackle the most challenging engineering problems while shaping architecture, technical strategy, and long-term platform direction.
The role combines hands-on software development with mentorship, cross-functional leadership, and organization-wide technical influence.
You will work across cloud-native infrastructure, distributed systems, high-throughput services, and modern backend technologies.
As part of an AI-native engineering environment, you will also help define how AI-assisted development is applied across design, implementation, testing, and code review.
Your work will directly influence engineering standards, system reliability, performance, and the ability of teams to deliver complex products effectively.
Success means becoming a trusted technical voice while raising the engineering bar through architecture, mentorship, and consistently high-quality execution.

Accountabilities

    • Provide technical leadership across engineering teams by setting high standards for software quality, architecture, reliability, and engineering practices.
    • Mentor and coach engineers, support their technical development, and promote a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
    • Architect, design, and build robust, scalable, and maintainable systems capable of supporting high-volume, low-latency workloads.
    • Lead the resolution of complex technical challenges, applying strong architectural principles, design patterns, and engineering best practices.
    • Drive complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from technical discovery through delivery, ensuring alignment with business objectives and timelines.
    • Contribute to technical strategy, architecture roadmaps, and long-term engineering priorities in collaboration with product and organizational stakeholders.
    • Work closely with Product, Design, and other stakeholders to translate complex technical concepts into clear decisions and actionable plans.
    • Improve system performance and scalability through efficient algorithms, clean code, rigorous testing, and continuous technical optimization.
    • Establish and promote strong automated testing practices across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing within Agile, DevSecOps, and CI/CD environments.
    • Help shape AI-native engineering practices by using AI-assisted tools across development workflows and establishing effective approaches that can be adopted across teams.
    • Strengthen engineering standards through technical reviews, tooling improvements, architectural guidance, and the introduction of practices that improve development quality.
    • Within the first 6–12 months, take architectural ownership of at least one major system, become a trusted contributor to technical strategy, and demonstrate measurable impact through mentorship and engineering improvements.

      • Requirements

      • Extensive professional software engineering experience, with deep expertise in Go and/or Kotlin and strong full-stack engineering capabilities.
      • Proven experience designing and building robust, scalable, and maintainable distributed systems, with strong knowledge of architecture principles, design patterns, and software engineering best practices.
      • Demonstrated ability to analyze and solve complex technical problems and translate them into effective, maintainable solutions.
      • Strong hands-on experience with AWS and cloud-native services such as RDS, ECS, EKS, S3, and related technologies.
      • Excellent understanding of automated testing, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, within Agile, DevSecOps, and CI/CD workflows.
      • Proven technical leadership experience, including mentoring engineers and influencing technical vision, strategy, architecture, and complex delivery.
      • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose issues efficiently and make sound technical decisions.
      • Advanced written and spoken English communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
      • Experience with technologies such as Kafka, SQS, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, GitHub Actions, and ArgoCD is highly relevant.
      • Experience in payments or fintech, particularly within globally scaled environments, is preferred.
      • Experience optimizing high-throughput, low-latency systems and applying efficient algorithms is an advantage.
      • Familiarity with static analysis and code-quality tools such as SonarQube and mature CI/CD practices is beneficial.
      • Experience with Python or other languages for data processing, tooling, and automation is a plus.
      • A track record of introducing engineering practices or standards across multiple teams is highly valued.
      • Open-source contributions, technical writing, or other activities that demonstrate technical influence are considered an additional advantage.
      • Ability to work effectively in a remote, distributed, and international environment.

        • Benefits

        • Competitive compensation.
        • Fully remote working environment with the flexibility to work from different locations.
        • One-time home office allowance to help create an effective workspace.
        • Company-provided work equipment.
        • Stock options.
        • Health plan available wherever you are.
        • Flexible days off.
        • Access to language, professional, and personal development courses.
        • Opportunity to work on globally scaled systems and complex technical challenges.
        • Significant autonomy and influence over architecture, engineering practices, and technical strategy.
        • Opportunity to shape AI-assisted engineering practices within an AI-native environment.
        • Collaborative international culture with strong opportunities for technical leadership and career growth.

title: Claude Solution Architect
description:

Operating within the India AI Center of Excellence and reporting to the Director, the architect partners with delivery, sales, and Anthropic partner teams across insurance, healthcare, and banking engagements. CCA (Claude Certified Architect) certification is required or in progress.

  • Produce reference architectures, solution design artefacts, and reusable accelerators for the Claude CoE.
  • Partner with Anthropic teams on solution acceleration, enablement, and certification, and stay current with Claude model and Claude Code capabilities.
  • Guide and review the work of GenAI engineers to ensure architectural consistency and delivery quality.
  • Establish responsible-AI, security, and privacy controls appropriate to regulated BFSI and healthcare domains.

Must-Have Skills

  • 7–9 years of experience in solution architecture, AI/ML, or software engineering, with hands-on GenAI delivery.

Claude & GenAI Architecture

  • Hands-on experience designing solutions with the Claude API and Claude Code, including agentic workflows and MCP-based integrations.
  • Strong expertise in RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and retrieval quality evaluation.
  • Experience with orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph) and prompt engineering/orchestration at scale.
  • CCA (Claude Certified Architect) certification required or in progress.

Delivery & Domain

  • Client-facing solutioning experience across one or more of insurance, healthcare, or banking.
  • Strong understanding of responsible AI, data privacy, security, and governance in regulated enterprise environments.
  • Excellent communication skills—able to translate business needs into technical architecture and articulate trade-offs to senior stakeholders.

Good-to-Have / Preferred

  • Cloud architecture experience on AWS and/or Azure, including containerized deployment, CI/CD, and monitoring.
  • Experience defining reusable accelerators, playbooks, or reference architectures for a CoE or practice.
  • Familiarity with Claude Computer Use and emerging agentic-coding workflows.
  • Additional cloud or AI architecture certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Information Systems, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

  • Experience managing confidential and highly sensitive legal data, including familiarity with litigation holds, document preservation, US discovery obligations (FRCP), and data governance practices.

  • Strong understanding of litigation workflows, legal service delivery standards, and in‑house legal operations.

  • Experience partnering effectively with senior in-house counsel and external law firms/ALSPs in a global environment.

  • Experience building, leading, and developing high-performing teams in an offshore or shared-services environment.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including communicating confidently and clearly with senior stakeholders globally.

  • Willingness and flexibility to work hours provide significant overlap with US Eastern Time.

  • Experience establishing governance frameworks, performance metrics, and operational reporting.

  • Sound judgment in legal and operational risk, with a results‑oriented execution mindset and strong risk awareness.

  • Experience in private equity, alternative asset management, or financial services litigation support.

Preferred

Du indgår i en 4-ugers vagtplan med varierende dag- og aftenvagter samt vagter hver fjerde weekend.

  • Rengøring

  • Gartnerisk vedligeholdelse af grønne områder
  • Vedligeholdelse af tekniske installationer
  • Tilsyn med bygninger og udeområder

et sted, hvor alle bidrager og har indflydelse

  • har interesse for sport og foreningsliv
  • besidder gode sociale kompetencer og motiveres af at yde god service
  • kan arbejde både selvstændigt og i teams
  • har gode kommunikationsevner
  • kendskab til ABA-anlæg, ABDL-anlæg og CTS-styring eller er villig til at lære det
  • har kørekort (kategori B) – gerne med trailerkort

title: Handicaphjælper søges - vikar med mulighed for fastansættelse hos 22-årig pige nord for Randers
description:
Har du godt humør, er du ansvarsfuld og kan du se dig selv gøre en forskel i en andens hverdag? Så er det måske dig, jeg leder efter!

Jeg er en glad pige på 22 år med muskelsvind (SMA type 2), og jeg søger en handicaphjælper, som i første omgang kan være vikar og senere blive en fast del af mit team.

Jeg bor i en lille by mellem Randers og Hadsund sammen med min familie, vores hund, kat og heste. Jeg sidder i kørestol og har brug for hjælp døgnet rundt. Jeg har brug for støtte til dagligdags aktiviter, da jeg ikke kan gå eller løfte mine arme.

Om jobbet

Som min hjælper bliver du en vigtig del af min hverdag. Du hjælper mig blandt andet med:

  • Personlig pleje og andre daglige opgaver
  • Praktiske ting omkring mig
  • At få fjernet spyt og slim, da jeg danner en del af det
  • At placere mine arme, så jeg blandt andet kan spille computer - hvilket jeg er vild med.

Du bliver en del af et fast team på 5 medarbejdere, hvor vi arbejder sammen om at få hverdagen til at fungere bedst muligt.

Vagterne er på 12 timer, og der er primært dagvagter kl. 07:15-19:15. Der kan også forekomme nattevagter.

Lidt om mig

Jeg er en glad pige, som som regel har et smil på læben, og jeg sætter stor pris på humor og en god stemning omkring mig.

Jeg har brug for en hjælper, som er tålmodig, positiv og god til at håndtere nye situationer. Nogle situationer kan være udfordrende for mig, og derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan bevare roen og tænke praktisk, når tingene ikke altid går helt som planlagt.

Jeg bor sammen med min familie, og vores dyr fylder også en del i hverdagen. Derfor skal du selvfølgelig kunne lide dyr og have det godt med at være omkring både hund, kat og heste.

Jeg forestiller mig, at du:

  • Er en ung kvinde
  • Har kørekort og egen bil
  • Er ikke-ryger, da jeg er følsom over for røg
  • Kan lide dyr og ikke er allergisk over for pelsdyr
  • Er fleksibel og ansvarsfuld
  • Har et godt humør og et positivt sind

Vikar nu - mulighed fir fastansættelse senere

Du starter som vikar, hvor du i begyndelsen skal kunne træde til og dække vagter for de faste medarbejdere ved fx ferie, sygdom eller andre situationer, hvor de er forhindrede i at møde.

Har vi et godt match, og du også har lyst til at fortsætte, er der mulighed for fastansættelse fra midten af oktober, hvor du kan blive en fast del af mit team.

Løn

Grundlønnen er 155,87 kr. i timen, og derudover er der tillæg for aften, nat, lørdag og søndag. Hvis du vil se mere omkring løn kan du se det lige her: https://dho.dk/handicaphjaelper/loen-og-ferie/

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Hvis du kan se dig selv som en del af min hverdag og som en del af vores team, så glæder jeg mig meget til at høre fra dig!

title: Technical Lead – Site Reliability Engineering
description:
Before you apply to a job, select your language preference from the options available at the top right of this page.

Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.

Job Description:

Role Summary

The Technical Lead provides technical leadership for the SRE organization by driving architecture decisions, operational excellence, observability, and automation. This individual serves as the highest technical authority within the engineering team.

Responsibilities

  • Define operational standards, engineering best practices, and runbooks.
  • Lead critical production incidents and complex troubleshooting efforts.
  • Design and implement reliability improvements across applications and infrastructure.
  • Drive self-healing systems and automation initiatives.
  • Establish observability standards using metrics, logs, and distributed tracing.
  • Mentor engineers and QA team members.
  • Drive adoption of AI-powered engineering and operational tooling.
  • Collaborate with development teams on production readiness and operational improvements.

Required Skills

  • 11+ years of backend engineering and production support experience.
  • Strong Java development experience.
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with Azure/GCP cloud platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of messaging systems (AMQ, MQ, Kafka, etc.).
  • Expertise with Couchbase, PostgreSQL, and cloud databases.
  • Experience with observability tools such as Grafana and Splunk.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills (Python preferred).

As part of the Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) organization, every team member plays a critical role in maintaining the reliability and availability of our production systems.

This role supports a 24x7 production environment supporting business-critical applications.
All engineers are expected to participate in an on-call support rotation, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays as scheduled.
During on-call periods, you will be expected to respond to production incidents within defined response time objectives, troubleshoot issues, and work collaboratively to restore service as quickly as possible.
Candidates should be comfortable diagnosing complex production issues across applications, cloud infrastructure, databases, messaging systems, and integrations.
Participation in post-incident reviews, root cause analysis (RCA), and implementation of permanent corrective actions is an essential part of the role.
Team members are expected to continuously improve operational processes through automation, monitoring enhancements, and proactive reliability improvements to reduce recurring incidents.
Flexibility to collaborate with globally distributed teams, including occasional overlap with US business hours, is expected to support production operations and major releases.
A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and customer focus is essential, as ensuring platform stability and business continuity is a shared responsibility across the entire team.

      • Strong AWS expertise across services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, and RDS, combined with solid networking fundamentals.
      • Hands-on Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tools, with infrastructure managed through version-controlled workflows and code reviews.

description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer

Team: IT

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Denmark.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you’ll champion a quality-first mindset across an agile software development environment. You’ll contribute throughout the full software development lifecycle, from requirements refinement and test strategy through release validation. The role combines hands-on testing, automation, backend validation, API testing, database testing, and exploratory testing. You’ll work closely with product, architecture, engineering, and quality teams to identify risks early and improve testability. As the automation expert within the team, you’ll help build and maintain robust automated test suites for new and existing functionality.       • Strong experience developing test strategies, defining test scenarios, and writing detailed test cases.
      • Extensive experience testing backend systems using multiple approaches, including REST APIs, message queues, databases, and front-end interfaces.
      • Strong SQL skills and practical experience with relational database tools such as DBeaver, SQL Server, or MySQL Workbench.
      • Experience creating or seeding databases with test data is an advantage.
      • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Git and version control workflows.
      • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP; familiarity with AWS services including EKS, RDS, SQS, and API Gateway is a plus.

      • Strong exploratory testing skills, with a sharp eye for functional defects, edge cases, usability concerns, and unexpected behavior.
      • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate issues and communicate findings clearly and efficiently.
      • Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the flexibility to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
      • A proactive, collaborative mindset with the confidence to challenge assumptions and advocate for quality.
      • At senior level, the ability to influence software quality beyond your immediate team and contribute to broader engineering improvements.
      • Strong ownership, curiosity, communication, and continuous-learning skills.

        • Benefits

        • Opportunity to work within a diverse, international team spanning multiple countries and cultures.

title: Guest Experience Agent
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

Be You

The Guest Experience Agent is a key element for the success of the guest journey whose main objective is to recognize, meet & greet and anticipate the guest´s needs throughout their stay while curating memorable moments for them.

Must be able to accommodate any reasonable guest request either personally or through the pertinent departments utilizing approved communication channels to ensure efficiency within the process. Will act as point of contact for VIP´s and special attention guests assigned by management team throughout their stay.

Target Hire Date – October 2026

Skills and Abilities:

  • At least 2~3 years of relevant work experience in Luxury Hotel.

  • Self-driven and a strategic resourcing professional.

  • Able to work independently and under pressure in a fast pace working environment.

  • Good team spirit, cooperative with good communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to multi-task in a high-volume environment, utilizing a variety of computer systems to check in and out, run daily reports, select/assign rooms arriving guests, and restaurant/activity/spa reservation systems.

  • Reading, writing and oral proficiency in both Spanish and English language

  • Able to multitask and prioritize workload and projects simultaneously and efficiently.

*This position requires applicants to have valid work authorization in Mexico.

Master Your Craft

  • Prepares and sets up “Welcome Experience” for every guest arrival in coordination with the rest of the Front Office Team (welcome beverage, cold oshi-bouri, etc.)

  • Is able to perform a check in personalizing each interaction.

  • Prepares and sets up “Farewell Experience” for guest´s departure in coordination with the rest of the Front Office Team.

  • Connects with guests assigned on a daily basis, anticipates and coordinates any transportation need, restaurant reservation, etc.

  • Plans and executes special and meaningful tokens/experiences for guests assigned throughout their stay utilizing approved vendors and budget.

  • Handles all guest interactions with the highest level of hospitality and professionalism, accommodating special requests whenever possible; resolves customer complaints; assists customers in all inquiries in connection with hotel services, hours of operations, key hotel personnel, in-house events, directions, etc. Responds to all guest requests in an accurate and timely manner. Interactions with guest will be in person, phone, FS Chat and by email.

  • Utilizes a variety of computer systems to communicate with guests, run reports, etc.

  • Communicates with internal personnel and departments via radio, Hotsos, Teams, and phones. Chat guests via messenger application and utilize Four Seasons guest recognition program.

  • Works harmoniously and professionally with co-workers and supervisors.

  • Assists with responsibilities and duties in the absence of or due to heavy volume in areas of Guest Services and lobby coverage.

  • Works closely with Guest Service staff to ensure smooth handling of guest luggage, guest escorts, deliveries and special requests.

  • Perform other tasks or projects as assigned by management.

What We Offer and What You Can Expect

  • You will become part of a supportive team with a genuine family spirit, where your talent will be valued and recognized.

  • Highly competitive salaries, with an attractive annual incentive plan for management and Department Head positions.

  • Transportation service from San Lucas and San José del Cabo to the resort.

  • Uniform laundry service, ensuring comfort and a professional appearance.

  • Training programs and in-house workshops to support your professional development.

  • A dynamic, diverse, and challenging work environment with close interaction with the leadership team.

  • Recognition programs that celebrate your achievements, including awards for years of service, Employee of the Month, and Employee of the Year.

About Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts opened its first hotel in 1961, and its history has been one of continuous innovation, remarkable growth, and an unwavering commitment to the highest standards. For nearly 50 years, Four Seasons has transformed the hospitality industry by combining genuine care and efficiency with the finest traditions of international hospitality. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts has been ranked EVERY YEAR as one of FORTUNE Magazine’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” since 1998 and has been named a Great Place to Work Legend, an honor currently held by only 12 companies worldwide.

Service Culture

Currently operating 120 hotels and resorts and 45 residential properties in major city centers and resort destinations across 47 countries, with more than 50 projects under planning or development, Four Seasons consistently ranks among the world’s finest hotels and most prestigious brands in reader surveys, traveler reviews, and industry awards. Our greatest asset—and the key to our success—is our people. We believe that each of us deserves a sense of dignity, pride, and satisfaction in what we do.

What Is It Like to Work for Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts?

At Four Seasons, we guide all our actions by the Golden Rule: “Treat others as you would like to be treated.” Here, you will work on a team built on mutual respect, collaboration, exceptional service, and a passion for hospitality. As a luxury brand, your work will also be guided by the highest standards to ensure exceptional quality and service at all times. Expect to work hard while having fun and learning along the way, taking your career, experience, and skills to the next level. As an added benefit, working with Four Seasons gives you the opportunity to build an international career and travel around the world while staying at incredible properties at no cost.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:
You own the backend systems and money paths for payments, payouts, deposits, transfers, and reconciliation. You design secure app-facing APIs and authentication services, integrate financial providers, trace on-chain settlement, and establish testing, documentation, correctness, and security standards for backend development.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build backend systems for a high-usage consumer app
  • Own versioned and backward-compatible app-facing API contracts
  • Implement client idempotency keys, error models, and pagination
  • Own authentication and authorization services
  • Implement passkey and WebAuthn relying-party functionality
  • Manage session and token lifecycles
  • Enforce authorization at every API boundary
  • Defend authentication services with rate limiting and anomaly detection
  • Securely handle PII and secrets
  • Set backend patterns, tests, and documentation
  • Trace money paths through APIs, wallets, execution, indexing, event streams, and settlement
  • Deliver test-first implementations of payment paths

Requirements

  • Build and operate production backend systems that move real money
  • Design client-facing APIs for mobile applications at scale
  • Know API contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, idempotency keys, error models, pagination, and rate limiting
  • Build authentication and authorization backends
  • Know OAuth2, OIDC, JWT, RBAC, ABAC, MFA, and step-up authentication
  • Integrate financial third parties and handle webhooks and reconciliation
  • Understand on-chain settlement, nonces, gas, reorgs, RPC failures, and confirmation depth
  • Use TypeScript or transition credibly from Go, Kotlin, Rust, or Java
  • Use Postgres, event or queue systems, and gRPC
  • Practice test-first, behavior-driven, and integration testing
  • Use agentic development workflows

This is a remote contract opportunity supporting the implementation and enhancement of enterprise information systems within a healthcare and clinical environment. The role focuses on ensuring that systems meet functional and non-functional requirements through rigorous testing and validation. You will contribute across requirements analysis, process mapping, test planning, scenario development, and execution. The position offers the opportunity to work on complex web and client-server applications where quality, accuracy, and reliability are critical.
