title: Jobtitel: Social- og sundhedsassistent eller social- og sundhedshjælper, til plejehjemmet Ankersgade 25-27
description:
Om jobbet:
Stillingen ligger inden for det døgndækkede område, og tjenesten forventes fortrinsvis at være i nattevagt/dagvagt. Vi søger en social- og sundhedsassistent eller social- og sundhedshjælper, der har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af vores nattevagtsteam og bidrage til tryghed, nærvær og høj faglighed i beboernes hjem.

Din profil:
Vi vægter særligt, at du er opsøgende, ansvarlig og har hjertet med i dit arbejde. Du skaber ro og tryghed om natten, både for beboere og kolleger. At du trives med at arbejde selvstændigt, samtidig med at du bidrager til et stærkt fællesskab.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent eller social- og sundhedshjælper
  • Er både hjertevarm og fagligt velfunderet
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og kan arbejde selvstændigt
  • Er ansvarlig, stabil og gør dig umage
  • Trives med nattearbejde
  • Har overblik og arbejder struktureret
  • Er god til at kommunikere med beboere og pårørende, også i komplekse situationer
  • Har lyst til at lære og lære fra dig
  • Har kendskab til CURA (en fordel, ikke et krav)
  • Arbejder personcentreret og tager udgangspunkt i beboernes ønsker og behov

Derfor skal du vælge os:
Hos os bliver du en del af et stærkt og omsorgsfuldt fællesskab, hvor faglighed, nærvær og samarbejde går hånd i hånd. Vi arbejder i beboernes hjem, og vi tager altid udgangspunkt i, hvad den enkelte beboer ønsker og har brug for. Kommunens 5 ledetråde er en naturlig del af vores hverdag og giver retning for vores faglige prioriteringer.

Du skal vælge os, fordi:

  • Vi opnormerer nattevagtsteamet fra 2 til 3 medarbejdere, så der bliver bedre tid, større tryghed og mere faglig kvalitet i opgaveløsningen.
  • Vi oplever stigende kompleksitet i opgaverne om natten og prioriterer derfor både SSA- og SSH-kompetencer i teamet.
  • Du bliver en del af et velfungerende, hjertevarmt og fagligt stærkt team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og har fokus på trivsel.
  • Vi arbejder målrettet med kompetenceudvikling, så du får mulighed for at udvikle dig både fagligt og personligt.
  • Vi vægter arbejdsmiljø, ordentlighed og respekt højt – både i samarbejdet med beboere, pårørende og kolleger.
  • Du får en arbejdsplads, hvor din faglighed gør en reel forskel for beboernes nattesøvn, tryghed og livskvalitet.

Kort sagt: Hos os bliver du en del af et sted, hvor vi passer på hinanden – og hvor du kan være stolt af dit arbejde.

Om afdelingen:
Ankersgade rummer to plejehjem, som tilsammen består af fire bygninger, hvor af du vil blive ansat og tilknyttet Ankersgade 25-27. De fire huse er forskellige i både indretning og beboersammensætning, men fælles for dem alle er et stærkt fokus på hjemlighed, nærvær og høj faglig kvalitet.

Om natten deler vi personalet på tværs af gaden, og du bliver en del af et velfungerende nattevagtsteam, der har stort fokus på samarbejde, stærk faglighed og en varm kollegial kultur. Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af husene, og du vil opleve en arbejdsplads, hvor man både bliver taget godt imod og bliver en vigtig del af fællesskabet fra dag ét.

Vi arbejder tæt på beboernes hverdag og livshistorie, og vi lægger vægt på personcentreret omsorg, ro, tryghed og respekt for den enkelte. De fire bygninger giver variation i opgaverne og mulighed for at bruge dine kompetencer bredt.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:
Stillingen ønskes tiltrådt 01.10.2026
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og efter konkret forhandling med den forhandlingsberettigede faglige organisation.

Ugentligt timetal: 37

Hvis du vil vide mere:
Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan fås ved henvendelse til Forstander Christina Opolzer på mobil nr. 5336 3758 eller mail cop@aarhus.dk.

Ansøgning
Klik på ”Ansøg” nedenfor for at udfylde og sende din ansøgning. Alle felter med * skal udfyldes. Først når du har modtaget en kvittering pr. e-mail, har vi modtaget din ansøgning.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 24.08.2026

Vi forventer at afvikle jobsamtaler den 28.08.2026

I Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg har vi en generel politik om, at der ved ansættelser indhentes referencer og evt. straffeattest. Du må derfor forvente at blive anmodet herom, hvis vi tilbyder dig stillingen.
Vi gør opmærksom på, at der i forbindelse med rekrutteringsprocessen vil blive foretaget opslag i vores referenceregister. Referenceregisteret omfatter tidligere medarbejdere i Magistratsafdelingen for Sundhed og Omsorg, der er blevet bortvist grundet væsentlig misligholdelse af ansættelsesforholdet.


Om Sundhed og Omsorg og Aarhus Kommune:

Sundhed og Omsorg (MSO) i Aarhus Kommune arbejder med omsorg for ældre og sundhed for alle borgere.


Aarhus Kommune betragter mangfoldighed som en ressource og opfordrer derfor alle - uanset alder, køn, handicap, livsstil, religion eller etnisk tilhørsforhold - til at ansøge stillingen.
Aarhus Kommune er en af Jyllands største arbejdspladser, hvor 28.000 professionelle og passionerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at gøre visioner til virkelighed og skabe værdi for borgere og samfundet omkring os. Vi er en arbejdsplads, der vægter faglighed og samarbejde højt og vi tror på, at vores forskelligheder er med til at gøre Aarhus til en god by for alle. Sammen arbejder vi for en bæredygtig og inkluderende by, hvor både ansatte, borgere, virksomheder og naturen kan trives og blomstre. Vi har ambitioner for byen – og for dig. Kom og vær med!

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer

Team: IT

Location: Chile

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Chile.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you’ll champion a quality-first mindset across an agile software development environment. You’ll contribute throughout the full software development lifecycle, from requirements refinement and test strategy through release validation. The role combines hands-on testing, automation, backend validation, API testing, database testing, and exploratory testing. You’ll work closely with product, architecture, engineering, and quality teams to identify risks early and improve testability. As the automation expert within the team, you’ll help build and maintain robust automated test suites for new and existing functionality. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence engineering practices and raise software quality beyond your immediate team. This is a collaborative, remote role in a fast-moving environment where ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

Accountabilities

    • Contribute to feature refinement by challenging assumptions, clarifying requirements, identifying edge cases, and assessing system architecture and testability.
    • Develop and formalize comprehensive test strategies covering test scenarios, integration points, test data, APIs, applications, queues, databases, and result verification.
    • Deploy and configure software updates in QA environments and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end tests.
    • Investigate defects, identify root causes where possible, and document bugs with clear, accurate reproduction steps and supporting information.
    • Validate completed functionality and provide production sign-off when quality and acceptance criteria have been met.
    • Drive test automation for both new and existing features, working closely with quality engineering leadership to maintain reliable and effective automated test suites.
    • Act as the team’s automation specialist and promote quality engineering practices across the wider development organization.
    • Perform backend testing through multiple interaction methods, including REST APIs, message queues, databases, and front-end interfaces.
    • Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, technical leads, developers, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
    • Advocate for quality, usability, testability, and continuous improvement while managing and reprioritizing multiple workstreams in a dynamic environment.
    • During the first 90 days, build a strong understanding of the products, customers, teams, tools, and processes, while establishing relationships and contributing to the team’s quality goals.
    • Participate actively in feedback, professional development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

      • Requirements

      • 5–8+ years of proven experience working as a QA tester or QA engineer within an Agile software development environment.
      • Strong experience developing test strategies, defining test scenarios, and writing detailed test cases.
      • Extensive experience testing backend systems using multiple approaches, including REST APIs, message queues, databases, and front-end interfaces.

      • Experience creating or seeding databases with test data is an advantage.
      • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Git and version control workflows.

      • Hands-on experience with API testing and documentation tools such as Swagger, Bruno, and Postman.
      • Experience writing and maintaining test scripts using JavaScript.
      • Knowledge of configuring mocks for isolated service testing is highly desirable.
      • Strong exploratory testing skills, with a sharp eye for functional defects, edge cases, usability concerns, and unexpected behavior.
      • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate issues and communicate findings clearly and efficiently.
      • Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the flexibility to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
      • A proactive, collaborative mindset with the confidence to challenge assumptions and advocate for quality.
      • At senior level, the ability to influence software quality beyond your immediate team and contribute to broader engineering improvements.
      • Strong ownership, curiosity, communication, and continuous-learning skills.

        • Benefits

        • Fully remote working environment.
        • Opportunity to work within a diverse, international team spanning multiple countries and cultures.
        • Meaningful opportunity to contribute to technology that improves financial access and supports communities.
        • High level of trust, autonomy, and ownership without unnecessary bureaucracy.
        • Collaborative culture focused on customer impact, experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
        • Opportunities to influence quality engineering practices beyond your immediate team.
        • Structured career and development conversations, including the opportunity to create a training and career growth plan aligned with your goals.
        • Regular feedback and opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues across product, engineering, and other functions.

title: Senior Insider and Data Risk Analyst
description:
Sr. Insider & Data Risk Analyst

Team: Analyst

Location: Switzerland

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Insider & Data Risk Analyst based in Switzerland.

This is a senior individual contributor role focused on protecting sensitive information, systems, and people from insider and data-loss risks. You will own complex investigations from initial triage through resolution while helping mature insider risk management and Data Loss Prevention capabilities. The role sits at the intersection of cybersecurity, data protection, privacy, and regulated financial services. You will work closely with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security teams on highly sensitive cases requiring discretion and sound judgment. The position also offers an opportunity to strengthen risk processes, automate investigations, and apply AI to emerging security challenges. Success requires a highly organized professional who can translate complex findings into clear recommendations for both technical teams and leadership.

Accountabilities

    • Own insider risk investigations from initial triage through closure, including establishing case timelines, coordinating containment and escalation, documenting determinations, and capturing lessons learned.
    • Mature the Insider Risk Management Program by developing scalable case-management processes, risk-tiering methodologies, investigation standards, and repeatable workflows.
    • Operate, monitor, and tune Data Loss Prevention capabilities across SaaS applications, endpoints, and other environments, improving detection quality while reducing false positives.
    • Investigate potential data exfiltration, misuse, policy violations, and inappropriate access involving source code, cloud platforms, collaboration tools, third-party applications, and critical business or trading systems.
    • Strengthen data classification and governance practices while aligning DLP controls with information sensitivity and business risk.
    • Assess risks associated with unauthorized AI and agentic tooling, including potential exposure of sensitive or proprietary information through approved and unsanctioned AI applications.
    • Use workflow automation, AI, and security orchestration capabilities to improve alert triage, investigation efficiency, and the overall maturity of insider risk processes.
    • Lead insider risk and data protection assessments, maintain risk registers, and track remediation activities and emerging threats.

    • Monitor developments in insider risk, data protection, privacy, cybersecurity, and financial services regulation to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

      • 4+ years of professional experience in insider risk, Data Loss Prevention, digital forensics, security investigations, or a closely related discipline.
      • Demonstrated hands-on experience leading sensitive investigations and managing cases involving personnel matters, data misuse, policy violations, or potential exfiltration.
      • Practical experience operating and tuning DLP solutions across SaaS and endpoint environments, with an understanding of detection quality and false-positive reduction.
      • Experience with workflow automation, AI, or SOAR platforms for alert triage, investigation support, and case orchestration.

      • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks including NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and privacy regulations such as GDPR and APPI.
      • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear investigation reports, case documentation, risk assessments, and executive summaries.
      • Exceptional integrity, discretion, and judgment when handling confidential personnel, customer, business, and security information.
      • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple sensitive investigations in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
      • Ability to collaborate effectively with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security stakeholders.
      • Experience with digital forensics, eDiscovery, UEBA, insider risk platforms, security operations, or incident response is an advantage.
      • Scripting or automation experience using technologies such as Python or SQL is a plus.
      • Experience with major cloud platforms and familiarity with supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or regulatory audits is beneficial.
      • Exposure to fintech, financial services, trading platforms, or regulated environments is strongly valued.
      • Relevant certifications such as GCFA, GCFE, CISSP, CISM, CIPP, CFE, or equivalent are considered a plus.
      • Familiarity with financial services regulatory expectations and multi-jurisdiction privacy requirements is advantageous.
      • A genuine interest in AI-related data risk and using emerging AI capabilities to improve security operations and investigation workflows.

description:

                                     fuldtid 
                         

                        
 
                             Erfaren Industritekniker med styr på CNCdrejning søges til HydraComp i Skive 
                             
                                
 
                                         HydraComp A/S
                                 

                                
  
    Bjørnevej 30 7800 Skive 

                             
                         

                     

                    
 
                        
 Er du typen, der kan få metal, mål og maskiner til at spille sammen? Har du erfaring med CNCdrejebænke, og kan du lide en hverdag, hvor præcision, godt håndværk og godt humør går hånd i hånd? 

 Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter til vores afdeling i Skive. 

  

 Om HydraComp 

 HydraComp har i 25 produceret hydraulikcylindre og hydraulikstationer til kunder på tværs af brancher. Vi er ca 40 - som sammen udvikler, bygger og vedligeholder skræddersyede hydrauliske løsninger. 

 Hos os er alle nøglepersoner: Vi prioriterer faglighed, ordenligt samarbejde og en god tone - også når tempoet er højt. Vi vokser, og derfor investerer vi i ordentlig oplæring, videndeling og fremtidssikring af vores kompetencer. 

  

 Om dig 

 Du er industritekniker - eller har solid erfaring fra lignende stilling. Du trives ved maskinerne, tænker i stål, har øje for detaljen - og sætter en ære i at levere et ordentligt stykke arbejde - til tiden. 

 Det er ikke sikkert du ved alt om hydraulik, men du har lysten til at tage ansvar, lære nyt og være en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden. 

  

 Dine superkræfter 
 
 
 Du har erfaring med betjening af CNC-drejebænke 
 

 
 Du har kendskab til ISO-programmering 
 

 
 Du arbejder struktureret og har styr på detaljerne 
 

 
 Du tager ansvar for kvaliteten af dit arbejde 
 

 
 Du er typen, der giver en hånd med, når der er travlt 
 

 
 Du værdsætter en ærlig, uformel og direkte tone 
 

 
 Du er åben for perioder med aftenarbejde, som du selv er med til at planlægge 
 
 
  

 Dine opgaver 

 Du bliver en vigtig del af vores produktion i Skive, hvor du kommer til at arbejde med CNC-drejning af emner til hydrauliske løsninger. 

 Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være: 
 
 
  Betjening og indstilling af CNC-drejebænke 
 

 
 Programmering og tilpasning i ISO 
 

 
 Kontrol og kvalitetssikring af emner 
 

 
  Løbende optimering af processer og arbejdsgange 
 

 
  Samarbejde med dine kolleger i produktionen om at få opgaverne godt i mål 
 
 
 Vi sørger selvfølgelig for en grundig oplæring i vores maskiner, processer og måde at gøre tingene på. 

  

 Derfor skal du vælge os 
 
 
 Meningsfulde opgaver: Du ser resultatet af dit arbejde - i driftssikre løsninger hos kunderne 
 

 
  Kort vej fra idé til handling: Uformel omgangstone og direkte beslutningsveje 
 

 
 Udvikling i jobbet: Oplæring af erfarne kolleger og mulighed for at præge processer 
 

 
 Ordentlige vilkår: Fuldtidsstilling, løn efter kvalifikationer og resultater, pensionsordning m.v. 
 

 
 Et humoristisk og kollegialt miljø, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, når der er travlt 
 
 
  

 Praktisk 

 Arbejdssted: Skive 

 Arbejdstid: Fuldtid 

 Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt - vi venter gerne på den rette 

 Send ansøgning (gerne med CV og referencer) til fabrikschef Flemming Stubkjær Steffensen på flemming@hydra-comp.dk. Har du spørgsmål, så ring til 96 69 40 80. 

 Vi holder samtaler løbende, så søg gerne allerede i dag.

description:

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Germany.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you’ll champion a quality-first mindset across an agile software development environment. You’ll contribute throughout the full software development lifecycle, from requirements refinement and test strategy through release validation. The role combines hands-on testing, automation, backend validation, API testing, database testing, and exploratory testing. You’ll work closely with product, architecture, engineering, and quality teams to identify risks early and improve testability. As the automation expert within the team, you’ll help build and maintain robust automated test suites for new and existing functionality. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence engineering practices and raise software quality beyond your immediate team. This is a collaborative, remote role in a fast-moving environment where ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

Accountabilities

    • Contribute to feature refinement by challenging assumptions, clarifying requirements, identifying edge cases, and assessing system architecture and testability.
    • Develop and formalize comprehensive test strategies covering test scenarios, integration points, test data, APIs, applications, queues, databases, and result verification.
    • Deploy and configure software updates in QA environments and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end tests.
    • Investigate defects, identify root causes where possible, and document bugs with clear, accurate reproduction steps and supporting information.
    • Validate completed functionality and provide production sign-off when quality and acceptance criteria have been met.
    • Drive test automation for both new and existing features, working closely with quality engineering leadership to maintain reliable and effective automated test suites.
    • Act as the team’s automation specialist and promote quality engineering practices across the wider development organization.
    • Perform backend testing through multiple interaction methods, including REST APIs, message queues, databases, and front-end interfaces.
    • Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, technical leads, developers, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
    • Advocate for quality, usability, testability, and continuous improvement while managing and reprioritizing multiple workstreams in a dynamic environment.
    • During the first 90 days, build a strong understanding of the products, customers, teams, tools, and processes, while establishing relationships and contributing to the team’s quality goals.
    • Participate actively in feedback, professional development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

      • Requirements

      • 5–8+ years of proven experience working as a QA tester or QA engineer within an Agile software development environment.
      • Strong experience developing test strategies, defining test scenarios, and writing detailed test cases.
      • Extensive experience testing backend systems using multiple approaches, including REST APIs, message queues, databases, and front-end interfaces.
      • Strong SQL skills and practical experience with relational database tools such as DBeaver, SQL Server, or MySQL Workbench.
      • Experience creating or seeding databases with test data is an advantage.
      • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Git and version control workflows.
      • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP; familiarity with AWS services including EKS, RDS, SQS, and API Gateway is a plus.

      • A proactive, collaborative mindset with the confidence to challenge assumptions and advocate for quality.

      • Strong ownership, curiosity, communication, and continuous-learning skills.

title: Teamkoordinator til analysekontor i stor it-styrelse
description:
Er du analytisk stærk og har du mod på at udvikle og lede dit team fagligt, så I kan levere gennemarbejdede beslutningsgrundlag med udgangspunkt i data? Har du lyst til at være med til at drive udviklingen af den offentlige sektor i en af de største it-organisationer i Danmark? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

Analysekontoret er en del af Udviklings- og Forenklingsstyrelsen (UFST), som understøtter og driver digitaliseringen af den danske skatteforvaltning. Vores arbejde har stor bevågenhed – både politisk og i offentligheden.

I kontoret gennemfører vi analyser med henblik på at styrke den ledelsesmæssige prioritering i styrelsen gennem skarpe beslutningsoplæg. Analyserne er drevet af, hvad der strategisk efterspørges af styrelsens direktion. Det overordnede fokus er på udvikling, prioritering og effektivisering af styrelsens opgaveportefølje på tværs af et samlet årligt budget på ca. 4,5 mia. kr. Det kan fx være analytiske oplæg inden for strategi, leverandørstyring, økonomi, porteføljestyring mv. I et komplekst organisatorisk landskab skal vi gennemføre solide kvantitative analyser samt understøtte implementeringen af besluttede initiativer.

Ansvar, udfordringer og udviklingsmuligheder
Analysekontoret fungerer som styrelsens in-house konsulenthus. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du udover en interesse for tal, også er nysgerrig og formår at tilegne dig ny viden på områder, som du ikke har stiftet bekendtskab med før, særligt indenfor IT. Kontoret er en del af fagområdet Styring, som har ansvaret for bl.a. økonomistyring i Udviklings- og Forenklingsstyrelsen.

Da kontoret er problem- og talknuser for strategisk prioriterede indsatser i styrelsen, lægger vi stor vægt på evnen til at angribe komplekse problemstillinger med metodisk stringens, en struktureret og selvstændig tilgang til problemløsning samt viljen til at skabe samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af kontorer i styrelsen. Som teamkoordinator vil du få stor indflydelse på de opgaver, du og dit team løser og der vil være rig mulighed for at sætte dit eget aftryk på produkterne.

Vi tilbyder en spændende stilling, hvor du:

  • bliver en del af et stærkt fagligt miljø omkring analyser
  • kommer til at udvikle og arbejde med dit eget team, som består af dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere
  • står for faglig feedback, sparring og sikring af kvaliteten på dit teams leverancer
  • fordeler og prioriterer opgaverne inden for teamet
  • arbejder med strategisk vigtige udviklingsopgaver forankret i og prioriteret af direktionen
  • bliver udfordret på dine analytiske færdigheder og modtager kompetent sparring og feedback på dit arbejde og dine produkter
  • bliver drivende af, og ansvarlig for, planlægningen og gennemførslen af projektforløb i samarbejde med dine kolleger og eksterne interessenter
  • får stor indflydelse på de opgaver du og dit team løser
  • bliver en del af et kontor med et godt socialt sammenhold
Kvalifikationer, erfaring og kompetencer
Vi lægger vægt på, at du har et højt fagligt niveau og evnen til at opnå gode resultater demonstreret gennem hidtidig beskæftigelse og en relevant samfundsvidenskabelig eller økonomisk uddannelse.

Du har styr på din kvantitative metode og er analytisk stærk. Du er en god projektleder og kan holde overblikket over dit teams forskellige leverancer og kommunikerer aktivt om den ønskede fremdrift til både dit team, jeres interessenter og vores ledelse. Problemløsning er en af dine kernekompetencer, og du kan derfor hurtigt sætte dig ind i komplekse problemstillinger og komme med kvalificerede løsninger.

Vi forventer, at du har mod på at udvikle dig selv og dit team, så I opnår de bedst mulige resultater. Det er ikke et krav, at du har erfaring med faglig ledelse, men du skal have mod på at bringe dig selv i spil og udvikle dine kompetencer på området. Det er vigtigt, at du kan se dig selv i en rolle, hvor du dagligt koordinerer, følger op og sparrer om de forskellige arbejdsopgaver samt er med til at synliggøre teamets resultater i organisationen. Du skal samtidig føle dig godt til rette i en udadvendt rolle, hvor du dagligt interagerer med mange forskellige interessenter og løser problemerne i fællesskab.

Vi lægger samtidig vægt på, at du:

  • har en stærk interesse for tal og data samt er hjemmevant i Excel
  • har lavet analyser og/eller økonomistyring i statsligt regi
  • kan kommunikere komplekse problemstillinger på en intuitiv og letforståelig måde både skriftligt og mundtligt
  • har stærke samarbejdsevner og kan navigere i en stor og kompleks organisation med forskelligartede mennesker og faggrupper
  • er ambitiøs med vilje til, og ønske om, at tage et stort ejerskab for at skabe konkrete resultater
  • er en holdspiller, der motiveres af at levere resultater og lykkes i fællesskab
Kontakt og ansættelsevilkår
Send din ansøgning inkl. CV og eksamensbevis via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest 30. august 2026. Spørgsmål vedr. stillingen besvares gerne af kontorchef Peter Herborg Bay Nielsen på tlf. 42 49 19 35. Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes løbende.

Der indgår en logisk test og en personanalyse i ansættelsesforløbet, og der vil blive indhentet straffeattest forud for ansættelsen.

Du bliver ansat på overenskomstvilkår i henhold til enhver tid gældende overenskomst for akademikere i staten (AC), overenskomst for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og It-medarbejdere (HK) eller overenskomst for fuldmægtige m.fl. (DTS) i Skatte- og Vækstministeriet. Der vil være mulighed for individuel forhandling og indplacering alt efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Ansættelsesområdet er Skatteministeriet med tilhørende institutioner. Dit arbejdssted vil være Osvald Helmuths Vej 4, 2000 Frederiksberg.

title: Business Intelligence Lead (Remote)
description:
Business Intelligence Lead

Location: Remote Nationwide

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Become a part of our caring community

The Business Intelligence Lead is an individual contributor role embedded into a digital product team. This is not a generalist analytics role but requires someone who has spent their career in product analytics, understands how digital product teams work, and can operate as a peer to senior product managers and designers rather than a support function beneath them. The right candidate has lived inside a product organization, shaped roadmap decisions with data, and knows the difference between reporting on what has happened and explaining why it matters.

Humana has articulated a strategic vision to drive the digital adoption and a digital-first strategy. The Consumer Digital Business Intelligence team provides support by partnering with digital product owners and enterprise partners in understanding not only the digital footprint but the upstream and downstream impact of digital behavior. We are dedicated to improving the experience of our members through delivering analytics and insights.

The Business Intelligence Lead solves complex business problems and issues using a variety of internal Humana data and tools. The Business Intelligence Lead works closely with product leaders, engineers, and designers to deliver insights related to digital activity, efficiency, emerging trends, process improvement, pilot measurement, and member, provider and associate experience. As a Business Intelligence Lead, you will:

  • Serve as the primary analytics partner to your assigned product team. Attending sprint reviews, PI planning, and discovery sessions as a full participant, not a data supplier

  • Own the measurement plan for your assigned product portfolio. Defining KPIs, funnels, and success metrics before they ship

  • Be the first touchpoint for product leader data needs, responsible for identifying solutions both home-grown and in partnership with other data and analytic teams, including our own data science team.

  • Evaluate the effectiveness of the digital product strategy and recommend adjustments when needed to drive outcomes.

  • Build and maintain product performance dashboards in PowerBI that drive active product decisions

  • Analyze member behavior across the digital experience, funnel drop-off, feature adoption, session depth, and engagement patterns

  • Work with Data Science teams to design and analyze A/B tests and experiments, communicate results clearly without overstating significance

  • Write and maintain SQL and Python to support analysis and automate recurring data pulls

  • Translate complex findings into clear, opinionated recommendations for product managers and senior leadership


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and 6+ years of experience in product analytics, OR Master's degree and 4+ years of experience in product analytics OR 8+ years of hands-on experience in product analytics without a degree

  • Prior experience embedded within a consumer-facing digital product organization

  • Proven ability to influence product roadmap and prioritization decisions with data

  • Strong SQL, Advanced PowerBI, and basic Python

  • Proven experience with product funnel and behavioral event data

  • A/B testing experience, test design, statistical interpretation and clear stakeholder communication

title: Chef for Familie- og ungeindsatsen i Center for Børn, Unge og Familier i Faxe Kommune
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for vores ambitiøse udvikling på det samlede udfører-område på det specialiserede børneområde i Faxe Kommune? Har du blik for både at udvikle opgaveløsningen i fht. borgerne og organisationen, således at medarbejdere trives og udvikler sig? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.



Har du stærke ledelsesmæssige kompetencer, erfaring fra det specialiserede børneområde og drives du af at udvikle og lede en stor organisation fyldt med medarbejdere og ledere, der brænder for at gøre en forskel for børn og unge i udsatte positioner?



Og har du blik for, hvordan almenområdet og det specialiserede børneområde er afhængige af hinanden, og har du ideer, viden og evner til at føre almenområdet og det specialiserede børneområde tættere sammen, så vi lykkes endnu bedre med alle børn og unge.



Så er det dig vi leder efter. Vi søger nemlig en engageret og dygtig chef til vores samlede udfører-område, der er en del af et samlet center med almenområdet og det specialiserede område for Børn, Unge og deres Familier i Faxe Kommune.

Vi tilbyder:

Som Chef for familie- og ungeindsatser får du ansvaret for vores interne familie- og ungeindsats, der er vores udfører på området.

Du får det overordnede ansvar for kommunens interne udførerorganisation, Familie- og Ungeindsatsen, der består af cirka 60 medarbejdere og ledere. Du indgår i en DUO-ledelse med Chef for Myndighed og Tidlig Forebyggelse. Sammen skal I sikre sammenhæng mellem myndighed, tidlig forebyggelse og indsatser til børn, unge og familier med behov for støtte og hjælp efter Barnet Lov samt stå i spidsen for den videre udvikling af hele Familieområdet. Chefen for familie- og ungeindsatser referer til centerchefen for center for børn, unge og familier.

Du får ligeledes ansvaret for opbygningen af en strategisk indkøbsfunktion i et tæt samarbejde mellem Myndighedsområdet og din egen udførerorganisation.

Chefområdet er en del af et samlet center for hele 0-18 års området, hvor vi er i gang med en spændende udvikling. Vi har fokus på at skabe helhed og sammenhæng i børnenes og de unges liv på tværs af 0-18 årsområdet – og mellem almenområdet og det specialiserede børneområde. Vi tror på, at vi skal styrke indsatsen på almenområdet og i det forebyggende arbejde for at sikre bedre rammer og muligheder for børn, unge og familier i udsatte positioner.



Vi er samtidig en kommune, hvor vi insisterer på at have arbejdspladser, hvor medarbejdere og ledere trives og har en fælles forståelse for, at vi er hinandens arbejdsmiljø. Vi tror på, at fokus på samarbejde og stærke arbejdsfællesskaber er nøglen til at sikre både trivsel og glæde - men også høj produktivitet blandt medarbejdere og ledere.



Så hvis du motiveres af ovenstående, og samtidigt er en dygtig og erfaren leder indenfor udfører- og indsatsdelen på det specialiserede børneområde, og du er optaget af at skabe og videreudvikle gode arbejdspladser, så er det dig, vi leder efter.



På det specialiserede børneområde i Faxe Kommune arbejder vi ud fra en politisk vedtaget udviklingsplan på området, suppleret af vores børne- og ungesyn.



Du kan se mere om stillingen i vedlagte job – og personprofil her: javascript:void(0)



Om dig:

Vi søger en Chef for Familie- og ungeindsatser, der evner både at lede for ved at gå forrest og vise retningen, og at lede efter læringspotentialer ved at søge de gode løsninger sammen med lederne og medarbejdere og anvende deres kompetencer i bestræbelserne på at skabe fortsat udvikling. Kort sagt en chef, der lytter, viser vej og ønsker at spille alle gode, samtidigt med at du kultiverer et miljø, hvor ideer og nytænkning ofte vokser ”fra neden”.



Vi ønsker en chef, der forstår og kan udvikle og vedligeholde et godt og konstruktivt ledelsesteam, der kan udfordre hinanden positivt og samtidigt sammen kan skabe den fælles udvikling i organisationen.



Du har en lederuddannelse, flere års erfaring som leder eller chef på det specialiserede børneområde, og du skal have forståelse for strategisk ledelse, organisationsudvikling og økonomistyring.



Du skal være i stand til at omsætte politiske strategier og beslutninger til udvikling, handlinger og tiltag. Mindst lige så vigtigt er det, at du også formår at sætte mål og retning, følge arbejdet til dørs og sikre implementering i bund, så ændringerne kommer til at leve i praksis.


Med din viden og ledelseserfaring fra det specialiserede børne- og ungeområde har du blik for den rivende udvikling det specialiserede børneområdet er i med fokus på udviklingen af indsatsviften i samarbejde med almenområdet og styrkelsen af empowerment-tankegangen i vores indsatser for børn, unge og deres familier og/eller netværk.

Du kan koble dig til vores grundlæggende værdimæssige børne- og læringssyn, om at børn aldrig er problemet – de viser problemerne i fællesskaberne og i lærings- og dannelsesmiljøerne.

Du samarbejder bredt og godt med alle samarbejdspartnere i og uden for organisationen, og du har blik for at skabe følgeskab omkring opgaverne og den strategiske udviklingsretning.



Vi forventer, at du mestrer oversættelsesopgaven både opadtil, nedadtil og udadtil på et højt niveau, og at du forstår og udlever det grundlæggende mindset om at ”vi lykkes kun sammen” – både sammen som professionelle og børn, unge og deres familier og/eller nærmeste og sammen som kolleger, og sammen som medarbejdere og ledere.




Ansættelsesforløbet:

Hvis du har lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte centerchef Dorthe Lund Nielsen på tlf. 3010 4172.

title: Senior Software Engineer- Customer Support
description:
Senior Software Engineer- Customer Support

About M&S

Marks & Spencer is transforming how it operates as a digital-first, engineering-led retailer. Our Digital & Tech teams build the services, platforms and experiences used by millions of customers and thousands of colleagues across stores, websites, apps and support functions.

We are ambitious about the future of retail. We aim to raise standards, do the right thing and create inclusive teams where people can bring their whole selves to work.

About the role

We are looking for a backend-focused Senior Software Engineer to design, build and operate the services and experiences that power our Contact Centre. You will work as a strong individual contributor within a multidisciplinary team, integrating Contact Centre as a Service (CCaaS) platforms such as Azure, Google, Zendesk and Twilio and helping customers find answers through effective FAQ and self-service experiences.

You will collaborate with engineers, Product, Architecture, Data, Security and Customer Service stakeholders. You will take ownership from discovery through delivery and live operation, balancing customer value, maintainability, security, performance and speed. The role is primarily backend engineering in Java, with opportunities to contribute to customer and colleague interfaces built with React and Next.js.

Due to high interest, this role may close earlier than advertised. We recommend applying as soon as possible.

What you’ll do

  • Design, develop, test, deploy and support reliable software across the full delivery lifecycle.
  • Translate product and business needs into clear technical approaches and incremental delivery plans.
  • Contribute to the design of APIs, services, integrations, data flows and event-driven solutions.
  • Build and maintain integrations with Zendesk, Twilio and other CCaaS capabilities, including messaging, telephony, case management and customer context.
  • Develop customer self-service and FAQ capabilities that provide accurate, accessible answers and a smooth hand-off to Contact Centre colleagues when further help is needed.

Who you are:

  • Proven experience delivering and operating robust software in a professional engineering environment.
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering principles, design patterns and maintainable code.
  • Experience developing backend systems, APIs and integrations, or equivalent depth in the relevant engineering discipline.
  • Strong backend development experience with Java and its associated frameworks and testing practices.
  • Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms; knowledge of Zendesk, Twilio or another CCaaS platform is particularly relevant.
  • Good understanding of automated testing, continuous integration and continuous delivery.

What’s in it for you

  • 20% colleague discount across M&S products and selected third-party brands after probation.
  • Competitive holiday entitlement, with the option to buy additional days.
  • Discretionary bonus schemes linked to personal and business performance.
  • Defined contribution pension scheme and life assurance.
  • Tailored induction, training and development opportunities.
  • Discounts and wellbeing support through the M&S Choices portal.
  • Family-friendly parental, adoption and neonatal policies.
  • Wellbeing support, including virtual GP access and support for you and your family.
  • One paid charity volunteering day each year.

Benefits and eligibility are subject to the applicable M&S terms and policies.

Everyone’s welcome

We are ambitious about the future of retail. We’re disrupting, innovating and leading the industry into a more conscientious, inspiring digital era. We’re transforming how we work together and offering our most exciting opportunities yet. Marks & Spencer strives to be an inclusive organisation, trusted and admired by our colleagues, customers and suppliers. Join us and make change happen.

We are committed to building diverse and representative teams, where everyone can bring their whole selves to work and be at their best. We support each other and work together to win together.

If you feel you'd benefit from any support or reasonable adjustments during any stage of the recruitment process, please don’t hesitate to let us know when completing your application. This information will be picked up by our team, so we can try and put steps in place to help you be at your best through this process.

description:

Location: GA - Atlanta, CT - Hartford

Remote Type: Hybrid

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Technology

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$99,100.00 - $163,400.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

What Is the Opportunity?

As a member of the Enterprise AI and Emerging Technology organization at Travelers, you'll be joining a strategic and collaborative team focused on transforming our business and technology capabilities leveraging best in class AI-enabled technology. We're looking for a Software Engineer I in the Enterprise AI Platforms organization to join our team focused on delivering agent harnesses and platform capabilities that enable and accelerate the development of AI applications across the enterprise.

• Will deliver harness capabilities that other engineering teams build on, including orchestration, tool integration, context management, and the guardrails around them.
• Engineers at this level work across the full architecture of product delivery from requirements gathering to maintenance and enhancement of existing systems.
• Will contribute to architecture and solution design in partnership with engineering, architecture, and product, and build SME-level depth in the technologies they own.
• This role is for engineers who take full ownership of what they develop and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

What Will You Do?

  • Build and operate agent harness capabilities consumed by engineering teams across the enterprise, working within the team's technical direction.
  • Integrate agents with tools, APIs, and enterprise systems, and make those integrations reliable under real load.
  • Advance test automation and deliver code against non-functional requirements: secure, observable, scalable, recoverable, financially responsible.
  • Contribute to application and solution design in partnership with architects, product owners, and consuming teams.
  • Own your assets end to end, including currency, vulnerability management, and production readiness.
  • Document your work so others can build on it, and actively deepen your expertise in the technologies you own.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of hands-on software development experience, including code you have shipped and supported in production.
  • Proficiency in Python, with exposure to TypeScript for AI integration work.
  • Hands-on experience building generative AI or agentic applications.
  • Experience using agentic coding tools, with an informed point of view on where they help and where they fall short.
  • Familiarity with the components of an agent harness: orchestration loops, tool interfaces, context and memory management, and guardrails.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud services.
  • Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration tools, including Kubernetes.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tooling such as GitHub Actions or Jenkins.
  • SME-level depth in at least one technical discipline, and the appetite to build more.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, including with partners outside engineering.
  • Agentic runtimes and harness platforms such as AWS AgentCore experience.
  • OSS agent frameworks such as Strands Agents or LangGraph experience.
  • Terraform, CDK, or an equivalent for provisioning cloud infrastructure experience.
  • Helm for Kubernetes application deployment experience.
  • Observability tooling and distributed tracing in production environments experience.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
  • 2 additional years of software engineering experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Bank of America:

title: Commercieel Adviseur Integrale Oplossingen
description:
De energievraagstukken van morgen vragen om nieuwe denkers en doeners. Als Commercieel Adviseur Integrale Oplossingen verbind jij klanten, kansen en oplossingen en speel je een sleutelrol in de energie transitie. Ontdek hoe jij het verschil kunt maken en kom op gesprek in Rosmalen:

We don't want to disappoint, but we only accept applicants that have a good command of the Dutch language and are already (or about to be) based in the Netherlands.

Hier krijg je positieve energie van

  • Het openen van deuren bij organisaties met complexe energie- en vastgoedvraagstukken en het bouwen aan relaties met strategische besluitvormers.

  • Het adviseren van klanten over integrale energieoplossingen en het vertalen van complexe uitdagingen naar concrete commerciële kansen.

  • Het samenwerken met collega’s uit verschillende disciplines om klanten vooruit te helpen én een zichtbare bijdrage te leveren aan de energietransitie.

Dit ga je doen als Commercieel Adviseur Integrale Oplossingen

De energietransitie stelt vastgoedeigenaren en -ontwikkelaars voor grote uitdagingen én kansen. Als Senior Accountmanager ben jij degene die deze organisaties helpt koers te bepalen. Je bouwt voort op je bestaande netwerk en ontwikkelt nieuwe relaties op binnen de vastgoedsector. Daarbij verdiep je je in de energie-uitdagingen van klanten, vertaal je hun ambities naar passende oplossingen en positioneer je Greenchoice Integrated als strategische partner in de energietransitie.

Vanuit jouw kennis van vastgoed, energie, techniek en energielevering voer je de regie over het commerciële traject: van eerste contact tot concrete businesscase. Je brengt klantvragen scherp in beeld, koppelt deze aan onze proposities en adviseert over integrale oplossingen, inclusief passende leveringscontracten. Zodra een klant besluit de volgende stap te zetten, neemt de Commercieel Ontwikkelaar de verdere uitwerking over. Zo help je organisaties de energietransitie succesvol te realiseren met ons als partner.

Jouw belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden:

  • New business ontwikkelen in een markt die volop in beweging is.

  • Complexe energievraagstukken vertalen naar slimme en haalbare oplossingen.

  • Bouwen aan strategische klantrelaties en versnellen van de energietransitie in de vastgoedsector.

Samen impact maken

Je wordt onderdeel van een ondernemend en hecht team dat volop in ontwikkeling is. De sfeer is open, energiek en samenwerkingsgericht: we helpen elkaar verder, delen kennis en vieren successen samen. Hoewel iedereen verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor zijn eigen resultaten, kijken we ook nadrukkelijk naar het gezamenlijke doel. Juist omdat we samen groeien, krijg je de kans om ervaring over te dragen, van elkaar te leren en samen te bouwen aan de volgende stap van het team én de business.

Hiermee laten we jouw energie branden

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van € 5.157 - tot € 7.367,- op basis van een 40-urige werkweek exclusief 8% vakantietoeslag.Een individueel keuzebudget van 8,33% van je bruto jaarsalaris waarmee je zelf keuzes kunt maken in arbeidsvoorwaarden. Zo kun je dit bedrag laten uitbetalen of bijvoorbeeld extra verlofdagen kopen. Je kunt (een deel van) het bedrag ook schenken aan een goed doel via onze samenwerking met The Social Handshake.

  • Een prestatiegerichte bonus van maximaal twee bruto maandsalarissen per jaar.

  • 26 vakantiedagen als je fulltime werkt en 8 uur per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk naar keuze.

  • Een leaseautoregeling, zodat jij je vrij kunt bewegen naar al je afspraken.

  • Diversiteit en inclusiviteit is belangrijk voor ons, ruil daarom gerust officiële culturele en religieuze feestdagen om voor dagen die beter aansluiten bij jouw achtergrond.

  • Volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen, onder meer door trainingen via onze Greenhouse Academy. Ook hebben we een aantrekkelijke studiekostenregeling voor ontwikkelactiviteiten buiten de deur. Lees meer over ontwikkeling in de FAQ.

  • Een uitgebreide pensioenverzekering via Zwitserleven, waarvoor jij als medewerker maar een kleine bijdrage levert, en een arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering van Nationale Nederlanden.

  • Benieuwd naar wat we nog meer bieden? Bekijk de overige arbeidsvoorwaarden.

En heb jij iets nodig om het werk voor jou mogelijk te maken? Laat het ons weten. We denken graag met je mee in mogelijkheden. Goed om te weten: ons kantoor is toegankelijk voor rolstoelen. Ook is het mogelijk om je werkplek naar jouw situatie aan te passen en kunnen we je voorzien in specifieke software.


We kunnen jouw energie goed gebruiken

Je bent een ondernemende netwerker die energie krijgt van het openen van nieuwe deuren en het bouwen aan duurzame klantrelaties. Je combineert commerciële slagkracht met strategisch inzicht en weet complexe energievraagstukken te vertalen naar kansen voor de klant. Daarbij werk je graag samen, deel je jouw kennis met collega's en neem je anderen mee in de groei van het team én de energietransitie.


Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een academische achtergrond en minimaal 5 jaar commerciële ervaring, waarvan meerdere jaren op strategisch niveau, en bent een volwaardige gesprekspartner voor senior beslissers.

  • Een bewezen trackrecord in new business en het ontwikkelen van langdurige commerciële relaties binnen een complexe omgeving.

  • Ervaring met complexe stakeholderomgevingen zoals de energie- of bouwsector, waarbij je verschillende belangen samenbrengt en richting geeft aan trajecten met meerdere betrokken partijen.

Solliciteer en kies voor team Green!

Enthousiast over deze baan? Reageer via de sollicitatiebutton. Als we een match zien, maken we graag zo snel mogelijk kennis. We wachten dus niet op de uiterlijke reactiedatum met het uitnodigen van kandidaten. Heb je nog vragen over de functie of de sollicitatie- en selectieprocedure? Neem dan contact op met Yvonne, HR Adviseur, via yvonne.derooij@greenchoice.nl

Waar Yvonne natuurlijk beschikbaar is voor jou als sollicitant, hoef je als recruiter geen reactie te verwachten. Acquisitie wordt niet gewaardeerd.

title: Offensive Security Lead
description:
Lead, Offensive Security

Location: Remote Nationwide

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Become a part of our caring community

We're hiring the technical leader of our red team, a hands-on Lead who runs our hardest adversary-emulation campaigns, sets how the team operates, owns the rules of engagement, and moves us into AI-augmented red teaming. You will own the craft: the tradecraft, the standards, the objective-based operations, and the safe, authorized conduct of offensive work.

Red teaming here is not vulnerability coverage and not automated control validation, it's objective-based adversary emulation: we measure whether the enterprise can detect, resist, and respond to a realistic adversary pursuing a mission objective, across network, social engineering, physical, and assumed-breach domains, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and validated with our defenders through purple teaming.

This is a remote role on a specialized offensive-security team, red teaming shoulder-to-shoulder with Penetration Testing, Breach & Attack Simulation, and Bug Bounty. Fridays are for research and development. You'll have Hack The Box Pro Labs and role-based paths, discretionary certification funding, and a conference/training budget.

What you'll own

  • The red-team tradecraft and standards. You set the methods, playbooks, and quality bar the team operates to. These are adversary emulation, C2 tradecraft, initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, defense evasion, and assumed-breach methodology — and keep them current as adversaries and defenses evolve.
  • The hardest campaigns. You scope, lead, and land the most complex objective-based operations end-to-end, and you're the technical escalation point when an operation hits a wall.
  • Rules of engagement and safe conduct. You own the authorization, scoping, deconfliction, and rules-of-engagement governance that keep offensive operations legal, in-scope, and safe.
  • AI-augmented red teaming, on two fronts. You drive how the team operates and matures agentic AI offensive tooling to sharpen planning, tradecraft research, evidence synthesis, reporting, and you lead adversarial testing of the enterprise's own production AI systems as targets.
  • Defensive impact and functional influence. You turn campaigns into executive-consumable risk narratives, advise leadership on the direction of the red-team function, and partner with detection engineering and the SOC to close the loop on what we found.

What you'll do

  • Set and govern the team's adversary-emulation methodology, C2 tradecraft standards, and evidence-quality bar; standardize how objective-based operations are scoped, executed, and reported.
  • Lead the most complex red-team campaigns, external/internal network, social engineering, assumed-breach, and full-scope objective operations, with full autonomy, and mentor Senior red teamers on tradecraft without being their manager.
  • Own rules of engagement: define authorization, scope, deconfliction, and safe-conduct standards for every operation, in partnership with the Associate Director and stakeholders.
  • Operate and mature agentic AI red-team tooling: apply it to improve campaign planning, adversary research, and reporting quality; evaluate AI-assisted output for accuracy and operational fit; and feed practitioner requirements back to the Offensive AI Engineering team who build the platform.
  • Test AI systems as targets: lead adversarial assessments of production AI-enabled systems, prompt injection (direct/indirect), agent/tool abuse, RAG/training-data poisoning, sensitive-data exposure, and guardrail/control bypass, including abusing an internal AI agent as a step toward a mission objective within a broader adversary-emulation campaign, mapped to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework.
  • Run purple-team engagements: measure detection and response (dwell time, alert fidelity, ATT&CK coverage) and drive detection-engineering improvements from what the campaign surfaced.
  • Advise leadership on the direction of the red-team function; identify gaps in coverage and defensive controls; propose new adversary-emulation approaches for emerging threats.

Your first 6–12 months

  • By 90 days: you've learned about our most complex prior campaigns and have had input on the planning/strategy for the next set, mapped the current state of our tradecraft and rules-of-engagement standards, and identified the first standards to raise.
  • By 6 months: the team operates to methodology and RoE standards you've set; agentic AI tooling is integrated into at least one core red-team workflow, and you've led at least one adversarial assessment of a production AI system.
  • By 12 months: AI-augmented red teaming and AI-system testing are a normal part of how the team works; you're advising leadership on the multi-quarter direction of the red-team function.


Use your skills to make an impact

Why this role, and why here

  • Real authority over the craft. You set the tradecraft, own the rules of engagement, and engage with key enterprise and information security leaders, incorporating their input into campaign objectives and Red Team strategy.
  • A program that's serious about AI. Red teaming here means both using AI to sharpen operations and testing the enterprise's own AI systems as adversarial targets, backed by a dedicated Offensive Platform/DevOps Engineering team building and integrating the tooling you help shape.
  • A mission that matters. Every campaign tells the business whether it can actually detect and respond to a real adversary. Fridays for R&D, HTB Pro Labs, cert funding, conference budget.

What we're looking for

You do not need to check every box below. If you're a deep red-team operator and leader who's started testing AI systems and is ready to bring AI fluency to a team, we want to talk.

You'll need:

  • 7+ years in red team, adversary emulation, or offensive security operations, with ~2 years leading complex operations or technical workstreams, setting the tradecraft and standards other operators follow.
  • Deep adversary-emulation tradecraft. Objective-based operations across the full attack lifecycle (initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, defense evasion), hands-on C2 (e.g. Cobalt Strike, Brute Ratel, Nighthawk, and Mythic), and Active Directory / Entra ID attack paths, with a track record leading the most complex campaigns autonomously.
  • Rules-of-engagement discipline. You've owned the authorization, scoping, deconfliction, and safe-conduct standards that keep offensive operations legal and in-scope, and you can represent the red team's risk to security leadership.
  • You've attacked AI. Hands-on adversarial testing of AI/LLM-powered systems (prompt injection, agent/tool abuse, jailbreaks), demonstrated ability to red-team emerging AI systems, or a strong red-team operator ready to build AI-attack capability and lead the team into it. We care about what you've done, not years on a framework that's only a few years old.
  • You operate agentic AI tooling. You've used modern AI-assisted or agentic offensive tooling in real operations and can judge where it helps, or you're a strong operator ready to adopt it and lead a team's move toward it.
  • You script. Advanced proficiency in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or Ruby for automation and custom red-team tooling.
  • You translate operations into defensive impact. Purple-team debriefs, detection-engineering feedback, and executive-consumable risk narratives that change what the business does next.

Certifications are a plus, not a gate (e.g. OSCP, OSEP, OSED, OSCE3, CRTO, CRTL, or equivalent advanced credentials.)

Strong pluses (any of these will make you stand out):

  • Contributing practitioner requirements to, or extending, agentic AI offensive tooling (multi-agent orchestration, MCP servers, LLM-as-judge) built by an AI-engineering team.
  • Deeper adversarial ML, model extraction/inversion, membership inference, data/supply-chain poisoning, and hands-on with PyRIT or Garak.
  • Malware development, custom tooling/implant development, or novel attack-chain research; published research or conference talks (DEF CON, Black Hat, BSides, x33fcon).
  • Threat-intelligence-driven emulation (mapping APT/eCrime TTPs to campaigns) and detection-engineering collaboration.

How you'll work

You'll embed with our offensive service lines and set the rigor the red team operates to. You'll own, with the Associate Director and stakeholders, the authorization and rules of engagement for every operation, and the acceptable use of AI tooling in engagements. You lead the red-team craft; the Associate Director leads the people; the Offensive AI Engineering team builds the platform you help mature.

title: Data Classification Engineer
description:
Position: Data Classification Engineer
Location: Abu Dhabi (Onsite)
Required Experience: 6+ years
Salary Range: AED 15,000-16,000

Summary:

We are looking for a Data Classification Engineer to help manage how we organize and secure our data. In this role, you will make sure that our data is properly labelled (e.g., Public, Confidential, Restricted) before we share it with our clients. You will manage our data classification tools, prepare reports for client reviews, and prove to our clients that their information is safe with us.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Label and Organize Data: Scan our databases to find sensitive information and apply the correct security labels.
  2. Manage Security Tools: Set up and run data tools (like Microsoft Purview or IDMC data governance) to automate data scanning and tagging.
  3. Prepare Client Reviews: Create clean, easy-to-understand reports showing clients how their data is classified and protected.
  4. Host Audits: Act as the main technical contact when clients want to log in and review our security tools or files.
  5. Fix Security Gaps: Work with our IT and database teams to fix any issues or mislabelled files found during client checks.
Skills & Requirements:
  1. Tool Experience: At least 2-3 years of hands-on experience using data tools like Microsoft Purview, IDMC Data governance and data cataloguing, Informatica EDC, Informatica AXON, IBM Watson Knowledge Catalog, or BigID, or similar programs.
  2. Database Basics: Good knowledge of SQL to look through data tables and columns.
  3. Audit Knowledge: Experience dealing with security audits or customer reviews (like UAE PDPL, ISO 27001, GDPR, or SOC 2).
  4. Communication: Ability to clearly explain technical security rules to clients and internal teams.
  5. Attention to Detail: Highly organized and precise when handling sensitive documents.

Education & Experience:
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience: 6+ years of experience working in data security, data governance, or IT auditing.

title: Virtual Chief Information Security Officer (vCISO) - OT & Cybersecurity Governance
description:
Job Description

Position Title: Virtual Chief Information Security Officer (vCISO) - OT & Cybersecurity Governance

Location

Hybrid (Remote with Scheduled Onsite Visits to Nchanga)

Reporting To

Service Delivery Director

Job Purpose

The Virtual Chief Information Security Officer (vCISO) will provide strategic leadership and governance for Cybersecurity and Operational Technology (OT) security program. The role is responsible for establishing and executing the cybersecurity strategy, developing governance frameworks, managing cyber risk, ensuring regulatory and audit compliance, overseeing security policies and controls, driving security awareness, coordinating incident response activities, and providing executive-level reporting to management and Board stakeholders.

The vCISO will act as trusted cybersecurity advisor, ensuring that IT and OT environments remain secure, resilient, compliant, and aligned with business objectives. The role will be particularly focused on securing mining operations, industrial control systems, SCADA environments, critical infrastructure, and enterprise technology platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Security Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and maintain Cybersecurity and OT Security Strategy.
  • Define short-term, medium-term, and long-term security roadmaps.
  • Align cybersecurity initiatives with business objectives and operational risks.
  • Advise executive leadership on security priorities, investments, and emerging threats.
  • Establish cybersecurity governance structures and steering committees.

OT Security Governance

  • Develop security controls and governance frameworks for Operational Technology (OT) environments.
  • Assess and improve security posture across mining operations, industrial networks, SCADA systems, and production environments.
  • Define network segmentation and security architecture standards between IT and OT environments.
  • Oversee OT cybersecurity risk management and mitigation programs.
  • Recommend security controls for critical industrial infrastructure.

Cyber Risk Management

  • Establish enterprise cybersecurity risk management frameworks.
  • Conduct cyber risk assessments and maturity assessments.
  • Maintain Cyber Risk Registers and remediation roadmaps.
  • Identify vulnerabilities, threats, and potential business impacts.
  • Present risk findings and mitigation plans to executive leadership and governance boards.

Security Governance & Compliance

  • Establish cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, and security baselines.
  • Define governance controls for identity management, privileged access, endpoint security, network security, cloud security, and OT environments.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and internal security requirements.
  • Support internal audits, external audits, and regulatory assessments.
  • Drive closure of audit observations and security findings.

Security Architecture & Control Oversight

  • Review and approve security designs for infrastructure and transformation initiatives.
  • Provide governance over firewalls, VPNs, endpoint protection, identity services, network security, cloud security, and monitoring platforms.
  • Ensure security-by-design principles are adopted across projects.
  • Review security exceptions and compensating controls.
  • Advise on technology investments and cybersecurity improvements.

Incident Response & Cyber Resilience

  • Establish and maintain Cyber Incident Response and Escalation Procedures.
  • Provide executive oversight during cybersecurity incidents.
  • Coordinate investigation, containment, recovery, and post-incident reviews.
  • Ensure lessons learned and corrective actions are implemented.
  • Develop cybersecurity resilience, business continuity, and disaster recovery governance programs.

Security Awareness & Culture

  • Develop and lead enterprise-wide cybersecurity awareness programs.
  • Conduct executive security awareness sessions and phishing simulations.
  • Promote cybersecurity best practices across business and operational teams.
  • Develop security communications, advisories, and awareness campaigns.
  • Improve overall security maturity and culture.

Executive & Board Reporting

  • Prepare cybersecurity dashboards and executive reports.
  • Present cybersecurity risks, compliance status, incidents, and strategic initiatives to management and board members.
  • Define and report cybersecurity KPIs, KRIs, and maturity metrics.
  • Provide recommendations on risk acceptance, mitigation priorities, and investment planning.
  • Facilitate periodic Cybersecurity Governance Review meetings.

Third-Party & Vendor Security Governance

  • Assess third-party cybersecurity risks.
  • Review vendor security controls and compliance requirements.
  • Participate in contract reviews from a security perspective.
  • Ensure suppliers and service providers comply with security expectations.
  • Monitor remediation of third-party security risks.

Required Skills & Experience

Core Cybersecurity Competencies

  • Cybersecurity Governance
  • OT/ICS/SCADA Security
  • Enterprise Security Architecture
  • Risk Management
  • Security Compliance & Audits
  • Incident Response Governance
  • Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery
  • Security Awareness & Training
  • Third-Party Risk Management
  • Security Program Development

Technical Knowledge

  • Industrial Control Systems (ICS)
  • SCADA Security
  • Network Security
  • Identity & Access Management (IAM)
  • Privileged Access Management (PAM)
  • Endpoint Security
  • Cloud Security (M365, Azure, AWS)
  • Vulnerability Management
  • Security Operations & SIEM
  • Data Protection & Information Security

Experience

  • 15+ years of IT and Cybersecurity experience.
  • 8+ years in Cybersecurity Leadership, Governance, or CISO-level functions.
  • Demonstrated experience securing OT, SCADA, Industrial, Mining, Utilities, Manufacturing, or Critical Infrastructure environments.
  • Experience leading audit readiness, risk management, and enterprise security programs.
  • Experience presenting to Executive Leadership and Board-level stakeholders.

Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Master's Degree preferred.

Preferred Certifications

  • CISSP
  • CISM
  • CRISC
  • CGEIT
  • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
  • IEC 62443 (Industrial Cybersecurity)
  • CCSP or equivalent cloud security certification
