Job Description

Become a part of our caring community

At Humana, we're building human-centered experiences that help people navigate healthcare with confidence. We're looking for a Content Designer to support content design and strategy across product experiences within our digital ecosystem.

As part of Humana's Consumer Digital team, you'll create and optimize content that helps people choose, understand, and use their healthcare plans. You'll work as an embedded partner within cross-functional teams, shaping experiences across web, mobile, apps, and emerging digital surfaces.

This role is ideal for someone who is continuing to grow their content design craft, combines strong content skills with product thinking, uses research and data to inform decisions, and enjoys solving complex communication challenges in a regulated environment. You'll collaborate closely with product, design, research, engineering, legal, compliance, and content design peers to create experiences that are clear, accessible, and user-centered.

What you’ll do

  • Own content design for assigned features, user journeys, and projects using research, analytics, and content assessments (audits, inventories, touchpoint mapping)

  • Translate research, stakeholder, and journey insights into clear, actionable digital experiences

  • Plan and execute content throughout the product lifecycle, including creation, review, approval, and quality assurance

  • Simplify complex healthcare information into clear, accessible content across UI, microcopy, and multi-channel experiences

  • Structure content for usability and findability, contributing to information architecture, navigation, and taxonomy

  • Partner with product management, design, research, engineering, legal, and compliance teams to deliver cohesive experiences

  • Apply and contribute to content guidelines, standards, reusable patterns, design systems, and supporting tools

  • Use analytics, feedback, and testing insights to identify opportunities and improve content performance

  • Contribute content recommendations during discovery, ideation, and iterative design activities

  • Identify content opportunities and recommend improvements that support user needs and business goals

Scope and impact

  • Own content for assigned features, user flows, and projects from discovery through optimization

  • Contribute to product decisions through content design, research insights, and human-centered design practices

  • Support scalable content systems, including information architecture, reusable patterns, and design system adoption

  • Improve content quality, clarity, consistency, and accessibility across experiences

  • Drive continuous improvement through measurement, testing, iteration, and feedback

Why this role matters

You'll help make healthcare experiences clearer, more accessible, and easier to navigate, enabling people to get the information they need to make confident decisions about their health. Through your work, you'll contribute to experiences that improve understanding, support business goals, and advance Humana's commitment to delivering human-centered healthcare solutions.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, content strategy, or a related discipline, with experience contributing content from discovery through delivery and iteration

  • Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to simplify complex or regulated information

  • Experience conducting content audits, leveraging research findings, and using data to inform content decisions

  • Working knowledge of information architecture, content structures (taxonomies, models), and findability, with familiarity in accessibility and brand/style standards

  • Experience collaborating within cross-functional product teams and a portfolio demonstrating content design work and user impact

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently while collaborating effectively across disciplines

  • Familiarity with human-centered design practices, UX processes, and design tools such as Figma

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare or other regulated industries

  • Familiarity with SEO and content optimization practices

  • Experience contributing to guidelines, templates, governance processes, or design systems

  • Knowledge of inclusive and accessible design principles

  • Experience working within agile product teams

Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.

Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Pay Range

The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.


$65,000 - $88,600 per year


This job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.

Description of Benefits

Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.

Application Deadline: 08-13-2026

About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. title: Senior Data Scientist, AI/ML and Anomaly Detection
description:
Senior Data Scientist / AI-ML & Anomaly Detection Lead

Team: IT

Location: US

Commitment: Contract

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Data Scientist / AI-ML & Anomaly Detection Lead based in United States.

This role leads the technical intelligence layer of a high-visibility government data and analytics initiative.
You will design and optimize anomaly detection engines that identify unusual spending, contract vulnerabilities, and fraud, waste, and abuse risks.
The position combines advanced data science, machine learning engineering, statistical analysis, and rigorous model validation.
You will work with complex, transaction-level datasets and build transparent, explainable analytical solutions suitable for auditors and investigators.
A major focus will be on achieving measurable accuracy, controlling false positives, and ensuring every model can be independently reproduced and validated.
The role is highly hands-on, with significant ownership over model architecture, feature engineering, thresholds, monitoring, and technical documentation.
This is a part-time consulting engagement, averaging 14–18 hours per week, with workload concentrated around key delivery and acceptance milestones.

Accountabilities:

    • Lead the modernization of an existing 11-rule proof-of-concept library, evolving deterministic analytics into a scalable enterprise detection framework.
    • Architect transaction-focused anomaly detection approaches, defining relevant data features, risk scores, tolerance thresholds, alert priorities, and detection criteria.
    • Develop, refine, and deploy supervised and unsupervised machine learning models where they provide measurable value beyond conventional business rules.
    • Apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques including classification, clustering, forecasting, feature engineering, and anomaly detection.
    • Establish rigorous model evaluation and calibration processes, including accuracy measurement, threshold optimization, and detailed false-positive and false-negative analysis.
    • Ensure all analytical models remain explainable and transparent, with human-readable reasoning and supporting evidence for every material anomaly or flagged transaction.
    • Build audit-ready validation datasets and technical test processes capable of demonstrating model accuracy, reproducibility, and compliance with defined performance thresholds.
    • Provide technical documentation, configuration baselines, test scripts, and system logs that enable independent government validation teams to reproduce and rerun analytical routines.
    • Implement monitoring approaches for model scoring, feature mapping, version control, data drift, and ongoing analytical performance.
    • Develop standardized methodologies for measuring the value generated by analytical insights, including potential cost avoidance, financial recovery, risk exposure, and investigative referrals.
    • Work with complex financial, procurement, contract, purchasing-card, and other transaction-level datasets to uncover patterns and potential risks.
    • Maintain a strong focus on scientific reproducibility, technical traceability, and defensible analytical evidence throughout the project lifecycle.
    • Support technical validation, milestone acceptance, and performance tuning activities as required, including periodic travel to Tallahassee, Florida.

      • Requirements:

      • 10+ years of comprehensive experience in data analytics and data science, including at least 5 years of hands-on machine learning engineering experience.
      • Demonstrated experience delivering data science, predictive modeling, or advanced analytics solutions within federal, state, military, or local government environments.
      • Advanced hands-on proficiency with Python and SQL for complex data manipulation, analysis, engineering, and model development.
      • Deep expertise in supervised and unsupervised machine learning, classification, clustering, statistical forecasting, anomaly detection, and advanced feature engineering.
      • Proven ability to evaluate and calibrate models, establish appropriate thresholds, and analyze the operational impact of false positives and false negatives.
      • Experience translating model outputs into defensible, audit-ready evidence rather than relying solely on probability scores or opaque predictions.
      • Strong understanding of scientific reproducibility, including the creation of technical documentation, configuration baselines, validation artifacts, and materials that support independent third-party replication.
      • Experience working with highly diverse, transaction-level datasets, particularly financial, procurement, contract management, purchasing-card, or related ledger data.
      • Prior experience developing fraud, waste, abuse, improper-payment, financial-crime, or corporate-risk analytics is strongly preferred.
      • Experience working with oversight-oriented data from government agencies or comparable public-sector environments is a plus.
      • Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks, MLflow, or Azure Machine Learning in secure government cloud environments is preferred.
      • Familiarity with hybrid detection architectures combining deterministic business rules with machine learning-based anomaly detection is highly desirable.
      • Experience with model cards, explainability frameworks, and structured human-in-the-loop validation workflows is a strong advantage.
      • Must be a U.S.-based citizen or resident and able to successfully complete an FDLE Level II background screening, including fingerprinting, within 5 business days of contract award.
      • Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate specific government project experience, including the agency served, analytical problem addressed, technical approach, individual contribution, deployment and validation status, and measurable outcomes.

        • Benefits:

        • Part-time consulting engagement averaging 14–18 hours per week.
        • Remote work within the United States.
        • Flexible workload structure, with additional hours concentrated around major project milestones, technical validation, and government acceptance activities.
        • Milestone- and deliverable-based fixed-price compensation structure.
        • Opportunity to contribute to a high-visibility government Decision Intelligence initiative addressing financial oversight, risk detection, and fraud, waste, and abuse.
        • Exposure to advanced machine learning, anomaly detection, data engineering, and explainable AI applications in a complex public-sector environment.
        • Periodic travel to Tallahassee, Florida, as required by project activities.
        • Opportunity to work on a technically demanding initiative involving large-scale, multi-agency data and measurable analytical performance requirements.

title: Information System Security Officer - Senior
description:
In support of a challenging, critical, and rewarding program that provides integrated voice, video, and data services throughout the Information Technology lifecycle, Amentum is seeking a Senior Information System Security Officer to join our dynamic team of IT professionals dedicated to fostering a positive and collaborative work environment. You must be a critical thinker, have a strong work ethic, and be able to work independently or as a member of a team in a dynamic environment. We value candidates who are detail-oriented while also being able to think and react quickly to emerging and unique problem sets. To be successful, you must be able to rapidly adapt and learn how to operate the front and back end of new products and processes.

Work Schedule:

  • 5 Days (Mon – Fri); 8 hrs/Day; 40 hrs/wkly

Essential Responsibilities:

The duties and responsibilities of the Senior Information System Security Officer include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Generate and maintain the complete security Body of Evidence (BoE) while leading the A&A activities according to the Risk Management Framework (RMF) processes (ICD 503, CNSSI-1253, NIST 800-37, NIST 800-53, etc.) for all multiple information systems.
  • Lead the development and maintenance of information security policies, standards, and control procedures to enable compliance with RMF.
  • Complete Security Authorization packages, to include System Security Plans, Security Assessment Reports, POA&M summaries, and a Continuous Monitoring Plan/assessment schedule within XACTA, and present executive briefings to senior management.
  • Conduct thorough auditing of security information and events utilizing advanced tools like Splunk and NESSUS to detect and mitigate potential threats, ensuring the integrity of the enterprise.
  • Ensure security risk assessments are conducted as appropriate on any system upgrades, software/hardware changes, etc.
  • Ensure security authorization boundaries are properly defined and captured in the system security plans, and that all interconnection agreements are in place and current.
  • Ensure system security controls contain accurate implementation statements and assessment results, and that appropriate artifacts are completed to support findings; provide hands-on assistance as appropriate.
  • Ensure POA&Ms have appropriate milestones, accurate description of the weaknesses and remediation, estimated cost and realistic due dates providing hands-on assistance to components as necessary.
  • Maintain day-to-day security posture and continuous monitoring of all Information Systems.
  • Review system vulnerability scans, verify implementation of DISA STIGs, and ensure other security relevant information system configuration tasks are completed.
  • Perform test/evaluation of required technical security controls including performing certification tests and periodic inspections of information systems.
  • Develop and conduct test procedures for verification A&A, RMF safeguards to meet customer requirements based NIST publications.
  • Assess changes to an IS by performing periodic self-inspections, tests, and reviews of the IS program to ensure that systems are operating as authorized/accredited and that conditions have not changed; ensure corrective actions are taken for identified findings and vulnerabilities.

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

  • Must have active Top-Secret clearance with SCI or TS with the ability to acquire SCI
  • 8 years of relevant experience
  • In-depth knowledge of Microsoft Windows OS (client and server) and familiarity with Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL).
  • Experience with security configurations across multiple operating systems in various environments, to include Windows and Linux, utilizing Active Directory/Group Policy
  • Experience in the development of technical documentation to include artifacts required to support Assessment and Authorization (A&A) under the Risk Management Framework
  • Experience with XACTA, ACAS/NESSUS, Trellix, and Splunk
  • Experience with DISA STIGs and DISA Viewer
  • Experience with risk
  • 2 years of knowledge and experience with NESSUS/ACAS and Trellix administration
  • Must be able to work a 40-hour work week, normally Monday through Friday.
  • Ability to work overtime during critical peaks and be available to meet last-minute requests for overtime if needed.
  • Ability to travel (5-10%) primarily within 75 miles.
  • Familiarity with MS Office applications such as Excel, Word, Outlook, SharePoint, Project, and Visio.
  • Exceptional attention to detail; excellent verbal and written communication skills; strong critical thinking, organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a dynamic environment.

Security Clearance Required:

Must have active Top-Secret clearance with SCI or TS with the ability to acquire SCI

Minimum Education:

Bachelor’s degree in IT related field

Minimum Years of Experience:

8 years of relevant experience

Required Certifications:

Must possess or be able to obtain one of the following 8140 IAT Level II or III baseline certifications before start date:

  • Level II certs include – CCNA Security, CySA+, CND, Security+ CE
  • Level III certs include – CASP CE, CCNP Security, CISA, CISSP (or Associate)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Previous supervision and/or participation with Cybersecurity Assessments and Authorizations
  • Familiarity and the ability to aid with the cybersecurity tools such as ForeScout, Ivanti, and Trellix

Other Responsibilities:

Safety - Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks and serving on safety committees and teams.

Quality - Quality is the foundation for the management of our business and the keystone to our goal of customer satisfaction. It is our policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Accordingly, each employee must conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts. PURPOSE OF POSITION

The purpose of the End User Support Systems Administrator is to ensure the seamless operation of Microsoft-based end-user systems, providing top-tier technical support to end users, optimizing system security, and fostering effective collaboration with clients. They play a pivotal role in enhancing organizational efficiency and technological proficiency. Their role encompasses safeguarding data, supporting colleagues, and contributing to process improvements.

Service Delivery:

  • Administer, configure, and maintain Microsoft-based end-user systems, including Windows operating systems, Office 365, and related software applications.
  • Provide technical support to end users, troubleshooting hardware, software, and network issues promptly and effectively.
  • Implement and manage endpoint security solutions to protect against threats and vulnerabilities, ensuring data confidentiality and integrity.
  • Create, manage, and deactivate user accounts, ensuring that proper access controls and security protocols are adhered to.
  • Maintain system stability and security by monitoring and applying software updates, patches, and security fixes on a daily basis.
  • Design and execute workstation-related data backup and recovery strategies to ensure data availability and integrity.
  • Participate in project initiatives, including on-site infra related projects.

  • Independently coordinate project tasks and contributes to the achievement of project objectives.

Technologies

  • Deploy, configure, and manage virtual machines (VMs) and other Azure resources that end users rely on.
  • Create and manage user accounts, groups, and roles in Azure AD.
  • Enforce and create compliance policies (password policies, multi-factor authentication policies and identity protection policies, conditional access policies) and regulatory requirements within Azure.
  • Monitor resource usage on Azure to optimise cost and performance.
  • Implement Azure Firewall and Azure VPN Gateway for network security.
  • Configure and manage Azure Backup for data protection.

SharePoint Responsibilities

  • Create and manage user accounts, groups, and permissions within SharePoint.
  • Create, configure, and manage SharePoint site collections by setting up access controls and permissions to align with business needs.
  • Manage document libraries, lists, and content types within SharePoint.
  • Implement metadata and tagging strategies for efficient content organization and search.
  • Develop and maintain workflows using SharePoint Designer, Microsoft Power Automate (formerly Flow), or other automation tools.
  • Implement and manage backup and disaster recovery strategies for SharePoint data.

O365 Responsibilities

  • Manage Exchange Online for email services, including configuring mailboxes, distribution lists, and email routing.
  • Configure and support email clients (Outlook, mobile devices, etc.).
  • Implement and maintain Microsoft Teams for real-time collaboration and communication.
  • Support the use of Microsoft 365 apps like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneNote.
  • Configure data loss prevention (DLP) policies to protect sensitive information.
  • Monitor security threats and incidents using tools like Microsoft Defender for Office 365.

Customer Service

  • Collaborate closely with clients to understand their IT requirements and recommend technology solutions to the EUS teams to enhance their operations.
  • Conduct end-user training sessions to enhance their IT proficiency and awareness.

Documentation & Reporting

  • Create and maintain accurate and up-to-date technical documentation, including system configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Generate and share monthly reports on system performance, security, and compliance with clients.

Teamwork

  • Collaborate with IT team members to identify recurring issues, propose solutions, and contribute to process improvements.
  • Provide technical support and mentorship to the First Responder Team.
  • Support fellow team members to ensure the team succeeds collectively.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to the next level of support personnel.

Personal Development

  • Demonstrates a proactive approach to personal, technical, and career development.
  • Always maintains a professional demeanour in all interactions.
  • Stays current with the latest technology trends, products, and solutions.
  • Ensures efforts and contributions are aligned with the organization's OKRs to enhance goal achievement and impact.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

Required

  • Minimum 1-3 years’ Infrastructure experience in an IT services company.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (preferred).
  • A+.
  • N+.

  • At least one of the following or proven experience working on or towards achieving the following:
    • MS-102: Microsoft 365 Administrator
    • MS-700: Teams Administrator Associate

Beneficial

  • Apple - Support Essentials for macOS 14

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Knowledge of security best practices and endpoint security solutions.

title: Bookingassistenter til Check-In i Rødby
description:
Bookingassistenter til Check-In i Rødby

Introduktion

Hos Scandlines søger vi engagerede og servicemindede kolleger til vores check-in i Rødby. Vi leder efter 2 fuldtidsmedarbejdere og 4 afløsere, der helt naturligt føler et ansvar for, at vores kunder bliver budt smilende velkommen til Scandlines.

Du bliver en del af et professionelt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø, hvor samarbejde, kommunikation og kundeservice er i fokus. Hos Scandlines er ingen dage ens, og vi lægger vægt på trivsel, faglig udvikling og en stærk holdånd.

Jobbeskrivelse

Som bookingassistent i Check-In i Rødby kommer du tæt på vores kunder og bliver deres første kontaktpunkt. Du spiller en central rolle i at skabe en positiv oplevelse gennem professionel kundeservice, billetsalg og tydelig vejledning.

Hos os er det afgørende, at kunderne møder et engageret team, der sætter en ære i at være høflige, imødekommende og servicemindede.

Arbejdstider
Scandlines opererer 24/7, så du skal være indstillet på skiftende arbejdstider, herunder nætter, weekender og helligdage. Det er derfor en forudsætning, at du kan transportere dig til og fra arbejde og ikke er afhængig af offentlig transport.

Ansvarsområder

En arbejdsdag kunne bestå af følgende opgaver:

  • At være i vores billetsalg og sælge billetter til personbiler, busser og lastbiler
  • Være behjælpelig ved vores automatiske check-in
  • Ekspedition af busser og lastbiler, herunder kontrollere dokumenter vedrørende farligt gods
  • Hjælpe vores bilplads med at servicere vores kunder ved ombord kørsel og håndtering i opmarchbanerne
  • Udfærdige og afslutte manifester

Personlige kompetencer

Vi forventer at:

  • Du er stabil og fleksibel
  • Du kan tale og forstå dansk som arbejdssprog
  • Du kan tale engelsk – og kan du tysk, er det en fordel

Som person er du udadvendt og udpræget teamplayer. Vi forventer, at du kan bevare overblikket i pressede situationer og samtidig være
serviceminded med en høflig og positiv fremtræden overfor såvel kunder som kollegaer. Du er en god kollega der altid støtter op og bidrager til at holdet når i mål.

Vi tilbyder

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn i henhold til gældende overenskomst
  • Medarbejderrabatter og adgang til forplejning
  • Udlevering af arbejdstøj og klare uniformsregler
  • Et uformelt og trivselsorienteret arbejdsmiljø med fokus på samarbejde
Ansøgningsfrist

31-08-2026

Yderligere oplysninger

Hvis du vil vide mere om jobbet, kan du kontakte Skifteholdsleder Christian Hendriksen på mail christian.hendriksen@scandlines.com

Du kan også besøge vores Facebook og Instagram eller finde mere information på .

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV via nedenstående link. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og indkalder til samtale. Vi forbeholder os derfor retten til at tage opslaget ned, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Scandlines er et moderne og innovativt rederi med en grøn vision for fremtiden. Vi har en stolt kultur baseret på et stærkt dansk-tysk samarbejde og en maritim historie, som rækker tilbage til 1872.

Scandlines driver to færgeruter med høj kapacitet og frekvens. Seks af vores syv færger er hybridfærger, og to er desuden udstyret med et innovativt rotorsejl – og det bidrager til at gøre vores færger grønnere.

Vores kerneforretning består i at levere en effektiv og pålidelig transportservice til både passagerer og fragtkunder. Fokus i alle vores aktiviteter – uanset om det er om bord på vores færger eller i vores BorderShops – er at give vores kunder en god oplevelse.

Med 37.500 afgange fordelt på syv færger transporterede Scandlines i 2024 tæt på 6,4 millioner passagerer, over 1,6 millioner personbiler og 700.000 fragtenheder på ruterne Rødby-Puttgarden og Gedser-Rostock.

title: Accountmanager Oostelijke provincies
description:
Wil jij veel vrijheid, een eigen klantenportefeuille én direct invloed op je commerciële succes? Als accountmanager Oostelijke provincies bij DPD Nederland ben je verantwoordelijk voor jouw rayon Oostelijke provincies: Gelderland, Overijssel en een deel van Drenthe. Je bouwt bestaande klantrelaties verder uit en haalt actief nieuwe klanten binnen. Met veel zelfstandigheid, een leaseauto en een bonusregeling krijg je alle ruimte om resultaten te behalen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Lees verder en ontdek of deze baan bij jou past.

Wat ga je doen?

Je rapporteert aan de Sales Manager Noord en werkt samen met 4 collega-accountmanagers. Iedereen beheert zijn eigen rayon, maar jullie helpen elkaar waar nodig. Een groot deel van je tijd besteed je aan het onderhouden en uitbreiden van bestaande klantrelaties. Daarnaast spot je commerciële kansen en zet je deze om in nieuwe business.

Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden

  • Bezoeken van klanten en prospects binnen jouw rayon.

  • Uitbouwen van bestaande klantrelaties door up- en cross-selling.

  • Genereren van nieuwe business bij MKB-bedrijven.

  • Signaleren en benutten van commerciële kansen.

  • Adviseren van klanten over de logistieke oplossingen van DPD.

  • Opstellen en opvolgen van offertes.

  • Vastleggen van klantinformatie en activiteiten in Salesforce.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris tussen € 3.651,25 en € 5.941,98 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring, met ruimte om door te groeien tot € 5.216,08 bruto per maand.

  • Een aantrekkelijke bonusregeling en een leaseauto.

  • Een functie van 38,75 uur (1 fte) per week.

  • De mogelijkheid om hybride te werken inclusief een netto thuiswerkvergoeding en flexibele werktijden.

  • Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub.

  • 28 vakantiedagen (+ optie tot bijkoop) en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Veel extra’s, zoals een collectieve zorgverzekering en een aantrekkelijk pensioen (3,55% eigen bijdrage).

Wat neem je mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur commercieel.

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring als accountmanager in de buitendienst binnen de logistieke of transportsector.

  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

  • In het bezit van een rijbewijs B.

  • Ervaring met relatiebeheer en acquisitie.

  • Commerciële drive en resultaatgerichte instelling.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

Solliciteren

Solliciteer direct bij DPD door op de rode knop ‘solliciteren’ te klikken. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op.

Heb je eerder vragen? Neem gerust contact op met onze corporate recruiter, Donne van der Wal via +31 6 29 989 532.

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

Within the CoE organisation, the Data and Digital Catalyst (DDC) organisation drives the modernisation of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science and accelerate decision-making.

One of the Engineering Capability teams in the DDC Organization is called Solutions. The solutions team is building a modernized and interconnected computational and data ecosystem. On top of the Data Ecosystem we are building engineering solutions to accelerate the work done by our Computational and Bench Scientists and enable the work done on ML/AI. Our team specializes in building Data Pipelines and Applications for data acquisition, collection, storage, transformation, linkage and sharing.

Join our team, where you will shape the future of our data solutions. In this pivotal role, you will lead a talented team of engineers to design and deliver innovative engineering solutions that impact stakeholders across our global organization, from lab scientists to AI specialists. title: Authorization Coordinator
description:
Authorization Coordinator

Job Overview


Location/Schedule: This position is located at the Hope Center located in SE Portland, OR. The schedule is Monday through Friday - 8:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.

Position: Authorization Coordinator

Program: Enhanced Care Services

Cascadia's Mission and Vision:

Mission: Cascadia Health delivers whole health care – integrated mental health and addiction services, primary care, and housing – to promote hope and support the well-being of the communities we serve.

Vision: We envision a community where everyone benefits from whole health care, experiences well-being, and has a self-directed, connected life.

Position Description: The Authorization Coordinator provides administrative support essential to Cascadia Health’s trauma-informed approach. This position completes and submits service authorization and reauthorization requests for clients, appeals denials, and assists in correcting service documentation errors to prevent revenue loss. Working in collaboration with multiple departments, the Authorization Coordinator ensures that service utilization documentation aligns with Cascadia’s mission and supports the financial integrity of the organization.

Essential Responsibilities

This position description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities or an all inclusive job description.

  • Submit and track service authorizations and reauthorizations for clients in residential and outpatient programs.

  • Work with leadership and clinicians to obtain necessary information and complete the denial appeal process.

  • Regularly review insurance systems to monitor activity, address denials, and correct service documentation errors.

  • Verify insurance details, update Electronic Medical Records (EMR), and maintain accuracy in client records.

  • Complete annual audits and maintain financial records compliance.

  • Collaborate with other departments to support Cascadia’s mission, vision, and values.

  • Serve as the point of contact for self-pay functions, adjudicating applications, tracking balances, and reconciling accounts.

  • Assist clients with insurance applications and support Oregon Health Plan enrollments.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education:

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent required; a QMHA (Qualified Mental Health Associate) preferred.

Experience:

  • Two years’ experience in administrative coordination, preferably in healthcare.

Specialized Skills and Knowledge:

  • Proficiency in Word processing, Excel, and database applications.

  • Strong data entry, typing (50 wpm), and verbal/written communication skills.

  • Ability to travel to various Cascadia sites as needed.

Other:

  • Ability to commute to various Cascadia sites and/or locations as required.

Working Conditions

Work is performed at multiple Cascadia sites, however the primary assigned site is an essential location for many of the organizational communications and duties. The nature of the work dictates that the Residential Authorization Coordinator is flexible and able to move from site to site as need arise. Work hours are typically standard business hours, Monday through Friday, 8:30 am-5:00 pm. Daily routines may be hectic; meal periods and breaks are subject to interruption.

Mental Demands: The work assigned is diverse and involves facing new and unusual circumstances where clinical and administrative outcomes could have negative effects on employee morale and/or client services. The work requires the incumbent’s strong organization of time and resources to ensure that tasks are managed in an effective and proactive manner. Time management skills are important to handle program changes, responding to crises, regular interruptions, and the like.

Physical Demands: A typical work day consists of sitting at a desk and utilizing computers and other office equipment.

Cascadia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at 503.963.7654.

  • Supplemental Insurance

Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur is looking for top talent to join the team.

Four Seasons Hotel and Residences is located in the Golden Triangle neighborhood, Kuala Lumpur’s thriving business and financial district. The Hotel is part of a 65-storey mixed-use tower that will include 242 Four Seasons Private Residences, 27 serviced apartments, a 209-key Four Seasons Hotel and a six- floor of 250,000 square foot luxury retail podium, collectively known as Four Seasons Place Kuala Lumpur.

The latest addition to the city’s dramatic skyline and a vibrant hub for both business and leisure travelers, Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur will be conveniently located in close proximity to the city’s major attractions, including the Petronas Twin Towers and the Kuala Lumpur City Centre (KLCC). Often referred to as a “city within a city,” the KLCC will offer designer shopping, fine dining, and the best of the city’s electric nightlife. Founded in 1960, Four Seasons continues to define the future of luxury hospitality with extraordinary imagination, unwavering commitment to the highest standards of quality, and the most genuine and customized service. Seamstress

This role supports the seamless operation of the laundry department by maintaining the appearance, functionality, and longevity of all assigned textile items while delivering efficient and timely service.

  • Operate and maintain sewing machines, pressing equipment, and other tailoring tools safely and efficiently.

  • Inspect uniforms and linens for damage, wear, and quality, ensuring repairs are completed to a high standard.

  • Ensure employee uniforms are properly fitted and altered as required.

  • Maintain accurate records of alterations, repairs, and inventory when required.

  • Ensure compliance with hotel policies, health and safety regulations, and departmental procedures.

  • Report damaged equipment or replacement needs promptly to the supervisor.

  • Support laundry operations and perform other related duties as assigned.

What You Bring:

  • High school diploma or equivalent; vocational training in tailoring, dressmaking, or garment construction is an advantage.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a seamstress, tailor, or garment technician, preferably in a luxury hotel, hospitality, or commercial laundry environment.

  • Proficient in garment alterations, repairs, hemming, pattern adjustments, and hand and machine sewing techniques.

  • Experience operating industrial sewing machines, overlock machines, steam irons, and pressing equipment.

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing high-quality workmanship.

  • Good organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.

  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

  • Physically able to stand for extended periods and safely handle sewing and pressing equipment.

  • Must be able to speak, read, and write basic English and Bahasa Malaysia.

  • Must have the right to work in Malaysia.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary, wages, and a comprehensive benefits package

  • Excellent training and development opportunities

  • Complimentary accommodation at other Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts

  • Complimentary dry cleaning for employee uniforms

  • Complimentary employee meals

Work Type: Full Time

Join Our Team

Join a team that is built on mutual respect, collaboration, creativity and a commitment to the highest quality of service. Four Seasons Hotel Kuala Lumpur provides guests with a haven of serenity and luxury in a bustling city. Four Seasons provides employees with the same level of care that we expect to be shared with our guests. We have been ranked in FORTUNE Magazine’s 100 Best Companies to work for since 1998.

Be a champion of the Golden Rule: Do unto others as you would have them do unto you

Be part of a cohesive team with opportunities to learn, grow and develop

Be recognized for excellence

title: Director of DevOps and Release Management
description:
Director of DevOps and Release Management

Location: CT - Hartford, MN - St. Paul

Remote Type: Hybrid

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Technology

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$139,400.00 - $230,000.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers is seeking a Director of Software Engineering to join our organization as we grow and transform our Technology landscape. Individual will complete advanced software end to end engineering tasks that span many parts of a system including designing, developing, analyzing, configuring, testing, debugging, troubleshooting, documenting, health monitoring/alerting, and implementing based on user or system specifications. Individual will also consult with users to determine hardware, software or system functional specifications, manage the effective use of resources, act as subject matter expert across multiple applications, systems and technologies, leverage technical and business knowledge to drive the planning and execution of complex initiatives, participate in the design/ development process, and provide technical leadership, while leading a team of SWE.

What Will You Do?

  • People Leadership – Manage all aspects of HR accountability for the team, including hiring, performance management, career development, compensation decisions, and fostering an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture.
  • Lead a team of Software engineers by providing technical guidance and mentorship while modeling Travelers' leadership behaviors.
  • Direct complex design, development, analysis, configuration, testing, debugging, troubleshooting, documenting, health monitoring/alerting, and implementation based on user or system specifications for impactful and high-visibility tasks.
  • Lead investigation and resolution efforts for critical, high impact problems, defects, and incidents.
  • Seek opportunities where technology can be utilized to improve the business and provide more efficient processes.
  • Apply knowledge of current industry trends and techniques to formulate solutions for software engineering problems.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • 5 years of related experience; including insurance / financial services industry experience.
  • Hands-on experience with GitHub Actions or equivalent enterprise pipeline tooling.
  • Demonstrated experience leading or coordinating release management processes across multiple concurrent workstreams in a large enterprise environment.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing current technology trends and techniques (e.g., cloud-based solutions leveraging microservices).
  • Interprets internal/ external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve SDLC processes.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Ownership – Demonstrated experience designing, managing, and optimizing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tooling; ability to drive pipeline standardization and maturity across multiple engineering teams.
  • Release Governance & Change Management – Proven track record establishing and enforcing release management processes, including change advisory oversight, release calendaring, and go/no-go decision frameworks across complex, multi-team delivery environments.
  • DevSecOps Practices – Familiarity with integrating security tooling (SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, secrets detection) into CI/CD pipelines; experience partnering with security teams to shift left and maintain compliance without sacrificing delivery velocity.
  • BI Platform Context – Experience working with or enabling engineering teams operating on platforms such as HSP, CPC, TravPorter, and Kafka; ability to tailor DevSecOps practices to the constraints and requirements of a complex insurance technology ecosystem.
  • Cross-Team Coordination – Demonstrated ability to align and coordinate across multiple BI DevSecOps teams, driving consistency in tooling, process, and release standards while respecting team autonomy and delivery cadences.
  • Delivery - Advanced delivery skills including the ability to determine the software design strategy and methodology to be used for efforts, use automated tests, analysis, and informed feedback loops to ensure the quality and production readiness of work before release, monitor the health of work efforts and that of adjacent systems.
  • Domain Expertise - Demonstrated track record of domain expertise including the ability to develop business partnerships and influence priorities by identifying solutions that are aligned with current business objective and closely follow industry trends relevant to domain, understanding how to apply them, and sharing knowledge with coworkers.
  • Problem Solving - Strong problem solver who utilizes data and proofs of concepts to find creative solutions to difficult problems, reflects on solutions, measuring their impact, and uses that information to ideate and optimize.
  • Also adept at making decisions that involve a significant number of factors with broad implications.
  • Communication - Strong communicator who possesses the ability to describe technology concepts in ways the business can understand, document initiatives in a concise and clear manner, collaborate effectively with teammates and others regardless of role, quickly extract core issues from discussions and meetings, give and receive constructive feedback, offer help when asked, and ensure everyone has a chance to share their thoughts and are heard; an attentive and empathetic listener.
  • Leadership - Advanced leadership skills with the ability to take action even when there is no clear owner, inspire and motivate others, and be effective at influencing team members.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
  • 6 additional years of software engineering experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

title: Data Engineer
description:
• X2 Full time, fixed term roles available until 30 June 2027
  • Geelong office location, with flexible hybrid working
  • Offering a competitive starting base salary of $136,500 plus super and benefits

Care in Action

With a career at the TAC, you’ll be helping us look out for the lives of everyone who travels on Victoria’s roads. That’s care in action.

Find out more about our shared purpose, and what drives every one of us.

Right now, we’re seeking two Data Engineers who will play their part in this shared purpose, while also supporting the progress of clients and colleagues so they can achieve great things. That’s truly rewarding work that will help us continue to deliver life‑critical services where it matters.

About the role

As a Data Engineer, you’ll design, build and optimise modern, scalable data pipelines and Databricks‑based solutions that enable high‑quality insights across the TAC. This is a hands‑on technical role where you’ll work deeply with Python (PySpark), SQL, Azure cloud technologies and Databricks to deliver reliable, high‑performing data products.

You’ll thrive in an agile, fast‑moving environment, applying contemporary engineering practices, automation and continuous improvement to ensure our data foundations are robust, efficient and ready to support advanced analytics and AI use cases.

About the Team

This role sits within the Performance Insights & Analytics branch in the broader Performance, Risk & Strategy division, working closely with data engineers, analysts, data scientists and product teams to deliver high‑value data solutions.

You’ll be supported by a Manager who values clarity, autonomy and technical excellence, and you’ll collaborate with a team known for being curious, adaptable and committed to making the complicated simple.

What we’re looking for

Hands‑on technical expertise

You have strong, hands‑on experience building robust data pipelines using Python (PySpark), SQL and Azure technologies such as Databricks, Data Factory, Synapse and Data Lake. You work confidently end‑to‑end across ingestion, transformation, modelling and optimisation. You’re skilled at identifying platform‑level non‑functional requirements and proactively refining solutions to meet them, consistently improving delivery speed and quality.

Adaptable and agile‑minded

You’re comfortable working in an agile delivery environment, iterating quickly, managing competing priorities and adjusting to changing needs. You apply contemporary engineering practices, automation and CI/CD principles to deliver high‑quality outcomes.

Self‑managed and collaborative

You work autonomously with strong ownership, yet you’re equally effective collaborating with stakeholders, analysts and data scientists. You communicate clearly, solve problems proactively and contribute positively to team culture.

Continuous Learner

You learn new skills and techniques to keep up with the latest features and releases in big data area and in the Databricks product and bring implementation clarity to TAC. You use AI coding helpers and write efficient and faster code.

Why you’ll love it here

There’s more to work than a competitive salary and amazing employee benefits. As our newest Data Engineer, you’ll also:

Make a positive difference

Every day the work you do at the TAC contributes to something bigger. As part of an inclusive, supportive team you’ll find real purpose in achieving goals, together.

Be rewarded for great work

We value our people, offering a service delivery payment, salary packaging and a reward and recognition program.

  • service delivery payment, salary packaging and a reward and recognition program

Grow and go places

We’re invested in your progress. When you work for one of Victoria’s largest and leading workplaces, you’ll receive extensive internal opportunities for development and access to the LinkedIn Learning Digital Hub.

For more information, read the attached Position Description or contact Shay McLean at Shay_Mclean@tac.vic.gov.au for a confidential discussion. Applications for this role will be accepted up until 11:55pm on Tuesday 11 August 2026.

If we can do anything to help make applying for this role easier, or you have an adjustment request, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know at recruitment@tac.vic.gov.au. If over the phone is better for you, our number is 03 9300 0501.

A safe place to work

We’re committed to the health, safety and wellbeing of employees. This extends to inclusion, diversity and accessibility in our employment practices, and encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, people with disability, men, women and gender diverse people, culturally diverse, and LGBTIQA+ people to apply for roles.

Child Safety

At the TAC we are committed to the safety of children and young people. For more information regarding our commitment to child safety, please visit our website.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer II

Location: Huntington Beach, CA, US

Employment Type: FULL_TIME

Company Overview

Nikkiso Clean Energy & Industrial Gases is a leading provider of cryogenic pumps, heat exchangers, process systems, turboexpanders, services, and solutions for the liquefied natural gas (LNG), liquefied hydrogen (LH2), and industrial gases industries. Applications include fueling stations, marine engines, peak shaving, power generation, virtual pipelines, carbon capture, geothermal power and well stimulation. We are a subsidiary of Nikkiso Company Ltd, a leading industrial manufacturer headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, with $1.5 B USD in annual revenue, 8000 + employees worldwide, and publicly traded on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

Job Overview

We are currently looking for an experienced project engineer. The project engineer will schedule, plan, forecast, resource and manage all the technical activities aiming at assuring project accuracy and quality from conception to completion.

Responsibilities

  • Completes engineering projects by organizing and controlling project elements.
  • Develops project objectives by reviewing project proposals and plans and consulting with Project Manager.
  • Determines project responsibilities by identifying project phases and elements, assigning personnel to phases and elements, and reporting schedule performance for project tasks.
  • Determines project specifications by studying product design, customer requirements, and performance standards.
  • Completes technical studies and prepares cost estimates as needed.
  • Confirms product performance by designing and conducting tests, assists in design and expediting of project.
  • Determines project schedule by studying project plan and specifications, calculating time requirements, and sequencing project elements.
  • Maintains project schedule by monitoring project progress, coordinating activities, and resolving problems.
  • Controls project plan by reviewing design, specifications, and plan, scheduling changes, and recommending actions.
  • Controls project costs by reviewing cost implications with Project Manager.
  • Prepares project status reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing information and trends, recommending actions.
  • Maintains safe and clean working environment by enforcing procedures, rules, and regulations.
  • Maintains project data base by writing computer programs; entering and backing up data. Excel & Access expertise a plus.
  • Maintains product and company reputation by complying with federal and state regulations.
  • Contributes to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.
  • Good communication skills, proven discipline to carry out assigned tasks with little supervision and proven “Team Player."

Qualifications

  • Proficient in MS Office Suite
  • Skilled in time management, prioritizing and managing changing priorities
  • Communicate effectively both verbally and in writing

Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher is preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in rotating equipment industry is required.
  • Exposure to marine industry & class societies is highly desired.
  • Advance skills in MS Office and Project suites are required.
  • Experience with large manufacturing sites or construction facilities is preferred.
  • Time management and organization skills.

Work Environment:

This job operates in a professional office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as laptop computers, photocopiers, and smartphones.

Physical Demands:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and ability to adjust focus. This would require the ability to lift files, open filing cabinets and bend or stand on a stool as necessary.

Other Duties:

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

Salary Range: $75,000 - $100,000, plus annual bonus.

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. title: Senior QA Engineer
description:
Senior QA Engineer

Team: IT

Location: Australia

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Engineer based in Australia.

This is an opportunity to take end-to-end ownership of quality across complex Supply Chain Management (SCM) and workflow-based enterprise systems.
You will combine hands-on functional testing with automation to ensure platform changes are reliable, scalable, and production-ready.
The role involves working closely with product managers, developers, and cross-functional teams to understand business workflows and technical requirements.
You will play a key role in validating integrations, data accuracy, migrations, and evolving system logic.
A strong focus on automation will help strengthen regression coverage and support stable CI/CD delivery.
You will also contribute to UAT, release readiness, defect resolution, and continuous improvement of QA practices.
This role is well suited to a proactive QA professional who enjoys solving complex business problems and owning quality decisions.

Accountabilities

    • Review and validate SCM business requirements, workflows, and functional logic to ensure they are accurately reflected in the platform.
    • Design and execute functional, regression, integration, and workflow-based test cases covering status changes, business rules, and error scenarios.
    • Own and maintain automated regression suites using Katalon Studio, converting high-value manual tests into reliable automated coverage.
    • Support CI/CD processes by ensuring test automation remains stable, maintainable, and effective throughout development and release cycles.
    • Validate consistency between legacy systems and new platform components, including data accuracy during migrations and system or engine changes.
    • Support user acceptance testing, release testing, and production-readiness activities.
    • Identify, document, and manage defects in Jira while collaborating closely with developers to investigate and resolve issues.
    • Prepare test plans, test results, quality reports, and other documentation required to communicate testing outcomes and risks.
    • Identify quality risks early and contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes, automation practices, and testing standards.

      • Requirements

      • 5+ years of professional QA experience, particularly within Supply Chain Management, workflow-based, or other enterprise systems.
      • Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
      • Hands-on experience with both manual and automated software testing.
      • Practical experience with Jira for defect tracking, test management, and collaboration with development teams.
      • Experience with test automation tools, with Katalon Studio experience strongly preferred.
      • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a structured approach to investigating complex business and technical issues.
      • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
      • Ability to work independently, take ownership of quality decisions, and proactively identify potential issues.
      • Strong attention to detail and a continuous-improvement mindset.
      • Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is an advantage.
      • Familiarity with API testing and basic SQL for data validation is a plus.
      • Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments is preferred.
      • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated testing into delivery workflows is beneficial.

        • Benefits

        • Competitive salary range of AUD 70,000–100,000.
        • Full-time employment opportunity.
        • Opportunity to work on complex enterprise and Supply Chain Management systems.
        • Strong ownership of quality across the software development lifecycle.
        • Opportunity to expand expertise in test automation, SCM workflows, and enterprise technologies.
        • Collaborative environment working closely with product, development, and other cross-functional teams.
        • Opportunity to contribute to continuous QA and automation improvements.

title: Nysgerrig kollega med analytiske evner søges til Analysekontor
description:
Er du metodisk og analytisk stærk? Har du lyst til at være med til at drive udviklingen af den offentlige sektor igennem solide analyser og beslutningsoplæg i en af de største it-organisationer i Danmark? Så er du måske den kollega, vi søger!

Analysekontoret er en del af Udviklings- og Forenklingsstyrelsen (UFST), som understøtter og driver digitaliseringen af den danske skatteforvaltning. Vores arbejde har stor bevågenhed – både politisk og i offentligheden.

I kontoret gennemfører vi analyser med henblik på at styrke den ledelsesmæssige prioritering i styrelsen gennem skarpe beslutningsoplæg. Analyserne er drevet af, hvad der strategisk efterspørges af styrelsens direktion. Det overordnede fokus er på udvikling, prioritering og effektivisering af styrelsens opgaveportefølje på tværs af et samlet årligt budget på ca. 4,5 mia. kr. Det kan fx være analytiske oplæg inden for strategi, leverandørstyring, økonomi, porteføljestyring mv. I et komplekst organisatorisk landskab skal vi gennemføre solide kvantitative analyser samt understøtte implementeringen af besluttede initiativer.

Ansvar, udfordringer og udviklingsmuligheder
Analysekontoret fungerer som styrelsens in-house konsulenthus. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du udover en interesse for tal, også er nysgerrig og formår at tilegne dig ny viden på områder, som du ikke har stiftet bekendtskab med før, særligt indenfor IT. Kontoret er en del af fagområdet Styring, som har ansvaret for bl.a. økonomistyring i Udviklings- og Forenklingsstyrelsen.

Da kontoret er problem- og talknusere for strategisk prioriterede indsatser i styrelsen, lægger vi stor vægt på evnen til at angribe komplekse problemstillinger med metodisk stringens, en struktureret og selvstændig tilgang til problemløsning samt viljen til at skabe samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af kontorer i styrelsen. Du vil få stor indflydelse på de opgaver, som du og dit team løser samt mulighed for at definere din egen rolle.

Vi tilbyder:

  • et spændende og varieret arbejde, hvor hver dag er forskellig
  • arbejde med strategisk vigtige udviklingsopgaver forankret i og prioriteret af direktionen
  • et stærkt fagligt miljø med bred viden og erfaring med analyser, databehandling og it.
  • et arbejde med fokus på udvikling af nye metoder, færdigheder og løsninger
  • at du udfordres på dine analytiske færdigheder og modtager kompetent sparring og feedback på dit arbejde og produkter
  • stor indflydelse på egen opgaveløsning og ansvar efter kompetenceniveau
  • dygtige kollegaer med drive og gå-på-mod, der hjælper hinanden
  • socialt kontor med fredagsquiz, sommerfest og fredagsbarer
Kvalifikationer, erfaring og kompetencer
Vi lægger vægt på, at du har et højt fagligt niveau og evnen til at opnå gode resultater, demonstreret gennem hidtidig beskæftigelse eller en relevant uddannelse (fx cand.scient.pol., cand.polit., cand.oecon., cand.soc., cand.merc.pol., cand.scient.adm., cand.mag. mv.).

Hertil, at du har styr på din kvantitative og kvalitative metoder og er analytisk stærk, og det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra relevant arbejde i fx det offentlige eller i et konsulenthus.

Vi lægger samtidig vægt på, at du:

  • er udadvendt og har lyst til at arbejde i krydsfeltet mellem flere fagligheder
  • kan drive en proces og tænke flere skridt frem
  • analytisk velfunderet med flair for tal
  • hjemmevant i Excel
  • kan omsætte din viden i et klart sprog, der er forståeligt for andre faggrupper
  • har gode skriftlige kompetencer og formidlingsevner i Word og PowerPoint
  • er selvstændig, fleksibel og ansvarsfuld
  • holdspiller, der motiveres af at levere resultater og lykkes i fællesskab
  • interesse for og mod på at lære om it og it-udvikling
Vi har brug for flere nye kolleger og er på udkig efter både erfarne profiler og nyuddannede. Hvis ovenstående lyder som noget for dig, ser vi frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Kontakt og ansættelsesvilkår
Send din ansøgning inkl. CV og eksamensbevis via linket ”Søg stillingen” senest 30. august 2026. Spørgsmål vedr. stillingen besvares gerne af kontorchef Peter Herborg Bay Nielsen på tlf. 42 49 19 35. Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes løbende.

(DTS) i Skatte – og Vækstministeriet. Der vil være mulighed for individuel forhandling og indplacering alt efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

Se tú

Como Cocinero A apoyará en la preparación de platillos de manera activa durante el servicio, junto con el resto de la brigada de cocina llevará a cabo la sanitización, recepción, acomodo, limpieza, preparación y producción de alimentos y todas sus actividades colaterales.

  • Máximo nivel de integridad y transparencia

  • Aplicar un enfoque ético al resultado de las situaciones.

  • Habilidades razonables para resolver problemas, tomar decisiones y resolver conflictos

  • Trabajar de manera segura, prudente y organizada

Domina tu oficio

  • Garantizar la higiene y acomodo del área de trabajo, materiales e insumos previos a toda manipulación de alimentos.

  • Dar apoyo en la preparación (misen place) asignadas.

  • Apoyo en la realización de las recetas/proceso de manera cabal y disciplinada en caso de existir dudas solicitar asistencia.

  • Revisar que los insumos se encuentren en óptimas condiciones.

Lo que Ofrecemos y lo que Puedes Esperar

  • Formar parte de un equipo colaborativo con un genuino espíritu de familia, donde tu talento será valorado y reconocido.

  • Salarios altamente competitivos, con un atractivo plan de incentivos anual para puestos gerenciales y de Jefatura de Departamento.

  • Servicio de transporte desde San Lucas y San José del Cabo hasta el resort.

  • Servicio de lavandería de uniformes, garantizando comodidad y una imagen profesional.

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO como "Las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE desde 1998 y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

En Four Seasons, guiamos todas nuestras acciones por la regla de oro: “Trata a los demás como te gustaría ser tratado”.
