title: Petroleum Engineer
description:
Job Family Group:

Subsurface Group


Job Description:

About bp
In production & operations, we find, develop and operate oil and gas resources and assets, as well as refineries, pipelines and terminals around the world.
Our vision is to become an industry-leading hydrocarbons business and the engine room of our integrated energy company.
Gas & low carbon energy (G&LCE) encompasses businesses, platforms and partnerships helping to deliver shareholder value and decarbonize our operations while positioning us for growth through the next decade.

Our organization also aims to:
Partner with bp’s businesses to provide integrated solutions and governance across our NOJV portfolio.
Lead the development of deep and enduring relationships with targeted strategic corporates and partners in service of bp’s businesses.
Ensure bp’s strategy, plans and wide-ranging activities in the US and China are unified and regionally integrated for value.

About the role
This is an opportunity for a motivated individual to join the agile, fast-paced and exciting integrated team that advises partners on opportunities for Production Management, Depletion Management, and Area Development Planning to improve production and recovery from this field. The successful candidate will lead core activities within an integrated group of bp and partners subsurface staff and constantly collaborating with other departments and the India Shareholding team to define and progress the implementation of the short and long-term plans.

As a Petroleum Engineer, you will be responsible for improving oil and gas production safely and efficiently by handling wells, production systems, and surveillance data, while working closely with subsurface, wells and operations teams across the 4 chokes (reservoir, wells, plant and export).

What you will Deliver:
Promote a strong safety culture, recognize the HSE impact on all works, communicate as appropriately to possible collaborators. Ensure all programs evaluated for potential hazards during the execution.
Enhance utilization of area wellstock and production/ injection systems to deliver production target. Understand well set’s technical production forecast and well set’s contribution to business target.
Perform artificial lift (gas lift, ESP), well, and wellhead platform (WHP) site optimization.
Deeply understand well operating performance; maintain well performance models, and support surface system understanding.
Execute and analyze all surveillance in compliance with the surveillance plan. Communicate outcomes to appropriate stakeholders (Reservoir Engineer, Subsurface Team, Wells Engineer)
Understand and minimize reservoir & wells related production and injection impacts including well losses/deferrals from shut in wells, pressure restrictions and bottlenecks. Understand reservoir losses/deferrals from non-optimal injection, conformance issues, etc.
Shape and deliver rate adding activity by populating the rate adding hopper with options and understanding basis of prioritization.
Perform routine well ownership requirements.
Quality controls all well information including well tests, well events, production/ injection rates and well trends.
Prepare for and lead discussions in capacity reviews including well reviews.
Maintain current well information in the appropriate folder and ensure the proper databases are updated for perfs, logs, etc.
Review and provide quality control for well intervention evaluation tracking system.
Perform and review long-term shut-in, high GOR well list updates, and other required periodic duties.
Integrate with Reservoir Management team
Understand the depletion mechanism and provide PE input to pattern/sector performance, waterflood targets, and other reservoir management issues as appropriate.
Support RE on maintaining hopper of donor wells for sidetrack options and provide this donor well information to help progress rig options.
Contribute to subsurface target ideas.
Provide consultation, as requested, on new well and sidetrack completion and perforation decisions.
Integrate with Operations
Understand the surface facility equipment. Work with various operations and projects/facilities/process groups to progress any facility projects which affect the well set including well tie-ins, debottlenecking, well meter repairs, etc.
Understand metering equipment and any issues, perform any updates or other metering inputs as required, and lobby for metering improvements where needed.

What you will need to be successful
Must have educational qualifications:
Batchelor/Master’s degree in Engineering or Science

Must have experience/skills:
Great communication and integrations skills. Ability to communicate complex subsurface topics to team members across multiple functions.
Experience with offshore operations.
Proficient with system modeling and optimization.
Experience with planning and executing well interventions.
Understanding of flow assurance risks (hydrates, scale, asphaltenes) and management strategies.
Ability to handle multiple activities and to quickly respond to changing business priorities and make value and risk-based prioritization decisions.
HSE: Uphold and demonstrate safety leadership behaviours.
Strong technical contributor: Broad production operations experience, proven integration, optimization and monitoring across 4-chokes (Reservoir, Wells, Plant, Export) and strong track record of delivery.
Digital tools: Working knowledge of Petroleum Engineering toolkit inc. Integrated Production Modelling e.g. PETEX. Experience in use of data analytics.
Skillful Communicator: Ability to communicate effectively with multi-disciplinary, operational and leadership teams with track record of sharing takeaways. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Natural Integrator: Able to listen to different perspectives, adapt and identify how to converge different points of view in an integrated solution.
Agile: Ability to handle and prioritize multiple activities, quickly respond to changing business priorities and cope with short-term deadlines.
Learning: Strong desire to further develop and learn new skills

Minimum years of proven experience:
Minimum 6+ years’ experience as Petroleum Engineer, with experience in production management and operations engineering.

Good to have experience/skills:
Pressure transient analysis (PTA), downhole flow control, reservoir and well integrity management and sand management.
Gas reservoir management experience and/or waterflood management.

You will work with
Your line manager will be the Performance Manager PE/RE
You will work in the bp and partner offices at Mumbai.
You will work in close collaboration with both bp and partners subsurface and production teams and with bp’s global subsurface technical specialists and domain experts.

Why join bp
At bp, we support our people to learn and grow in a diverse and challenging environment. We believe that our team is strengthened by diversity. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment in which everyone is respected and treated fairly.

There are many aspects of our employees’ lives that are meaningful, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit in with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generously paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.


Travel Requirement:

Up to 10% travel should be expected with this role


Relocation Assistance:

This role is eligible for relocation within country


Remote Type:

This position is not available for remote working


Skills:

Data acquisition strategy, Data Analysis, Data Management, Depletion and Storage Development Planning, Fluid Properties, Fluid sampling and analysis, Geological Reservoir and Storage Unit Modelling, Integrated Resource Progression, Measuring and Verification for Carbon Storage, Monitoring, Operations Geology, Petrophysical Dynamic Reservoir Description, Petrophysical Static Reservoir Description, Reservoir Forecasting and Business Planning, Reservoir quality, Rock Properties Framework, Subsurface integration, Subsurface uncertainty and risk management, Subsurface verification and assurance, Well and Area Performance Management

.

title: Data Engineer - Snowflake or Databricks
description:
Data Engineer


AWS / Databricks or Snowflake. Sydney. $150k upto $200k + Super. Australian Citizens or Permanent Residents only.


  • Full stack, no exceptions: infra, DataOps, platform engineering, the lakes themselves
  • Senior engineers only, no exceptions: AWS plus Snowflake OR Databricks, $150k-$200k + super
  • Bored doing easy work? Come argue about genuinely hard problems with seriously sharp peers

About the Client


A leading global professional services and consulting firm with a fast-growing Data and AI practice based in Sydney. They work across some of Australia's largest and most complex enterprise and government environments, on programs where the architecture actually matters and the technical bar is genuinely high. It's a business built around senior engineers who want to keep arguing about hard problems, not just keep shipping tickets.


About the Role


You don't measure your work by how many pipelines you've built. You measure it by how many unnecessary ones you avoided.


This isn't a role for someone who wants to stay in their lane. You'll work across the full stack: infrastructure, DataOps, platform engineering, and the data lakes themselves, on programs large enough that no single decision is trivial. Some engagements mean building a lake architecture from first principles; others mean pulling apart a platform that's accumulated years of shortcuts and making it defensible again. Either way, you're not executing someone else's design: you're the one senior enough in the room to make the call.


If you're good at this and quietly bored doing it somewhere that doesn't stretch you, this is built for people exactly like that.


Duties


  • Own architecture and delivery across infra, DataOps, platform engineering and data lake design, working in AWS alongside either Snowflake or Databricks.
  • Build and industrialise ETL and ELT pipelines using SQL, Python and PySpark, at a scale where shortcuts get found.
  • Make and defend real architectural calls: data models, platform design, lake structure, and the trade-offs behind each.
  • Work directly with client stakeholders as the technical authority in the room, not just the delivery resource.
  • Collaborate with a senior bench of architects and engineers across multiple large, concurrent programs.

Requirements


  • You've got senior-level data engineering experience, and a real track record of owning platforms end to end: architecture, delivery, the lot, not just stitching pipelines together and calling it done.
  • You've got hands-on AWS experience, and it's genuine: you've made real decisions in it under real constraints, not just enough to talk your way through an interview.
  • You're deep in either Snowflake or Databricks, not both. If you're claiming equal strength in both, we'll both know that's not quite true, and it'll show fast.
  • You write SQL, Python and PySpark properly, and you're just as comfortable a level down in infra and DataOps as you are writing the transformation logic itself.
  • You can hold your own technical position in a room full of senior client stakeholders, and argue it convincingly, without needing someone senior to back you up.
  • You're an Australian Citizen or Permanent Resident. This one genuinely can't be worked around: we're not able to support visa sponsorship for this role, sorry.

description:

Job Description

Become a part of our caring community

Humana’s Product organization is seeking a Lead Product Manager to drive the strategy, development, and optimization of the Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) in support of Next Best Action (NBA). In this role, you will serve as a key product leader responsible for translating business needs into platform capabilities that enable personalized, data-driven customer experiences. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions across Real-Time CDP, Journey Optimizer, and Customer Journey Analytics.

This role is focused on growing adoption and usage of Adobe Experience Platform as an enterprise platform while supporting and scaling capabilities to support NBA driving dynamic, context-aware customer engagement. Success in this role means partnering with key lines of business to translate requirements into detailed product features for engineering teams to enable, while building decisioning strategies that optimize customer outcomes and business value.

Key Role Functions

Product Strategy & Vision

  • Collaboratively own and manage the product backlog for assigned next best action platform capabilities, ensuring alignment with the multiyear enterprise roadmap

  • Translate enterprise strategy, regulatory requirements, and business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria

  • Partner closely with our Next Best Action team, engineering, architecture, and delivery teams to plan, execute, and release platform enhancements on time and at quality

  • Balance near-term business needs with long-term platform scalability, maintainability, and compliance

Platform Development & Integration

  • Lead development of specific platform capabilities such as consent capture, preference updates, suppression logic, policy enforcement, and downstream activation

  • Drive platform integration with Next Best Action engine

  • Ensure data models, APIs, and workflows adhere to enterprise standards and regulatory guidance

  • Validate that platform functionality supports omnichannel use cases across web, mobile, CRM, contact center, and third-party integrations

  • Identify dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs, escalating decisions as needed

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as a key product partner to NBA, Marketing, Digital, CRM, Customer Service, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance teams

  • Support onboarding and adoption of the platform by lines of business through enablement, documentation, and partnership

  • Collaborate with enterprise data, identity, and analytics teams to ensure accurate, reliable use of consent and preference data

  • Serve as a day-to-day product escalation point for delivery teams and business stakeholders

Customer-Centric Design

  • Ensure experiences are intuitive, transparent, and aligned with customer trust expectations

  • Advocate for customer-centric design patterns that clearly communicate data usage, choices, and controls

  • Incorporate customer, compliance, and operational feedback into product iteration and refinement

Measurement & Optimization

  • Track and report on product-level KPIs such as consent capture rates, preference usage, data quality, error rates, and activation success

  • Partner with the Director to identify opportunities to reduce operational friction, manual processes, and compliance risk

  • Monitor platform performance and integration health, driving corrective actions and enhancements as needed

title: Performance & Growth Specialist
description:
Din rolle

Vi leder efter en datadrevet marketingprofil, der kan hjælpe os med at forstå, hvad der virker, hvad der ikke virker, og hvor vi kan skabe større effekt af vores marketingindsats.

Vi arbejder med kampagner, content, websites, mails, sociale medier, marketing automation og leadgenerering i B2B-kontekst. Vi har masser af aktiviteter. Vi har masser af data. Men vi mangler én, der tager ejerskab for at forbinde de to.

Derfor søger vi nu en Performance & Growth Specialist, der kan analysere vores performance på tværs af digitale kanaler, kunderejser og indhold, og som samtidig har lyst til at omsætte indsigterne til konkrete forbedringer.

Med andre ord: Du skal ikke bare fortælle os, hvad der er sket. Du skal hjælpe os med at finde ud af, hvad vi skal gøre nu.

Dine arbejdsopgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Analysere performance på mails, landing pages, kampagner, content og kunderejser

  • Identificere hvad der virker, hvad der bør optimeres, og hvad vi bør gøre mindre af eller stoppe med

  • Arbejde med tracking, dashboards og data fra blandt andet GA4, HubSpot, Semrush og andre relevante værktøjer

  • Kortlægge kunderejser, finde frafaldspunkter og komme med forslag til bedre konvertering

  • Analysere markedet og spotte muligheder, hvor vi kan være mere proaktive i vores marketingindsats

Du bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for vores HubSpot-ansvarlige, Nicklas Madsen. Han har ansvaret for platformen. Du får indsigten i dataene og ansvaret for at hjælpe os med at forstå og bruge dem aktivt i vores prioriteringer.

Vi søger en team8, der:

  • Har 2-4 års erfaring med digital marketing, performance, marketing analytics, growth eller lignende

  • Er stærk analytisk og nysgerrig på, hvorfor noget performer bedre end andet

  • Kan omsætte data og indsigter til klare anbefalinger og konkrete handlinger

  • Har lyst til både at analysere og eksekvere på de optimeringsopgaver, analyserne peger på

  • Trives med at arbejde på tværs af content, marketing automation, web og kampagner

  • Tør udfordre mavefornemmelser og hjælpe teamet med at prioritere ud fra data

  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for værktøjer som GA4, HubSpot, Semrush, Search Console, dashboards og tracking

Du behøver ikke være specialist i det hele fra dag ét. Det vigtigste er, at du har en stærk digital forståelse, en naturlig analytisk nysgerrighed og lyst til at tage ejerskab for en ny rolle, som skal være med til at løfte vores marketingindsats.

Det du får

Du får mulighed for at blive den første dedikerede Performance & Growth-ressource i itm8 Marketing. Det betyder, at du ikke overtager en fastlåst rolle. Du er med til at forme den.

Du får en central plads i Content & Activation-teamet, hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe content, kampagner og digitale aktiviteter, der skal flytte både markedet og forretningen. Du bliver den, der hjælper os med at se mønstrene på tværs og gøre vores indsatser skarpere.

Konkret får du:

  • En nyoprettet rolle med stor mulighed for at påvirke retningen

  • Et tæt samarbejde med specialister inden for content, HubSpot, SoMe, kampagner og brand

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med data på tværs af vores marketingindsatser

  • En rolle, hvor dine analyser bliver brugt til reelle beslutninger

  • Plads til både at være nørdet, nysgerrig og praktisk eksekverende

Kort sagt: Du får ansvar for at hjælpe os med at blive bedre til at vælge til, vælge fra og skrue op for det, der virker.

Skal du med på holdet?

Så ser vi frem til at modtage dit CV.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, så er du velkommen til at kontakte Team Lead, Steffen Højfeldt Frandsen, på tlf. 28357571 eller på e-mail sthfr@itm8.com. Alle henvendelser behandles fortroligt.

Vi afholder løbende samtaler og afslutter rekrutteringsprocessen, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Vi indhenter desuden straffeattest forud for ansættelse.

Om itm8

Vi er itm8 - vores kunders IT-mate.

Bag os står 1.600+ teammates fordelt på Danmark, Sverige, Filippinerne og Tjekkiet. Vi har specialister inden for alt fra IT-sikkerhed og ERP til AI og softwareudvikling.

Det, der binder os sammen, er ikke kun teknologi. Det er PURPLE POWER - vores måde at arbejde på. Her hjælper vi hinanden først, fejrer det der virker, og skærer igennem bullshit. Vi tror på ambition frem for status quo - og på at forskellighed gør os stærkere.

Hos os handler det ikke om at være perfekt. Det handler om at tage ansvar, skabe værdi og udvikle sig - hver dag.

Lyder det som dig? Så søg - og bliv vores næste team'm8.

title: Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel i en lille piges liv – hver eneste dag? - Lyngby
description:
Vi søger en nærværende, hjertevarm hjælper til Alia – en glad og kærlig pige med et helt særligt blik på verden. Måske er det netop dig, der skal være med til at give hende tryghed, støtte og nærvær i hverdagen?

Hvem er Alia?

Alia er en nysgerrig og livsglad pige, som oplever verden på sin egen måde – ofte med munden som sanseredskab og med lyde frem for sprog. Hun har endnu ikke udviklet talesprog, men hun kommunikerer alligevel med dem, hun føler sig tryg ved. Og det mærkes!

Hun har brug for en voksen ved sin side – en, der ser hende, mærker hende og hjælper hende med at navigere i verden. Når hun føler sig tryg, blomstrer hendes personlighed frem, og hun knytter hurtigt tætte bånd.

Din rolle som medarbejder

Som Alia’s hjælper bliver du en vigtig støtte i hendes daglige liv. Din tilstedeværelse og dit nærvær vil være afgørende for hendes trivsel og udvikling. Du skal være hendes trygge base, som med ro, omsorg og stabilitet giver hende mulighed for at udforske verden i sit eget tempo.

Du vil være en del af en hverdag med struktur og kærlighed, hvor samspil og nærvær er nøgleord. Du arbejder tæt sammen med Alia’s familie, som vil tage godt imod dig og støtte dig i opgaven.

Vi forestiller os, at du...

  • Har et roligt og varmt væsen.
  • Er tålmodig, stabil og oprigtigt interesseret i at gøre en forskel for et barn med særlige behov.
  • Har erfaring med (eller interesse i) autisme og udviklingshæmning – men det vigtigste er din tilgang, ikke din uddannelse.
  • Er fleksibel og kan møde Alia, præcis dér hvor hun er, også når dagen ikke går som planlagt.
  • Er god til at skabe kontakt og nærvær, og kan være til stede i det små og det nære.

Arbejdstid og fleksibilitet

Vagterne er 2 hverdage i tidsrummet 15-18:30 ( Der kan tales ind i at tiden rykkes frem til 15:30)

1 weekend om måneden 8 timer lørdag og søndag.

Men vigtigst af alt: Du er meget velkommen til at søge – også selvom du ikke kan alle dage. Vi ved, at fleksibilitet skaber de bedste rammer for både dig og Alia, og vi vil rigtig gerne finde en løsning sammen med dig.

Alia’s forældre vil være hjemme under vagterne, men de har primært fokus på hendes tvillingesøskende. Du er derfor aldrig alene med ansvaret, men vil få din egen betydningsfulde rolle.

Løn og vilkår

Du bliver ansat gennem Olivia Danmark, hvor vi arbejder med høj faglighed og stor respekt for både borgere og medarbejdere. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger overenskomst med FOA, og fastsættes ud fra dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

No

Make a meaningful impact in rural Iowa while building your nursing career with Good Samaritan. The Registered Nurse (RN) is responsible for utilizing the nursing process (assessment, diagnosis, outcomes/planning, implementation and evaluation) to provide individualized nursing care to residents. Collaborates with resident and family, other inter-disciplinary colleagues, including providers, to plan, implement and evaluate care.

Job Description

Demonstrates competency and practices within the full scope of nursing expertise/knowledge and utilizes appropriate age and population specific standards as designated in their assigned clinical setting. Cares for residents in all phases of preventative care, health maintenance, diagnosis, and treatment. Responsible for the coordination of care, resident assessment, resident education and various other nursing interventions. title: Auxiliar de Uniformes
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

Se tú

El Auxiliar de Uniformes se encarga de la entrega y recepción de los uniformes del resort, así como del orden y acomodo de los mismos. Da seguimiento a los pendientes de su área y mantiene todo perfectamente cuidado y limpio.

Fecha estimada de contratación: Octubre 2026

Conocimientos y Habilidades

  • Experiencia requerida en el puesto mínimo de 1 año
  • Experiencia en hotelería de lujo
  • Comprender y familiarizarse con los estándares de calidad y estándares de servicio del hotel
  • Habilidad para hablar, escribir y leer el idioma Español.
  • Máximo nivel de integridad y transparencia
  • Habilidades razonables para resolver problemas, tomar decisiones y resolver conflictos
  • Trabajar de manera segura, prudente y organizada

* Esta posición requiere que los candidatos cuenten con autorización vigente para trabajar en México.

Domina tu oficio

  • Comportarse de manera profesional, cumplir con los estándares de conducta y presentación de Four Seasons Resort Tamarindo.
  • Llevar el uniforme asignado limpio y en excelente estado.
  • Presentarse en su área de trabajo en tiempo y forma para recibir pendientes del turno anterior, recibiendo el área ordenada y limpia.
  • Realizar la entrega de uniformes al personal en el turno al que corresponde.
  • Revisar los racks de uniformes en búsqueda de prendas con faltantes de botones o en estado inconveniente para su reparación, en coordinación con la costurera.
  • Clasificar los uniformes para su lavado según el tipo de suciedad, fibra y color.
  • Realizar los inventarios en tiempo y forma de las prendas del área de uniformes.
  • Atender las solicitudes que los empleados solicitan en el área de uniformes.
  • Después del almuerzo retoma sus tareas.
  • Antes de finalizar el turno dejar su área ordenada

Lo que Ofrecemos y lo que Puedes Esperar

  • Formar parte de un equipo colaborativo con un genuino espíritu de familia, donde tu talento será valorado y reconocido.
  • Salarios altamente competitivos, con un atractivo plan de incentivos anual para puestos gerenciales y de Jefatura de Departamento.
  • Servicio de transporte desde San Lucas y San José del Cabo hasta el resort.
  • Servicio de lavandería de uniformes, garantizando comodidad y una imagen profesional.
  • Programas de capacitación y talleres internos que apoyan tu desarrollo profesional.
  • Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico, diverso y desafiante, con interacción cercana con el equipo de liderazgo.
  • Programas de reconocimiento que celebran tus logros, incluyendo reconocimientos por años de servicio, Empleado del Mes y Empleado del Año.

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO como "Las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE desde 1998 y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

Cultura de servicio

Actualmente operando 120 hoteles y resorts, y 45 propiedades residenciales en los principales centros de las ciudades y destinos turísticos en 47 países, y con más de 50 proyectos en planificación o desarrollo, Four Seasons se ubica constantemente entre los mejores hoteles del mundo y las marcas más prestigiosas en las encuestas de lectores, críticas de viajeros y premios de la industria. Nuestro mayor activo, y la clave de nuestro éxito, es nuestra gente. Creemos que cada uno de nosotros necesita un sentido de dignidad, orgullo y satisfacción en lo que hacemos.

¿Cómo es trabajar para Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts?

En Four Seasons, guiamos todas nuestras acciones por la regla de oro: “Trata a los demás como te gustaría ser tratado”. Aquí, podrá trabajar en un equipo que se basa en el respeto mutuo, la colaboración, el excelente servicio y la pasión por el servicio. Como marca de lujo, su trabajo también se guiará por estándares muy estrictos para garantizar un alto nivel de calidad y servicio en todo momento. Espere trabajar duro pero diviértase y aprenda en el camino, llevando su carrera, experiencia y habilidades al siguiente nivel. Como beneficio adicional, trabajar con Four Seasons le brinda la oportunidad de trabajar para una empresa internacional y viajar por todo el mundo mientras se hospeda en propiedades increíbles de forma gratuita.

      • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with a focus on clean code, maintainability, quality and pragmatic delivery.
      • Ability to work independently on feature-level problems while collaborating effectively with more experienced engineers.
      • Strong communication and feedback skills, with a proactive approach to identifying risks, asking questions and sharing knowledge.
      • Curiosity about AI-assisted software development and willingness to incorporate AI tools into the engineering workflow.

    • Urgent production support: Respond to SQL Server Agent alerts, severity errors, critical incidents, and urgent customer calls, diagnosing and resolving production database issues promptly.
    • Weekend operations: Execute scheduled maintenance activities, including cumulative updates, index and statistics rebuilds, DBCC CHECKDB, schema changes, and other database administration tasks.

      • T-SQL and performance tuning: Ability to write T-SQL independently, interpret execution plans, identify parameter sniffing and deadlocks, and optimize poorly performing queries, stored procedures, and triggers.
      • Core DBA capabilities: Strong understanding of native backups, point-in-time restores, database file management, instance patching, and routine SQL Server administration.
      • High availability: Practical experience with Always On Availability Groups and Windows Server Failover Clusters, including configuration, troubleshooting, and failover procedures.

Contribute to reusable migration patterns, standards and knowledge assets across the migration factory.

  • Strong SQL and data analysis skills.
  • Experience with source-to-target mapping and data requirement definition.

title: Lærer til undervisning i matematik og naturfag
description:
Vi leder efter en lærer, der gør en forskel

Kan du tænde nysgerrigheden hos unge mennesker og få dem til at opleve, at matematik og naturfag giver mening – både i skolen og i livet?

På Ejby Skole søger vi en engageret og ansvarsbevidst lærer til en fuldtidsstilling i vores udskoling. Vi leder efter en kollega, der møder eleverne med høje forventninger, tydelighed og nærvær. En lærer, der tror på, at stærke relationer er fundamentet for læring, og som har lyst til at være en aktiv del af et fællesskab, hvor vi udvikler os sammen.

Kan du undervise i matematik og naturfag, og motiveres du af at gøre fagene levende, undersøgende og relevante? Har du også kompetencer inden for musik, ser vi det som en ekstra gevinst.

Hvem er vi?

Ejby Skole er en velfungerende tosporet folkeskole beliggende i en mindre by i Køge Kommune. Vi har omkring 380 fantastiske elever fra børnehaveklasse til 9. årgang og en engageret personalegruppe bestående af 35 lærere, 2 børnehaveklasseledere, 15 pædagoger samt en skoleleder, en viceskoleleder og en SFO-leder.

Vi er stolte af at være en skole med høj faglighed og stærk elev- og medarbejdertrivsel. Hos os er fællesskab ikke bare et ord – det er noget, vi skaber hver dag. Vi tror på, at elever udvikler sig bedst, når de oplever at høre til, bliver mødt med respekt og møder voksne, der både stiller krav og viser omsorg.

Vi har høje ambitioner på alle elevers vegne og arbejder målrettet med både faglighed, trivsel og dannelse. Samarbejdet mellem medarbejderne er præget af tillid, sparring og lysten til at lykkes sammen. Her er dørene åbne, humoren er en del af hverdagen, og vi hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det.

Skolen ligger i naturskønne omgivelser og har gode faciliteter både ude og inde, som giver utallige muligheder for fleksibel, praksisnær og undersøgende undervisning – særligt inden for naturfagene.

Et stærkt professionelt læringsfællesskab

Gennem de seneste år har vi udviklet vores undervisning med afsæt i co-teaching. Det betyder, at vi prioriterer den fælles forberedelse, et tæt samarbejde mellem kolleger og en undervisning, hvor to-lærerordninger bruges aktivt til at styrke både elevernes læring og deres deltagelsesmuligheder.

Vi ser samarbejdet som en styrke og tror på, at vi bliver dygtigere, når vi udvikler undervisningen sammen. Derfor er vores professionelle læringsfællesskaber en central del af hverdagen, hvor vi deler erfaringer, giver hinanden sparring og sammen finder de løsninger, der gavner eleverne bedst.

Hvis du motiveres af at udvikle din undervisning i tæt samarbejde med andre, og ser værdien i fælles refleksion og fælles ansvar, vil du passe godt ind på Ejby Skole.

Vi søger en lærer, der:

  • har undervisningskompetence i matematik og et eller flere naturfag
  • brænder for at skabe engagerende undervisning, hvor eleverne bliver nysgerrige og udfordret
  • er en tydelig klasseleder, der skaber trygge læringsfællesskaber
  • arbejder struktureret, tager ansvar og følger sine opgaver til dørs
  • trives i et tæt samarbejde med kolleger og ser co-teaching som en naturlig del af en stærk undervisningspraksis
  • bidrager aktivt til teamsamarbejdet og skolens professionelle læringsfællesskaber
  • møder elever, forældre og kolleger med anerkendelse, respekt og godt humør
  • gerne kan og vil undervise i musik (ikke et krav, men en fordel).

Hos os får du

  • en fuldtidsstilling i en velfungerende udskoling
  • engagerede og dygtige kolleger, som prioriterer samarbejde, fælles forberedelse og faglig sparring
  • mulighed for at udvikle din undervisning gennem co-teaching og professionelle læringsfællesskaber
  • mulighed for at sætte dit præg på undervisningen og skolens fortsatte udvikling
  • en arbejdsplads med fokus på trivsel, tillid og faglig udvikling
  • en ledelse, der er tæt på hverdagen, prioriterer dialog og har tillid til medarbejdernes faglighed.

Ansættelse

Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling med tiltrædelse 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst.

Bliv en del af Ejby Skole

Vi søger ikke bare de rigtige kompetencer – vi søger den rigtige kollega. En kollega, der har lyst til at være en del af et stærkt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, udvikler os sammen og hver dag arbejder for, at vores elever bliver så dygtige, som de kan, samtidig med at de trives.

  • Kan du se dig selv hos os, glæder vi os til at modtage din ansøgning. Måske er det dig, der bliver vores næste kollega på Ejby Skole.
Ansøgning og kontakt

Har du spørgsmål, eller har du lyst til at opleve stemningen på Ejby Skole, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte viceskoleleder Rikke Kruse på telefon 30 48 12 46. Vi viser gerne skolen frem og fortæller om vores hverdag – vi tror nemlig på, at en god arbejdsplads opleves bedst i virkeligheden.

Ansøgningsfrist: 25. august 2026.

I Køge Kommune bliver du en del af en organisation med dedikerede medarbejdere, der hver dag forenes i et fælles mål om at skabe værdi for borgerne. I kommunen ser vi mangfoldighed som en ressource, og ønsker at fremme ligestillingen. Vi opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge stillingen – uanset køn, etnisk oprindelse, religion, alder eller eventuel funktionsnedsættelse.

Så bliv en del af holdet! Vi tilbyder dig et forskelligartet arbejdsmiljø og en lang række forskellige personalegoder, såsom sociale aktiviteter og adgang til vores feriehuse.

description:
Cybersecurity Ops Technologist I (Email Security)

Location: CT - Hartford, GA - Atlanta, MN - St. Paul, NJ - Edison

Remote Type: Hybrid

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Technology

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$99,100.00 - $163,400.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Cybersecurity operations is responsible for the identification, protection, detection, response and disruption of cybersecurity events across Travelers through critical analysis, threat intelligence gathering, and agile cybersecurity techniques to assess, support, and resolve cyber incidents. Within Cybersecurity Operations, our Email Security team protects a complex messaging environment with a hybrid architecture spanning more than 50,000 mailboxes. As a Cybersecurity Ops Technologist I on this team, you will own the day-to-day administration, configuration, and optimization of our Proofpoint infrastructure, acting as the subject-matter authority on email threat prevention, authentication, and mail flow across Travelers. This is a hands-on technical operations role for someone who has deep, product-level expertise in enterprise email security and is ready to apply that expertise at scale.

What Will You Do?

  • Administer and optimize our enterprise Proofpoint deployment — including Targeted Attack Protection (TAP), Threat Response Auto-Pull (TRAP), Secure Email Relay, Adaptive Email Security/Email DLP, Email Isolation, and Email Fraud Defense — to protect a hybrid M365/on-premises Exchange environment.
  • Design, configure, and maintain secure email gateway rulesets, mail flow policies, and quarantine management strategies, balancing threat containment against business continuity across 50,000+ mailboxes.
  • Own DKIM, SPF, and DMARC strategy end-to-end: authoring and maintaining records, tuning alignment and enforcement policies, and troubleshooting authentication failures across multiple sending domains and third-party senders.
  • Manage and troubleshoot complex mail relay and connector configurations spanning Microsoft 365 and on-premises Exchange, ensuring reliable mail flow through the Proofpoint gateway.
  • Analyze internal and external threat intelligence and TAP telemetry to identify emerging phishing, BEC, and malware campaigns targeting the organization, and tune detection rules and policies in response.
  • Partner with the SOC to build and refine automated response playbooks for email-borne threats, including TRAP-driven message remediation.
  • Serve as the email security escalation point of contact for operational inquiries and troubleshooting, providing technical analysis on message trace, header forensics, and delivery/authentication failures.
  • Evaluate and integrate complementary controls such as M365 Defender for Office 365 (Safe Links, Safe Attachments, Threat Explorer) to strengthen a layered email defense strategy.
  • Communicate email threat trends, platform health, and risk posture clearly to security leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Degree or Certificate in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3+ years of dedicated email security engineering experience, including substantial hands-on administration of the Proofpoint platform (TAP, TRAP, Secure Email/Secure Email Relay, Adaptive Email Security, Email Isolation, Email Fraud Defense, CLEAR) within a large enterprise deployment — strongly preferred for this role.
  • Alternatively, multiple years of comparable, production-level depth administering another leading secure email gateway platform (e.g., Mimecast, Cisco Secure Email/IronPort, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Abnormal Security, Barracuda), with demonstrated command of secure email gateway architecture and policy management at scale.
  • Proven experience configuring and managing quarantine policies, end-user digest and release workflows, and gateway rulesets in a high-volume mail environment.
  • Deep working knowledge of DKIM, SPF, and DMARC; able to independently design authentication strategy, diagnose alignment/enforcement failures, and manage third-party sender exceptions.
  • Solid understanding of email relay architecture, MX/connector design, and mail flow troubleshooting in a hybrid Microsoft 365 and on-premises Exchange environment.
  • Experience working within an Email Security group or an email-focused response function of a SOC, with familiarity in incident handling methodologies as applied to phishing, BEC, and email-delivered malware.
  • Understanding of M365 Defender for Office 365 and how it complements a Proofpoint-led defense-in-depth strategy is a plus.
  • Ability to translate technical email threat findings into clear risk insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent in work experience.
  • 2 years of experience working in a Technology related field or role.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Business Unit Description

Legal & Compliance partners with the business to manage legal and regulatory risk, supporting disciplined and compliant execution across the firm.

Job Title

Vice President – Contracts

Job Description

Legal & Compliance partners with Blackstone's businesses globally manage legal and regulatory risk and support disciplined, compliant execution.

The Vice President – Contracts will be based in India and serve as the offshore leader for contracts and contract operations activities delivered through Blackstone's India Center of Excellence. The role sits within the Legal & Compliance function and is responsible for overseeing the delivery of contract lifecycle management, contract repository and document management, and related legal operations support for global Legal stakeholders.

This role is designed for a contract lifecycle management and contract operations professional with sound judgment, operational discipline, and team leadership experience. Operating in a global, matrixed environment, the position partners closely with senior in-house counsel, business unit Legal teams, technology partners and alternative legal service providers to support high-quality, well-controlled, and scalable contract operations.

This is a build-out role, with the opportunity to establish the firm's contract operations capability in India and shape its operating model, standards, and technology footprint from inception.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide leadership and accountability for contracts and contract operations activities delivered through the India Center of Excellence in support of global Legal teams.

  • Own administration and ongoing management of the firm's contract lifecycle management (CLM) platform, including business administration, configuration and workflow maintenance, user access and permissions, template and clause library upkeep, reporting, and coordination of platform enhancements with technology partners and vendors.

  • Lead contract repository and document management support, including repository governance and structure, metadata standards and abstraction quality, data remediation, inventorying of existing contract locations, and establishing a more structured approach to contract storage and retrieval pending full implementation of the firm's document management roadmap.

  • Establish and continuously maintain contract-related processes, standard operating procedures, playbooks, process maps and desktop procedures, ensuring documentation remains current as the capability matures.

  • Support execution and administration of ancillary, lower-complexity agreements in partnership with business unit Legal teams, including intake triage, routing, version control, signature coordination, execution and post-execution filing.

  • Support outside counsel and law firm invoice reconciliation, including invoice review and validation against engagement terms and billing guidelines, exception identification and follow-up, accrual and reporting support, and maintenance of the associated controls and audit trail.

  • Act as the primary offshore liaison to senior in-house counsel, business unit Legal teams and alternative legal service providers (ALSPs), aligning on priorities, capacity, and service expectations.

  • Ensure consistent delivery standards, quality, risk management, and operational excellence across all contracts and contract operations activities.

  • Serve as an offshore escalation point for complex contract operational, delivery, and risk-related matters.

  • Translate contracting priorities into clear operating plans, balancing efficiency and standardization with business-unit-specific, jurisdictional and matter-specific requirements.

  • Establish and maintain governance frameworks, service level expectations, performance metrics, management reporting and escalation mechanisms for contracts and contract operations activities.

  • Lead and develop a team of contract operations professionals and oversee the performance of ALSP and vendor resources supporting the capability, including transition, knowledge transfer and steady-state delivery.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, including process optimization, CLM and legal technology enhancements, contract data quality and analytics, automation opportunities, and operating model improvements.

  • Ensure strong controls, documentation, confidentiality standards, records retention and audit readiness across all supported activities.

  • Support additional contracts and legal operations requirements as the capability develops; the role is not limited to the activities listed above.

  • Partner closely with global stakeholders across time zones and support business needs outside of regular business hours as required.

Qualifications

Blackstone seeks professionals who demonstrate sound judgment, a strong work ethic, and a consistent record of achievement. The successful candidate must have:

Required

  • Law degree (LLB, LLM, or equivalent); US JD or LLM from a US-accredited institution strongly preferred. Significant contract management experience in lieu of formal qualification considered.

  • 12+ years of experience in contract management, contract lifecycle management, legal operations, in-house legal teams, law firms, ALSPs, or professional services environments, including experience overseeing contract operations functions such as CLM administration, contract abstraction and repository management, contract data and metadata governance, and records management.

  • Hands-on experience administering or supporting CLM platforms such as Ironclad, Leah (formerly known as ContractPodAi) DocuSign, including workflow configuration, template and clause library management, user administration, reporting and vendor-supported enhancement cycles.

  • Experience managing confidential and highly sensitive legal data, including familiarity with document retention, information governance and data governance practices.

  • Strong understanding of contracting workflows, legal service delivery standards, and in-house legal operations.

  • Experience establishing governance frameworks, performance metrics, and operational reporting.

  • Sound judgment in legal and operational risk, with a results-oriented execution mindset and strong risk awareness.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to communicate clearly with global senior stakeholders.

  • Proven experience partnering effectively with senior in-house counsel, business stakeholders, and external law firms/ALSPs in a global environment.

  • Ability and willingness to work flexible hours with significant overlap with US Eastern Time.

Preferred

  • US JD or LLM from a recognized US institution.

  • Experience supporting multi-jurisdictional contract work (EMEA, APAC) in addition to US matters.

  • Prior experience in asset management, financial services or a regulated environment, with exposure to commercial, vendor, fund or investment management agreements.

  • Experience establishing or scaling contracts capability within a global capability centre or shared services environment, including offshore transition and knowledge transfer.

  • Familiarity with legal technology and document management systems, contract data extraction tooling, and applied AI in contract review or abstraction.

title: Erfaren sygeplejerske med lederkompetencer til tværfaglig lederstilling på Fælledgården
description:
Vil du være med til at forme fremtidens pleje og ledelse på Fælledgården?
Vi søger en engageret lederkollega, der vægter et godt miljø for både beboere og medarbejdere højt. Som leder for en mindre afdeling med 15 beboere, ansvarlig for den tværfaglige sygepleje samt uddannelsesopgaven, får du en unik mulighed for at sætte dit præg i en nyoprettet stilling. Er du klar til at tage føring i et vigtigt arbejde, hvor faglighed, udvikling og omsorg går hånd i hånd? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Det tredelte lederansvar
Med et tredelt lederansvar mener vi, at dit lederskab bliver delt op indenfor tre specifikke fagområder. Udover ledelse, ønsker vi, at du har forskellige kompetencer og perspektiver og bidrager til Fælledgårdens samlede strategi og teams' succes.

Du får som afdelingsleder ansvar for at skabe fundamentet for den indholdsrige og trygge hverdag for 15 beboere på Fælledgården, med udgangspunkt i den enkeltes ønsker for eget liv. På afdelingen er der otte medarbejdere, der er uddannede social- og sundhedsassister eller social- og sundhedshjælpere.

Sygeplejegruppen på Fælledgården arbejder på tværs af hele huset, og du får ansvar for den daglige ledelse af 10 sygeplejersker, og organiseringen af sygeplejeopgaven sker på tværs af Fælledgården i tæt samarbejde med ledelsesteamet.

Fælledgården er uddannelsessted for en større gruppe af SOSU-elever samt sygeplejestuderende på flere niveauer. I samarbejde med vores kliniske vejledersygeplejerske og vores koordinerende oplæringsansvarlig, vil du også få det overordnede ansvar for dette område. Samlet set vil du have knap 20 medarbejdere i direkte reference til dig.

Lederteamet på Fælledgården
Vi drømmer om en lederkollega, der er teamplayer og som motiveres af at bidrage til ledelsesteamet med nysgerrighed og som har en opsøgende tilgang til samarbejdet. Vores ledelsesteam er præget af en høj grad af psykologisk tryghed, hvor der er rum for at sparre med hinanden og bede om hjælp.

Afdelingslederfunktionen er helt central i forhold til Fælledgårdens samlede faglige drift og udvikling, og et velfungerende arbejdsfællesskab på tværs af huset. Du vil deltage i de tværgående ledelsesopgaver og strategisk planlægning i samarbejde med et engageret ledelsesteam på Fælledgården. Dine kommende lederkollegaer siger:

'Du vil opleve at kunne bruge os som sparringspartnere, dele viden og sammen med lederteamet bidrage til at skabe rum for fælles løsninger. I fællesskab arbejder vi for teamets og organisationens helhed.'

Om dig – vores nye lederkollega
Du er uddannet sygeplejerske og har en diplomuddannelse i ledelse – alternativt har du lyst til at starte på en lederuddannelse. Det er ønskværdigt, at du har nogle års erfaring som leder, gerne som afdelingsleder på et andet plejehjem. Det vil klart være en fordel, hvis du har indsigt i eller erfaring med uddannelsesområdet.

Som afdelingsleder er du tydelig, og det falder dig naturligt at være med til at udvikle medarbejdere og lederkollegaer, så vi sammen kan skabe udvikling i balance med en stærk og stabil drift.

Du ved allerede, at du er god til at samarbejde og har erfaring med, hvordan man lykkes med at arbejde på tværs af en enhed. Din ledelsesstil er tillidsskabende med fokus på psykologisk tryghed. Du har en positiv indstilling og bliver motiveret af at lykkes selvstændigt såvel som i teams.

Endelig er det væsentligt, at du kommer med en høj grad af faglighed, en opdateret og evidensbaseret viden på området samt et skarpt fokus på kvalitetssikring.

'Vores nye leder skal have en faglig stolthed og gå foran. Det skal være en, som er virkelig god til at kommunikere, både når det gælder at informere os om, hvad der er i gang af tiltag på tværs af huset og som kan kommunikere på en anerkendende og løsningsorienteret måde'. (Medarbejder på Fælledgården)

Kulturen på Plejecenter Fælledgården - vi er på vej
Som arbejdsplads er Fælledgården altid 'på vej' et nyt sted hen, og der sker noget. Det er en arbejdsplads med stærk faglighed, kreativ tænkning og stor stabilitet. Ledelsen består af forstander, seks afdelingsledere samt en køkken- og serviceleder. I ledergruppen gør vi meget ud af 'at være et fælles vi', så Fælledgården ikke opleves som mange små plejehjem i det store. Sagt med andre ord, det handler om at arbejde for og fremstå som et fælles plejecenter.

Fælledgården er et plejecenter fuld af aktiviteter – små som store – med plads til udvikling og forandring. Der er fokus på kvaliteten både i forhold til den enkelte beboers trivsel og stemme, samt at medarbejderne trives ved at være en del af en fleksibel og udviklingsorienteret arbejdsplads.

Plejecenter Fælledgården er en selvejende institution med 193 boliger fordelt på seks afdelinger, hvoraf en afdeling er en skærmet demensafdeling, hertil kommer eget stort produktionskøkken. Vi har egne terapeuter ansat, samt en række andre tværgående funktioner. Fælledgården er Københavns største plejecenter med driftsoverenskomst med Københavns Kommune.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og indenfor rammerne af lokal løndannelse. Vi indhenter straffeattest og tager referencer i forbindelse med ansættelse.

Vi ønsker at besætte stillingen fra den 1. november 2026.

Interesseret?
Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte forstander Joan Marie Aaatrand på 24 21 89 74 på hverdage mellem kl. 9-15.

Læs mere på Fælledgårdens hjemmeside.

Søg via linket senest onsdag den 9. september 2026
Vi holder 1. samtaler den 21. september og 2. samtaler den 28. september 2026. Hvis du går videre til 2. samtale, skal du være indstillet på at gennemføre en personlighedstest.

Job Description

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

This role is based in the Real-World & Clinical Data Strategy (RWCDS) team which drives data excellence and analytics to power enhanced decision-making and evidence-generation within Roche Product Development (PD). We develop and implement data strategies that unlock the value of clinical, operational, and real-world data to accelerate evidence generation, decision-making, and innovation across PD and beyond. By embedding FAIR principles, advancing data governance, and enabling data productization, RWCDS ensures that data is not only findable and usable, but also a driver of scientific rigor, regulatory readiness, and AI-powered transformation. Through deep partnerships with internal functions and external collaborators, we shape a future-ready data ecosystem that supports personalized healthcare and efficient drug development.

The Opportunity

The Principal Data Innovation Specialist (RWD) helps identify, prototype, and scale novel methods and technologies that transform how data is used across product development. Reporting to the Data Innovation Lead, you will explore emerging capabilities such as AI, semantic integration, and knowledge graphs to unlock new use cases for clinical, real-world, and operational data. You will collaborate with scientists, engineers, product teams, and external partners to design proof-of-concepts, validate innovative solutions, and assess long-term feasibility. This role requires curiosity, strong technical grounding, and a mindset oriented toward experimentation and continuous learning.

  • Multi-Agent & AI Development: Prototype, validate, and scale advanced AI capabilities, focusing heavily on multi-agent development and orchestration architectures to unlock complex use cases across product development.

  • Core Data Engineering: Lead robust data engineering activities to design, optimize, and streamline data workflows, building scalable data pipelines that integrate unstructured, multi-modal, and unconventional data sources.

  • Analytical Project Leadership: Drive innovation activities and lead complex analytical projects focused on exploring novel data types , automated agent-driven workflows, and knowledge graph integrations in a multi-modal environment.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with scientists, engineers, and product teams to pilot data innovations , integrating advanced engineering pipelines and multi-agent frameworks into broader clinical development and data science workflows.

  • Platform & Tool Creation: Drive the development of low-/no-code analytics platforms to democratize multi-modal data access and establish frameworks for the scalable evaluation, productization, and reuse of experimental data approaches.

  • Subject Matter Expertise & Mentorship: Serve as an innovation methodology expert , guiding peers through new data modalities while mentoring junior team members on cutting-edge techniques, data tools, and agent architectures.

  • Compliance & Data Governance: Proactively identify innovation areas via research while ensuring all engineering and AI frameworks maintain absolute compliance with data privacy and security regulations like HIPAA and GDPR.

Who You Are

  • Educational & Professional Foundation: You hold a Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field , with 6+ years of experience across data engineering, data science, or healthcare innovation settings.

  • AI & Agent Architecture Expertise: You demonstrate proven success implementing innovation pilots , with deep practical experience in AI-driven analytics, multi-agent architectures, and the application of engineering frameworks in complex research or industry environments.

  • Methodological Frameworks: You are highly proficient with agile development, product-thinking , and innovation lifecycle frameworks (such as Lean Startup or Design Thinking) , alongside experience evaluating new data platforms, APIs, or data partnerships.

  • Strategic & Independent Agility: You possess exceptional critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and independent decision-making capabilities that extend across both technical engineering domains and broader strategic areas.

  • Global Communication & Collaboration: You have excellent presentation and communication skills to explain complex technical concepts simply , thrive in a culturally diverse global workplace , and actively contribute to internal or external biomedical innovation communities.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to real-world data or research informatics in a biomedical setting

  • Interest in emerging technologies such as machine learning, knowledge graphs, or clinical AI

  • Ability to summarize results for both technical and non-technical audiences

Relocation benefits are not available for this posting

title: Sorø Kommune søger elever til Social- og sundhedsassistentuddannelsen med uddannelsesstart januar 2027
description:
For at blive optaget på Social og sundhedsuddannelsen, skal du have bestået folkeskolens afgangseksamen og have opnået mindst 02 i dansk og matematik på 9.klasses niveau. Du skal derudover have grundforløb 2 (GF2) for social- og sundhedsuddannelse / pædagogisk assistent eller anden baggrund, som giver merit og direkte adgang til SSA-uddannelsen.
Du kan læse mere om social- og sundhedsassistentuddannelserne på ZBCs hjemmeside.

I forbindelse med din elevuddannelse skal du søge om optagelse på social- og sundhedsassistentuddannelsen på

Hvis du ikke har GF 2 eller en anden adgangsgivende baggrund, kan du ansættes på grundforløbet (januar 2027) + et hovedforløb med løn.

Skoleforløbet foregår, som udgangspunkt, på ZBCs afdelinger i Ringsted eller Slagelse.

Vi lægger vægt på:
  • at du er engageret og motiveret
  • at du er positivt indstillet på at indgå i faglig og personlig udvikling under vejledning
  • at du er mødestabil og indgår i arbejdsfællesskabet med initiativ og samarbejdsvilje.

Når du ansættes, indgår du en uddannelsesaftale med Sorø Kommune. Ansættelsen er på 37 timer om ugen.
Praktikstederne er placeret forskellige steder i Sorø Kommune, herunder i Dianalund og Stenlille. Du vil derfor skulle regne med transporttid til dit praktiksted. Mødetiden i praktik vil oftest være kl. 7.00.

Som elev afhænger din lønindplacering af, om du kan få elevløn eller voksenelevløn.
Du kan finde lønindplaceringerne på FOA's hjemmeside.
For at få voksenelevløn under uddannelsen, skal du være fyldt 25 år.

Hvis du har brug for flere oplysninger, kan du kontakte uddannelseskonsulent Sybille L. Robert på telefon 23 43 31 53.

Sorø Kommune indhenter offentligt straffeattest ved ansættelse.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 30/09-26. Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler d. 07/10-2026.

I Sorø Kommune ser vi mangfoldighed som en styrke, og vi opfordrer alle interesserede til at søge stillingen uanset alder, køn, handicap, race, religion og etnisk tilhørsforhold. Vores værdigrundlag er: troværdighed, engagement og arbejdsglæde, dialog, åbenhed og anerkendelse.

Kommunen har godt 30.000 indbyggere og ligger midt på Sjælland i et naturskønt område med søer og skove. Sorø Kommune har ca. 2.500 medarbejdere – og så er vi i øvrigt en røgfri arbejdsplads.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:

You’ll contribute throughout the full software development lifecycle, from requirements refinement and test strategy through release validation. The role combines hands-on testing, automation, backend validation, API testing, database testing, and exploratory testing. title: Pædagog/pædagogisk assistent/pædagogmedhjælper med relevant erhvervserfaring til Heldagsskolen på Frydenstrandskolen
description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for børn med særlige behov og blive en del af et meningsfuldt pædagogisk arbejde?
Frydenstrandskolen i Frederikshavn søger en engageret og faglig dygtig pædagog/pædagogisk assistent/pædagogmedhjælper med relevant erhvervserfaring til en 37 timers stilling på Heldagsskolen.

Om Frydenstrandskolen og Heldagsskolen
Frydenstrandskolen er en stor skole med ca. 830 elever og 130 medarbejdere fordelt på tre matrikler, hvoraf Heldagsskolen udgør den ene matrikel. Vi har både almen undervisning, modtageklasser, talentsportsklasser og fælleskommunale specialtilbud, - herunder Heldagsskolen.

Heldagsskolen er Frederikshavn Kommunes specialtilbud for børn med AKT-vanskeligheder.
Vi har pt. 42 elever fordelt i 4 teams. Elevtallet svinger, da vi både modtager og udsluser elever hen over året.
Vi modtager elever fra 0. kl. – 9. klasse fra hele Frederikshavn Kommune. Eleverne undervises i alle folkeskolens fag, og det er vigtigt for os, at de bliver så dygtige som muligt.
Du bliver en del af en personalegruppe på 9 pædagoger, 10 lærere, en sekretær og en afdelingsleder, der alle har et ligeværdigt, professionelt og stærkt samarbejde.

Organisering og hverdag
Dit team består af 3 lærere, 1 pædagog og dig. I hverdagen arbejder I tæt sammen om at skabe struktur, tryghed og faglig/personlig/social udvikling for teamets 10 elever, som går i 0. – 3. klasse.
Du vil blive kontaktperson for 1-2 elever. Dette indebærer bl.a. tæt forældresamarbejde, mødedeltagelse og ansvar for elevhandleplanen.
Børnene er på skolen fra 08.00 – 15.30 og dagen består af både faglig undervisning, aktiviteter, leg og ekskursioner. Du vil som pædagog have en central rolle i både undervisnings- og fritidsdelen.
Du skal forvente at deltage i mødevirksomhed efter skoletid, vikardækning samt feriepasning.

Vores pædagogiske tilgang
Vi arbejder ud fra en anerkendende og relationsbåren tilgang, hvor alle føler sig velkomne, set og hørt, - både elever, forældre, samarbejdspartnere og personale.
Gennem en stærk faglighed, viden om elevens vanskeligheder og gode relationer til elever og forældre, søger vi at skabe grundlag for den størst mulige trivsel hos den enkelte elev.

  • Vi er ressourceorienterede og tror på, at alle børn gør det godt.
  • Vi har særligt fokus på det neuroaffektive område og Low Arousal tilgangen, hvor vi arbejder med afstemning, ro og konfliktnedtrapning.
  • Vi er optagede af at give alle børn mulighed for at deltage og være del af et fællesskab.


Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er pædagog, pædagogisk assistent eller pædagogmedhjælper med relevant erhvervserfaring
  • Har erfaring eller interesse for specialområdet og børn med særlige behov
  • Har stærke relationskompetencer
  • Er robust, bevarer roen og agerer professionelt i pressede situationer
  • Er handlekraftig, fleksibel og initiativrig
  • Har overblik og tænker hurtigt i komplekse pædagogiske situationer
  • Har en god humoristisk sans og bidrager til det positive arbejdsmiljø


Du vil opleve

  • En arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab
  • Et tæt samarbejde mellem pædagoger, lærere, ledelse, forældre og eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • Mulighed for udvikling og sparring
  • At blive en del af et team, som arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe struktur, tryghed og udvikling for vores elever
  • At få en central rolle i både undervisnings- og fritidsdelen
  • En hverdag med mening, variation og mulighed for at gøre en forskel

Efter gældende overenskomst

title: Junior Systems Analyst
description:
Junior Systems Analyst

The Junior Systems Analyst will be responsible for providing support, training, maintenance,
and acting as a liaison between the company and service providers for various information
systems used within our agricultural business. This role will require a deep understanding of
the systems, as well as the ability to facilitate effective communication and collaboration
between internal stakeholders and external service providers. Analyzing and identifying any
gaps within the departments and various systems to be addressed.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. System Support:
    Provide first level support for the following information systems: Dipar Datagear,
    Peopleflow, Hubdoc, Payspace, Syft, Power BI, Mesh, Xero, Approval Max, Sign now,
    Netcash, Picsa, and Microsoft 365, Jotform.
    Troubleshoot and resolve system related issues in a timely and efficient manner.
    Maintain a detailed knowledge of each system to assist end users effectively.
  2. Training:
    Develop and deliver training programs and materials for employees to ensure they
    have a solid understanding of the systems they use.
    Conduct regular training sessions and workshops to enhance system proficiency.
  3. System Maintenance:
    Regularly update and maintain the information systems, ensuring they are up to date
    and secure.
    Collaborate with IT and system administrators to implement patches, updates, and
    fixes.
  4. Liaison with Service Providers:
    Serve as the primary point of contact between the company and external service providers for the supported systems.
    Coordinate communication and resolution of issues between the company and service providers.
  5. User Access Management:
    Manage user access and permissions within the systems to ensure data security and compliance.
    Assist in creating and revoking user accounts as needed.
  6. Reporting and Analysis:
    Generate reports and analyze system data using Power BI to provide insights and
    recommendations for improving system performance.
    Design and develop a reporting dashboard for management across the business.
  7. Documentation:
    Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all supported systems,
    including user manuals and procedures.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

  1. System Uptime: Maintain a high level of system uptime, with minimal downtime due to issues or maintenance.
  2. Response Time: Respond to and resolve system-related issues within established timeframes.
  3. User Satisfaction: Regularly gather feedback from end users and maintain a high level of user satisfaction with system support and training.
  4. Training Effectiveness: Measure the effectiveness of training programs through post-training assessments and feedback from employees.
  5. System Security: Ensure that all supported systems are secure and up-to-date, with no security breaches.
  6. Resolution Time: Monitor and reduce the time taken to resolve system-related issues.
  7. Communication and Collaboration: Facilitate smooth communication and collaboration between the company and service providers.
  8. Documentation Quality: Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation for all systems.

Qualifications and Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Knowledge of the listed information systems is a plus.
Certification in relevant systems and technologies is desirable.
Power BI implementation and exposure.
Development experience in a backend and/or frontend environment.

As a Staff Data Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader shaping the architecture, scalability, security, and performance of an enterprise data platform.
You will guide strategic decisions across data engineering while building modern warehouse, lakehouse, pipeline, and data product solutions.
The role focuses heavily on healthcare data, requiring strong expertise in clinical standards, governance, privacy, and large-scale data management.
You will work across hybrid cloud environments, using technologies such as Databricks, AWS, Terraform, Python, SQL, and Delta Live Tables.
You will partner with engineering, data science, analytics, development, and business teams to translate complex requirements into reliable and secure solutions.

Accountabilities

    • Act as a subject matter expert and thought leader for the Data Platform domain, providing technical guidance and influencing architecture and engineering decisions.
    • Define and advance data engineering strategy, including approaches for moving, storing, processing, governing, and maintaining high-quality enterprise data.

    • Expand and optimize enterprise data warehouses and lakehouse environments supporting healthcare-focused data products and internal use cases.
    • Establish and maintain data governance capabilities, including Unity Catalog configuration, data lineage, data quality, auditability, stewardship, and compliance with evolving industry standards.

    • Build platform infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code practices, including Terraform, Asset Bundles, and GitHub-based development workflows.
    • Partner with business stakeholders to design cost-effective and transparent data solutions while balancing performance, scalability, security, and operational requirements.
    • Architect, build, maintain, monitor, and optimize scalable data pipelines and ETL infrastructure across diverse data sources.
    • Work with migration and integration technologies such as Fivetran, AWS services, and custom data ingestion solutions.
    • Design reliable event-driven data processing and effective pipeline monitoring capabilities to improve resilience and operational visibility.
    • Design and implement internal APIs that enable data integration across systems and applications.

    • Assemble complex datasets that satisfy functional and non-functional requirements while ensuring models align with business objectives and data privacy regulations.
    • Collaborate with data engineering, software development, analytics, data science, clinical, and business teams to gather requirements and deliver meaningful data solutions.

      • Expert-level experience with Databricks and AWS.
      • Expert knowledge of relational and non-relational databases, including technologies such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and DocumentDB.
      • Demonstrated experience managing and standardizing clinical data from both structured and unstructured sources.
      • Extensive experience building, deploying, and managing data solutions within AWS environments.
      • Expert knowledge of healthcare data standards, including FHIR, C-CDA, and traditional HL7.
      • Expert knowledge of clinical standards and ontologies such as ICD-10, SNOMED, NDC, LOINC, and RxNorm.
      • Expert capability in data modeling, enterprise data warehouse architecture, data lake design, and data product development.
      • Strong experience designing and building APIs, ETL frameworks, data ingestion processes, and supporting enterprise data solutions.
      • Experience with performance tuning, query optimization, data security, monitoring, and release management.
      • Proven ability to work with large, disparate datasets, including identified and de-identified healthcare data from multiple sources.
      • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Asset Bundles, and GitHub.
      • Experience collaborating with Data Science teams and developing or supporting AI-based solutions that generate operational efficiencies and business value.
      • Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical disciplines.
      • Ability to navigate ambiguity, identify practical solutions, and balance strategic priorities with tactical execution.
      • Demonstrated ability to teach, mentor, and influence engineering teams on new and emerging technologies.
      • Customer-focused and business-oriented approach, with the ability to connect technical decisions to measurable organizational outcomes.
      • Self-directed, thorough, driven, and comfortable taking ownership of complex technical initiatives.
      • Strong influencing and persuasion skills, with the ability to lead without relying solely on formal authority.
      • Curiosity about emerging industry trends and a commitment to selecting fit-for-purpose technologies and approaches.
      • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
      • Experience within the health insurance or life insurance industry is preferred.
      • Professional-level AWS solution architecture certification is a plus.
      • Willingness to travel to a company office in Brookfield, Wisconsin, as needed, as well as travel nationally for meetings, conferences, and team events.
