title: Alberquero
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

Se tú

El Alberquero será responsable del mantenimiento, operación y óptimas condiciones de las piscinas, spas y demás cuerpos de agua que forman parte de las instalaciones del hotel, contribuyendo al cumplimiento de los objetivos diarios, semanales y mensuales del departamento.

Fecha estimada de contratación: Octubre 2026

Conocimientos y Habilidades

  • Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en operación y mantenimiento de piscinas, spas y cuerpos de agua, preferentemente en la industria hotelera.

  • Conocimientos en el manejo y control del balance fisicoquímico del agua en piscinas, spas y cuerpos de agua.

  • Conocimientos en el uso y manejo de equipos y herramientas especializadas para el mantenimiento de piscinas y cuerpos de agua.

  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera eficiente en espacios reducidos o con obstáculos físicos.

* Esta posición requiere que los candidatos cuenten con autorización vigente para trabajar en México.

Domina tu oficio

  • Mantener el balance fisicoquímico del agua de piscinas, spas y cuerpos de agua dentro de los parámetros establecidos.

  • Realizar la limpieza, mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo de piscinas, spas, filtros, bombas, válvulas y equipos relacionados.

  • Monitorear diariamente el funcionamiento de los equipos y detectar oportunamente cualquier anomalía o riesgo.

  • Realizar la correcta dosificación y manejo seguro de productos químicos.

  • Registrar en HotSOS y bitácoras los parámetros, mantenimientos e incidencias del área.

  • Mantener las áreas de piscinas y spas limpias, seguras y en óptimas condiciones para el uso de los huéspedes.

Lo que Ofrecemos y lo que Puedes Esperar

  • Formar parte de un equipo colaborativo con un genuino espíritu de familia, donde tu talento será valorado y reconocido.

  • Salarios altamente competitivos, con un atractivo plan de incentivos anual para puestos gerenciales y de Jefatura de Departamento.

  • Servicio de transporte desde San Lucas y San José del Cabo hasta el resort.

  • Servicio de lavandería de uniformes, garantizando comodidad y una imagen profesional.

  • Programas de capacitación y talleres internos que apoyan tu desarrollo profesional.

  • Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico, diverso y desafiante, con interacción cercana con el equipo de liderazgo.

  • Programas de reconocimiento que celebran tus logros, incluyendo reconocimientos por años de servicio, Empleado del Mes y Empleado del Año.

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO como "Las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE desde 1998 y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

Cultura de servicio

Actualmente operando 120 hoteles y resorts, y 45 propiedades residenciales en los principales centros de las ciudades y destinos turísticos en 47 países, y con más de 50 proyectos en planificación o desarrollo, Four Seasons se ubica constantemente entre los mejores hoteles del mundo y las marcas más prestigiosas en las encuestas de lectores, críticas de viajeros y premios de la industria. Nuestro mayor activo, y la clave de nuestro éxito, es nuestra gente. Creemos que cada uno de nosotros necesita un sentido de dignidad, orgullo y satisfacción en lo que hacemos.

¿Cómo es trabajar para Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts?

En Four Seasons, guiamos todas nuestras acciones por la regla de oro: “Trata a los demás como te gustaría ser tratado”. Aquí, podrá trabajar en un equipo que se basa en el respeto mutuo, la colaboración, el excelente servicio y la pasión por el servicio. Como marca de lujo, su trabajo también se guiará por estándares muy estrictos para garantizar un alto nivel de calidad y servicio en todo momento. Espere trabajar duro pero diviértase y aprenda en el camino, llevando su carrera, experiencia y habilidades al siguiente nivel. Como beneficio adicional, trabajar con Four Seasons le brinda la oportunidad de trabajar para una empresa internacional y viajar por todo el mundo mientras se hospeda en propiedades increíbles de forma gratuita.

title: Associate Principal AI Architect (Claude AI)
description:
What success looks like in this role:

The AI Architect owns the technical onboarding and integration of the Anthropic Claude platform, and leads the knowledge-transfer effort from the Outgoing Providers into Provider's BAU operating model. This role combines the SoW's "Platform & Integration" and "Knowledge Transfer Lead" scopes into a single Associate Principal Architect position, and is also the primary architecture-level escalation point for L1.5/L2 support.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead onboarding and configuration of the Anthropic Claude platform tenant, API gateway, single sign-on (SSO), SOC/SIEM, and observability integrations across UAT, staging, and production environments.
  • Lead the formal, time-boxed knowledge-transfer exercise with the Outgoing Providers (Accenture and Tribe AI), capturing configurations, the prompt/agent catalog, and integration documentation.
  • Develop and validate L1.5/L2 support runbooks and technical documentation as part of the Transition deliverables.
  • Support the estate assessment and BAU readiness report during the Discovery & Readiness phase, identifying and closing knowledge/documentation gaps.
  • Provide L1.5/L2 architecture-level support and escalation input for Priority 1 and Priority 2 Incidents, contributing to Response and Restoration Service Levels (SL-1 through SL-4).
  • Administer the Anthropic platform, APIs, and associated products (Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Claude Design, Claude Agents) as part of ongoing platform administration.
  • Support structured rollout waves and enterprise role-based access control (RBAC) enablement as directed by Customer's AI governance team.
  • Track continuous platform innovation — features, backlog items, and release cadence — and feed relevant changes into FinOps and adoption reporting.
  • Partner with the Security Architect on guardrail and policy governance, including usage controls and financial guardrails.
  • Participate in the biweekly AI Review Board.
  • Deliver Consulting-track engagements (Medium and Large advisory requests): prompt-library tuning, solution/agent design, integration guidance, and scoped proof-of-concept work.

Required Qualifications

  • Claude Certified Architect – Foundations (CCA-F) — Anthropic's official proctored certification for designing and shipping enterprise-grade Claude applications (or committed to obtaining it within an agreed timeframe of joining).
  • Proven experience architecting and integrating enterprise SaaS/AI platforms, including API gateway, SSO, and SIEM/observability integrations.
  • Hands-on experience with GenAI/LLM platforms (prompt engineering, agent design, integration patterns).
  • Experience leading knowledge-transfer exercises and producing operational runbooks/documentation for support teams.
  • Ability to operate as an escalation point for complex technical incidents (L1.5/L2).
  • Strong stakeholder-facing skills to support governance forums and consulting engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on production experience with Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Claude Design, or Claude Agents.
  • Experience with ServiceNow/ITSM-based operating models.
  • Familiarity with FinOps practices for AI/token-based usage reporting.
  • Experience supporting proof-of-concept to production transitions for AI solutions.

title: Senior Insider and Data Risk Analyst
description:
Sr. Insider & Data Risk Analyst

Team: Analyst

Location: Germany

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Insider & Data Risk Analyst based in Germany.

This is a senior individual contributor role focused on protecting sensitive information, systems, and people from insider and data-loss risks. You will own complex investigations from initial triage through resolution while helping mature insider risk management and Data Loss Prevention capabilities. The role sits at the intersection of cybersecurity, data protection, privacy, and regulated financial services. You will work closely with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security teams on highly sensitive cases requiring discretion and sound judgment. The position also offers an opportunity to strengthen risk processes, automate investigations, and apply AI to emerging security challenges. Success requires a highly organized professional who can translate complex findings into clear recommendations for both technical teams and leadership.

Accountabilities

    • Own insider risk investigations from initial triage through closure, including establishing case timelines, coordinating containment and escalation, documenting determinations, and capturing lessons learned.
    • Mature the Insider Risk Management Program by developing scalable case-management processes, risk-tiering methodologies, investigation standards, and repeatable workflows.
    • Operate, monitor, and tune Data Loss Prevention capabilities across SaaS applications, endpoints, and other environments, improving detection quality while reducing false positives.
    • Investigate potential data exfiltration, misuse, policy violations, and inappropriate access involving source code, cloud platforms, collaboration tools, third-party applications, and critical business or trading systems.
    • Strengthen data classification and governance practices while aligning DLP controls with information sensitivity and business risk.
    • Assess risks associated with unauthorized AI and agentic tooling, including potential exposure of sensitive or proprietary information through approved and unsanctioned AI applications.
    • Use workflow automation, AI, and security orchestration capabilities to improve alert triage, investigation efficiency, and the overall maturity of insider risk processes.
    • Lead insider risk and data protection assessments, maintain risk registers, and track remediation activities and emerging threats.
    • Partner with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security on sensitive personnel cases, departures, policy violations, and data-handling concerns with a high level of discretion and care.
    • Support internal and external audits, regulatory requirements, and security assurance activities related to insider risk, data protection, privacy, and information security.
    • Contribute insider risk and secure data-handling content to security awareness and employee training programs.
    • Serve as a senior escalation point for insider risk cases and mentor colleagues on investigation methodologies, case management, and effective risk analysis.
    • Monitor developments in insider risk, data protection, privacy, cybersecurity, and financial services regulation to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

      • Requirements:

      • 4+ years of professional experience in insider risk, Data Loss Prevention, digital forensics, security investigations, or a closely related discipline.
      • Demonstrated hands-on experience leading sensitive investigations and managing cases involving personnel matters, data misuse, policy violations, or potential exfiltration.
      • Practical experience operating and tuning DLP solutions across SaaS and endpoint environments, with an understanding of detection quality and false-positive reduction.
      • Experience with workflow automation, AI, or SOAR platforms for alert triage, investigation support, and case orchestration.
      • Strong understanding of data classification, data governance, data protection, and information security principles.
      • Working knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis, such as Elastic/ELK or Splunk, to support investigations and establish evidence-based conclusions.
      • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks including NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and privacy regulations such as GDPR and APPI.
      • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear investigation reports, case documentation, risk assessments, and executive summaries.

title: Social- og sundhedsassistent søges til specialiseret botilbud i Hadsten
description:
Er du uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent, og ønsker du at gøre en reel forskel for voksne med betydelige funktionsnedsættelser?

Vi søger en nærværende og fagligt engageret kollega, som har lyst til at blive en del af et stærkt tværfagligt arbejdsfællesskab. Hos os får du mulighed for at bringe både dine sundhedsfaglige og relationelle kompetencer i spil i en hverdag, hvor omsorg, pleje, dokumentation og livskvalitet går hånd i hånd.
Vi søger en ny kollega, fordi flere borgere fremover vil modtage helhedstilbud i botilbuddet.
Det giver os mulighed for at styrke bemandingen og skabe endnu bedre rammer for borgernes hverdag.
Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer ugentligt. Ønsker du et lavere timetal, er vi åbne for dialog. Erfaring med mennesker med nedsat funktionsevne er en fordel, men ikke en forudsætning.

Om stedet og borgerne
Ellemosevej 26B er et specialiseret botilbud i Hadsten og en del af Voksenhandicap i Favrskov Kommune.
Her bor ni voksne borgere med multiple funktionsnedsættelser. Flere af borgerne er nonverbale og har omfattende støttebehov både fysisk, psykisk og sanseligt.
Borgerne har behov for støtte til personlig pleje, måltider, kommunikation, aktiviteter og deltagelse i sociale fællesskaber. Alle borgere er kørestolsbrugere, og fælles for alle er, at de har brug for medarbejdere, der møder dem med nærvær, respekt og faglig nysgerrighed.

Fagligt ståsted
Vi arbejder med afsæt i borgernes tilstræbte indefra-perspektiv og Favrskov Kommunes tilgang Mest muligt i eget liv. Det betyder, at vi tager udgangspunkt i den enkelte borgers ønsker, behov og ressourcer, og at vi har fokus på at skabe et værdigt og meningsfuldt liv for den enkelte.
Vi er nysgerrige på borgernes individuelle udtryk og forsøger at forstå deres perspektiver, behov og intentioner bag deres handlinger og kommunikation.
Vi arbejder systematisk med mål og dokumentation med udgangspunkt i SMART. Dokumentationen er en vigtig del af den faglige indsats og bidrager til at sikre kvalitet, udvikling og sammenhæng i borgernes forløb.
Kommunikationen med borgerne foregår ofte gennem kropssprog, mimik, lyde, tegn til tale og andre alternative kommunikationsformer. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er nysgerrig på de små signaler og har lyst til at arbejde med forskellige kommunikationsformer og støttesystemer.
Vi prioriterer det tværfaglige samarbejde højt og har et tæt og tillidsfuldt samarbejde med pårørende, som vi ser som en vigtig del af borgernes liv.

Din hverdag hos os
Som social- og sundhedsassistent bliver du en del af et engageret og fagligt stærkt team, der samarbejder tæt om at skabe trygge og meningsfulde rammer for borgerne.
Din hverdag vil blandt andet veksle mellem personlig pleje, relationsarbejde, nærvær samt dokumentation, planlægning og samarbejde med pårørende, dagtilbud, myndighed og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.
Du vil være med til at udarbejde materiale til opfølgningsmøder og sikre, at borgernes støtte tilrettelægges med blik for deres individuelle behov, ressourcer og udtryk.
Du vil desuden bidrage aktivt til dokumentation, evaluering og opfølgning på borgernes mål og delmål.
Som social- og sundhedsassistent får du mulighed for at bringe din autorisation og sundhedsfaglige faglighed aktivt i spil i arbejdet med en kompleks borgergruppe.

Du får en central rolle i den sundhedsfaglige indsats omkring borgerne. Du bliver en del af gruppen af medicinansvarlige medarbejdere på Ellemosevej og får ansvar for medicinhåndteringen på Ellemosevej 26B samt medicinopgaver på botilbuddet Ellemosevej 26C.
Du vil have et tæt samarbejde med de øvrige sundhedsfaglige kolleger, som understøtter den sundhedsfaglige kvalitet og udvikling på området.
Du bliver en del af et sundhedsfagligt fællesskab i Voksenhandicap, hvor vi understøtter hinanden med sparring, videndeling og sundhedsfaglige opgaver på tværs af afdelingerne.
Mange af vores borgere oplever gradvist tab af funktioner og færdigheder. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan se betydningen af de små tegn og ændringer i borgernes trivsel, sundhedstilstand og funktionsniveau. Du skal kunne arbejde ud fra et sundhedsfagligt perspektiv og samtidig hvile i dit professionelle ståsted.
Du får en vigtig rolle i at understøtte kollegernes sundhedsfaglige praksis og skal kunne trives med at oplære og vejlede medarbejdere i borgerspecifikke kompetencer, herunder medicinrelaterede opgaver.

Vi arbejder med struktur og tydelighed som ramme og med nysgerrighed og respekt som tilgang. Du bliver en vigtig del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, værner om fællesskabet og har blik for de små tegn, der viser, at vores indsats gør en forskel.

Vi søger en kollega, der
  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent
  • Har lyst til at arbejde med voksne med betydelige funktionsnedsættelser
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en del af et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab
  • Har interesse for kommunikation, relationsarbejde og borgernes individuelle udtryk
  • Har lyst til at tage ansvar for og bidrage til den sundhedsfaglige indsats omkring borgerne
  • Trives med ansvar for medicinhåndtering og sundhedsfaglige opgaver
  • Arbejder metodisk og ser dokumentation som et vigtigt redskab i den faglige indsats
  • Har blik for små ændringer i borgernes trivsel, sundhed og funktionsniveau
  • Kan reflektere over egen og fælles praksis og bidrage til den faglige udvikling
  • Har kendskab til FMK eller lyst til at lære det
  • Trives med at vejlede og oplære kolleger i borgerspecifikke sundhedsfaglige opgaver
  • Møder borgere, pårørende og kolleger med en anerkendende og respektfuld tilgang
  • Er fleksibel, ansvarlig og stabil
  • Har kørekort (kategori B) og er villig til at køre botilbuddets handicapbusser
Erfaring med målgruppen er ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, engagere dig og være med til at skabe de bedst mulige rammer for borgerne.

Vi tilbyder
  • En spændende arbejdsplads med en unik borgergruppe
  • Månedlige sundhedsfaglige netværksmøder med faglig sparring og videndeling
  • En tilknyttet sygeplejerske til sparring og faglig understøttelse
  • Et tæt samarbejde med øvrige medicinansvarlige kolleger
  • En fast mentor, som bidrager til en tryg opstart og fungerer som løbende sparringspartner i hverdagen
  • Grundig introduktion og oplæring
  • Høj faglighed og et tæt samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper
  • Engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger
  • En nærværende ledelse, der prioriterer faglig sparring og udvikling
  • Fokus på faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med plads til humor, forskellighed og fællesskab
  • En hverdag, hvor du gør en mærkbar forskel for andre mennesker

Arbejdstid
Du indgår i en vagtplan med både dag- og aftenvagter og arbejder i gennemsnit hver 3. weekend.

Yderligere oplysninger
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, eller ønsker du at høre mere om arbejdspladsen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Stine Rose på telefon 20 31 46 17.
Ellemosevej 26B er beliggende i Hadsten med gode transportmuligheder og centralt placeret mellem Aarhus, Randers og Silkeborg.

Ansøgningsfrist og tiltrædelse
Ansøgningsfristen er den 26. august 2026. Vi afholder løbende ansættelsessamtaler.

Tiltrædelse 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt.
Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og til at byde dig velkommen i en hverdag, hvor faglighed og menneskelighed går hånd i hånd.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Du bliver ansat i Voksenhandicap, Favrskov Kommune.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst.

Favrskov Kommune kan kun modtage ansøgninger sendt elektronisk. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelsen, at den person, som vi ønsker at ansætte, ikke er straffet for forhold, som gør vedkommende uegnet til at bestride stillingen. Der vil derfor blive indhentet straffeattest på den kandidat, der tilbydes ansættelse.

title: Afløser søges – Træd ind i Zakarias’ og Elviras helt særlige univers - I Valby
description:
…hvor kreativitet, nærvær og små hverdagseventyr venter lige indenfor døren.

Forestil dig at træde ind i et hjem, hvor en lille allergivenlig hund kommer logrende for at sige hej, og hvor to meget forskellige – men lige fantastiske – børn er klar til at invitere dig ind i deres verden.

Mød Zakarias – elektronikmagikeren

Zakarias er 12 år og han har infantil autisme og ADHD. Han har et blik, der lyser op, så snart snakken falder på elektronik.
Han elsker at nørde., lodde, skille ting ad, bygge op igen, gaming, koblinger, nørdede YouTube kanaler der underviser i fysik/kemi, biologi, universet… du nævner det, han dyrker det.

Når du sidder med ham, kan tiden stå stille. Han snakker, du lytter og pludselig sidder I midt i en snak om kredsløb eller hvorfor hans nye computerdel er “sygt nice”.
Han har brug for en voksen, der gider hans interesse. En voksen, der ikke stopper ham, men guider ham, motiverer ham og hjælper ham med at finde balancen mellem skærm og alt det andet, han også kan og gerne må. Han er engageret, sjov, ekstremt kreativ – og du bliver hurtigt hans sparringspartner i et univers af idéer, hvad enten du kan støtte ham i det kreative omkring elektronikken, at sy kæmpe Wobble dogs eller bygge ting ud af pap.

Mød Elvira – ”Ronja Røverdatteren”

Hun er 7 år og har ADHD og en formodning om autisme. Hun er skøn, finurlig og der er fart på tankerne og fortællingerne. Elvira vil gerne ud. På rulleskøjter, en tur med hunden, eller til kaninerne på den bemandede legeplads. Elvira har brug for støtte til at koncentrere sig og måske er du nødt til at vinde hendes tillid. Hvis du er rolig, nærværende og giver hende plads, vil hun stille åbne døren til sit eget lille univers. Hun trives med gentagelser og en tydelig struktur og hun elsker hvis du vil lege med hende og følge hendes ideer.

Hverdagen hjemme hos familien

Familien består udover Zakarias og Elvira og deres venlige og glade hund også af en bror på 9 år og deres mor. Hjemmet er trygt, varmt og rart. Familien værdsætter pædagogik, hvor man lytter, læser rummet, skaber ro og brugbar motivation. Ikke krav, men relationer der er båret af lyst og struktur der rammesættes for børnene.

Du bliver ikke et “ekstra hænder-job”.
Du bliver den voksne, børnene glæder sig til at se.

Dine timer – små faste øjeblikke af hverdag og ro

Tirsdag – 15:45–19:45
Zakarias skal til svømning. Det vurderes på dagsform og tilknytning om du følger Zakarias eller at følge Elvira til kirkekor, en familieaktivitet i den lokale kirke
Du kan låne familiebilen – så kørekort er nødvendigt.

Du skal sidde i et rum når Zakarias er til svømning, hvor du har mulighed for at studere i 2 timer.

Onsdag – 15:30–18:30
Hyggestund hjemme med Zakarias og klargøring af familiens aftensmad.
Det kan være kreative aktiviteter, små projekter, leg, spil, noget roligt – eller at du hjælper med at finde alternativer til skærm, eller deltager i tiden på skærm hvis dagsformen passer bedst til det.

Mulighed for flere timer. Familien har flere timer til rådighed, og ser gerne, at du har mulighed for nogen fleksibilitet ved behov for hjælp ved møder, lægebesøg og div.

Hvem drømmer vi om?

Vi håber på at finde en som:

  • elsker at lytte og være nærværende
  • kan fornemme børn og rummet omkring dem
  • måske selv har en nørdet side – eller bare lyst til at lære af Zakarias
  • kan være den rolige voksen for Elvira
  • kan motivere frem for at stille krav
  • kan tilpasse og justere krav og forventninger i aktiviteter
  • er stabil, hjertevarm og tør træde ind i relationen
  • har kørekort (bil kan lånes)

men vigtigst er, at du er dig og at du vil børnene

Hvorfor netop du bliver vigtig:

Fordi du får lov at være en del af en familie og give børnene noget helt særligt:
Ro, tryghed, opbakning, motivation – og ægte relation.
Og du får samtidig en hverdag fuld af grin, hygge, knapper, ledninger, hundenus, kreative øjeblikke og små, store sejre.

Hvis det lyder som noget for dig, så send en ansøgning, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv – hvem du er, hvorfor du gerne vil være sammen med Zakarias og Elvira, og hvad du kan bidrage med.
Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Steward
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

Se tú

El Steward es el ​encargado de lavar, transportar y almacenar vajilla y cubiertos de los sectores de Alimentos y Bebidas del Hotel. Colaborará con tareas de limpieza de los sectores de Alimentos y Bebidas.

Conocimientos y Habilidades

  • Experiencia requerida en el puesto mínimo de 6 meses

  • Experiencia en hotelería de lujo

  • Experiencia requerida en el puesto mínimo de 1 año

  • Experiencia en hotelería de lujo

  • Habilidad para hablar, escribir y leer el idioma Español.

  • Máximo nivel de integridad y transparencia

  • Habilidades para resolver problemas, tomar decisiones y resolver conflictos

  • Trabajar de manera segura, prudente y organizada

* Esta posición requiere que los candidatos cuenten con autorización vigente para trabajar en México.

Domina tu oficio

  • Contribuir a nuestro entorno con una actitud positiva y amistosa.

  • Demostrar conocimiento en F & B.

  • Comunicarse con los miembros del equipo para asegurar el más alto nivel de servicio personalizado.

  • Se encarga del “Back” de la cocina lavando los platos, vasos, cubiertos, los utensilios de cocina en los que incluye ollas, sartenes, cacerolas, además de cocinas, freidoras, neveras etc.

  • Cumplir con las Reglas de Trabajo y Normas de Conducta según Four Seasons.

  • Trabajar armónica y profesionalmente con compañeros de trabajo y supervisores de manera respetuosa sin faltar a nuestra "regla de oro".

  • Cumplir los estándares de la compañía y secuencia de servicio.

  • Al final de la jornada limpiar pisos, mesones y dejar la cocina impecable después de todos los turnos.

Lo que Ofrecemos y lo que Puedes Esperar

  • Formar parte de un equipo colaborativo con un genuino espíritu de familia, donde tu talento será valorado y reconocido.

  • Salarios altamente competitivos, con un atractivo plan de incentivos anual para puestos gerenciales y de Jefatura de Departamento.

  • Servicio de transporte desde San Lucas y San José del Cabo hasta el resort.

  • Servicio de lavandería de uniformes, garantizando comodidad y una imagen profesional.

  • Programas de capacitación y talleres internos que apoyan tu desarrollo profesional.

  • Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico, diverso y desafiante, con interacción cercana con el equipo de liderazgo.

  • Programas de reconocimiento que celebran tus logros, incluyendo reconocimientos por años de servicio, Empleado del Mes y Empleado del Año.

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO como "Las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE desde 1998 y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

Cultura de servicio

Actualmente operando 120 hoteles y resorts, y 45 propiedades residenciales en los principales centros de las ciudades y destinos turísticos en 47 países, y con más de 50 proyectos en planificación o desarrollo, Four Seasons se ubica constantemente entre los mejores hoteles del mundo y las marcas más prestigiosas en las encuestas de lectores, críticas de viajeros y premios de la industria. Nuestro mayor activo, y la clave de nuestro éxito, es nuestra gente. Creemos que cada uno de nosotros necesita un sentido de dignidad, orgullo y satisfacción en lo que hacemos.

¿Cómo es trabajar para Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts?

En Four Seasons, guiamos todas nuestras acciones por la regla de oro: “Trata a los demás como te gustaría ser tratado”. Aquí, podrá trabajar en un equipo que se basa en el respeto mutuo, la colaboración, el excelente servicio y la pasión por el servicio. Como marca de lujo, su trabajo también se guiará por estándares muy estrictos para garantizar un alto nivel de calidad y servicio en todo momento. Espere trabajar duro pero diviértase y aprenda en el camino, llevando su carrera, experiencia y habilidades al siguiente nivel. Como beneficio adicional, trabajar con Four Seasons le brinda la oportunidad de trabajar para una empresa internacional y viajar por todo el mundo mientras se hospeda en propiedades increíbles de forma gratuita.

description:

Job Description:

Internal Precision Logistics (Marken) Candidates only

Marken is seeking a strategic and solutions-driven Key Account Excellence Investigation Analyst to join a growing team dedicated to operational excellence and client satisfaction. This role blends investigative rigor with continuous improvement, supporting Marken’s mission to deliver high-quality logistics solutions in healthcare, pharmaceuticals, and essential labs. As part of the Key Account Operational Excellence (KAOE) team, you’ll collaborate across Operations, Quality, and regional departments to resolve issues, enhance processes, and prevent future incidents. You’ll be a key player in driving performance and strengthening client relationships.

Schedule: Monday – Friday, approximately 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM ET
Internal Grade: 10D - Job Level: 51 Specialist

  • Conduct root cause analysis through perceptive interviews, data review, and procedural audits to identify and correct systemic gaps.

  • Champion continuous improvement by documenting findings, recommending preventive actions, and contributing to Marken’s growth.

  • Perform regulatory compliance audits (TSA/FAA) and ensure adherence to transportation rules and hazmat shipping protocols.

  • Leverage Marken technologies to track shipping milestones and provide actionable insights that improve future performance.

  • Collaborate on future-focused initiatives to streamline investigations and enhance security protocols using innovative tools and methodologies.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or international equivalent (preferred).

  • Experience in quality-driven industries such as healthcare, pharmaceuticals, or essential labs.

  • Familiarity with airline logistics, hazmat shipping, and dangerous goods regulations.

  • Prior experience in military, law enforcement, or investigations is a plus.

  • High ethical standards and ability to maintain strict confidentiality.

  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and time management skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Access, Outlook).

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with a focus on client satisfaction and operational excellence.

Permanent

title: Software Craftsperson

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Craftsperson/Flutter/React based in Mexico.

This is a remote opportunity for a mid-level software engineer who is passionate about building high-quality, maintainable software.
You will work on mobile product features and medium-sized engineering challenges while developing greater technical ownership.
The role combines hands-on development with strong software craftsmanship, test-driven development and pragmatic engineering practices.
You will collaborate closely with experienced engineers, contribute to technical decisions and help turn ambiguous problems into clear solutions.

    • Follow an MVP-oriented approach by delivering small, valuable increments frequently while maintaining a high quality bar.

title: Medarbejder til myndighedsopgaver - Sygedagpenge-udbetaling og refusion
description:
Vil du være en livline for mennesker, der står i en svær livssituation? Hos Ydelsescentret guider og hjælper vi borgere, der har brug for en økonomisk ydelse. Du skal være skarp til at formidle kompleks viden på en letforståelig måde, være hurtig til at vække tillid og have lyst til at skabe gode relationer til borgere og samarbejdspartnerne.

Tillid, nysgerrighed og høj faglighed er grundlæggende værdier for vores arbejde. Derfor tror vi på, at borgeren kan og vil det meste selv. Vi møder borgere med nysgerrighed og engagement, så vi bruger alles ressourcer bedst muligt.

Det er vigtigt for os, at vi bruger hinanden i opgaveløsningen og til at sparre, så vi sammen udvikler vores faglighed. Derfor skal du være god til at samarbejde – og samtidig kunne arbejde selvstændigt med dine opgaver.

Du er måske uddannet administrationsbachelor/-økonom, kontoruddannet eller lignende. Det er en fordel, at du har erfaring med myndighedsarbejde, men du behøver ikke at kunne det hele på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du har mod på at dykke ned i et komplekst område – og er lærenem. Du bliver omgivet af dygtige kollegaer, der glæder sig til at lære dig at kende og står klar til at hjælpe dig godt i gang.

Vi har en ledig stilling i Sygedagpenge-udbetaling og refusion, der organisatorisk hører til i Ydelsescenteret under Beskæftigelsesafdelingen. Stillingen er en fast stilling.


Opgaver:

Dine primære opgaver bliver borger- og virksomhedsrelaterede myndighedsopgaver, der knytter sig til de ydelser, vi udbetaler, herunder opgaver indenfor:

  • Sagsbehandling i form af beregning, bevilling og udbetaling af forskellige ydelser
  • Personlig og telefonisk betjening, herunder vejledning af borgere, virksomheder og samarbejdspartnere
  • Deltagelse i løbende udviklings- og effektiviseringsopgaver inden for funktionen, men også i mere tværgående indsatser.

I Ydelsescentret har vi ansvaret for udbetaling af mange forskellige ydelser. Opgaverne vil derfor over tid variere og kommer også til at omfatte økonomisk sagsbehandling og vejledning indenfor andre beskæftigelsesrettede områder.


Vi forventer, at du:
  • Du har stærke kommunikationsevner og kan skabe relationer med fokus på tillid og empati samt er velformuleret – både mundtligt og skriftligt
  • Er engageret i at udvikle din forståelse for området, herunder i forhold til lovgivning og retningslinjer, samt bidrage til mål og opgaveløsning
  • Er nysgerrig på lovgivning og arbejdsgange og kan ’undre’ dig i opgaveløsningen
  • Aktivt deltager i din egen og gruppens løbende kompetenceudvikling
  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og har fokus på kvalitet, men er også ansvarlig i forhold til gruppens opgaver
  • Har gode it-kompetencer
  • Har godt humør og viljen til at gøre en forskel i dit arbejde

Vi tilbyder:
  • Grundig oplæring i vores sagsgange og gode muligheder for faglig sparring og støtte
  • Vi har fokus på udvikling af gruppens opgaveløsning, faglige standarder, arbejdsgange og på din personlige kompetenceudvikling
  • Sygedagpenge-udbetaling og refusion er præget af højt fagligt engagement, respektfuldt og anerkendende samarbejde og frihed med tilhørende ansvar i opgaveløsningen
  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø og et velfungerende socialt fællesskab
  • Fleksibel arbejdstilrettelæggelse med flekstid og på sigt mulighed for hjemmearbejde

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og aftale om lokal løndannelse.

Stillingen er med ansættelse snarest muligt eller senest 1. november 2026.

Er du interesseret i stillingen? Send din ansøgning digitalt, hvor du beskriver din motivation, hvem du er, og hvad du kan bidrage med. Vedlæg et udførligt CV med beskrivelse af relevant erfaring i indhold og tidsperiode.

Yderligere information:
Vil du vide mere om jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte funktionsleder Tim Rødsgaard Pabst på tlf. 2026 2020 eller faglig koordinator Rikke Søndergaard Fey på tlf. 8970 5704.

Ansøgningsfrist onsdag 26. august 2026. Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt torsdag den 3. september 2026.

title: Head of AI & Technology
description:
As a senior leader, the Head of AI and Technology will partner closely with the CEO and leaders across the organisation to identify, develop and implement AI-driven solutions that improve sales performance, productivity, customer experience, profitability and operational efficiency.

The Head of AI and Technology will oversee all technology functions while championing the transformation of the organisation into an AI-enabled retailer. This role is accountable for ensuring technology investments generate measurable business outcomes and position the company for long-term growth and competitive advantage.

The role combines strategic vision with execution and is responsible for embedding AI into every area of the business, creating sustainable commercial value through automation, insights and innovation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the organisation's AI, technology and digital transformation strategy.
  • Act as a trusted adviser to the CEO and Executive Leadership Team on emerging technology opportunities and risks.
  • Build a multi-year roadmap that aligns technology investment with business strategy and growth plans.
  • Identify opportunities to improve competitive advantage through AI, automation and digital innovation.
  • Lead enterprise-wide transformation initiatives that improve organisational effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Present regular updates to the CEO and Board on technology, cybersecurity, AI adoption and investment outcomes.
  • Develop and implement an organisation-wide AI strategy.
  • Identify and prioritise AI opportunities across all business functions.
  • Lead implementation of AI solutions that improve: Inventory management, Demand forecasting, Workforce planning, Recruitment and talent acquisition, Supply chain efficiency, Financial reporting and analytics.
  • Establish governance frameworks to ensure the ethical, responsible and secure use of AI.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and identify future opportunities for competitive advantage.
  • Foster a culture of innovation and experimentation throughout the business.

Technology Leadership

  • Lead all IT operations, systems, infrastructure and support services.
  • Establish a modern and scalable technology architecture that supports future business growth.
  • Oversee all business applications including: ERP systems, HRIS platforms, eCommerce platforms, Reporting and analytics environments, Collaboration technologies.
  • Ensure technology solutions meet business requirements and deliver operational efficiency.
  • Manage technology budgets and investment planning.
  • Lead strategic vendor partnerships and technology procurement.
  • Develop an enterprise data strategy.
  • Ensure business data is accessible, reliable, secure and actionable.
  • Build advanced reporting and analytics capabilities that support decision making.
  • Establish data governance standards and data quality frameworks.
  • Deliver predictive analytics and AI-driven insights that enhance commercial performance.
  • Create executive dashboards that provide real-time business intelligence.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

  • Lead information security, cybersecurity and technology risk management activities.
  • Ensure compliance with all regulatory, privacy and data protection requirements.
  • Implement effective controls to protect company, employee and customer information.
  • Oversee disaster recovery and business continuity planning.
  • Monitor and mitigate emerging technology and AI-related risks.

Organisational Capability & Change

  • Lead organisational AI adoption programs.
  • Develop AI literacy and capability across all levels of the business.
  • Establish training frameworks that enable employees to safely and effectively utilise AI tools.
  • Build cross-functional partnerships to accelerate transformation outcomes.
  • Support leaders in redesigning work processes and operating models to maximise productivity.
  • Drive continuous improvement and innovation across all functions.

Leadership Responsibilities

  • Operate as a strategic executive leader.
  • Inspire innovation and challenge traditional approaches.
  • Build high-performing technology and transformation teams.
  • Drive accountability for delivering measurable business outcomes.
  • Influence decision making through data and insights.
  • Foster collaboration across all departments.
  • Champion a culture of continuous learning and adaptability.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Delivery of technology and AI initiatives that improve profitability.
  • Measurable productivity improvements across departments.
  • Achievement of approved technology investment returns.
  • Cost reductions through automation and process optimisation.
  • Increased sales attributable to AI-enabled initiatives.

Technology

  • System uptime and reliability targets achieved.
  • Successful delivery of technology projects on time and within budget.
  • Technology user satisfaction scores achieved.
  • Cybersecurity compliance and risk metrics maintained.

AI Transformation

  • Number and value of AI initiatives successfully implemented.
  • AI adoption rates across the organisation.
  • Percentage reduction in manual or repetitive processes.
  • Measurable improvements in business productivity.
  • Improvement in decision-making capabilities through AI insights.

Leadership

  • Employee engagement within the Technology team.
  • Leadership capability development and succession planning.
  • Achievement of strategic transformation milestones.

Skills & Experience

  • Senior executive experience leading technology, digital transformation or innovation functions.
  • Demonstrated success delivering enterprise-wide technology and transformation programs.
  • Strong understanding of artificial intelligence, automation and data analytics.
  • Significant commercial and strategic planning capability.
  • Experience leading technology budgets and vendor relationships.
  • Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive organisational change.
  • Retail, multi-site or customer-facing industry experience.
  • Experience implementing Microsoft Copilot, generative AI and intelligent automation solutions.
  • Experience with enterprise data and analytics platforms.
  • Cybersecurity leadership experience.
  • Relevant qualifications in Information Technology, Business, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence or related disciplines.

Success Looks Like

Within the first 24 months the Head of AI and Technology will:

  • Establish a clear AI strategy and governance framework.
  • Implement AI solutions across every major business function.
  • Deliver measurable improvements in productivity and operational efficiency.
  • Build a strong AI-enabled culture across the organisation.
  • Modernise the technology environment to support future growth.
  • Deliver commercial outcomes through technology that contribute directly to sales growth, cost reduction and improved customer experience.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer

Team: IT

Location: Australia

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Australia.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you’ll champion a quality-first mindset across an agile software development environment. You’ll contribute throughout the full software development lifecycle, from requirements refinement and test strategy through release validation. The role combines hands-on testing, automation, backend validation, API testing, database testing, and exploratory testing. You’ll work closely with product, architecture, engineering, and quality teams to identify risks early and improve testability. As the automation expert within the team, you’ll help build and maintain robust automated test suites for new and existing functionality. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence engineering practices and raise software quality beyond your immediate team. This is a collaborative, remote role in a fast-moving environment where ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

Accountabilities

    • Contribute to feature refinement by challenging assumptions, clarifying requirements, identifying edge cases, and assessing system architecture and testability.
    • Develop and formalize comprehensive test strategies covering test scenarios, integration points, test data, APIs, applications, queues, databases, and result verification.
    • Deploy and configure software updates in QA environments and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end tests.
    • Investigate defects, identify root causes where possible, and document bugs with clear, accurate reproduction steps and supporting information.
    • Validate completed functionality and provide production sign-off when quality and acceptance criteria have been met.
    • Drive test automation for both new and existing features, working closely with quality engineering leadership to maintain reliable and effective automated test suites.
    • Act as the team’s automation specialist and promote quality engineering practices across the wider development organization.
    • Perform backend testing through multiple interaction methods, including REST APIs, message queues, databases, and front-end interfaces.
    • Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, technical leads, developers, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
    • Advocate for quality, usability, testability, and continuous improvement while managing and reprioritizing multiple workstreams in a dynamic environment.
    • During the first 90 days, build a strong understanding of the products, customers, teams, tools, and processes, while establishing relationships and contributing to the team’s quality goals.
    • Participate actively in feedback, professional development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

      • Requirements

Location: USA, Louisville, KY

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

At GE Appliances, a Haier company, we come together to make “good things, for life.” As the fastest-growing appliance company in the U.S., we’re powered by creators, thinkers and makers who believe that anything is possible and that there’s always a better way. We believe in the power of our people and in giving them the freedom to explore, discover and build good things, together.

This individual will work closely with customers, strategic partners, engineering, manufacturing, sourcing, quality, product management, and other cross-functional teams to ensure products meet technical, cost, quality, and schedule objectives.

Position

Senior Program Engineer – OEM and Strategic Projects

Location

USA, Louisville, KY

How You'll Create Possibilities

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Support new product programs from initial requirements through design, validation, production readiness, and launch.

  • Coordinate with customers and strategic partners to understand, document, and align product requirements, specifications, and acceptance criteria.

  • Translate customer requirements into clear engineering deliverables and product-development plans.

  • Coordinate the creation, review, and release of new models, bills of material, engineering drawings, specifications, and product documentation.

  • Ensure model configurations, component selections, and bills of material accurately reflect approved product requirements.

  • Work with design engineering and strategic partners to track technical deliverables, open issues, design changes, and milestone completion.

  • Coordinate design decisions with manufacturing to ensure products are manufacturable, cost effective, and ready for production.

  • Support prototype builds, engineering builds, pilot runs, validation testing, certification activities, and production launches.

  • Partner with manufacturing, quality, sourcing, service, product management, and supply-chain teams to resolve program issues and maintain execution timing.

  • Develop and maintain program schedules, action plans, technical deliverables, and risk-mitigation plans.

  • Lead regular cross-functional and partner program reviews to communicate status, decisions, risks, and required actions.

  • Manage engineering changes and evaluate their impact on product requirements, cost, tooling, validation, manufacturing, and launch timing.

  • Support supplier and component-development activities, including technical reviews, qualifications, and issue resolution.

  • Identify program risks early and coordinate corrective actions with internal teams and external partners.

  • Support post-launch issue resolution and continuous improvement activities related to product design, quality, and manufacturing performance.

  • Maintain accurate program documentation and ensure decisions, requirements, and approvals are clearly recorded.

What You'll Bring to Our Team

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field

  • 5+ years of experience in engineering, product development, or technical program execution

  • Experience supporting new products from requirements definition through production launch

  • Experience coordinating engineering activities with customers, suppliers, or strategic development partners

  • Experience creating, reviewing, or releasing bills of material, engineering drawings, specifications, and model configurations

  • Strong understanding of engineering change control, product lifecycle management, and configuration management

  • Ability to translate customer and business requirements into actionable technical deliverables

  • Experience working with manufacturing and cross-functional teams to support design decisions and production readiness

  • Strong program planning, organization, communication, and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, track detailed deliverables, and drive timely issue resolution

  • Ability to influence internal and external teams without direct authority

  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate engineering documentation

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in water heating, HVAC, appliances or another engineering-product industry

  • Experience with strategic partnerships, customer-specific products, white-label products, or externally developed product platforms

  • Experience using product lifecycle management, enterprise resource planning, and CAD systems

  • Familiarity with stage-gate product-development processes and new product introduction

  • Experience supporting factory builds, pilot production, certification, and launch-readiness reviews

  • Experience working with domestic or global manufacturing and supplier partners

Our Culture

Our work is centered on our People and Culture as reflected in our Zero Distance philosophy and we recognize the importance of reaffirming our commitment to inclusion and diversity (I&D). This underscores our commitment to fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, connected, and empowered to contribute, while positioning our organization to adapt seamlessly to the evolving needs of our workforce and communities.

This reflects our dedication to creating solutions that: Empower colleagues by fostering an environment where all voices are heard, valued, and encouraged to contribute. Strengthen communities where we live and work. Reinforce a culture of belonging, purpose, and engagement. Reflect the diversity of the communities we serve through our workforce, products, and practices.

By further embedding Zero Distance into our People and Culture framework, we will continue to build a deeply connected organization. We are cultivating a culture of engagement, belonging, and connection, because while attracting new talent remains a priority, retention is a cornerstone of our strategy.

GE Appliances is a trust-based organization. It is important we offer our employees the flexibility they need to do their best work while balancing the needs of the business and individuals. When you join GE Appliances, you will have the opportunity to work with your leader to create a flexible work arrangement that balances the needs of the individual, team, and organization.

GE Appliances is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE Appliances participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S

title: Employee Relations Advisor
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an Employee Relations Advisor to join our HR team here at Harrods. You will provide employee relations support and case management; predominantly managing behaviour, absence, performance, maternity/paternity, flexible working cases within a business area.

About the Role

As the Employee Relations Advisor you will provide expert HR support across multiple channels, including phone, email and web-based enquiries, managing employee relations and people management cases from inception through to resolution. You will coach and influence line managers on best practice people management, ensuring consistent application of policies while driving positive change across the business. Using management information and insight, you will identify trends, address recurring challenges and implement sustainable solutions that enhance the employee experience.

You will build strong relationships with employees and managers, delivering training and guidance that empowers leaders to confidently manage people matters with reduced reliance on HR support. Acting as a subject matter expert in employment law and company policies, you will ensure legislative compliance, support the development and continuous improvement of HR processes, and promote consistency in their application. In addition, you will maintain accurate HR records, support the growth of junior team members, and contribute to a culture of learning, accountability and operational excellence

About You

You are a highly organised and customer-focused HR professional with excellent communication skills, able to convey information clearly and concisely both verbally and in writing, with exceptional attention to detail. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing high volumes of work accurately and meeting deadlines while maintaining a friendly, empathetic and solutions-focused approach to supporting colleagues and managers. Driven by continuous improvement, you are comfortable working with data from multiple sources, using insights to identify efficiencies, enhance processes and deliver an outstanding service

About Us

Harrods is one of the world’s leading luxury department stores and we’re becoming a destination for top designers, and the most sought-after brands from around the globe. Our combined mission is to make visiting our iconic Knightsbridge store one of the world’s most inspiring shopping experiences.

Our Promise to You

Help us make the impossible possible for our customers and we’ll do something remarkable for you. As well as offering a friendly environment to inspire your best work, we provide abundant opportunities and support to build an exceptional career across the varied specialisms of our business.

Uniquely You

Whilst our job adverts outline the ideal qualities, skills, and prior experience for the role, we believe in the potential for growth and value individual strengths. If you can demonstrate the majority of skills and strong experience to thrive in this role, we would encourage you to apply.

At Harrods we believe the personality and authenticity of our people sets us apart. We celebrate and invite applications from all cultures, backgrounds, tastes, and experiences and are proud of our culture where people from all walks of life can grow and thrive. What makes you unique makes us exceptional.

If you want to know more about life at Harrods, search #TogetherHarrods on LinkedIn, or follow us on Instagram @togetherharrods.

title: Senior Scientific Software Engineer, Analytics and Workflows
description:
Senior Scientific Software Engineer, Analytics and Workflows

Location: South San Francisco

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide.

The Analytics and Workflows group within the Center of Excellence (CoE) is dedicated to turning complex data into actionable insights that advance drug discovery and development. We leverage cutting-edge high-throughput technologies and foundational multimodal machine learning models to analyze large-scale biological data, enabling deeper understanding of disease mechanisms and the identification of novel therapeutic opportunities. Despite advances in these fields, however, transforming raw data and computational models into meaningful biological insights remains a key challenge. In this role, you’ll work at the intersection of data science, biology, and engineering to build innovative analytical tools that bridge the gap between data generation and biological interpretation—helping unlock new avenues for scientific discovery and impact.

The Opportunity:

Genentech seeks a talented and highly motivated Bioinformatics Software Engineer with expert knowledge of reproducible and scalable analysis of proteomics and genomic datasets for target and biomarker discovery.

  • The primary focus of this position is to establish new and maintain existing workflows, libraries and visualizations for the analysis and QC of proteomics and genomics data.

  • You will evaluate, refine, and productionize analytical workflows that enable our scientists to interrogate biology and make drug pipeline relevant decisions.

  • You are facilitating data reuse, multi-modal analyses and AI/ML efforts by fostering the adoption of standardized data formats and repositories.

  • You will deeply engage with computational scientists to understand their analytical needs and turn these into reusable components. To achieve this outcome you confidently evaluate and combine open-source, commercial and in-house developed solutions and combine them into reliable, cutting edge applications.

  • A successful candidate will collaborate with interdisciplinary teams of Software Engineers, Computational Biology and Data Scientists to develop scientific workflows and tools that make data available to machines and humans using a variety of interfaces.

Who You Are:

  • You have a PhD in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Bioinformatics, or similar and 2 years of relevant experience in a clinical, academic or commercial setting. Alternatively, a Masters degree or equivalent and at least 5 years of relevant experience.

  • You have successfully analyzed complex biological datasets using a modern data science framework and are familiar with major tools and statistical methods used during the analysis of various omics modalities.

  • You have expert knowledge of proteomics analysis and can rapidly identify, diagnose and mitigate unlikely or surprising results.

  • You have successfully delivered a software project throughout the whole development cycle (planning, implementation, testing, release, maintenance) following modern software development practices and are using AI expert assistance in all stages of your work.

  • You are comfortable working with MCPs, REST APIs and other modern data science programmatic interfaces.

  • You have abundant experience in managing FAIR data as well as tracking data lineage, ensuring data quality and improving data discovery.

  • You are able to break down large problems into smaller software components and can develop them independently or as part of a large team.

  • You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively, and with handling several concurrent, fast-paced projects.

  • Experience with Bioconductor and the Tidyverse ecosystem, as well as RMarkdown / Quarto, and Shiny and Plumber deployment, are beneficial.

  • Experience with Python technologies (e.g. Pandas, Polars, Streamlit, FastAPI) is a plus as many of our stakeholders and systems are bilingual (R/python).

  • Prior experience in a life science or drug development environment is beneficial.

What to expect from us

  • A highly collaborative and dynamic research environment where we aim to advance the rate of scientific discovery using purposefully built solutions.

  • Access to large data sets, samples and compute resources.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technologies and pioneering research.

  • Participation in seminar series featuring academic and industry scientists.

  • Campus-like lifestyle with a healthy work-life balance.

  • Mentored opportunities to further develop professional skills.

Onsite presence, on our South San Francisco campus, is expected for at least 3 days a week.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

description:
På Solhjem er vi en mangfoldig gruppe af dedikerede, omsorgsfulde og fagligt dygtige medarbejdere, som hver dag går ind ad døren for at være med til at skabe den bedst mulige hverdag for de kun 32 mennesker, der bor på Solhjem.

På Solhjem kender alle hinanden, og det giver tryghed og fleksibilitet i hverdagen for både medarbejdere og beboere. Ledelsen på Solhjem ved, at du kun kan skabe trivsel hos andre, hvis du selv er i trivsel, og derfor har vi på Solhjem fokus på trivsel hos både beboere og medarbejdere.

Med udgangspunkt i en personcentreret tilgang er vores mål at skabe en aktiv og tryg hverdag for beboerne. På Solhjem ser vi mennesket før opgaven og værdsætter alles perspektiver og fagligheder.

På Solhjem har vi ambitioner om at være en arbejdsplads, der skaber udvikling for både beboere, medarbejdere og organisationen. Vi er nysgerrige og ambitiøse og tør udfordre os selv fagligt. Vi prioriterer faglig refleksion og ønsker at være opdaterede og dygtige inde for områder som f.eks. demens og palliation.

Vi ønsker os en kollega, der:
  • Vil være med til at skabe en aktiv og tryg hverdag for vores beboere, hvor dagligdagen er fyldt med meningsfuldhed i form af nærvær, stjernestunder, masser af fysisk aktivitet og frisk luft.
  • Som er spontan og kreativ, og som kan fungere i en hverdag, hvor tingene ændrer sig og beboernes ønsker og behov imødekommes.
  • Som er nysgerrig, tør stille spørgsmål og undre sig og som ønsker at udvikle sin faglighed og sine kompetencer.
  • Kan se vigtigheden af og kompleksiteten i den forebyggende og sundhedsfremmende pleje.
Hvad kan du forvente af os?
  • Du vil blive en del af en veldrevet organisation med dygtige faglærte medarbejdere, og hvor der er en faglig stærk, synlig og tilgængelig ledelse.
  • På Solhjem er vi altid åbne for nye ideer, og der skal være kort fra tanke til handling. Vi giver plads til, at dine ideer og kompetencer kan blive en del af hverdagen.
  • Et arbejdsmiljø præget af høj faglighed og refleksion, hvor social- og sundhedshjælpere, social- og sundhedsassistenter, sygeplejersker og pædagoger samarbejder om at få løst kerneopgaven.
  • En arbejdsplads, der er modig og tør prøve nye ting af som f.eks. yoga, saunagus, NADA, skovbadning og meget mere.

Vi er en moderne og rummelig arbejdsplads med cirka 3.000 kollegaer, der hver dag gør sig umage for at levere velfærd og service af høj kvalitet. Vores værdier – redelighed, mulighed og helhed – er fundamentet for alt, vi gør.

title: Commissioning Engineer I
description:
About SES:

Sustainable Engineering Solutions was founded in 2008 by professionals who understand the need for hands-on, practical engineering expertise. We have a foundation of diverse experience in commissioning, energy engineering, and project management. The SES team has commissioned millions of square feet of construction with a consistent focus on sustainability and high-quality service.

At Sustainable Engineering Solutions, we advocate for our clients to achieve healthy and efficient buildings. We have a team of enthusiastic and innovative people who are eager to learn and grow. We approach projects with a collaborative mindset, working with project teams, striving towards a common goal: a successful outcome for every project.

Commissioning Engineer I Description:

Work alongside and provide assistance to project managers and engineers with various commissioning and envelope testing tasks. Work will involve both clerical in an office setting and fieldwork on job sites. Typical functions include providing site observations and field reports, conducting functional tests from detailed procedures, and office-related tasks such as filing project documents, writing specifications, developing testing procedures, and sending email correspondence. This position requires frequent travel throughout MA, CT, and RI, as well as periodic long-distance travel within the United States.

Tasks:

  • Review building design and construction documents, including drawings and specifications, for comprehension of design intent, construction requirements, and operational needs.
  • Under the direction and supervision of a project manager, produce various engineering documents, including field observation reports, construction checklists, testing documents, deficiency notices, general and email correspondence, and final project reports.
  • Assist project engineers or managers in fieldwork on construction project sites performing commissioning or energy engineering tasks that include: overseeing and directing functional testing of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, life safety, security, tel/data, and building envelope systems.
  • Office-related tasks of filing project documents, writing specifications, and field reports. Researching and development of functional testing documents.

Education:

  • High School Diploma (or GED or High School Equivalence Certificate) is required.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or building construction-related field preferred.
  • Fundamental understanding of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and building envelope systems and equipment.
  • Familiarity with general construction practices and procedures.

Skills:

  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Critical thinking
  • Complex problem-solving skills
  • Advanced Microsoft Word and Excel skills

Job Details:

  • Job Type: Full-Time
  • Benefits: SES offers a competitive benefits package, including Paid Time Off, Flex Time, Health Insurance, and 401(K) plan
  • Location: Boston, MA

SES is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Acceptant
description:
Wil je meewerken aan de cirkel van afval naar grondstoffen en energie?

Sortiva verwerkt afval van particulieren, bedrijven en gemeenten voor hergebruik. Door dat op een milieubewuste manier te doen, dragen wij bij aan een duurzame samenleving. Afvalstoffen als sloophout, asfalt, betonpuin, kunststof en papier krijgen via recycling een nieuwe bestemming als grond-, bouw- of brandstof.

Als acceptant afvalstoffen bij Sortiva ben jij de gastheer/-vrouw op de locatie in Alkmaar. Je ontvangt de klanten en beoordeelt de aangeleverde afvalstroom. Na een visuele controle volgens vastgestelde eisen en op basis van de inhoud van de vracht geef jij toestemming voor acceptatie of weigering. Bij toestemming verwijs jij de klanten naar de juiste be-/verwerkingslocatie. Ook kan het voorkomen dat jij kleine vervuilingen uit de vracht haalt. Dit alles verwerk jij in de tablet.

Is er iets niet in orde? Dan grijp jij in en zet je de vracht om naar een passende afvalstroom. Je ziet toe op een veilig verloop van de activiteiten op de ontvangstlocatie en houdt de kwaliteit van onze producten hoog.

Om onze locatie in Alkmaar er netjes uit te laten zien, verzorg je hand- en spandiensten. Samen met collega’s leg jij de basis voor de kwaliteit van onze grondstoffen.

Wij verwachten:

  • Je werkt zorgvuldig en houdt je aan de veiligheidsregels;

  • Je communiceert op nette en heldere wijze;

  • Je raakt niet snel in paniek en weet te overleggen wanneer situaties daarom vragen.

Wij bieden:

  • Een salaris conform de CAO beroepsgoederenvervoer in loonschaal D (€ 2.893 en € 3.520) per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring. Deze maken we stipt op de 24e van de maand aan je over;

  • Een pensioenregeling, 25 verlofdagen en 4 atv dagen;

  • Je kunt gebruikmaken van leuke extra’s zoals tanken met korting, korting op je telefoon- en sportschool abonnement, op verzekeringen, ect;

  • Dagelijks vers fruit in de kantine;

  • Mogelijkheid om door te groeien binnen GP Groot Groep of Sortiva B.V.

title: Tech Lead / Solution Architect
description:
Tech Lead / Solution Architect – Backend, Workflow Engine, SSO, Observability, QA

Team: IT

Location: Switzerland

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Tech Lead / Solution Architect – Backend, Workflow Engine, SSO, Observability, QA based in Switzerland.

This is a senior technical leadership opportunity focused on designing and delivering the backend foundation of a new Legal OS MVP.
You will own architecture decisions across backend services, workflow orchestration, security, observability, and quality engineering.
The role combines hands-on engineering with solution architecture, requiring you to turn complex requirements into reliable, production-ready systems.
You will design resilient workflows with strong guarantees around retries, idempotency, consistency, auditability, and failure recovery.
You will also establish secure SSO and permissions models while building comprehensive observability and automated QA practices.
The environment is highly autonomous, project-based, and focused on delivering a pragmatic MVP with a strong emphasis on reliability and security.
This role is ideal for a senior backend engineer or architect who enjoys owning technical direction and building robust systems from the ground up.

Accountabilities

    • Own backend architecture and technical direction, translating product goals into scalable and maintainable production solutions.
    • Define the architecture boundaries and minimal service contracts, including APIs and event-driven interfaces required for the MVP.
    • Design the core data model, including Matter IDs, mapping rules, and idempotency keys to ensure reliable and consistent processing.
    • Build and define the workflow layer with retry and backoff strategies, dead-letter handling, replay capabilities, deduplication, and resilient failure recovery.
    • Establish security architecture covering SSO, role-based permissions, access controls, and secure secrets management.
    • Implement comprehensive audit trails that clearly capture who performed an action, what occurred, when it happened, and why, supported by correlation IDs and distributed tracing.
    • Design and implement observability practices covering structured logging, metrics, tracing, system health, and operational troubleshooting.
    • Establish robust QA gates covering integration, end-to-end, and regression testing for critical workflows such as document delivery, deadlines, and audit functionality.
    • Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to make pragmatic architectural decisions and ensure solutions are ready for production.
    • Contribute hands-on code and technical implementation while maintaining a strong focus on reliability, security, maintainability, and operational excellence.

      • Requirements

      • Senior-level experience in backend engineering and solution architecture, with a proven track record of shipping production systems.
      • Strong understanding of distributed systems and failure modes, including retries, idempotency, consistency, race conditions, deduplication, and recovery strategies.
      • Hands-on experience designing and implementing backend services, ideally using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI.
      • Strong knowledge of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL.
      • Experience with queues and event-driven architectures using technologies such as NATS, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or comparable platforms.
      • Strong understanding of APIs and integrations with external platforms and services.
      • Experience implementing OIDC, SSO, authentication, authorization, roles, permissions, and secrets management.
      • Practical knowledge of observability and monitoring technologies such as OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, ELK, or similar platforms.
      • Strong experience with integration, end-to-end, and regression testing, including integrating automated QA into CI pipelines.
      • Familiarity with Docker and modern software delivery practices.
      • Ability to independently make architecture decisions, define technical contracts, and translate ambiguous requirements into actionable solutions.
      • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive approach to identifying reliability, security, and scalability risks.
      • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
      • Comfortable working autonomously in a project-based environment and taking ownership from architecture through implementation and delivery.

        • Benefits

        • 100% remote working arrangement, with a preference for candidates working within European/CET time zones.
        • Full-time or part-time engagement options.
        • Freelance/project-based working arrangement.
        • Opportunity to shape the architecture of a new Legal OS MVP from the ground up.
        • High level of technical ownership and autonomy.
        • Hands-on work across backend engineering, workflow automation, security, observability, and QA.
        • Opportunity to build reliable, security-focused systems designed for real-world legal workflows.
        • Start as soon as possible, with workload and engagement level agreed upon based on project needs.
