title: Tilkaldevikarer til botilbuddet Nordlys i København S
description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en positiv forskel for udviklingshæmmede borgere i København? Så er du måske vores nye medarbejder.

Vi søger nye vikarer, da flere af vores dygtige vikarer er blevet færdige med deres studier og derfor ikke længere arbejder hos os.

Vi søger dig, der

  • ligesom os ønsker at arbejde engageret med borgere med nedsat funktionsevne og har hjertet på rette sted lige som os: Vi har hjertet med, når vi går på arbejde i Socialforvaltningen i Københavns Kommune - Video.kk.dk
  • vil være med til at skabe en meningsfuld hverdag for 12 skønne, voksne beboere
  • er fleksibel, rolig og med godt humør
  • har en etisk velfunderet og respektfuld tilgang til de mennesker, som du arbejder med
  • kan arbejde selvstændigt, ansvarsbevidst og loyalt ud fra bostedets tilgange og retningslinjer
  • kan lide en stor diversitet i arbejdsopgaverne, hvor både praktiske, omsorgs- og plejemæssige opgaver indgår
  • forstår, at der er masser af pædagogik i at løse de personlige plejeopgaver med beboerne
  • har evner for skriftlig dokumentation og it-kompetencer på brugerniveau
Om Nordlys – et lille tilbud med stor faglighed og gode naboer tæt på
På botilbuddet Nordlys bor 12 voksne beboere med udviklingshæmning og diagnoser inden for autismespektret. Flere af beboerne har desuden psykiatriske problemstillinger. Botilbuddet er inddelt i tre bo-afsnit med fire beboere pr. afsnit.

Vi tilbyder dygtige, dedikerede kollegaer, en nærværende og lyttende ledelse og en hverdag med mening, hjertevarme og faglighed i højsædet. Er det noget for dig?

Vi lægger vægt på, at alle på Nordlys er medansvarlige for at fastholde og udvikle et godt arbejdsmiljø og en høj faglighed, hvor alle trives og motiveres til at bidrage med den viden og kompetence, som vi hver især besidder. En god balance mellem professionalitet, ansvarlighed, glæde, humor og kollegial omsorg betyder meget for os.

Udadreagerende adfærd – når kroppen taler med
Beboerne på Nordlys er kognitivt udfordrede i en grad, der betyder, at de nogle gange har svært ved at udtrykke sig verbalt. Derfor bruger de kroppen til at tale, og det betyder til tider udadreagerende eller selvskadende adfærd. Du skal derfor kunne fremstå rolig, tydelig og tillidsvækkende samt formå at skabe tryghed for beboerne.

På Nordlys skaber vi plads til den enkelte samtidig med, at vi forebygger eller minimerer selvskadende og udadreagerende adfærd. Det gør vi fx gennem rolige, strukturerede rammer, neuropædagogisk tilgang og Low Arousal.

Hvis du kan se dig selv i nedenstående udsagn, så er du typen, vi søger

  • hvis jeg opdager en skraldepose, der ikke er blevet smidt i containeren, eller jeg ser, at nogen har spildt en sjat kaffe på gulvet, så tager jeg mig af det. Vi skal hjælpes ad med at få det hele til at lykkes
  • jeg er en ukompliceret person, der hellere vil løse opgaven end at sidde og snakke om den
  • faglig dokumentation er vigtig – ikke fordi det står i en paragraf, men fordi det er vores måde at bevidne borgerens liv og udvikling. Uden dokumentation ingen udvikling
  • jeg er typen, der handler, hvilket også vil sige, at jeg nogle gange fejler. En dygtig leder og en god arbejdsplads er for mig et sted, hvor vi tør fejle og tale åbent, så vi lærer af det
Vi tilbyder

  • et godt team af dedikerede, dygtige kollegaer og en ledelse, der har fokus på psykologisk tryghed, arbejdsmiljø og medarbejdernes trivsel
  • et arbejde med skønne, livsbekræftende beboere, hvor du hver dag gør en kæmpe forskel
  • onboarding og introvagter
Om stillingen
Stillingerne er som tilkaldevikar og kan ligge alle ugens dage og året rundt efter botilbuddets behov.

Opgaverne er

  • at yde støtte til personlig pleje og omsorg
  • at være en del af beboernes morgenrutine
  • at varetage praktiske opgaver af forskellig karakter
  • mindre dokumentationsopgaver
Løn- og ansættelsesforhold
Du ansættes som tilkaldevikar. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår sker efter gældende overenskomst og indenfor rammerne af lokal løndannelse.

Vi ønsker tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Vi indhenter referencer og straffeattest i forbindelse med ansættelsesprocessen.

Vil du høre mere? Ring eller kom forbi til en uforpligtende snak.
Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen eller om livet på Nordlys, er du velkommen til at kontakte tilbudsleder Peter Vingaard Salgado på 2363 7195.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Søg via linket senest onsdag den 30. september 2026

title: Pest Control Technician (Las Cruces, NM)
description:
Benefits Start Day 1 for Full-Time Colleagues - No Waiting Period!

For more information about our benefits, see below!

We are proud to be a member of the Rentokil family of companies, the global leader in Pest Control and other services across more than 90 countries. We pride ourselves on being a trusted partner to many of the world's leading brands and serve consumer and business customers across multiple industries. We are extremely proud of our legacy of excellence and constantly work to fulfill our mission to "protect people, enhance lives, and preserve the planet."

What do our Pest Control Technicians do?

The primary purpose of this role is to perform our industry leading pest management services for residential customers. You will be responsible for identifying and eliminating pests from residential properties by conducting thorough inspections, determining the type of pest infestation, applying appropriate treatments like pesticides and traps, and providing preventative measures to prevent future infestations, all while adhering to safety regulations and communicating with clients about pest control solutions.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

  • Conduct thorough inspections of client properties to identify signs of pest infestations, damage, and entry points

  • Apply approved pest control products, including chemicals, baits, and traps, to effectively eliminate pests while adhering to safety standards

  • Educate customers on pest prevention methods and the importance of maintaining a pest-free environment. Provide advice on how to reduce the risk of future infestations.

  • Build relationships with customers, schedule and confirm their appointments, help with sales to current customers, and expand our product to new customers

  • Ensure that all pest control equipment is properly maintained, stocked, and in good working condition

  • Adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations regarding pest control products and safety protocols

  • Drive and safely operate a company provided service vehicle (we provide routine maintenance)

Essential Job Functions:

  • Working in tight, confined spaces such as basements, attics, crawl spaces, narrow aisles, or passageways

  • Working around animals, insects and termites

  • You’ll sometimes be working around mechanical parts, vehicles, electrical current, heights and scaffolding, fumes, dust, and chemicals, and we’ll train you how to handle all of these conditions safely

  • Able to work both inside and outside in your local climate in company-provided weather gear

  • Lots of moving around — regularly sitting, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling, up and down stairs, ladders, scaffolding, ramps, and poles

  • You’ll need to wear personal protective equipment (PPE), like an OSHA-compliant respirator

What do you need?

  • Clean shaven face- for safety reasons (rebreathers have to be able to seal your face)

  • High school diploma or GED; related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience

  • Possess a valid driver’s license from state of residence.

  • Licenses/certificates as required by federal, state, and/or local regulations (covered by us)

  • Available to work Monday-Friday and weekends as needed

  • Open to learning and becoming knowledgeable in all areas of pest control

  • Solid reading, writing, and verbal communication skills

  • Basic math skills — You’ll need to be able to follow instructions for mixing on product labels

  • Customer-facing experience preferred

Why Choose Us?

A career with the Rentokil family of companies can be a professional trajectory filled with opportunity. We pride ourselves on being a world-class team that rewards high performance, and we love to promote from within. We offer competitive pay and many of our roles offer performance incentives.

Below you'll find information about some of what we have to offer. All Full-Time Colleagues qualify for the following and Part-Time Colleagues qualify for most benefits after they meet certain criteria.

  • Full-time colleagues are eligible to begin enrollment immediately upon hire with benefits starting on day 1


Savings and Retirement

Work-Life Balance

  • Company-paid holidays & floating holidays

  • A company mindset that prioritizes health, safety, and flexibility

title: Omgevingsmanager
description:
Jij maakt het net beter als omgevingsmanager

Als omgevingsmanager sla je de brug tussen omgeving en techniek. Je borgt dat het project voldoet aan wet- en regelgeving op het gebied van ruimtelijke ordening, en haalt wensen en eisen op vanuit bevoegd gezag en andere stakeholders. Bij Qirion ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ruimtelijk/planologische haalbaarheidstoets, conditionerende onderzoeken, vergunningen en stakeholdermanagement.

Qirion werkt voornamelijk in opdracht van netbeheerders Liander en TenneT. De omgevingsmanager van Liander Ruimtelijke Inpassing is vooral in de planfase van het project betrokken, en voert strategische gesprekken met stakeholders. Jij fungeert hierbij als sparringpartner.

Het energienet van de toekomst maken we voor iedereen, mét iedereen. Je werkzaamheden als omgevingsmanager zijn veelzijdig. Zo ben jij gedurende je werkweek bezig met het:

  • Aan de hand van kaartmateriaal onderzoeken van de haalbaarheid van een bovengrondse hoogspanningslijn in agrarisch gebied, of een warmtenet door een binnenstad;

  • Het bezoeken van een bouwproject om met de aannemer te overleggen;

  • Het faciliteren van een overleg over de landschappelijke inpassing van een nieuw hoogspanningsstation met speciale aandacht voor natuur inclusieve voorzieningen;

  • Het verzamelen van tekeningen en relevante gegevens voor het uitzetten van conditionerende onderzoeken en aanvraag van een omgevingsvergunning;

  • Bespreken van de voortgang van een omgevingsplanprocedure met de planjurist van de gemeente;

  • Toelichten van een nieuw project tijdens een inloopbijeenkomst voor omwonenden.

Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander

Wist je dat Alliander bestaat uit verschillende bedrijven die samen werken aan een betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig energienet? Met een grote club vakmensen ontwikkelen en beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners en ondernemers in Nederland. Alles wat we doen, doen we met oog voor de mensen die op ons rekenen: onze klanten. En dankzij onze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken we de energietransitie mogelijk, voor en mét onze klanten.

En jij gaat dat doen bij ons bedrijfsonderdeel Qirion. Hier houd jij je bezig met de energie-infrastructuur en slimme energieoplossingen. Zo ontwerp, bouw en onderhoud je het hoogspanningsnet van vandaag en de toekomst. Slimme ontwerpen maken kan alleen als jij genoeg energie hebt. En de juiste werkomgeving geeft jou dat. Het moet dus wat opleveren.

De afdeling Ruimte & Recht bestaat uit ongeveer 75 betrokken collega’s, bestaande uit omgevingsmanagers, juristen en communicatieadviseurs. Er heerst een cultuur van samenwerking, waarin iedereen bijdraagt aan het gemeenschappelijke doel. Binnen de afdeling werken we met vier teams. Deze vacature valt onder team Ruimte en Recht Oost met als standplaats Duiven, maar je zal ook regelmatig onderweg zijn voor een afspraak of locatiebezoek.

"Binnen de afdeling Ruimte & Recht geloven we in de kracht van samenwerking en innovatie. We moedigen voortdurend nieuwe ideeën aan en ondersteunen elkaar met eerlijke feedback. Zo helpen we elkaar om de beste versie van onszelf te worden."

Jouw toekomstige collega’s vertellen hier meer over in onderstaande webinar:

Werken als omgevingsmanager - Werken bij Alliander

Jij maakt het net energieker

Werken aan een organisatie die toekomstproof is. Dat doe je vanuit je eigen kracht en talent. En dat doe je bij ons. Draag jij daaraan bij met jouw doorzettingsvermogen? Geweldig! Zeker als je dit aanvult met:

  • Minimaal een hbo-diploma;

  • Ruime relevante werkervaring als omgevingsmanager;

  • Ervaring met bewonersgesprekken, conditionerende onderzoeken en vergunningsaanvragen;

  • Kennis van energie-infrastructuur is een pré.

Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 40-urige werkweek:

  • Een salaris van € 4.672,- tot € 6.674,- bruto per maand (schaal 9). Het salaris is afhankelijk van de kennis en ervaring die je meebrengt.

  • Werken waar dit voor jou het beste werkt, als je functie dit toelaat. Vanaf kantoor of vanuit eigen huis. Werk je vanuit huis, dan ontvang je hiervoor een thuiswerktegemoetkoming.

title: Enablement Lead for Container Hosting Platforms
description:
Enablement Lead for Container Hosting Platforms

Location: South San Francisco

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche!

Advances in artificial intelligence (AI), data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organizations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximizing these opportunities.

The Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CSCoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness this transformative power of data and AI to assist our scientists in pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative medicines for patients worldwide. Within the CSCoE, the Data and Digital Catalysts (DDC) organization drives the modernization of our computational and data ecosystems and integration of digital technologies across Research and Early Development to enable our stakeholders, power data-driven science, and accelerate decision making.

The Role

The Enablement Lead for Container Hosting Platforms sits within our Engineering core, serving as a high-impact bridge to our scientific user community. This role is accountable for driving the effective adoption, usability, and scientific impact of our core hosting platforms.

You will focus on reducing friction, accelerating onboarding, and radically improving the developer experience (DevEx) for researchers, primarily supporting CSCoE and gRED use cases in the United States. The role spans a complex technical landscape, covering multi-region (US/EU) general-purpose EKS hosting, specialized GPU and scale-out compute infrastructure, and the full breadth of AWS managed services required for modern application hosting. This includes storage, databases, event processing, workflow management, and serverless computing. You will ensure these environments are intuitive, accessible, and optimized for the unique demands of modern drug discovery.

The Opportunity:

  • Define, communicate, and continuously improve strategies for onboarding, adoption, and effective use of diverse scientific computing platforms.

  • Develop and lead comprehensive strategies for the adoption of cloud-native computing platforms, ensuring technical capabilities translate into cross-domain scientific outcomes.

  • Assist in the resolution of highly technical challenges related to containerized workloads, GPU-accelerated computing, and scale-out infrastructures.

  • Proactively identify and dismantle organizational and technical barriers to platform adoption, implementing solutions to reduce developer friction and enhance usability and accessibility.

  • Build and nurture communities of practice to share knowledge, best practices, and innovations.

  • Develop and deliver training and maintain high-quality documentation, tutorials, and example workflows.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to users and senior stakeholders, providing guidance on platform capabilities and best practices.

  • Influence product roadmaps where appropriate based on deep analysis of scientific usage patterns and direct researcher and developer feedback.

Who You Are:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, life sciences, or information technology with 5-8+ years of relevant experience.

  • Extensive experience designing, operating, and enabling Amazon Web Services (AWS) Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) environments.

  • Experience supporting research computing environments, including bioinformatics, cheminformatics, and AI/ML.

  • Experience in software engineering with proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Python or Go.

  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar.

  • A relentless focus on usability and the continuous improvement of the researcher experience.

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and influence technical direction across cross-functional teams.

Onsite presence, on our South San Francisco campus, is expected for at least 3 days a week.

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of California is $142,500 - $264,700. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. title: Matematiklærere til Peder Lykke Skolen
description:
Kan du få matematik til at give mening, begejstre og udfordre?

På Peder Lykke Skolen leder vi efter to matematiklærere, der brænder for stærke fællesskaber og faglig udvikling. To lærere, der kan skabe nysgerrighed omkring matematik og samtidig være en tydelig og nærværende voksen for eleverne.

Vi søger to kollegaer med tiltrædelse den 1. september 2026 eller snarest derefter. Hos os bliver du en del af et engageret team på en skole centralt på Amager, tæt på både Amager Fælled og DR Byen.

Hvad indebærer stillingerne?
Brænder du for at gøre matematik levende, undersøgende og meningsfuld for eleverne? Har du lyst til at være med til at udvikle stærke matematiske læringsfællesskaber? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Stillingerne er i indskolingen og på mellemtrinnet og indeholder undervisning i matematik, natur/teknologi og andre relevante fag på egen årgang. Du bliver klasselærer i én af årgangens klasser og en vigtig del af et tæt samarbejdende årgangsteam.

Vi planlægger og udvikler undervisningen sammen, og elevernes timer fordeles i fællesskab på årgangen. Derfor søger vi kollegaer, der trives med samarbejde, faglig sparring og fælles ansvar for elevernes læring og trivsel.

Stillingerne er på fuld tid.

En skole med åbne rammer og stærkt fællesskab
På Peder Lykke Skolen tror vi på, at de bedste løsninger opstår, når vi udvikler undervisningen sammen. Derfor er samarbejde ikke bare noget, vi taler om – det er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Dørene står måske ikke åbne hos os; de findes faktisk næsten ikke. Til gengæld finder du kolleger tæt på, masser af sparring og en kultur, hvor vi hjælper hinanden.

Vi er opdelt i indskoling (0.-5. årgang) og udskoling (6.-9. årgang), og vores faciliteter omfatter bl.a.

  • fire aldersopdelte skolegårde
  • personale- og forberedelsesrum i hver afdeling samt personalefitness
  • et nyt Madhus – skolens samlingspunkt med madkundskabslokale og Sciencehus
  • et lokalmiljø med mulighed for mange forskellige ture i gåafstand til natur, legepladser og kultur som fx teater
Vores klasseværelser har ingen døre (på nær hos børnehave- og 1. klasser), hvilket giver en unik mulighed for at skabe et åbent læringsmiljø. Vi tror på fællesskab, samarbejde og faglig sparring, og vi har et stærkt teamsamarbejde mellem lærere og pædagoger. Vi har desuden to-lærertimer, fordi vi ved, at vi udvikler os bedst i fællesskab. Vores lærere underviser i gennemsnit 25 lektioner om ugen. For nyuddannede lærere er gennemsnitstimetallet 23 lektioner om ugen samt en tilknyttet mentor.

Hvem er du?
Vi søger engagerede lærere, der

  • er læreruddannede, arbejder med tydelig klasseledelse og er fagligt stærke inden for både matematik, didaktik og pædagogik
  • brænder for teamsamarbejde og ønsker en skole, hvor vi løfter i flok
  • er åbne for feedback og ser værdi i at dele undervisning med kolleger
  • har et ressourceorienteret børnesyn, stærke relationskompetencer samt en anerkendende tilgang til både børn og voksne
Vi tilbyder

  • en dynamisk og fagligt stærk lærergruppe med plads til humor og faglig sparring
  • undervisning i nyrenoverede lokaler med moderne faciliteter
  • en udviklingsorienteret skole, hvor der er plads til nye initiativer
  • en skole, hvor lærernes stemme vægtes højt
  • et stærkt lærer-pædagog-samarbejde med fokus på mangfoldige læringsfællesskaber
Ansættelsesforhold
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst. I forbindelse med ansættelserne indhenter vi børne- og straffeattest samt reference.

Vil du med på holdet?
Hos os får du ikke bare et skema og et klasselokale. Du får et engageret team, en skole i udvikling og kolleger, der gerne deler idéer, erfaringer og en kop kaffe i pausen.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Christie Beckmann på 2166 7137 eller mail hf27@kk.dk eller souschef Trine Bendixen Johansen på fh7d@kk.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Senior Insider and Data Risk Analyst
description:
Sr. Insider & Data Risk Analyst

Team: Analyst

Location: Ireland

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Insider & Data Risk Analyst based in Ireland.

This is a senior individual contributor role focused on protecting sensitive information, systems, and people from insider and data-loss risks. You will own complex investigations from initial triage through resolution while helping mature insider risk management and Data Loss Prevention capabilities. The role sits at the intersection of cybersecurity, data protection, privacy, and regulated financial services. You will work closely with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security teams on highly sensitive cases requiring discretion and sound judgment. The position also offers an opportunity to strengthen risk processes, automate investigations, and apply AI to emerging security challenges. Success requires a highly organized professional who can translate complex findings into clear recommendations for both technical teams and leadership.

Accountabilities

    • Own insider risk investigations from initial triage through closure, including establishing case timelines, coordinating containment and escalation, documenting determinations, and capturing lessons learned.
    • Mature the Insider Risk Management Program by developing scalable case-management processes, risk-tiering methodologies, investigation standards, and repeatable workflows.
    • Operate, monitor, and tune Data Loss Prevention capabilities across SaaS applications, endpoints, and other environments, improving detection quality while reducing false positives.
    • Investigate potential data exfiltration, misuse, policy violations, and inappropriate access involving source code, cloud platforms, collaboration tools, third-party applications, and critical business or trading systems.
    • Strengthen data classification and governance practices while aligning DLP controls with information sensitivity and business risk.
    • Assess risks associated with unauthorized AI and agentic tooling, including potential exposure of sensitive or proprietary information through approved and unsanctioned AI applications.
    • Use workflow automation, AI, and security orchestration capabilities to improve alert triage, investigation efficiency, and the overall maturity of insider risk processes.
    • Lead insider risk and data protection assessments, maintain risk registers, and track remediation activities and emerging threats.
    • Partner with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security on sensitive personnel cases, departures, policy violations, and data-handling concerns with a high level of discretion and care.
    • Support internal and external audits, regulatory requirements, and security assurance activities related to insider risk, data protection, privacy, and information security.
    • Contribute insider risk and secure data-handling content to security awareness and employee training programs.
    • Serve as a senior escalation point for insider risk cases and mentor colleagues on investigation methodologies, case management, and effective risk analysis.
    • Monitor developments in insider risk, data protection, privacy, cybersecurity, and financial services regulation to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

      • Requirements:

      • 4+ years of professional experience in insider risk, Data Loss Prevention, digital forensics, security investigations, or a closely related discipline.
      • Demonstrated hands-on experience leading sensitive investigations and managing cases involving personnel matters, data misuse, policy violations, or potential exfiltration.
      • Practical experience operating and tuning DLP solutions across SaaS and endpoint environments, with an understanding of detection quality and false-positive reduction.
      • Experience with workflow automation, AI, or SOAR platforms for alert triage, investigation support, and case orchestration.
      • Strong understanding of data classification, data governance, data protection, and information security principles.
      • Working knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis, such as Elastic/ELK or Splunk, to support investigations and establish evidence-based conclusions.
      • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks including NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and privacy regulations such as GDPR and APPI.
      • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear investigation reports, case documentation, risk assessments, and executive summaries.
      • Exceptional integrity, discretion, and judgment when handling confidential personnel, customer, business, and security information.
      • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple sensitive investigations in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
      • Ability to collaborate effectively with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security stakeholders.
      • Experience with digital forensics, eDiscovery, UEBA, insider risk platforms, security operations, or incident response is an advantage.
      • Scripting or automation experience using technologies such as Python or SQL is a plus.
      • Experience with major cloud platforms and familiarity with supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or regulatory audits is beneficial.
      • Exposure to fintech, financial services, trading platforms, or regulated environments is strongly valued.
      • Relevant certifications such as GCFA, GCFE, CISSP, CISM, CIPP, CFE, or equivalent are considered a plus.
      • Familiarity with financial services regulatory expectations and multi-jurisdiction privacy requirements is advantageous.
      • A genuine interest in AI-related data risk and using emerging AI capabilities to improve security operations and investigation workflows.

        • Benefits:

        • Competitive salary and stock options.
        • Health benefits.
        • One-time USD $500 new-hire home-office setup allowance.

        • Opportunity to work within a globally distributed team spanning multiple countries and time zones.
        • Exposure to cutting-edge cybersecurity, financial technology, cloud infrastructure, AI, and data protection challenges.

description:
About us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About the Engineering team

Following a successful year of engineering growth in Poland, we're continuing to expand our teams and strengthen our presence in the region. Our Polish hub is a key part of our engineering organization, bringing together talented people who work on complex, international products and collaborate across a global environment.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for people who are excited by new challenges, enjoy working with experienced teams, and want the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while continuing to develop their skills and career.

About the role

As a Software Engineer, we are seeking a talented and motivated Software Engineer with 2+ years of experience in Java backend development. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in Java 17+, Spring Boot, Business Process Management (BPM) workflows, AWS cloud services, and automation testing frameworks. You will be responsible for developing scalable enterprise applications, ensuring application quality through automated testing, and contributing to the complete software development lifecycle.

At Auctane, we value professionals at every stage of their career journey. When applying for this position, please note that we'll assess your profile and skills based on your experience level—whether junior, intermediate, or senior. Our goal is to build a diverse and complementary team that brings together different perspectives and levels of expertise. If you're excited to contribute to a newly formed team, we'd love to hear from you!

What will you be doing?

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications using Java 17+ and Spring Boot/Spring Framework.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Business Process Management (BPM) workflows and process automation solutions.
  • Build and consume RESTful APIs and integrate with internal and external systems.
  • Deploy, manage, and troubleshoot applications on AWS (EC2, S3, and related services).
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and manage source code using GitHub.
  • Monitor application health, performance, and logs using Datadog and Elasticsearch.
  • Develop and maintain automation test suites to ensure application quality and reliability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software.
  • Participate in code reviews and follow coding standards, secure coding practices, and software engineering best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues in a timely manner.

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience in backend application development with Java 17+ and Spring Boot / Spring Framework
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, object-oriented programming, design patterns, and software engineering principles.
  • Experience with Git, GitHub, and software development using Agile methodologies, including Scrum and Kanban.
  • Hands-on experience with automation testing frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG,Selenium, Cucumber, Rest Assured, or Karate.
  • Knowledge of API and integration testing with automated test suites.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced Agile environment.
  • Passion for learning new technologies and contributing to engineering best
    practices.
  • Proficiency in Polish and English is required for this role

What will make you stand out?

  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Exposure to Microservices Architecture.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native application development.
  • Experience with messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
  • Knowledge of BDD/TDD practices and integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.

What do we offer?

🗓️ Annual Salary Review: We are reviewing the salaries of all our teams annually in order to evaluate an increase according to individual performance and the business results.

📙 Personal Training Budget. Up to 7.000/ 4.100 PLN/year training budget (certifications, conferences attendance, etc.) to invest in your professional development. We want to help you improve your technical skills, feel involved in the product community, and develop your soft skills to lead teams and manage other stakeholders.

🌅 Up to 30 days of vacation per year (additional days are granted along with seniority at AUCTANE).

💙 Up to 500 PLN/year to match your NGO donations! We are happy to support your initiatives by duplicating the amount donated.

💜 Lunch card

😊 Volunteer day. You can take 1 day off per year in order to participate in volunteering activities! We will love to see some pictures in our slack!

Referral Fee 🔗 We need your support in hiring top-class talent! We offer a referral bonus of 4k-20k PLN, depending on the complexity of the role and the hiring process.

👩‍⚕️We have an Employee Assistance Program with psychological assistance free of charge.

⚖️ Great work-life balance We offer a flexible work schedule and will do our best to adapt to your personal situation. Working in a fast-paced environment can be intense, but that doesn’t mean you shouldn’t enjoy your free time!

💜 An inclusive and upbeat work environment Leave your suit behind... we’re a t-shirt and converse kind of place! More importantly, our company culture promotes diversity and inclusion. The personality and opinions of each of our team members are important and valid, and we aim to offer all employees a safe environment where they can be themselves and thrive.

🌍 A cross-cultural atmosphere We are a truly international team of 20 nationalities that speak 10 languages. Our company language is English and all internal communication and company-wide meetings are in English.

🏟️ Company events Work hard, play hard! We do our best every day, even at our regular team-building events.

🏠 Possibility to work in a home-office using equipment provided by AUCTANE, or in our office prepared in accordance with all safety requirements.

🗺️ Languages classes every week. Thirsty for knowledge? Learn a new language by joining our free English/Spanish/German classes. You can connect and enjoy taking up a new language or improving your current skills with one of our great instructors.

title: Engageret udviklingskonsulent til Jobcenter Varde
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe fremtidens jobcenter og implementere beskæftigelsesreformen? Motiveres du af at finde nye veje, og har du et positivt sind med en grundlæggende tro på andre mennesker – så se her!

En af vores udviklingskonsulenter har fået andet arbejde, så vi kan tilbyde en stilling i vores centrale stab i Jobcenter Varde. Som udviklingskonsulent hos os bliver du en del af et fagligt stærkt hold med plads til og forventning om at tænke ud af boksen, og hvor et stærkt fællesskab betyder, at alle går langt for hinanden. Bevidstheden om, at vi er hinandens arbejdsmiljø, er stor!

Hvad træder du ind i?

Vi står midt i en beskæftigelsesreform og ser ind i, at Varde kommune kommer til at mangle arbejdskraft de kommende år, hvor vi har en central rolle i at sikre virksomhederne kvalificeret arbejdskraft. Vi har derfor sat øget fokus på vores virksomhedssamarbejde samtidig med, at vi fortsætter vores udvikling af borgerinddragende beskæftigelsesindsatser.

Retningen for, hvad vi vil lykkes med frem mod 2030 med tilhørende pejlemærker, er beskrevet i vores vision ”Fra det der virker i dag, til det der rækker længere”, som du kan læse mere om her.

Du skal være med til at understøtte dette arbejde og designe fremtidens jobcenter i tråd med visionen og beskæftigelsesreformens intentioner. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan understøtte forandringer samtidig med, at driften kører i højt tempo.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger en profil, der kan svare ja til disse spørgsmål:

  • Kan du omsætte lovgivning, tal og datamateriale som få forstår - til skriftlige og mundtlige præsentationer og figurer, som de fleste forstår?
  • Synes du, at det er spændende at arbejde med at skabe tæt sammenhæng mellem overordnede strategier og mål til den daglige drift?
  • Kan du planlægge, styre og gennemføre projekter?
  • Har du gode samarbejdsevner, og kan du begå dig i en politisk styret organisation?
  • Har du en relevant akademisk uddannelse?

Det er en fordel, hvis du kender til beskæftigelsesområdet, men ikke et krav. Til gengæld er det nødvendigt, at du evner løbende at grave dig ned i de områder, du ved mindre om, så du kan udvikle dig til en skarp udviklingskonsulent og sparringspartner på området.

Hvad bliver dine opgaver?

Som udviklingskonsulent vil dine opgaver spænde bredt. Du skal for eksempel:

  • Koordinere og deltage i udviklingsprocesser og projekter i tæt samarbejde med såvel interne som eksterne samarbejdspartnere
  • Udarbejde kontrakter med eksterne leverandører og understøtte ledelsen med opfølgning
  • Analysere og præsentere tal- og datamateriale
  • Udarbejde notater og præsentationer
  • Bidrage til en god politisk betjening, herunder forberede sager til politisk behandling
  • Udarbejde projekt- og puljeansøgninger til fx Styrelsen for Arbejdsmarked og Rekruttering (STAR)

Vi forventer, at du kan fungere i et miljø med mange samarbejdspartnere, hvor tingene hurtigt kan ændre sig. Derudover søger vi en god kollega, der både kan arbejde i team og selvstændigt – og som er klar til at hjælpe andre, når det brænder på.

Lidt om os

Vores kerneopgave er at sikre kvalificeret arbejdskraft til kommunens virksomheder og hjælpe mennesker, uanset alder og funktionsniveau, så tæt på selvforsørgelse som muligt ud fra værdien om, at netop det, giver livskvalitet. I helt særlige tilfælde kan dette ikke lade sig gøre, og så er opgaven, så vidt muligt, at sikre det enkelte menneske et økonomisk fundament.

Du bliver ansat i Administration & Udvikling, som er en stabsfunktion i Jobcenter Varde med 10 medarbejdere.

Vi er en ambitiøs og engageret afdeling, som vægter den kollegiale støtte højt, er uhøjtidelige med hang til et godt grin, og så har vi et stærkt fællesskab, som betyder, at alle går langt for at spille hinanden gode.

Som stabsfunktion har vi mange fagligheder, og på den private side rummer vi både madentusiaster, horrorskuespillere, strikkenørder, film- og seriefreaks og fitnessguruer i en skøn pærevælling.

Jobcenter Varde ligger på Frisvadvej i centrum af Varde. Du møder mulighed for fleksibel arbejdstid og hjemmearbejde. Humøret er højt, kantineordningen er i vinkel, og kaffen er faktisk tæt på baristaniveau.

Varde Kommune arbejder ud fra værdierne: Ordentlig – Værdiskabende – Stærk.

Varde Kommune er en røgfri arbejdsplads.

title: Senior Staff Identity and Access Management Engineer
description:
Sr. Staff IAM Engineer

Team: IT

Location: US

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Staff IAM Engineer (Architect) based in the United States.

This is a hands-on architecture leadership role responsible for defining the future of identity across workforce, customer, partner, non-employee, non-human, and AI-agent identities. You will serve as the design authority connecting multiple identity, governance, privileged-access, and security platforms into a cohesive enterprise architecture. The role combines strategic architecture with hands-on engineering, including Auth0 Actions, Okta Workflows, Terraform, and identity posture analysis. You will shape customer and partner identity, workforce authentication consolidation, federation, provisioning, and identity security posture management. Your work will directly support environments governed by HIPAA, HITRUST, and SOC 2 requirements. This is an opportunity to establish architecture standards and reference patterns while influencing engineering teams without relying on formal authority. You will thrive in an environment where platforms are already being deployed and the priority is to bring consistency, governance, and long-term direction to an evolving identity ecosystem.

Accountabilities:

    • Own the target-state identity architecture across workforce, non-employee, external, non-human, and AI-agent identities, establishing standards, reference architectures, and architecture decision records that create consistency across projects.
    • Lead the end-to-end customer identity architecture, including tenant and organization models, MFA, phishing-resistant authentication, machine-to-machine authentication, and external and partner identity use cases.
    • Define clear separation between customer/patient identity and workforce identity, while designing the interfaces and federation models required between them.
    • Establish the architecture and migration patterns required to consolidate application authentication onto a unified workforce identity provider.
    • Design SSO, SCIM provisioning, automated deprovisioning, and lifecycle-management patterns for applications handling sensitive information, ensuring audit evidence is generated through the architecture itself.
    • Define federation and directory strategies across Okta, Entra ID, AWS, and GCP, including repeatable approaches for subsidiaries, acquisitions, and other organizational changes.
    • Build and evolve Identity Security Posture Management capabilities, extending an existing identity posture and remediation platform while defining meaningful metrics for identity risk and improvement.
    • Partner with Security Operations and Security Architecture to integrate identity threat detection and response into the existing SIEM and broader security ecosystem.
    • Design access controls aligned with HIPAA, HITRUST, and SOC 2 requirements while minimizing manual operational effort and maintaining current architecture documentation and control mappings.
    • Act as the architectural bridge between identity-risk discovery and engineering remediation, ensuring findings have clear, scalable paths to resolution.
    • Establish and communicate architectural direction through reference implementations, technical standards, and written decision records that engineering teams can adopt without direct reporting authority.
    • Drive measurable outcomes, including adoption of the target-state architecture, customer identity maturity, workforce identity consolidation, identity posture improvements, and audit readiness.

      • Requirements

      • 8+ years of experience in identity and access management, security engineering, platform architecture, or a closely related discipline, including at least 3 years at staff, principal, architect, or equivalent seniority.
      • Deep hands-on customer identity and access management experience, ideally including end-to-end CIAM architecture and delivery using Auth0 or a comparable platform.
      • Strong expertise with SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, WebAuthn, and FIDO2, with the ability to apply these protocols to enterprise authentication and federation architectures.
      • Proven experience designing enterprise workforce identity architectures using Okta or an equivalent identity provider, including migrations away from legacy or fragmented authentication systems.
      • Demonstrated ability to establish architectural direction, influence engineering teams, and drive adoption without relying on formal organizational authority.
      • Strong written communication skills, including experience producing architecture decision records, reference designs, technical standards, and other durable documentation.
      • A builder mindset, with the ability and willingness to implement identity solutions rather than operating solely at a conceptual or advisory level.
      • Experience working effectively in ambiguous environments where systems and platforms are already in flight and require architectural consolidation and completion.
      • Experience with regulated or security-sensitive environments is highly valuable, particularly HIPAA, PHI safeguards, HITRUST, SOC 2, or SOX access controls.
      • Strong identity governance knowledge, including joiner-mover-leaver processes, RBAC, access certifications, segregation of duties, and non-employee lifecycle management. Experience with SailPoint ISC, NERM, or comparable IGA platforms is a plus.
      • Experience with cloud PAM, just-in-time access, and zero-standing-privilege models, particularly Britive or similar technologies.
      • Knowledge of cloud-native identity architectures across AWS, GCP, and Azure, including migrations away from cloud-provider user pools or social and directory-based authentication.
      • Experience building Identity Security Posture Management or identity threat-detection capabilities, including integration of identity telemetry with SIEM platforms.
      • Familiarity with non-human identity, service-account governance, secrets management, and emerging AI-agent identity models.
      • Experience using infrastructure as code for identity, particularly Terraform.
      • Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP, CISM, TOGAF, SABSA, Okta certifications, Auth0 or SailPoint certifications, or professional-level cloud architecture certifications are advantageous.
      • Experience in digital health, telehealth, or another regulated, high-growth environment is preferred.
      • Ability to work autonomously, communicate clearly with both technical and executive stakeholders, and build trust through sound technical judgment and well-documented decisions.

        • Benefits

        • Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans.
        • Flexible Spending Accounts and Health Savings Accounts.
        • Flexible paid time off.
        • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching.
        • Life insurance.
        • Pet insurance.
        • A relatively flat organizational structure that encourages autonomy, ownership, and direct contribution.
        • An environment where employees are encouraged to bring forward ideas, influence decisions, and make meaningful improvements.
        • A culture centered on autonomy, competence, and belonging.

Du skal søge om optagelse på , hvis det er mere end 1 år siden du har forladt folkeskolen og du ønsker at tage en uddannelse som social- og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent.

Du kan læse mere om Social- og sundhedsuddannelserne på ZBCs hjemmeside.

Vi lægger vægt på:
  • at du er engageret og motiveret
  • at du er positivt indstillet på at indgå i faglig og personlig udvikling under vejledning
  • at du er mødestabil og indgår i arbejdsfællesskabet med initiativ og samarbejdsvilje

Når du ansættes, indgår du en uddannelsesaftale med Sorø Kommune. Ansættelsen er på 37 timer om ugen.
Praktikstederne er placeret forskellige steder i Sorø Kommune, herunder i Dianalund og Stenlille og du vil derfor skulle regne med transporttid til dit praktiksted. Mødetiden i praktik vil oftest være kl. 7.00.

Som elev bliver du aflønnet på forskellige løntrin afhængigt af, om du kan få elevløn eller voksenelevløn. Du kan finde løntrinnene på FOAs hjemmeside.
For at få voksenelevløn under uddannelsen, skal du være fyldt 25 år

Når du ansættes på Grundforløb 2 + et hovedforløb i Sorø Kommune, vil du få løn både på Grundforløb 2 og hovedforløbet.

Hvis du har brug for flere oplysninger, kan du kontakte uddannelseskonsulent Sybille L. Robert på telefon 23 43 31 53.

Sorø Kommune indhenter offentlig straffeattest ved ansættelse.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 30/09-26. Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes d. 07/10-26

I Sorø Kommune ser vi mangfoldighed som en styrke, og vi opfordrer alle interesserede til at søge stillingen uanset alder, køn, handicap, race, religion og etnisk tilhørsforhold. Vores værdigrundlag er: troværdighed, engagement og arbejdsglæde, dialog, åbenhed og anerkendelse.

Kommunen har godt 30.000 indbyggere og ligger midt på Sjælland i et naturskønt område med søer og skove. Sorø Kommune har ca. 2.500 medarbejdere – og så er vi i øvrigt en røgfri arbejdsplads.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
The Senior AI Engineer is the technical cornerstone of the AI Accelerator delivery function, owning solution architecture, code quality, and the delivery of the team's hardest technical work

Wesfarmers OneDigital is building Australia's leading data and digital retail ecosystem, underpinned by AI across everything we do. We operate across four pillars - loyalty, data, retail media and AI, turning millions of customer interactions into insights that shape how Australians shop, live and connect.

We have an exciting, new opportunity for a Senior AI Engineer to join our team!

The Senior AI Engineer is the technical cornerstone of the AI Accelerator delivery function, owning solution architecture, code quality, and the delivery of the team's hardest technical work. This is a hands-on role, not a governance or oversight position. You will design solutions, write production code, review others' work, and solve the toughest problems the team encounters.

You will set the standards for how the Accelerator builds, establishing architectural patterns, coding standards, and quality practices that ensure consistency and maintainability. You will champion modern software engineering methodologies, including LLMOps and AI operationalisation, enacting them within the Accelerator and promoting adoption across the Group.

You will also lead contract engineers when engaged, mentor other team members, and package technical learnings for export through playbooks, reusable components, and partnership with the AI Enablement and Governance team.

What you'll be doing

Solution architecture and delivery

  • Lead solution architecture for AI initiatives built by the Accelerator, ensuring designs are scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards
  • Deliver complex technical work directly, writing production-quality code and modelling the AI-first execution mindset the team embodies
  • Solve the hardest technical problems the team encounters across LLMs, agent frameworks, and cloud AI service
  • Evaluate and recommend technical approaches, frameworks, and tools, maintaining currency with the rapidly evolving AI landscape

Engineering standards and quality

  • Establish and maintain coding standards, architectural patterns, and quality practices across the team's technical output
  • Champion modern software engineering methodologies, including LLMOps and AI operationalisation, both within the Accelerator and across the Group
  • Conduct code reviews and provide technical mentorship to other team members and embedded divisional engineers
  • Partner with the Enablement and Tooling Specialist on the technical dimensions of adoption tooling and developer experience

Leadership and coordination

  • Lead and coordinate contract engineers when engaged, ensuring quality, alignment, and effective integration with Accelerator delivery
  • Represent the Accelerator's technical perspective in architecture forums, governance bodies, and stakeholder engagements
  • Participate in technical due diligence for vendor and partner solutions as required

Knowledge export and governance

  • Contribute to the Accelerator's knowledge export function by documenting technical patterns, creating reusable components, and sharing learnings with divisional technology teams
  • Collaborate with the AI Enablement and Governance team, Data and Analytics, and other OneDigital functions to ensure solutions meet governance, security, and compliance requirements
  • Open-source reusable components where appropriate and contribute to Group-wide playbooks

What you'll bring to the table

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with significant recent focus on AI and ML implementation.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and building production AI systems operating at scale, not just proofs of concept.
  • Track record of technical leadership, including setting standards, mentoring engineers, and owning architectural decisions.
  • Deep proficiency in Python and modern AI and ML frameworks; familiarity with additional languages advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of LLM architectures, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, agent design, and fine-tuning approaches.
  • Expertise in LLMOps and AI operationalisation, covering model monitoring, evaluation frameworks, deployment pipelines, cost management, and production observability.
  • Experience with cloud AI platforms (Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, AWS) and associated services.
  • Solid foundation in software engineering fundamentals: version control, CI/CD, testing, observability, and security practices.
  • Experience leading and coordinating contract or contingent technical resources within enterprise environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.
  • AI-first mindset, using AI tooling extensively in day-to-day work and leading by example on what AI-augmented engineering looks like.
  • Microsoft or Google certification highly regarded

To support you at work, what you value in life and in the community, our team member benefits include:

  • Fantastic career and development opportunities within your role and across a diverse range of businesses within the Group
  • Convenient city location
  • Modern and spacious end of trip facilities
  • Supported Learning opportunities
  • Paid primary carer parental leave (16 weeks) and non-primary carer parental leave (4 weeks)
  • Paid leave to volunteer within the community
  • Hybrid working - we balance working together with working flexibly
  • A team member discount card and discounts across a range of businesses - including Bunnings, Kmart, Target, Officeworks, Clearskin Care and Kleenheat Gas
  • Free OnePass membership

title: Vakgroepleider Consultants
description:
De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als Vakgroepleider Consultants

Als Vakgroepleider ga je aan de slag in het cluster Warmte & Gas. Hier werkt DEP aan complexe vraagstukken op het snijvlak van warmtenetten, duurzame gassen, energieplanologie en systeemintegratie. De opgaven zijn technisch uitdagend, maar minstens zo vaak organisatorisch, bestuurlijk en maatschappelijk van aard.

Je bent primair verantwoordelijk op tactisch en operationeel niveau voor een vakgroep van maximaal 40 consultants en engineers.

Je geeft als vakgroepleider richting aan een team van specialisten dat dagelijks werkt aan deze vraagstukken voor netbeheerders, overheden, warmte- en warmteservicebedrijven. Tegelijkertijd bevindt het vakgebied zich in een periode van grote verandering. Wet- en regelgeving ontwikkelt zich continu, de warmtetransitie versnelt en de warmteservicebedrijven zoals Firan ontwikkelen zich snel.

Je zorgt voor het welzijn van jouw team, dat ze op hun plek zitten, een passend loopbaanpad volgen, goed functioneren en ze zich kunnen doorontwikkelen. Je denkt na over hoe je ze de juiste kennis en tools kan meegeven zodat zij optimaal hun talenten kunnen inzetten en kijkt naar kansen en mogelijkheden.

Ook zorg je ervoor dat ze de benodigde inhoudelijke - en vak expertise opdoen zodat ze heel goed worden in het thema waar ze in werken en daardoor de beste kwaliteit aan onze opdrachtgevers kunnen leveren. Hiervoor werk je nauw samen met de themaleiders, consultants die op inhoudelijke expertise leidend zijn op een inhoudelijk thema.

Jouw uitdaging is om een vakgroep te bouwen die niet alleen beschikt over diepgaande technische kennis, maar ook in staat is om opdrachtgevers te helpen bij het maken van keuzes in een onzekere en veranderende omgeving.

Je valt hiërarchisch onder de Manager Wamte & Gas en je maakt deel uit van het leiderschapsteam. De themaleiders vallen in jouw vakgroep maar hebben een belangrijke functionele lijn naar de manager. Daarnaast zorg je ook voor een goede opbouw en financiële huishouding en ben je verantwoordelijk voor de declarabiliteit van jouw team.

Het energienet van de toekomst maken we voor iedereen, mét iedereen. En als vakgroepleider werk jij hieraan mee. Zo ben jij bezig met:

  • Het coachen van medewerkers, in beeld brengen van hun persoonlijke ontwikkelpad en het ontwikkelen van persoonlijke competenties en kennis die hiervoor nodig zijn.
  • Een plan maken voor de ontwikkeling van jouw vakgroep, hierover heb je overleg met de manager en themaleiders.
  • Helpen bij de ontwikkeling van de organisatie en zorgen voor juiste matching tussen klus, opdracht of project. Hierbij kijk je naar de ambitie, competenties en vaardigheden van de medewerkers.
  • Op basis van kennis, competenties en persoonlijke ontwikkelambitie bepalen welke medewerkers op welke plek worden ingezet.
  • Samen met de andere vakgroepleiders ben je verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen en realiseren van een visie op de ontwikkeling van de consultants binnen DEP zodat ze over de benodigde kennis en competenties beschikken.

Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander

Wist je dat Alliander bestaat uit verschillende bedrijven die samen werken aan een betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig energienet? Met een grote club vakmensen ontwikkelen en beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners en ondernemers in Nederland. Alles wat we doen, doen we met oog voor de mensen die op ons rekenen: onze klanten. En dankzij onze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken we de energietransitie mogelijk, voor en mét onze klanten.

En jij gaat dat doen bij ons bedrijfsonderdeel DEP. DEP staat voor Duurzaam Energie Perspectief. DEP is hét technische consultancy bureau van Alliander. Met circa 200 collega’s zetten wij ons iedere dag in om te bouwen aan het energiesysteem van vandaag en de toekomst. Dat doen we vanuit de expertise gebieden: Elektrotechniek, Warmte en Gas, Digitaal en Energiesysteem. Wat ons kenmerkt is dat wij altijd zoeken naar hoe het wél kan. Met focus op de toekomst. Wij bedenken en realiseren slimme oplossingen voor het verbeteren en verhogen van het vermogen van het energienet. We hebben een open sfeer, nemen eigen initiatief, ondernemen activiteiten buiten werktijd, en we hebben zelfs een eigen band.

Jij maakt het net energieker

Werken aan een organisatie die toekomstproof is. Dat doe je vanuit je eigen kracht en talent. En dat doe je bij ons. Draag jij daaraan bij met jouw ideeën voor complexe vraagstukken? Geweldig! Zeker als je dit aanvult met:

  • WO werk- en denkniveau.
  • Minimaal 5 jaar leidinggevende ervaring en coachen van hoogopgeleide collega’s junior-, medior- en senior niveau.
  • Ervaring met meerdere leiderschapsstijlen en je hebt een visie op ontwikkelen van mensen.
  • Ervaring in de consultancy is een pré.
  • Je brengt actuele en relevante kennis van het vakgebied van DEP, of hebt minimaal affiniteit met de inhoud van het werk van je medewerkers.
  • Klantgerichtheid en ondernemerschap is voor jou vanzelfsprekend. Je begrijpt dat alles wat we doen uiteindelijk impact heeft op onze klanten, en je handelt daar ook naar.

Voor jou nét beter geregeld

Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 40-urige werkweek:

  • Een salaris van € 6438 tot € 9197 bruto per maand (schaal 11).
  • Jaarlijks een individueel keuze budget (IKB) van 18% (fulltime) of 12,8% (parttime) van je bruto jaarsalaris. Dit is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag. Je kunt dit bedrag uit laten betalen, maar je kunt er bijvoorbeeld ook extra vrije dagen voor kopen. Jij kiest wat bij jou past.
  • 24,5 vakantiedagen per jaar, ruim aan te vullen vanuit je IKB.Een eindejaarsuitkering in december van 6% van je jaarsalaris.
  • Elk jaar een DI-budget van € 700,- voor jouw duurzame inzetbaarheid. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een vergoeding van jouw sport op hobby, verduurzaming en vergroening van je huis, of het verlichten van je studieschuld bij DUO. Jij bepaalt waar jouw budget naartoe gaat.
  • Een pensioenopbouw bij ABP, speciaal voor de overheid en het onderwijs. Wij betalen 70% van jouw pensioenpremie.
  • Blijven leren en ontwikkelen. Jij staat op de eerste plek. Bij Alliander vinden we jouw ontwikkeling topprioriteit. Je leert door te doen, samen te werken en opleidingen en trainingen te volgen die passen bij jouw rol.

Natuurlijk hebben we nog veel meer! Lees meer over al jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Voor jou net wat meer informatie

Samen maken we het net beter. Voor iedereen, met iedereen. En daar hoor jij bij! Solliciteer op deze vacature vóór 31-08-2026. Wij komen uiterlijk in week 36 bij je terug.

Meer weten over de functie-inhoud?

Martijn Leseman, Manager Warmte & Gas, vertelt je hier meer over via martijn.leseman@dep.nl

title: Senior Software Engineer (HYBRID REMOTE)
description:
About us

At Auctane, we are united by a passion to help businesses deliver — whatever their size, wherever they are, and however they operate. We make it possible for businesses to meet the ever-changing requirements of their industry and customer expectations. Auctane products enable hundreds of thousands of businesses to annually mail and ship billions of items — over $200 billion worth — to recipients around the globe.

The Auctane family of mailing and shipping software products includes ShipStation, Stamps.com, ShipStation API, Metapack, GlobalPost, and Packlink. Our partners include Amazon, UPS, USPS, eBay, BigCommerce, Shopify, WooCommerce, and Walmart.

Our values

Win as One. Delight Customers. Deliver Great Outcomes.

About the Engineering team

Following a successful year of engineering growth in Poland, we're continuing to expand our teams and strengthen our presence in the region. Our Polish hub is a key part of our engineering organization, bringing together talented people who work on complex, international products and collaborate across a global environment.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for people who are excited by new challenges, enjoy working with experienced teams, and want the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while continuing to develop their skills and career.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will lead the architecture and evolution of our test automation platform and drive continuous improvement across our Speedship engineering ecosystem. You'll architect solutions, mentor junior engineers, and make strategic decisions about framework design and engineering best practices.

At Auctane, we value professionals at every stage of their career journey. When applying for this position, please note that we'll assess your profile and skills based on your experience level. Our goal is to build a diverse and complementary team that brings together different perspectives and levels of expertise. If you're excited to contribute to a newly formed team, we'd love to hear from you!

What will you be doing?

  • Design and architect core components of our Playwright-based test automation framework
  • Lead platform engineering decisions and establish architectural best practices
  • Mentor junior software engineers and conduct technical code reviews
  • Develop comprehensive testing strategies for complex feature sets
  • Optimize system performance, reliability, and maintainability across the platform
  • Diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure and framework issues
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define testability requirements
  • Evaluate and implement new tools, frameworks, and engineering techniques
  • Establish and maintain test data management and infrastructure strategies
  • Drive documentation, knowledge sharing, and engineering standards
  • Manage technical debt and refactor systems for scale and performance

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)
  • + 3 years of experience with Java 17+ and Spring Boot / Spring Framework and at least 5 years total experience in the software development field
  • Demonstrated ability to architect and lead technical initiatives
  • Proven ability to architect and maintain large-scale software systems
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals with focus on code quality and scalability
  • Leadership capability without requiring formal management title
  • Initiative to identify and solve problems proactively
  • Passion for continuous improvement and staying current with engineering practices
  • Collaborative approach to working across teams
  • Ability to balance pragmatism with technical excellence
  • Experience advocating for quality and engineering rigor within organizations
  • Proficiency in Polish and English is required for this role

What will make you stand out?

Previous experience in test automation with Playwright and/or Selenium

Tech stack

  • Core Platform: Java 21, Maven, TestNG, Extent Reports, Custom Playwright Framework
  • Infrastructure & Deployment: Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, GitHub/Bitbucke
  • Architecture & Patterns: Google Guice, Page Object Model, Data-driven Design, Excel/JSON/XML, OpenCSV
  • Data & Search: Elastic Search, OpenSearch, Jackson JSON, SQL Databases
  • AWS Services: S3, Secrets Manager, STS, RDS (IAM Auth)
  • Libraries & Integrations: Lombok, LaunchDarkly, Xray, PDF Processing, Image Processing

The Senior Storage Engineer responsible for the architecture, configuration, deployment, and ongoing management of large-scale production storage systems. Position Summary

The Senior Storage Engineer (L3) – Backup, Recovery & Data Protection Engineering is responsible for the design, engineering, implementation, operation, and continuous optimization of enterprise backup, recovery, cyber resilience, and data protection solutions supporting Humana's mission-critical business services and healthcare platforms.

This position serves as a senior technical leader within the Storage Engineering organization and functions as a primary escalation point for complex backup, recovery, and data protection challenges. The engineer will drive the strategy, architecture, and operational excellence of enterprise data protection platforms while ensuring recoverability, compliance, security, and resiliency across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructure environments.

The role is responsible for engineering and supporting enterprise-scale solutions leveraging IBM Storage Protect, IBM Storage Defender Data Protect, IBM Storage Protect (Spectrum Protect/TSM), Rubrik, Commvault and related technologies. The engineer will play a key role in data protect engeineering, cyber recovery initiatives, ransomware resilience, platform modernization efforts and automation.

The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise in backup and recovery technologies, enterprise storage platforms, infrastructure architecture, automation, and operational governance, along with the ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, cloud, security, application, and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Backup & Recovery Engineering

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise backup and recovery architectures supporting critical business applications and infrastructure.
  • Engineer scalable, resilient, and secure backup solutions across physical, virtual, cloud, SaaS, and containerized environments.

  • Lead backup platform upgrades, migrations, and modernization initiatives.

Automation & Operational Excellence

  • Develop automation solutions using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Automate provisioning, reporting, monitoring, and operational workflows.
  • Eliminate manual processes through engineering and self-service solutions.

  • Participate in intake reviews and solution design consultations.

Use your skills to make an impact

title: Model & AI Risk Data Scientist | Associate Director
description:
Our Model Risk Management team provides independent oversight and challenge of model and AI risks are well managed across Macquarie globally. We assess whether models and AI systems are fit for purpose, appropriately controlled, and aligned to the firm’s risk appetite and to regulatory expectations. Our team plays a critical role in enabling safe adoption of models and AI by providing robust validation, clear challenge and sound risk-based decisions.

We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.

What role will you play?

As an Associate Director, you will lead independent validation of complex AI use cases used across a wide range of business operations, forming independent risk opinions and providing credible challenge to senior business, engineering and governance stakeholders. Your work will assess whether AI systems are fit for purpose, operate as intended and ensure that the risks introduced are understood, appropriately controlled, and remain within the Macquarie’s risk appetite. Throughout your role, you will provide coaching and mentorship to junior team members, helping to build technical capability in AI risk and validation. You will also lead and manage AI validation engagements from planning through execution, coordinating stakeholders and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality validation outcomes. You will independently assess AI systems, evaluation methodologies, monitoring frameworks and control environments, forming evidence-based opinions on the effectiveness of risk management and controls.

In addition, you will contribute to the establishment and continuous improvement of AI validation methodologies, standards, tools and practices, helping to build a scalable and effective validation function that keeps pace with evolving AI technologies and risks. You will help shape Macquarie's approach to independent AI assurance, including validation methodologies for generative AI, agentic AI systems, foundation models, AI observability and emerging AI technologies.

What You Offer

  • Ability to lead a team, including guidance, training and direction on performing appropriate risk-based model and AI validation
  • Demonstrated track record of self-directed learning and rapidly acquiring new technical capabilities in a fast-evolving AI landscape.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex validation engagements, exercise sound judgement and provide independent challenge on novel and high-impact AI use cases.
  • Hands-on experience designing, developing, and evaluating AI and Generative AI solutions, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-agent systems, guardrail design, synthetic data generation, and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation frameworks.
  • Experience designing or executing AI evaluation, red-teaming, robustness testing, benchmarking or model assurance activities is highly regarded.
  • Advanced Python programming skills, along with strong experience using GitHub, version control best practices, and CI/CD pipelines. Knowledge of additional languages such as SQL, R, and TypeScript is highly regarded.
  • Practical experience with AI coding agents, including tools such as Claude Code and Codex, and the ability to develop and maintain skills, sub-agents, hooks, plugins for workflow automations.
  • Ability to critically assess the risks, limitations, monitoring requirements and control effectiveness of agentic AI systems.
  • Working knowledge of traditional machine learning models, including various regression models, random forests, Xgboost, and related model evaluation approaches.
  • Strong understanding of model limitations, performance degradation, validation techniques, monitoring approaches and sources of model risk.
  • Experience assessing AI systems against governance, risk management and control requirements, including human oversight, explainability, monitoring, security, resilience, data management and model lifecycle controls.

What We Offer

Benefits

At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on employment type, include:

  • 1 wellbeing leave day per year
  • Up to 5 additional service bonus leave days per year
  • Up to 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of transition leave upon return to work, and 6 weeks’ paid leave for non-primary caregivers
  • 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
  • Up to 12 months’ gender affirmation leave, including 6 weeks’ paid leave
  • Access to Employee Assistance Program and wellbeing benefits including skin and health checks, and flu vaccinations
  • Access to a wide range of salary packaging options
  • Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
  • Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
  • Reimbursement for work from home equipment

About the Risk Management Group

Our Risk Management Group works as an independent, and centralised function, responsible for independent and objective review and challenge, oversight, monitoring and reporting in relation to Macquarie’s material risks. We are a global team that aims to manage the risks of today and anticipate the risks of tomorrow. Our divisions include compliance, credit, financial crime risk, market risk, operational risk, aggregate risk and prudential, and central.

Inclusion at Macquarie

We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.
