description:
Senior Software Developer, Book of Record (Core Balances)

Team: IT

Location: Canada

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Developer, Book of Record (Core Balances) based in Canada.

As a Senior Software Developer, you will own critical backend services responsible for tracking client balances, financial activity, and reserved assets in real time.
You’ll join a small, high-trust engineering team where senior developers have meaningful ownership and autonomy from day one.
Your work will sit on the critical path for financial products used by millions of clients, making correctness, reliability, and performance essential.
You’ll tackle challenging distributed-systems problems involving high availability, low latency, event processing, database performance, and financial accuracy.
You’ll also help modernize mature systems, improving architecture without compromising live production workloads or client trust.
Working closely with Product and neighbouring engineering teams, you’ll turn complex financial requirements into dependable services and simple client experiences.
The environment values pragmatic engineering, continuous learning, mentorship, operational excellence, and thoughtful use of AI-assisted development.

Accountabilities:

    • Design, build, deploy, and operate backend services supporting real-time balances, asset reservations, and financial activity.
    • Own meaningful technical scope end-to-end, from architecture and technical design through implementation, production deployment, monitoring, and ongoing improvement.
    • Solve complex engineering challenges involving real-time correctness, low latency, high availability, database contention, event processing, and peak-volume reliability.
    • Modernize and evolve mature financial systems by consolidating overlapping services and data models, establishing reliable entry points for financial activity, isolating failure domains, and improving recovery and backfill capabilities.
    • Execute architectural changes and migrations safely on live, high-traffic systems while maintaining availability and ensuring clients are never presented with incorrect financial information.
    • Raise engineering standards through thoughtful system design, rigorous code reviews, testing, observability, and strong production ownership.
    • Mentor other engineers through pairing, reviews, technical guidance, and continuous feedback while contributing to a collaborative learning environment.
    • Work closely with Product and adjacent engineering teams to translate complex financial logic and requirements into scalable technical solutions.
    • Apply AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to improve engineering speed, quality, and safety while helping shape effective AI-enabled development practices.

      • Requirements

      • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating critical production systems.
      • Strong backend engineering capabilities, including sound judgment around system architecture, reliability, scalability, and technical trade-offs.
      • Proven experience developing highly available and low-latency services and operating them reliably under significant production load.
      • Strong experience with JVM-based technologies; Kotlin is the primary language, while deep Java experience or comparable backend expertise is highly transferable.
      • Familiarity with technologies such as Kafka, GraphQL, and modern distributed systems is valuable.
      • Strong production ownership mindset, with the ability to remain calm, analytical, and methodical when incidents or unexpected failures occur.
      • Comfort working within mature codebases and improving existing systems incrementally rather than relying on greenfield development.
      • Strong software quality practices, including automated testing, maintainable code, observability, and constructive code review.
      • Clear and proactive communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Product and Engineering and surface questions or concerns early.
      • Genuine curiosity about the business and financial context behind technical systems, including the real-world impact on clients.
      • Enthusiasm for AI-assisted development and an interest in establishing rigorous, effective approaches to incorporating AI into engineering workflows.
      • Experience in fintech, banking, trading, or another regulated or high-stakes environment is an advantage.
      • Familiarity with ledgers, reconciliation, financial correctness, event-driven architecture, stream processing, or transactional consistency patterns is preferred.
      • Additional experience with Kafka or Flink, GraphQL/Apollo Federation, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL performance at scale, or large-scale live-system migrations is a plus.

        • Benefits

        • Comprehensive health and life insurance benefits.
        • Long-term group savings program with employer matching.
        • 20 vacation days plus 4 wellness days annually.
        • Unlimited sick and mental health days.
        • 90 Days Away program allowing employees to work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year.
        • A hybrid working environment with a distributed team across North America.
        • Access to employee resource groups supporting inclusion and community, including groups focused on 2SLGBTQ+ employees, women, and Black employees.
        • Opportunity to work alongside highly talented, curious, and collaborative engineering professionals.
        • A culture that encourages continuous learning, experimentation, thoughtful use of AI, and evolving engineering practices.
        • Meaningful ownership over systems that underpin critical financial experiences used by millions of clients.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer

Team: IT

Location: Finland

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Finland.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you’ll champion a quality-first mindset across an agile software development environment. You’ll contribute throughout the full software development lifecycle, from requirements refinement and test strategy through release validation. The role combines hands-on testing, automation, backend validation, API testing, database testing, and exploratory testing. You’ll work closely with product, architecture, engineering, and quality teams to identify risks early and improve testability. As the automation expert within the team, you’ll help build and maintain robust automated test suites for new and existing functionality. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence engineering practices and raise software quality beyond your immediate team. This is a collaborative, remote role in a fast-moving environment where ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

Accountabilities

    • Contribute to feature refinement by challenging assumptions, clarifying requirements, identifying edge cases, and assessing system architecture and testability.
    • Develop and formalize comprehensive test strategies covering test scenarios, integration points, test data, APIs, applications, queues, databases, and result verification.
    • Deploy and configure software updates in QA environments and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end tests.
    • Investigate defects, identify root causes where possible, and document bugs with clear, accurate reproduction steps and supporting information.
    • Validate completed functionality and provide production sign-off when quality and acceptance criteria have been met.
    • Drive test automation for both new and existing features, working closely with quality engineering leadership to maintain reliable and effective automated test suites.
    • Act as the team’s automation specialist and promote quality engineering practices across the wider development organization.
    • Perform backend testing through multiple interaction methods, including REST APIs, message queues, databases, and front-end interfaces.
    • Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, technical leads, developers, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
    • Advocate for quality, usability, testability, and continuous improvement while managing and reprioritizing multiple workstreams in a dynamic environment.
    • During the first 90 days, build a strong understanding of the products, customers, teams, tools, and processes, while establishing relationships and contributing to the team’s quality goals.
    • Participate actively in feedback, professional development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

      • Requirements

      • 5–8+ years of proven experience working as a QA tester or QA engineer within an Agile software development environment.
      • Strong experience developing test strategies, defining test scenarios, and writing detailed test cases.
      • Extensive experience testing backend systems using multiple approaches, including REST APIs, message queues, databases, and front-end interfaces.
      • Strong SQL skills and practical experience with relational database tools such as DBeaver, SQL Server, or MySQL Workbench.
      • Experience creating or seeding databases with test data is an advantage.
      • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Git and version control workflows.
      • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP; familiarity with AWS services including EKS, RDS, SQS, and API Gateway is a plus.
      • Hands-on experience with API testing and documentation tools such as Swagger, Bruno, and Postman.
      • Experience writing and maintaining test scripts using JavaScript.
      • Knowledge of configuring mocks for isolated service testing is highly desirable.
      • Strong exploratory testing skills, with a sharp eye for functional defects, edge cases, usability concerns, and unexpected behavior.
      • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate issues and communicate findings clearly and efficiently.
      • Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the flexibility to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
      • A proactive, collaborative mindset with the confidence to challenge assumptions and advocate for quality.
      • At senior level, the ability to influence software quality beyond your immediate team and contribute to broader engineering improvements.
      • Strong ownership, curiosity, communication, and continuous-learning skills.

        • Benefits

        • Fully remote working environment.
        • Opportunity to work within a diverse, international team spanning multiple countries and cultures.
        • Meaningful opportunity to contribute to technology that improves financial access and supports communities.
        • High level of trust, autonomy, and ownership without unnecessary bureaucracy.
        • Collaborative culture focused on customer impact, experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
        • Opportunities to influence quality engineering practices beyond your immediate team.
        • Structured career and development conversations, including the opportunity to create a training and career growth plan aligned with your goals.
        • Regular feedback and opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues across product, engineering, and other functions.
        • A supportive environment that values well-being, collaboration, accountability, and having fun while doing meaningful work.

title: Data Engineer (BI back-end-udvikler) med øje for struktur og forretning
description:
Du taler måske ikke højest på kontoret – men dine løsninger og kvalifikationer taler for sig selv.

Får du energi af at skabe struktur i komplekse data, skrive ren kode og bygge løsninger, der giver værdi i forretningen? Har du lyst til at arbejde med ny teknologi og præsentere data, der bliver brugt til vigtige beslutninger? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Vi søger en Data-specialist til vores BI back-end team i Aarsleff-koncernen. Her bygger vi løsninger, der understøtter hele koncernen – fra IOT og arbejdsmiljø til finans og ESG. Du bliver en del af et erfarent og dygtigt BI-scrumteam på 7, hvor vi er nysgerrige på ny teknologi – også AI – og hvor der er plads til både fordybelse, sparring og udvikling

Hvem er du?

  • Du arbejder struktureret og værdsætter præcision – både i kode og kommunikation
  • Du er nysgerrig på forretning og god til at omsætte behov til datamodeller
  • PySpark og Power BI er velkendte værktøjer for dig
  • Og nej – vi forventer ikke, at du holder oplæg om det til afdelingsmødet

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • En central rolle i et BI-miljø i rivende udvikling
  • Mulighed for at arbejde tæt med forretningen – uden at blive forstyrret hele tiden
  • Kontor i Viby J. eller Storkøbenhavn – med mulighed for hjemmearbejde
  • Et team hvor faglighed, ordentlighed og kollegial respekt er vigtigere end smalltalk
  • Og ja, vi kan faktisk både grine og levere – og endda samtidigt

Klar til at høre mere?

I Aarsleff-koncernen er vi i fuld gang med en digital rejse. Vores IT-afdeling består af ca. 70 dygtige specialister. De arbejder med alt fra infrastruktur, udvikling, forretningsapplikationer og selvfølgelig BI. Vi sidder primært i Viby J., men har også kontor i Storkøbenhavn – og har fokus på fleksibilitet i både hverdag og lokation.

Hvis du vil vide mere om Aarsleff og vores projekter, kan du følge os på LinkedIn og aarsleff.dk

title: Vi udvikler os markant og positivt – og leder efter en ungerådgiver, der vil være med på rejsen
description:
Ungecenteret i Vordingborg Kommune står midt i en spændende udvikling med fokus på styrkelse af kvaliteten i ungeindsatsen og udvidelse af vores tværfaglige samarbejde. Da en af vores kollegaer er gået på barsel, søger vi en ny kollega, der vil være med til at løfte ungeområdet og sikre høj faglighed på tværs af forskellige faglige områder.

Som ungerådgiver hos os får du mulighed for at bringe din faglighed i spil i arbejdet efter Barnets Lov og i en hverdag med fokus på kvalitet, udvikling og tværfagligt samarbejde. Stillingen er et barselsvikariat.

Om os
Ungecenteret er en tværfaglig enhed under Borger og Arbejdsmarked med ca. 65 medarbejdere. Vi arbejder samlet med unge i alderen 15–29 år og har ansvar for alt fra grundskolevejledning til støttende indsatser efter Barnets lov, voksenområdet og beskæftigelsesrettede indsatser. Vi prioriterer tæt samarbejde på tværs af fagligheder og med både interne og eksterne aktører. Vores mål er at skabe de bedste betingelser for, at de unge lykkes – fagligt, socialt og personligt.

Som en del af vores fælles ungeindsats får du mulighed for at sætte dit præg på udviklingen, arbejde tæt sammen med dygtige fagkollegaer og bidrage til at sikre, at alle unge får den rette støtte på det rette tidspunkt.

Dine arbejdsopgaver
  • Modtage og behandle partshøringer i underretninger
  • Udarbejde screeninger, afdækninger og børnefaglige undersøgelser
  • Sikre reel inddragelse af den unge og dennes familie/netværk
  • Iværksætte indsatser og følge løbende op
  • Samarbejde bredt med andre fagområder og aktører
  • Myndighedssagsbehandling efter Barnets lov
  • Give råd og vejledning til unge og familier
Vi søger dig, som
  • Er uddannet socialrådgiver eller socialformidler
  • Har erfaring fra myndighedsområdet – eller lyst til at lære det
  • Har en nysgerrig, anerkendende og inddragende tilgang
  • Kan bevare ro og overblik i akutte situationer
  • Arbejder struktureret og løsningsfokuseret
  • Har interesse for ungeområdet og tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Har kørekort og adgang til bil
Vi tilbyder
  • En arbejdsplads i udvikling med fokus på kvalitet og forebyggelse
  • Høj faglig sparring og mulighed for kompetenceudvikling
  • En stærk tværfaglig kollegagruppe
  • Fleksible rammer og mulighed for hjemmearbejde
  • Indflydelse på tilrettelæggelsen af dit arbejde
  • En meningsfuld hverdag, hvor du gør en forskel for unge og familier
Ansættelsesvilkår
Stillingen er et barselsvikariat og som udgangspunkt på 37 timer ugentligt – andet kan drøftes.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst (Ny Løn).

Opstart 1. oktober 2026 eller efter aftale.

Vi gør opmærksom på, at vi som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen indhenter referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgivere, og ansættelsen er betinget af, at vi modtager en straffeattest.

Ansøgningsfrist
26. august 2026

Ansættelsessamtaler
Forventes afholdt d. 28. august 2026

Kontakt
Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Teamleder Britt Teut på tlf. 21 77 54 28, send evt. sms og du vil blive kontaktet.

Vordingborg Kommune

Vordingborg Kommune er en attraktiv og moderne arbejdsplads beliggende i Danmarks vildeste natur. Her langs Danmarks længste kystlinje mellem historiske købstæder og stærke fællesskaber er vi omtrent 4000 ansatte, der arbejder for at gøre vores kommune til et endnu mere grønt og attraktivt sted at bo og leve.

Vi har fokus på, at hverdagen skal hænge sammen og tilbyder rammerne om et liv i balance. Her får du mange kvadratmeter for færre penge, du kommer tæt på kysten, i spektakulær natur – med et meningsfuldt job. Så kom og vær med!

title: Site Reliability Engineer (Remote)
description:
Site Reliability Engineer

Team: IT

Location: UK

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer based in United Kingdom.

This is a senior reliability engineering role focused on defining and advancing the infrastructure standards behind a globally scaled, AI-native platform.
You will take ownership of reliability strategy across production infrastructure, with a particular focus on AWS, Kubernetes, event-driven systems, and AI agent workloads.
The role combines deep hands-on engineering with architectural leadership, incident management, observability, and technical mentorship.
You will design systems that remain resilient under increasing transaction volumes while establishing measurable standards for reliability across engineering teams.
A key part of the role will be evolving synchronous architectures toward durable asynchronous communication and strengthening the platform through resilience testing and chaos engineering.
You will also help shape how AI-assisted tools are used for automation, incident analysis, runbooks, and root-cause investigations.
Success means becoming the trusted technical authority for complex reliability decisions while creating practices that make reliability scalable across the organization.

Accountabilities

    • Define and implement the reliability strategy across the platform, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, incident practices, and reliability standards adopted by engineering teams.
    • Drive major architectural decisions as infrastructure evolves, evaluating technologies and designing systems that remain scalable, resilient, observable, and maintainable.
    • Design and own event-driven communication and messaging infrastructure, including the transition from synchronous patterns to durable asynchronous architectures.
    • Manage and evolve cloud infrastructure on AWS, using Infrastructure as Code to automate provisioning, configuration, deployment, and operational processes.
    • Ensure Kubernetes and containerized workloads scale reliably as transaction volumes and AI workloads increase.
    • Build and maintain comprehensive observability through monitoring, dashboards, alerting, application performance monitoring, and distributed tracing.
    • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex production incidents, leading incident response, root-cause investigations, and blameless postmortems.
    • Turn incident findings into permanent improvements through architectural changes, automation, operational controls, and resilience patterns.
    • Establish a continuous chaos engineering and resilience testing practice through fault injection, game days, and controlled failure experiments.
    • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers while raising the technical bar for reliability engineering and influencing engineering practices across teams.
    • Use AI-assisted tooling for automation, runbooks, incident analysis, and root-cause investigations, while helping establish effective AI-enabled engineering practices.
    • Within the first 6–12 months, establish the platform reliability strategy, lead at least one major architectural evolution, and drive adoption of the SLO and error-budget framework across engineering teams.

      • Requirements

      • Extensive experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or a closely related discipline, with demonstrated ownership of production-scale systems.
      • Deep expertise in event-driven architecture and messaging systems such as Kafka, NATS, or RabbitMQ, including at-least-once delivery, consumer groups, dead-letter queues, backpressure, and migrations from synchronous to asynchronous architectures.
      • Strong AWS expertise across services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, and RDS, combined with solid networking fundamentals.
      • Hands-on Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tools, with infrastructure managed through version-controlled workflows and code reviews.
      • Strong production experience with Kubernetes and Docker, including container lifecycle management, resource limits, health checks, and orchestration at scale.
      • Proven observability expertise using Datadog or equivalent platforms, including dashboards, monitoring, APM, distributed tracing, and alerting.
      • Demonstrated experience defining and operating SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets across multiple services.
      • Hands-on experience with chaos engineering, fault injection, game days, or resilience experiments using tools such as Gremlin, Chaos Mesh, AWS FIS, or similar technologies.
      • Strong distributed systems debugging skills, with experience diagnosing asynchronous workflows, cascading failures, and complex production incidents.
      • Ability to code for automation and engineering tooling using Go, Python, or a similar programming language.
      • Solid database knowledge across SQL and NoSQL technologies, particularly PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis, including indexing, replication, and performance optimization.

Position Summary
The Director - Equipment PMO will lead the Energy and Power Solution equipment program management function responsible for execution governance, procurement coordination, supplier performance, and delivery oversight for power distribution and generation equipment programs.
This role provides leadership across Development Engineering, Estimation, Supply Chain, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Project Execution to support commercial, industrial, utility, data center, EV charging, microgrid, backup power, distributed generation, and energy transition applications.
This position emphasizes people leadership, PMO discipline, technical rigor, customer engagement, scalable equipment delivery, and strong execution controls within an EPC framework.

Key Responsibilities
Equipment PMO Leadership
  • Lead the Equipment PMO function responsible for execution oversight of power distribution and generation equipment programs.
  • Adopt and implement PMO governance standards, execution playbooks, stage-gate processes, reporting dashboards, escalation protocols, risk registers, and portfolio review cadences.

People Management & Team Development

Supply Chain & Risk Management

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Support strategic pursuits, customer meetings, supplier reviews, project kickoffs, technical reviews, commercial discussions, and major issue resolution.
  • Ensure alignment between customer expectations, technical requirements, equipment procurement, supplier delivery, ﬁeld execution, and ﬁnancial performance.
Qualiﬁcations
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Business, Supply Chain, or a related technical ﬁeld.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in equipment project management, program management, electrical infrastructure, power distribution, power generation, EPC, design-build, electrical contracting, equipment manufacturing, utility infrastructure, or energy-related project execution.
  • Minimum 5 years of people management experience leading project managers, technical project managers, program managers, procurement execution teams, engineering coordination teams, or related technical delivery functions.
  • Demonstrated experience with power distribution and/or generation equipment such as switchgear, switchboards, transformers, ATS, E-Houses, MCCs, generators, backup power systems, battery systems, microgrids, transfer systems, or related infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of equipment procurement, supplier management, estimating support, submittals, manufacturing schedules, FAT coordination, logistics planning, commissioning handoff, warranty support, and project controls.
  • Experience operating within an EPC, construction, design-build, infrastructure, utility, data center, industrial, or energy transition environment.
  • Ability to interpret one-line diagrams, technical speciﬁcations, equipment schedules, submittals, construction documents, customer requirements, and supplier proposals.
  • Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, stakeholder management, commercial judgment, risk management, and executive reporting skills.
  • Proﬁciency with Microsoft Ofﬁce; experience with ERP, CRM, procurement, project management, scheduling, and reporting platforms.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% for customer meetings, supplier reviews, factory visits, site visits, project escalations, and business reviews.

Preferred Experience
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in equipment program management, power distribution, power generation, electrical infrastructure, EPC execution, supplier management, or technical delivery leadership.
  • Experience supporting data centers, critical power facilities, utility infrastructure, renewable energy, microgrids, backup power systems, EV charging deployments, industrial facilities, or large-scale infrastructure programs.

#KGS

Consultant Pricing Strategy

About us

The position in discussion is with the Deal Advisory team at KPMG Global Services (KGS), which is KPMG’s global delivery centre and is an integral part of the firm’s strategy to enhance innovation, build scalability, and improve profitability, globally.

KGS’ Deal Advisory Group is a team of 1500+ professionals, with three offices in Gurgaon, Mumbai and Bangalore.

KGS DA has been providing solutions to KPMG member firms globally. Leveraging insights and applying best practices, the team helps create customized approaches to M&A transactions. The team’s capabilities include Corporate Finance, Transaction Services, Strategy, Business Modeling, Accounting Advisory Services, Deal Advisory Research and Benchmarking

About the team

The Strategy team works with C-level Executives to identify, structure and solve their most critical strategic issues across the economic and transaction cycles. As part of a fast-paced and dynamic group, our consultants offer strategic advice on financial, business and operating models to corporate, public sector and private equity clients.

KGS Strategy team in India is organized by sectoral and functional capabilities to provide practical and actionable recommendations that can be delivered by the client in a cost-effective manner, both in a deal and non-deal environment. Key member firms with which KGS Strategy team works include KPMG UK and KPMG US.

About the role

Within the Strategy team we have an established Pricing strategy practice, serving number of sectors including retail, consumer goods, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, transport and industrial manufacturing sectors serving US, and other international clients. We work with C-level executives to identify, structure and solve their most critical strategic issues related to deal strategy, and growth strategy.

KPMG’s Pricing strategy practice is a specialised team focused on solving pricing and revenue optimisation problems for its clients using data and analytics techniques to deliver a sustainable solution which can deliver both short- and long-term margin improvements. As a team, we are a group of bright committed individuals who are passionate about delivering fantastic client work, solving complex data related problems, investing our time in acquiring new analytical skills, and having fun both inside and outside of work.

Responsibilities:

We are recruiting for a consultant with Pricing / Data Analytics experience. The role is currently part of KPMG’s Pricing Strategy team based in India that works closely with KPMG US and includes following core responsibilities:

  • Work collaboratively with senior onshore stakeholders and client teams, in the development and implementation of pricing strategy, solutions/ recommendations
  • Support in developing proposals and enhancing sales strategies for potential clients
  • Understand client system and data structures and designing and executing data intensive analysis to support development of evidence-based insights
  • Managing engagement work-streams and analysis, including defining deliverables, setting timelines, and develop high quality output, taking responsibility for teams when required
  • Leverage analytical tools & platforms such as Alteryx, Power BI, Python etc. to manage large data sets and drive insights
  • Develop documentation and insights in PowerPoint decks
  • Plan and undertake primary and secondary research to develop insightful analysis for clients
  • Implementation of solutions/tools in client environment and train client to implement new approach and appropriate tools
  • Contributing to thought leadership and knowledge management to support practice development

Required qualifications:

  • Education/professional qualifications: MBAs/ B. tech/ B.E. from a leading Indian/International educational institution
  • Extensive professional experience (minimum of 2-3 years) in strategy or analytics roles, acquired from corporate positions, analytic boutique firms, or strategic consulting firms
  • Minimum of 2 years of specific experience in pricing strategy and revenue optimization, handling complex pricing problems and developing effective strategies

Required key Skills:

  • Experience in business research and data analytics with strong understanding of databases and data manipulation (data cleansing, aggregation and summary)
  • Experience of complex modelling and analysis by using tools such as Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL, etc.
  • Proven ability to identify complex pricing problems, develop innovative solutions, and implement effective pricing strategies to drive business growth and profitability
  • In-depth understanding of pricing methodologies, including value-based pricing, cost-based pricing, competitive pricing, dynamic pricing, and pricing optimization

Preferred skills:

  • Good to have hands-on experience in developing Python codes (using IDEs like Spyder, Jupyter, etc.) and working with python libraries Pandas, Numpy, Scipy etc.
  • Experience in designing/implementing machine learning models for pricing applications including but not limited to price elasticity models, forecasting, customer segmentation, linear regression, logistic regression, random forest etc.
  • Possesses strong numerical, analytical, and strategic skills, with sound commercial acumen
  • Conduct pricing strategy and revenue optimization analyses using large and complex datasets to identify pricing opportunities, assess market dynamics, and develop data-driven recommendations that enhance profitability and growth.
  • Leverage analytics tools such as Python, SQL, Alteryx, and Power BI to perform data cleansing, modeling, forecasting, customer segmentation, and pricing optimization while translating insights into impactful client deliverables and executive presentations.
  • Collaborate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams to develop and implement pricing solutions, manage project workstreams, support business development initiatives, and deliver strategic recommendations for clients across diverse industries.

3+ years of experience in pricing, analytics or revenue strategy

title: Ayudante de Cocina
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

Se tú

Como Ayudante de Cocina apoyará en la preparación de platillos de manera activa durante el servicio, junto con el resto de la brigada de cocina llevará a cabo la sanitización, recepción, acomodo, limpieza, preparación y producción de alimentos y todas sus actividades colaterales.

Fecha estimada de contratación: Octubre 2026

Conocimientos y Habilidades

  • Experiencia requerida en el puesto mínimo de 1 año

  • Experiencia en hotelería de lujo

  • Comprender y familiarizarse con los estándares de calidad y estándares de servicio del hotel

  • Habilidad para hablar, escribir y leer el idioma Español.

  • Máximo nivel de integridad y transparencia

  • Aplicar un enfoque ético al resultado de las situaciones.

  • Habilidades razonables para resolver problemas, tomar decisiones y resolver conflictos

  • Trabajar de manera segura, prudente y organizada

* Esta posición requiere que los candidatos cuenten con autorización vigente para trabajar en México.

Domina tu oficio

  • Garantizar la higiene y acomodo del área de trabajo, materiales e insumos previos a toda manipulación de alimentos.

  • Dar apoyo en la preparación (misen place) asignadas.

  • Apoyo en la realización de las recetas/proceso de manera cabal y disciplinada en caso de existir dudas solicitar asistencia.

  • Apoyo en la preparación de alimentos durante el servicio de alimentos con pulcritud, sentido de urgencia y disciplina.

  • Apoyar de manera activa al acomodo de todos los espacios de almacenamiento de alimentos.

  • Revisar que los insumos se encuentren en óptimas condiciones.

  • Tener de forma anticipada y con la calidad requerida su misen place previo al servicio de alimentos.

Lo que Ofrecemos y lo que Puedes Esperar

  • Formar parte de un equipo colaborativo con un genuino espíritu de familia, donde tu talento será valorado y reconocido.

  • Salarios altamente competitivos, con un atractivo plan de incentivos anual para puestos gerenciales y de Jefatura de Departamento.

  • Servicio de transporte desde San Lucas y San José del Cabo hasta el resort.

  • Servicio de lavandería de uniformes, garantizando comodidad y una imagen profesional.

  • Programas de capacitación y talleres internos que apoyan tu desarrollo profesional.

  • Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico, diverso y desafiante, con interacción cercana con el equipo de liderazgo.

  • Programas de reconocimiento que celebran tus logros, incluyendo reconocimientos por años de servicio, Empleado del Mes y Empleado del Año.

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO como "Las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE desde 1998 y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

Cultura de servicio

Actualmente operando 120 hoteles y resorts, y 45 propiedades residenciales en los principales centros de las ciudades y destinos turísticos en 47 países, y con más de 50 proyectos en planificación o desarrollo, Four Seasons se ubica constantemente entre los mejores hoteles del mundo y las marcas más prestigiosas en las encuestas de lectores, críticas de viajeros y premios de la industria. Nuestro mayor activo, y la clave de nuestro éxito, es nuestra gente. Creemos que cada uno de nosotros necesita un sentido de dignidad, orgullo y satisfacción en lo que hacemos.

¿Cómo es trabajar para Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts?

En Four Seasons, guiamos todas nuestras acciones por la regla de oro: “Trata a los demás como te gustaría ser tratado”. Aquí, podrá trabajar en un equipo que se basa en el respeto mutuo, la colaboración, el excelente servicio y la pasión por el servicio. Como marca de lujo, su trabajo también se guiará por estándares muy estrictos para garantizar un alto nivel de calidad y servicio en todo momento. Espere trabajar duro pero diviértase y aprenda en el camino, llevando su carrera, experiencia y habilidades al siguiente nivel. Como beneficio adicional, trabajar con Four Seasons le brinda la oportunidad de trabajar para una empresa internacional y viajar por todo el mundo mientras se hospeda en propiedades increíbles de forma gratuita.

title: Senior Agentic Platform Engineer
description:
Senior Agentic Platform Engineer II

Team: IT

Location: India

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Agentic Platform Engineer II based in India.

This is a high-impact engineering role focused on building the shared platform that enables teams to develop and operate AI agents at scale. You will shape how retrieval pipelines, agent orchestration, MCP servers, model access, evaluation, and observability are designed and governed. Working primarily with Python, Kubernetes, and Google Cloud, you will create reusable capabilities that accelerate AI adoption across the organization. The role combines hands-on engineering, platform architecture, security, developer experience, and technical leadership. You will build proofs of concept, establish standards, and help internal teams move successful solutions into production. You’ll work in a highly collaborative, remote environment alongside teams adopting increasingly sophisticated agentic technologies. This is an opportunity to influence the foundations of an AI-first engineering ecosystem while solving complex, real-world platform challenges.

Accountabilities

    • Build and evolve an internal Agentic Platform, identifying recurring engineering needs and turning them into reusable capabilities, paved paths, and sensible defaults.
    • Design, develop, and operate internal MCP servers, including authentication, tool and schema design, versioning, testing, scaffolding, templates, and registries.
    • Build the platform infrastructure for remote AI agents, covering deployment, scheduling, credentials, observability, rate limiting, lifecycle management, and safe retirement.
    • Establish security and governance guardrails for autonomous agents, including scoped permissions, human approval workflows, sandboxing, audit logging, spending controls, and blast-radius limitations.
    • Lead technical approaches for retrieval-augmented generation, including ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector stores, incremental synchronization, and retrieval-quality measurement.
    • Own evaluation and observability practices for AI systems through evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, regression testing, prompt versioning, and instrumentation using relevant observability platforms.
    • Improve the agentic developer experience through internal tooling, skills and plugin libraries, code-review agents, remediation agents, and fleet-wide engineering automation.
    • Extend and operate the centralized LLM gateway, supporting model and provider coverage, secure access, routing, governance, PII monitoring, access controls, and cost attribution.
    • Develop reference implementations and proofs of concept that demonstrate scalable patterns before transitioning ownership to production engineering teams.
    • Establish engineering standards and playbooks, mentor teams adopting AI capabilities, advise on build-versus-buy decisions, and participate in an on-call rotation for platform services.

      • Requirements

      • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred.
      • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 2 years building production LLM-powered systems and 2+ years in a senior engineering or technical leadership role.
      • Strong production-grade Python skills, along with the ability to confidently read and modify large Java or Kotlin codebases and their build tooling; Scala is a plus.
      • Strong TypeScript/Node.js experience is preferred, particularly for AI and platform development.
      • Hands-on experience building MCP servers or clients, including tool and schema design, authentication, and secure integrations.
      • Experience with agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph or equivalent, including context and state management.
      • Proven production experience with RAG, vector stores such as PostgreSQL/pgvector, embedding models, chunking strategies, incremental synchronization, and retrieval-quality assessment.
      • Experience evaluating non-deterministic AI systems through evaluation harnesses, regression suites, quality gates, prompt versioning, and analysis of latency and cost.
      • Practical experience with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or comparable technologies, with a clear understanding of their strengths and failure modes.
      • Strong security awareness for agentic systems, including prompt-injection defenses, sandboxed execution, scoped credentials, audit logging, and blast-radius containment.
      • Hands-on Kubernetes and cloud experience, ideally with GCP technologies such as GKE, IAM, GCS, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, and BigQuery.
      • Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD, Terraform, Docker, and observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, and OpenTelemetry.
      • Strong platform-engineering mindset, with the ability to transform business problems into reusable capabilities, validate ideas through focused proofs of concept, and document standards clearly.
      • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.
      • Experience working with US-based business teams and willingness to overlap 2–3 hours with Pacific Time business hours.
      • Ability to participate in an on-call rotation and operate effectively in a collaborative, high-trust environment.
      • Nice-to-have experience includes internal developer platforms, replacing third-party SaaS or AI solutions with in-house capabilities, large-scale JVM migrations, workflow orchestration platforms, no-code/low-code automation, open-source AI contributions, or AI governance in regulated industries.

        • Benefits

        • Annual compensation range of ₹40,50,000 – ₹56,70,000 INR, depending on experience, skills, knowledge, market alignment, and location.
        • Fully remote work arrangement in India.
        • Comprehensive benefits supporting health, life, and financial well-being.
        • Medical and accident insurance.
        • Retiral benefits.
        • 12 company-paid holidays plus 2 flexible holidays.
        • Privilege/earned leave and casual/sick leave.
        • Paid maternity and paternity leave.
        • Company-supported wellness initiatives and weekly wellness events.
        • Opportunity to work on advanced agentic AI infrastructure with significant technical ownership and organizational impact.
        • Collaborative, inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives, autonomy, accountability, and continuous growth.
        • Exposure to complex AI, cloud, distributed systems, platform engineering, and developer productivity challenges.
        • Opportunities to mentor others, shape technical standards, and influence the adoption of emerging AI technologies.

description:
Opportunity Overview

We're hiring a Data Architect who will serve as a senior technical leader responsible for architecting the complete lifecycle data moves, transforms, and creates value across every product line we operate. This role would need experience with US healthcare domain data.

Semantic Layer Governance: Set the technical standard and reference architecture for a universal semantic layer across multiple distinct data products, ensuring unified definitions of complex metrics and healthcare business entities across

Architect the Enterprise Context Layer: Define, scale, and govern the global Enterprise Ontology (abstract domain maps, business entity classes, and entity-relationship rules) that serves as the backbone for Agentic AI systems.

AI-Native Prototyping: Leverage modern AI-native development environments (such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to rapidly generate, iterate, and document blueprints for complex enterprise data schemas and metadata layers.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with executive leadership, product management, and engineering to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Communicate complex architectural concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Must-Haves

  • 12+ years of deep data engineering, with a proven trajectory of operating in a Staff, Principal, or Architect capacity.

  • Mastery over diverse data modeling languages and paradigms- including Relational, Dimensional, Data Vault 2.0, and Graph/Ontological modeling frameworks.
  • Healthcare standards and compliance expertise: Deep understanding of healthcare interoperability standards (FHIR, HL7) and proven experience architecting HIPAA-compliant data platforms in production environments
  • Deep expertise in modern data platforms and cloud-native architectures, with strong command of AWS data services (S3, Glue, Athena, Redshift, Lake Formation)
  • Understanding of data pipeline orchestration, transformation frameworks (dbt, Airflow), and modern data stack components
  • Outstanding executive presence and communication skills, with a track record of translating highly abstract semantic concepts (ontologies, knowledge graphs) into compelling business value narratives for C-suite and business stakeholders.

  • Good knowledge of Information practices.

  • Ensuring the team and imparted with Competence related to Information security

Nice-to-Haves

  • Direct experience designing semantic graphs or metadata abstraction layers specifically designed to optimize multi-agent AI workflows.
  • Familiarity with enterprise metric storage paradigms and middleware tools (e.g., dbt)
  • Expertise in modern data lakehouse architectures leveraging open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake.
  • Contributions to open-source projects or thought leadership in the data architecture community

Amentum is searching for a Top-Secret cleared ISSO to join our team in Washington, DC. You will need experience determining products to meet client needs and presenting results.

Essential Responsibilities:

Serves as the principal advisor to the Information System Owner (SO), Business Process Owner, and the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) / Information System Security Manager (ISSM) on all matters, technical and otherwise, involving the security of an information system. ISSOs are responsible for ensuring the implementation and maintenance of security controls. Directs and implements the necessary controls and procedures to cost-effectively protect information systems assets from intentional or inadvertent modification, disclosure, or destruction. Provides guidance and direction for the physical protection of information systems assets to other functional units. Provides reports to superiors regarding effectiveness of data security and makes recommendations for the adoption of new procedures. Assist with reviewing, developing, and navigating the system, team, and customer through the Authority to Operate (ATO) accreditation/certification documentation process. Perform network self-inspections. Create new and edit existing documentation that forms the Authority to Operate (ATO) package to include the System Security Plan and IS contingency plan. Develop Plan of Action and Milestone (POAMS) from vulnerability data and enter into the system of record.

Possesses and applies a comprehensive knowledge across key tasks and high impact assignments. Plans and leads major technology assignments. Evaluates performance results and recommends major changes affecting short-term project growth and success. Functions as a technical expert across multiple project assignments. May supervise others. Minimum of 8 years’ experience recommended. In absence of years of experience, certifications or past work may be used to show the level of experience needed to perform at this level.

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

  • Minimum of 7 years of experience collectively with the following:
    • Proven work experience as an Information Systems Security Officer or a similar role, preferably in a complex organizational setting.
    • In-depth knowledge of information security principles, methodologies, and best practices.

    • Experience in conducting risk assessments and implementing security controls.
    • Experience with Risk Management Framework (RMF), ICD 503, NIST SP800-53 or DCID 6/3
    • Proficiency in using security tools and technologies, such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, SIEM, and vulnerability management tools.
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify security gaps and develop effective mitigation strategies.
    • Knowledge of incident response procedures
    • Documented and demonstrated experience with troubleshooting and problem solving

description:
Vi søger en teamkoordinator til aftenholdet til Orkla i Skælskør, hvor du får en central rolle i den daglige produktion.

Stillingen er med opstart tidligst den 17. august 2026 og med mulighed for fastansættelse på sigt.

Arbejdstid: Mandag–torsdag kl. 16.00–01.30.

Arbejdsopgaver

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor du skal være med til at skabe overblik, koordinere opgaver og sikre, at produktionen kører effektivt.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være:

  • Koordinering og fordeling af arbejdsopgaver på aftenholdet

  • Sikre overblik og et godt flow i den daglige produktion

  • Være bindeled mellem medarbejderne og ledelsen

  • Følge op på produktion og sikre, at arbejdsopgaverne bliver løst korrekt og effektivt

  • Truckkørsel og placering af varer

  • Arbejde med SAP i forbindelse med de daglige produktions- og lageropgaver

  • Bidrage aktivt i produktionen, når der er behov for det

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra produktions- eller lagerbranchen

  • Har erfaring med truckkørsel

  • Har kendskab til SAP

  • Har erfaring med koordinering eller en naturlig evne til at tage ansvar og skabe overblik

  • Kan arbejde struktureret og bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og samarbejdsvillig

  • Trives med at tage en ledende rolle

  • Er fleksibel og ikke er bange for selv at tage fat i de praktiske opgaver

  • Har kørekort og egen bil

Vi tilbyder

  • Grundig oplæring

  • Mulighed for fastansættelse for den rette medarbejder

  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige kollegaer

  • Mulighed for fastansættelse for den rette kandidat

Opstart hurtigst muligt. Ansøgninger behandles løbende.

title: Senior Lighting Engineer
description:
What if you could shape a career as unique as you?

At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.

A little more about your role...

As a Senior Lighting Designer, you'll play a key role in delivering innovative and sustainable lighting solutions across a diverse portfolio of projects. Working closely with colleagues, clients and stakeholders, you'll help shape projects from early concept through to construction, ensuring high-quality outcomes that enhance the built environment.

  • Support with the development of project proposals and progress against agreed programme milestones and budget constraints.
  • Liaise with Local Authority and Strategic Road Network clients building strong working relationships.
  • Analyse/evaluate Client briefs and offer expert guidance and tailored support.
  • Guide junior team members and Early Career Professionals on their career journeys
  • Represent WSP within the lighting industry, fostering industry relationships and driving business development.

Your team...

You'll be joining a growing, collaborative and highly respected team of lighting professionals who are passionate about creating safer, more sustainable and better-connected communities.

Our team works across a range of specialisms, including:

  • Local Government
  • Strategic Road Network
  • Electrical and EV Infrastructure
  • Environmental Lighting
  • Architectural Lighting

What makes this opportunity special?

  • You will be joining a growing, multi-disciplinary team of lighting professionals that is highly regarded within the industry, which includes the following specialisms: Electrical and EV, Environmental, Local Government, Architectural and the Strategic Road Network.
  • You'll contribute to projects that make a visible difference to communities, businesses and infrastructure across the UK and beyond.
  • You'll have access to structured development opportunities, advanced training programmes and regular CPD sessions.
  • We'll support your professional development, including maintaining or progressing professional memberships and Engineering Council registration.
  • You'll work on a diverse range of projects spanning transportation, infrastructure, urban realm and commercial developments for both public and private sector clients.

What we are looking for you to demonstrate….

We're keen to hear from people who are passionate about lighting design and enjoy finding innovative solutions to complex challenges as well as

  • Experience using Lighting Reality and/or DIALux, together with AutoCAD.
  • A strong understanding of external lighting standards, legislation, guidance and best practice.
  • Good knowledge of electrical design principles and lighting maintenance considerations.
  • Experience delivering lighting design projects from concept through to construction.
  • Understanding of central management systems
  • Strong communication and organisational skills, with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • A desire to support, coach and develop others.
  • Experience working with Local Authority and/or Strategic Road Network clients.
  • Knowledge of external lighting products and technologies.
  • Membership of a relevant professional institution, with EngTech status achieved or a clear ambition to progress towards IEng accreditation.

Above all, we're looking for someone who enjoys working as part of a team, is passionate about making a positive impact through great design, and wants to help shape the future of lighting at WSP.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?

With us, you can. Apply today.

description:
Sr. Insider & Data Risk Analyst

Team: Analyst

Location: France

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. Insider & Data Risk Analyst based in France.

This is a senior individual contributor role focused on protecting sensitive information, systems, and people from insider and data-loss risks. You will own complex investigations from initial triage through resolution while helping mature insider risk management and Data Loss Prevention capabilities. The role sits at the intersection of cybersecurity, data protection, privacy, and regulated financial services. You will work closely with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security teams on highly sensitive cases requiring discretion and sound judgment. The position also offers an opportunity to strengthen risk processes, automate investigations, and apply AI to emerging security challenges.     • Own insider risk investigations from initial triage through closure, including establishing case timelines, coordinating containment and escalation, documenting determinations, and capturing lessons learned.

    • Investigate potential data exfiltration, misuse, policy violations, and inappropriate access involving source code, cloud platforms, collaboration tools, third-party applications, and critical business or trading systems.
    • Strengthen data classification and governance practices while aligning DLP controls with information sensitivity and business risk.
    • Assess risks associated with unauthorized AI and agentic tooling, including potential exposure of sensitive or proprietary information through approved and unsanctioned AI applications.
    • Use workflow automation, AI, and security orchestration capabilities to improve alert triage, investigation efficiency, and the overall maturity of insider risk processes.
    • Lead insider risk and data protection assessments, maintain risk registers, and track remediation activities and emerging threats.
    • Partner with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security on sensitive personnel cases, departures, policy violations, and data-handling concerns with a high level of discretion and care.
    • Support internal and external audits, regulatory requirements, and security assurance activities related to insider risk, data protection, privacy, and information security.
    • Contribute insider risk and secure data-handling content to security awareness and employee training programs.
    • Serve as a senior escalation point for insider risk cases and mentor colleagues on investigation methodologies, case management, and effective risk analysis.
    • Monitor developments in insider risk, data protection, privacy, cybersecurity, and financial services regulation to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

      • Requirements:

      • 4+ years of professional experience in insider risk, Data Loss Prevention, digital forensics, security investigations, or a closely related discipline.
      • Demonstrated hands-on experience leading sensitive investigations and managing cases involving personnel matters, data misuse, policy violations, or potential exfiltration.
      • Practical experience operating and tuning DLP solutions across SaaS and endpoint environments, with an understanding of detection quality and false-positive reduction.
      • Experience with workflow automation, AI, or SOAR platforms for alert triage, investigation support, and case orchestration.
      • Strong understanding of data classification, data governance, data protection, and information security principles.
      • Working knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis, such as Elastic/ELK or Splunk, to support investigations and establish evidence-based conclusions.
      • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks including NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and privacy regulations such as GDPR and APPI.
      • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear investigation reports, case documentation, risk assessments, and executive summaries.
      • Exceptional integrity, discretion, and judgment when handling confidential personnel, customer, business, and security information.
      • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple sensitive investigations in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
      • Ability to collaborate effectively with People/HR, Legal, Compliance, Engineering, IT, and Security stakeholders.
      • Experience with digital forensics, eDiscovery, UEBA, insider risk platforms, security operations, or incident response is an advantage.
      • Scripting or automation experience using technologies such as Python or SQL is a plus.
      • Experience with major cloud platforms and familiarity with supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or regulatory audits is beneficial.
      • Exposure to fintech, financial services, trading platforms, or regulated environments is strongly valued.
      • Relevant certifications such as GCFA, GCFE, CISSP, CISM, CIPP, CFE, or equivalent are considered a plus.
      • Familiarity with financial services regulatory expectations and multi-jurisdiction privacy requirements is advantageous.
      • A genuine interest in AI-related data risk and using emerging AI capabilities to improve security operations and investigation workflows.

        • Benefits:

        • Competitive salary and stock options.

Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities!

title: Solution Architect
description:
Purpose and Impact:

As a Solution Architect at Amentum, you will serve as a critical technical and customer-facing leader, crafting innovative, executable solutions for our customers’ most complex challenges while actively contributing to the growth and success of Amentum’s capture portfolio and technical capabilities.

This role sits at the intersection of business development, technical solutioning, sales engineering, capture, and capability development. You will work closely with Capture, Business Development, Proposal, Pricing, and Program teams to understand customer mission needs, shape opportunities, develop differentiated technical solutions, and translate those solutions into compelling customer value propositions.

You will architect impactful technical, management, and transition solutions that address customer pain points, align with mission objectives, and differentiate Amentum in the competitive federal and Intelligence Community (IC) markets. You will also help build and mature Amentum’s capabilities by identifying technology and capability gaps, supporting the development of prototypes and laboratory demonstrations, and helping transform emerging technologies into repeatable offerings.

First and foremost, our team develops comprehensive and differentiated solutions for winning proposals. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable whiteboarding an architecture with an engineer, presenting a solution to a customer, developing a technical ROM/BOM, supporting a proposal, and helping build a lab demonstration that brings the solution to life.

Your expertise will drive early opportunity shaping, customer engagement, technical sales, proposal development, capability development, and solution delivery strategies that underpin key wins and long-term program success.

Work Schedule:

  • Shift Hours: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Occasional after-hours or weekend work may be required to support high-priority initiatives or deadlines. Some flexibility may be needed for on-call responsibilities.
  • Workdays: Standard business week (Monday–Friday).

Essential Responsibilities:

Solution Development & Architecture

  • Architect end-to-end solutions that integrate innovation, customer requirements, technical feasibility, operational considerations, and cost with a balanced approach to risk and delivery.
  • Translate complex customer mission requirements into clear, executable technical solutions and architectures.
  • Develop proposal-ready technical artifacts, including technical volumes, solution strategies, architecture diagrams, graphics, technical presentations, and oral presentation materials.
  • Conduct early shaping activities such as solution workshops, capability gap analysis, technical exchanges, demonstrations, prototypes, and proof-of-concepts to position Amentum ahead of formal RFP releases.
  • Research and integrate emerging technologies (e.g., AI/ML, Zero Trust architectures, cross-domain solutions, digital modernization, DevSecOps, enterprise IT, cloud, automation, and data integration) that enhance alignment with customer needs and provide clear competitive advantages.
  • Partner with Pricing and Program Managers to develop resource-loaded solutions, staffing models, labor estimates, and other solution inputs that are responsive, efficient, technically defensible, and executable.
  • Develop and/or support technical Rough Order of Magnitude (ROM), Basis of Estimate (BOE), Bill of Materials (BOM), labor, and other cost inputs necessary to support solution development and business development activities.

Technical Sales & Customer Engagement

  • Serve as a technical sales and solutions engineering resource, partnering with Business Development and Capture to translate customer challenges into compelling technical solutions and value propositions.
  • Participate in customer meetings, technical exchanges, demonstrations, whiteboarding sessions, industry engagements, and other customer-facing activities.
  • Present and defend technical solutions to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders and use customer insights to refine solution approaches and identify new opportunities.
  • Engage customers early to validate solution concepts, understand mission priorities, influence acquisition strategies, and position Amentum capabilities.
  • Clearly communicate the business and mission value of technical solutions rather than simply describing technical features or capabilities.
  • Support the development of customer-specific demonstrations, prototypes, and technical showcases that bring proposed solutions to life.

Capture & Proposal Leadership

  • Collaborate with Capture Managers and Business Development to define win themes, articulate value propositions, and integrate technical discriminators across proposal volumes.
  • Lead solution development across the opportunity lifecycle—from early capture and customer shaping through proposal submission and transition to delivery.
  • Drive the iterative development and refinement of technical solutions through internal reviews (Blue Teams, Pink Teams, Red Teams, etc.) to develop compelling, customer-specific solutions.
  • Lead and facilitate internal and external solutioning sessions with SMEs, teammates, partners, and customers.
  • Ensure proposed solutions are compliant with solicitation requirements, aligned to Section M evaluation criteria, responsive to customer hot buttons, and technically executable.
  • Support technical proposal pricing and solution reviews by validating staffing, labor categories, technical assumptions, ROMs, BOMs, and other cost-related inputs.

Capability Development & Technical Innovation

  • Help build, mature, and operationalize Amentum technical capabilities and offerings in alignment with customer demand and market opportunities.
  • Identify gaps in Amentum’s current capabilities, technologies, talent, tools, and partnerships and recommend strategies to address those gaps.
  • Support build/buy/partner decisions and the development of new technical offerings and reusable solution components.
  • Develop and support laboratory demonstrations, prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and technical demonstrations that showcase emerging capabilities and can be leveraged for customer engagement, capture, and proposals.
  • Collaborate with technical SMEs, engineers, developers, and delivery organizations to turn concepts into demonstrable, repeatable capabilities.
  • Identify opportunities to create reusable architectures, demonstrations, technical collateral, accelerators, and solution frameworks that can be leveraged across multiple opportunities.
  • Help connect emerging technologies and internal technical investments to real customer mission requirements and business opportunities.

Customer & Market Differentiation

  • Maintain awareness of customer missions, technology priorities, acquisition strategies, and competitive landscapes.
  • Develop technical discriminators, ghosting strategies, and differentiated solution approaches that position Amentum ahead of competitors.
  • Leverage customer and market intelligence to identify emerging requirements and opportunities for capability investment.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships within the federal and Intelligence Community customer environment.
  • Apply knowledge of IC customer missions and acquisition environments to develop solutions that are relevant, realistic, and executable.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead technical SMEs, developers, engineers, and operational experts in producing integrated, winning solution approaches.
  • Facilitate collaboration across technical disciplines and business functions to ensure solutions are cohesive and executable.
  • Mentor and support junior architects and capture team resources to build internal technical solutioning capacity.
  • Develop and maintain repeatable solution frameworks, reference architectures, templates, technical collateral, and reusable assets.

Strategic Contributions

  • Shape win strategies and integrated solution plans, ensuring alignment between technical strategies, capture objectives, and Amentum’s broader business growth goals.
  • Participate in and lead discussions during capture and proposal gate reviews, ensuring technical compliance, solution quality, and alignment with business priorities.
  • Identify emerging customer requirements and market opportunities that should influence Amentum’s technical investment strategy.
  • Recommend new capabilities, technologies, partnerships, and investments needed to maintain competitiveness and mission readiness.

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

  • Experience supporting Intelligence Community (IC) customers
  • Knowledge of solution architecture and technical solution development for federal government and/or Intelligence Community customers.
  • Experience participating in the technical components of proposal development, including designing innovative, compliant, and executable solutions.
  • Experience in technical pre-sales, sales engineering, solutions engineering, solution architecture, systems engineering, or a comparable customer-facing technical role.
  • Ability to translate customer mission requirements and technical challenges into actionable, high-level architectures and solution designs.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate and present complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong technical writing skills, including the ability to develop clear and compelling proposal narratives detailing solution approaches and capabilities.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Business Development, Capture, Proposal, Pricing, Program, engineering, and technical teams.
  • Experience developing or contributing to technical estimates, staffing models, ROMs, BOEs, BOMs, or other solution cost inputs.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent opportunities, technical initiatives, and aggressive deadlines.
  • Familiarity with current and emerging technologies relevant to federal and IC missions.
  • Ability to support customer-facing technical engagements, demonstrations, whiteboarding sessions, and solution workshops.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify technical capability gaps and translate those gaps into actionable capability development initiatives.

Security Clearance Required:

  • Active Top Secret with Polygraph

Minimum Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, or another STEM-related discipline.
  • Equivalent, directly related work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

Minimum Years of Experience:

  • 5+ years in solution architecture, technical pre-sales, systems engineering, or delivery with a focus on federal/IC missions.

Required Certifications:

  • PMP, ITIL, CISSP, advanced cloud certifications, or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven ability to craft differentiated technical solutions for high-value capture efforts, including contracts valued at $100M+.
  • Demonstrated success in a Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Architect, Technical Capture, or similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Experience selling, shaping, or positioning complex technical solutions in the federal government or Intelligence Community market.
  • Demonstrated understanding of IC mission environments, customer priorities, acquisition processes, and technology requirements.
  • Established experience engaging directly with IC customer stakeholders and mission partners.
  • Experience developing technical ROMs, BOEs, BOMs, labor estimates, staffing models, or other technical pricing inputs.
  • Experience developing or supporting laboratory demonstrations, prototypes, proof-of-concepts, technical demonstrations, or technology showcases.
  • Experience helping an organization build, mature, or productize technical capabilities and offerings.
  • Experience identifying capability gaps and developing build/buy/partner strategies to address them.
  • Experience integrating emerging technologies such as AI/ML, Zero Trust, cloud, DevSecOps, automation, data integration, cross-domain solutions, digital modernization, or enterprise IT.
  • Track record of producing proposal-ready technical artifacts, including solution strategies, technical volumes, architecture diagrams, security/integration plans, demonstrations, and oral presentation materials.
  • Demonstrated success leading iterative proposal efforts in collaboration with Capture and Proposal teams.
  • Experience developing reusable technical assets, reference architectures, demonstrations, accelerators, or solution frameworks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting and defending solutions to executive, technical, and customer audiences.
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and balance multiple competing priorities.
