title: Guest Experience Agent
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

When you think about Four Seasons, we hope unparalleled luxury comes to mind. But what is luxury, really? Our answer may surprise you. To us, true luxury is a meaningful sense of belonging. It is a dedicated focus on how people want to be treated, grounded in the genuine care you experience during your stay and defined by an abundance of humanity and generosity. This starts with our passionate team, welcoming you to be the centre of our world, anywhere in the world – and always with a distinctly human touch. The views are just the beginning at Four Seasons Hotel Sydney, located at the epicentre of the historic Rocks district, sparkling Harbour and buzzing CBD. Chic rooms and suites embrace the iconic attractions just steps away, while the award-winning restaurant and street front bar are destinations unto themselves.

About the role:

The Guest Experience Agent is responsible for creating exceptional and memorable experiences for guests throughout their stay. Working closely with the Guest Experience Manager and operational teams, this role serves as a key ambassador of the hotel, ensuring every guest receives personalised service from arrival to departure. The Guest Experience Agent proactively engages with guests, anticipates their needs, and collaborates with departments across the hotel to deliver seamless and unforgettable experiences that align with Four Seasons service standards. This role is part of the Rooms Division Department, reporting to the Guest Experience Manager.

What you will do:

  • Welcome and engage with guests throughout the hotel, ensuring a warm, personalised, and memorable experience from arrival through departure.
  • Act as a Lobby Ambassador, proactively assisting guests with requests, recommendations, and enquiries to maximise guest satisfaction.
  • Collaborate with Front Desk, Concierge, Guest Services, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, and other departments to ensure a seamless guest journey.
  • Identify opportunities to personalise guest interactions and create unique experiences that exceed guest expectations.
  • Resolve guest concerns and service challenges efficiently, ensuring positive outcomes and lasting impressions.
  • Build meaningful relationships with guests and recognise special occasions, preferences, and opportunities to enhance their stay.
  • Support the planning and execution of guest engagement initiatives, experiences, and special requests.

What you will bring:

  • A genuine passion for hospitality and creating exceptional guest experiences.
  • The ability to think creatively and proactively to enhance guest satisfaction and resolve challenges.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain calm and professional under pressure while managing multiple priorities.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with strong knowledge of local attractions, dining venues, and events.
  • A warm, engaging, and guest-focused personality with a natural ability to build rapport.
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills.
  • Previous experience in guest services, hospitality, luxury hotels, customer service, or a similar guest-facing role is highly regarded.
  • Professional presentation and attention to detail at all times.
  • Flexibility to work a rotating roster including weekends, evenings, and public holidays.

What we offer:

  • Competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package.
  • Excellent Training and Development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Accommodation at other Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts.
  • Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniform.
  • Complimentary Employee Meals.

title: Serviceadviseur
description:
Weet jij als geen ander wat klantvriendelijkheid is? Weet jij overzicht te behouden en kan je snel schakelen? Heb jij al enige ervaring als serviceadviseur en toe aan de volgende stap? Bij onze Peugeot vestiging in Zaandam zijn wij op zoek naar een serviceadviseur!

Wat ga je doen?

Voor onze Van Mossel Peugeot vestiging in Zaandam zijn wij op zoek naar een klantvriendelijke collega die ons team komt versterken als serviceadviseur. In deze rol ben jij het gezicht en visitekaartje van de vestiging. Jij ontvangt klanten met een grote glimlach en helpt hen met uiteenlopende vragen, voornamelijk gericht op service. Dankzij jouw technische automotive kennis weet jij de vertaalslag te maken tussen klant en werkplaats. Van werkorders aanmaken tot het beantwoorden van vragen over facturen, schade of garantieclaims – jij zorgt dat alles soepel verloopt! Je houdt de planning bij en communiceert met je collega’s in de werkplaats. En bovenal: je zorgt ervoor dat de klanten tevreden en met een glimlach weggaan. Jouw taken:

  • Het aanmaken van werkorders;

  • Administratief verwerken van de werkzaamheden aan de auto;

  • Inplannen van werkzaamheden bij je collega’s in de werkplaats;

  • Het bewaken van de voortgang van de planning;

  • Het bespreken van de factuur en uitleggen wat er precies aan de auto is gedaan.

Wie ben jij?

Laten we eerlijk zijn, deze afwisselende en dynamische baan is niet voor iedereen weggelegd. Het is in deze functie mooi meegenomen als je al ervaring hebt als serviceadviseur. Jij weet als geen ander wat klantvriendelijkheid is, bent communicatief vaardig en organisatorisch sterk. Hierdoor weet jij overzicht te behouden, ook als het plotseling erg druk is aan de balie. Verder beschik jij over onder andere:

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in een klantgerichte functie;

  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift;

  • Een fulltime beschikbaarheid.

Wat bieden wij jou?
In ruim 5 jaar tijd is de Van Mossel Automotive Group uitgegroeid tot het grootste en leukste autobedrijf van de Benelux. Wij zijn ambitieus, groeien hard en willen blijven groeien. Ondanks dat wij een groot bedrijf zijn, blijven wij een familiebedrijf. Verder kun je rekenen op

  • Een goed salaris passend bij jouw ervaring

  • De mogelijkheid om je eigen carrière pad te bepalen;

  • Het volgen van trainingen en workshops naar keuze;

  • De mogelijkheid tot het onbeperkt gebruik maken van de Van Mossel Academy;

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • Personeelskorting op een auto, onderhoudsbeurten en verzekeringen voor het hele gezin;

  • En natuurlijk een leuke baan binnen een snel groeiende organisatie!

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer

Team: IT

Location: Sweden

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Sweden.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you’ll champion a quality-first mindset across an agile software development environment. You’ll contribute throughout the full software development lifecycle, from requirements refinement and test strategy through release validation. The role combines hands-on testing, automation, backend validation, API testing, database testing, and exploratory testing. You’ll work closely with product, architecture, engineering, and quality teams to identify risks early and improve testability. As the automation expert within the team, you’ll help build and maintain robust automated test suites for new and existing functionality. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence engineering practices and raise software quality beyond your immediate team. This is a collaborative, remote role in a fast-moving environment where ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

Accountabilities

    • Contribute to feature refinement by challenging assumptions, clarifying requirements, identifying edge cases, and assessing system architecture and testability.
    • Develop and formalize comprehensive test strategies covering test scenarios, integration points, test data, APIs, applications, queues, databases, and result verification.
    • Deploy and configure software updates in QA environments and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end tests.
    • Investigate defects, identify root causes where possible, and document bugs with clear, accurate reproduction steps and supporting information.
    • Validate completed functionality and provide production sign-off when quality and acceptance criteria have been met.
    • Drive test automation for both new and existing features, working closely with quality engineering leadership to maintain reliable and effective automated test suites.
    • Act as the team’s automation specialist and promote quality engineering practices across the wider development organization.
    • Perform backend testing through multiple interaction methods, including REST APIs, message queues, databases, and front-end interfaces.
    • Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, technical leads, developers, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
    • Advocate for quality, usability, testability, and continuous improvement while managing and reprioritizing multiple workstreams in a dynamic environment.
    • During the first 90 days, build a strong understanding of the products, customers, teams, tools, and processes, while establishing relationships and contributing to the team’s quality goals.
    • Participate actively in feedback, professional development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

      • Requirements

      • 5–8+ years of proven experience working as a QA tester or QA engineer within an Agile software development environment.
      • Strong experience developing test strategies, defining test scenarios, and writing detailed test cases.
      • Extensive experience testing backend systems using multiple approaches, including REST APIs, message queues, databases, and front-end interfaces.
      • Strong SQL skills and practical experience with relational database tools such as DBeaver, SQL Server, or MySQL Workbench.
      • Experience creating or seeding databases with test data is an advantage.
      • Solid understanding and hands-on experience with Git and version control workflows.
      • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP; familiarity with AWS services including EKS, RDS, SQS, and API Gateway is a plus.
      • Hands-on experience with API testing and documentation tools such as Swagger, Bruno, and Postman.
      • Experience writing and maintaining test scripts using JavaScript.
      • Knowledge of configuring mocks for isolated service testing is highly desirable.
      • Strong exploratory testing skills, with a sharp eye for functional defects, edge cases, usability concerns, and unexpected behavior.
      • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate issues and communicate findings clearly and efficiently.
      • Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the flexibility to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
      • A proactive, collaborative mindset with the confidence to challenge assumptions and advocate for quality.
      • At senior level, the ability to influence software quality beyond your immediate team and contribute to broader engineering improvements.
      • Strong ownership, curiosity, communication, and continuous-learning skills.

        • Benefits

        • Fully remote working environment.
        • Opportunity to work within a diverse, international team spanning multiple countries and cultures.
        • Meaningful opportunity to contribute to technology that improves financial access and supports communities.
        • High level of trust, autonomy, and ownership without unnecessary bureaucracy.
        • Collaborative culture focused on customer impact, experimentation, learning, and continuous improvement.
        • Opportunities to influence quality engineering practices beyond your immediate team.
        • Structured career and development conversations, including the opportunity to create a training and career growth plan aligned with your goals.
        • Regular feedback and opportunities to learn from experienced colleagues across product, engineering, and other functions.
        • A supportive environment that values well-being, collaboration, accountability, and having fun while doing meaningful work.
        • Competitive compensation and benefits package, subject to the applicable employment location and hiring arrangement.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
Amentum is seeking a full-time Senior Database Administrator to support a Department of War (DoW) customer in Spokane, Washington. The successful candidate will provide enterprise database administration and SharePoint infrastructure support in a secure DoW environment. This position requires extensive experience administering Microsoft SQL Server, SharePoint 2019 on-premises, Windows Server technologies, cybersecurity compliance, and enterprise infrastructure. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical expertise, excellent troubleshooting skills, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a highly structured mission-focused environment.


Main Responsibilities:

Database Administration
• Install, configure, administer, and maintain Microsoft SQL Server 2019 – 2025 environments across development, test, and production systems.
• Design, implement, and support secure, highly available database solutions.
• Monitor database health, performance, and capacity; perform query tuning, index optimization, and routine maintenance.
• Manage database backup, recovery, disaster recovery, patching, upgrades, and lifecycle activities.
• Configure and maintain high availability technologies including Always On Availability Groups and failover clustering.
• Implement database security through access controls, encryption, auditing, and STIG compliance.
• Troubleshoot database performance, connectivity, replication, and integrity issues.
• Develop automation scripts using PowerShell and T-SQL to improve operational efficiency.
• Collaborate with developers on database design, schema changes, stored procedures, and application performance optimization.
• Create custom reports based on customer requirements.


SharePoint Administration
• Administer and support SharePoint Server 2019 on-premises environments, including installation, configuration, patching, troubleshooting, and upgrades.
• Manage SharePoint farms, site collections, service applications, content databases, permissions, and Active Directory integration.
• Support SharePoint customizations using ASP.NET Web Forms, ASP.NET MVC, C#, CSOM, and SharePoint Server APIs.
• Configure and maintain document libraries, lists, workflows, and enterprise collaboration features.
• Perform SharePoint backup, restoration, disaster recovery testing, and system maintenance.
• Provide technical support to site owners and end users while resolving SharePoint-related issues.


Security, Operations & Collaboration
• Apply DoD STIGs, RMF security controls, vulnerability remediation, and cybersecurity best practices.
• Monitor system availability and participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and change management activities.
• Gather business requirements and translate them into technical solutions and implementation plans.
• Maintain technical documentation, system configurations, standard operating procedures, and architecture diagrams.
• Collaborate with system administrators, network engineers, developers, cybersecurity personnel, and government stakeholders to support mission objectives.
• Provide technical mentoring, knowledge transfer, and occasional after-hours support during maintenance windows or operational requirements.


Minimum Requirements:
• Must be able to obtain and maintain an active Top Secret US Government Clearance with SCI eligibility. Note: US Citizenship is required to maintain a Top Secret Clearance.
• 7 or more years of experience administering Microsoft SQL Server and SharePoint 2016/2019 in an enterprise on-premises environment; or a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field with 4 years of relevant experience.
• Meet DoD 8140 advanced level workforce qualification requirements.
• Strong experience administering Microsoft SQL Server, including performance tuning, backup and recovery, high availability, and security.
• Strong experience with SharePoint Server 2016/2019 administration and enterprise farm management.
• Experience with SharePoint Designer, InfoPath, and third-party utilities such as Quest and Bamboo.
• Experience implementing STIGs, RMF security controls, vulnerability remediation, and DoD cybersecurity compliance.
• Strong understanding of relational database design, normalization, indexing, query optimization, and data modeling.
• Experience with PowerShell, T-SQL, and automation scripting.
• Experience performing database migrations, upgrades, disaster recovery planning, and business continuity operations.
• Experience developing database design documentation including Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERDs), functional specifications, and technical documentation.
• Experience supporting structured testing, validation, configuration management, and change management processes.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve complex database and infrastructure issues.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and technical documentation, especially related to their integration with SharePoint and use of macros.
• Ability to work independently or within a multidisciplinary technical team under demanding operational schedules.
• Strong customer service and interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively communicate with technical teams and government stakeholders.


Other requirements:
• This is a non-remote, full-time on-site position located in Spokane, Washington.
• Standard work schedule is 40 hours per week/8 hours per day with the occasional need to flex hours based on customer support needs.
• Some after-hours or short-term shift work may be required to support urgent customer requirements, including weekends and holidays.
• Occasional travel may be required (0-10%).
• Must be able to sit and stand for extended periods of time working in an office environment.
• Must be able to lift various sizes of materials and equipment (up to 50lbs).

Compensation Details:

$120,000.00 - $150,000.00

Original Posting:

08/12/2026 - Until Filled

title: Senior Software Engineer, AI
description:
Sr Software Engineer (AI Team Lead)

Location: CT - Hartford, MN - St. Paul

Remote Type: Hybrid

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

Who Are We?

Taking care of our customers, our communities and each other. That’s the Travelers Promise. By honoring this commitment, we have maintained our reputation as one of the best property casualty insurers in the industry for over 170 years. Join us to discover a culture that is rooted in innovation and thrives on collaboration. Imagine loving what you do and where you do it.

Job Category

Technology

Compensation Overview

The annual base salary range provided for this position is a nationwide market range and represents a broad range of salaries for this role across the country. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. As part of our comprehensive compensation and benefits program, employees are also eligible for performance-based cash incentive awards.

Salary Range

$139,400.00 - $230,000.00

Target Openings

1

What Is the Opportunity?

Travelers is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our organization as we grow and transform our Technology landscape. Individual will complete advanced software end to end engineering tasks that span many parts of a system including designing, developing, analyzing, configuring, testing, debugging, troubleshooting, documenting, health monitoring/alerting, and implementing based on user or system specifications. Individual will also consult with users to determine hardware, software or system functional specifications, manage the effective use of resources, act as subject matter expert across multiple applications, systems and technologies, leverage technical and business knowledge to drive the planning and execution of complex initiatives, participate in the design/ development process, and provide technical leadership.

What Will You Do?

  • Perform complex analysis, advanced level design, configuration and develop functions for impactful and high-visibility tasks.
  • Take the lead on directing and implementing solutions to moderately complex, loosely scoped problems that are aligned with team goals.
  • Deliver efforts both independently and by leading other team members.
  • Lead investigation and resolution efforts for critical, high impact problems, defects, and incidents.
  • Act as a technology advocate, independently seeking opportunities where technology can be utilized to improve the business.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship while fostering a team environment.
  • Apply knowledge of current industry trends and techniques to formulate solutions within the context of assigned efforts.
  • Seek opportunities to expand technical knowledge and capabilities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Five years of programming/development experience.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building or integrating solutions using large language model APIs or agentic frameworks in a professional software engineering context.
  • Experience contributing to or leading development of plugins, extensions, or integrations within a shared developer tooling platform.
  • Agentic Frameworks & LLM Tooling – Hands-on experience designing and engineering solutions leveraging large language models and agentic frameworks; familiarity with enterprise AI platforms such as Claude, SAGE, or AIDLC and the ability to apply them to real-world software delivery challenges.
  • Plugin & Marketplace Development – Demonstrated experience building and publishing plugins, extensions, or integrations within a developer tool ecosystem; ability to define contribution standards and drive adoption across engineering teams.
  • Cross-Team AI Enablement & Advocacy – Proven ability to champion AI adoption across multiple engineering teams, translating capability into practical workflows, identifying high-value use cases, and coaching engineers on effective AI-assisted development practices.
  • AWS & MCP Platform Expertise – Experience building and deploying agentic solutions on AWS Agent Core or equivalent cloud-native AI orchestration platforms; familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) server development, configuration, and integration within enterprise software ecosystems.
  • Enterprise AI Coordination – Demonstrated ability to coordinate AI initiatives across a large enterprise, including aligning stakeholders, navigating governance and compliance requirements, and driving consistent AI engineering standards across distributed teams.
  • Delivery - Advanced delivery skills including the ability to determine the software design strategy and methodology to be used for efforts, use automated tests, analysis, and informed feedback loops to ensure the quality and production readiness of work before release, monitor the health of work efforts and that of adjacent systems.
  • Domain Expertise - Demonstrated track record of domain expertise including the ability to develop business partnerships and influence priorities by identifying solutions that are aligned with current business objective and closely follow industry trends relevant to domain, understanding how to apply them, and sharing knowledge with coworkers.
  • Problem Solving - Strong problem solver who utilizes data and proofs of concepts to find creative solutions to difficult problems, reflects on solutions, measuring their impact, and uses that information to ideate and optimize.
  • Also adept at making decisions that involve a significant number of factors with broad implications.
  • Communication - Strong communicator who possesses the ability to describe technology concepts in ways the business can understand, document initiatives in a concise and clear manner, collaborate effectively with teammates and others regardless of role, quickly extract core issues from discussions and meetings, give and receive constructive feedback, offer help when asked, and ensure everyone has a chance to share their thoughts and are heard; an attentive and empathetic listener.
  • Leadership - Advanced leadership skills with the ability to take action even when there is no clear owner, inspire and motivate others, and be effective at influencing team members.

What is a Must Have?

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, related STEM field, or its equivalent in education and/or work experience.
  • 6 additional years of software engineering experience.

What Is in It for You?

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members – including spouses, domestic partners, and children – are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
  • Retirement: Travelers matches your 401(k) contributions dollar-for-dollar up to your first 5% of eligible pay, subject to an annual maximum. If you have student loan debt, you can enroll in the Paying it Forward Savings Program. When you make a payment toward your student loan, Travelers will make an annual contribution into your 401(k) account. You are also eligible for a Pension Plan that is 100% funded by Travelers.
  • Paid Time Off: Start your career at Travelers with a minimum of 20 days Paid Time Off annually, plus nine paid company Holidays.
  • Wellness Program: The Travelers wellness program is comprised of tools, discounts and resources that empower you to achieve your wellness goals and caregiving needs. In addition, our mental health program provides access to free professional counseling services, health coaching and other resources to support your daily life needs.
  • Volunteer Encouragement: We have a deep commitment to the communities we serve and encourage our employees to get involved. Travelers has a Matching Gift and Volunteer Rewards program that enables you to give back to the charity of your choice.

Employment Practices

Travelers is an equal opportunity employer. We value the unique abilities and talents each individual brings to our organization and recognize that we benefit in numerous ways from our differences.

In accordance with local law, candidates seeking employment in Colorado are not required to disclose dates of attendance at or graduation from educational institutions.

If you are a candidate and have specific questions regarding the physical requirements of this role, please send us an email so we may assist you.

Travelers reserves the right to fill this position at a level above or below the level included in this posting.

To learn more about our comprehensive benefit programs please visit http://careers.travelers.com/life-at-travelers/benefits/.

Travelers is seeking a Software Engineer II to join our organization as we grow and transform our Technology landscape. Individual will complete advanced end to end engineering tasks for specific system assignments including designing, developing, analyzing, configuring, testing, debugging, troubleshooting, documenting, health monitoring/alerting, and implementing based on user or system specifications, consulting with users to determine hardware, software or system functional specifications, managing interaction between the systems and other technical support areas and defining technical requirements and coordinating team resources to solve problems.

Engineers in this value stream work across the full arc of AI product delivery — from long-horizon strategic initiatives tackling complex, ambiguous problems where the path to production has yet to be defined, to hands-on field engagements that embed directly with Lines of Business to rapidly integrate enterprise AI platforms and prototype solutions at speed. You will partner with LOB stakeholders, product owners, architects, and platform teams to translate business problems into AI-powered capabilities that deliver measurable outcomes across the enterprise. This role is hands-on and delivery-oriented — ideal for an engineer who thrives on variety, moves fast, and finds energy in solving different hard problems every few months.

Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. The company does not sponsor/support H-1B petitions, TN, or Forms I-983/STEM OPT, for this role.

What Will You Do?

  • Design, build, and deliver AI-powered solutions across a range of engagement types — from sustained strategic initiatives requiring deep discovery and architecture work, to rapid field engagements focused on integrating LOB workflows with enterprise AI platforms and validating feasibility through working prototypes.

  • Perform analysis, assessment and resolution for defects and incidents of advanced complexity and escalate appropriately.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What Will Our Ideal Candidate Have?

  • Proficiency in Python, with experience in additional languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, or Java welcomed — particularly in candidates with backgrounds in enterprise AI integration.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud services.

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools, including Kubernetes.

  • Proficiency with RESTful APIs and microservices architecture.

  • Experience with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.

  • Experience designing and delivering agentic workflows, LLM integrations, or AI-powered automations.

  • Demonstrated ability to work in agile, collaborative development environments.

  • Strong communication skills — able to engage directly with non-technical business stakeholders and translate operational problems into technical solutions.

  • Ability to present technical concepts, solution designs, and project outcomes to both technical and non-technical audiences — including executive stakeholders, LOB partners, and cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with prompt engineering, RAG architecture, or LLM evaluation methods.

  • Exposure to MCP server configurations or multi-agent frameworks.

  • Experience with Terraform for infrastructure as code.

  • Experience with prompt engineering, RAG architecture, or LLM evaluation methods.

  • Exposure to MCP server configurations or multi-agent frameworks.

  • Delivery - Intermediate delivery skills including the ability to estimate accurate timelines for tasks and deliver work at a steady, predictable pace to achieve commitments, contribute to the software design strategy and methodologies used to best meet the system requirements, consider and build for many different use cases, avoid over engineering, and ensure automation, deliver complete solutions but release them in small batches, and identify important tradeoffs and negotiate them.
  • Domain Expertise - Demonstrated track record of domain expertise including understanding technical concepts necessary to do the job effectively and aware of industry trends, demonstrate willingness, cooperation, and concern for business issues and priorities, and possess in depth knowledge of immediate systems worked on and some knowledge of adjacent systems.
  • Problem Solving - Strong problem solver who ensures solutions are built for the long term, is able to resolve new issues, recognizes mistakes using them as learning and teaching opportunities and consistently breaks down large problems into smaller, more manageable ones.
  • Communication - Strong communicator who possesses the ability to articulate information clearly and concisely with the business, document work in a clear, easy to follow manner, collaborate well with team members as both a mentor and mentee, take in vague requirements and ask the right questions to ensure clarification, offer feedback appropriately and effectively, seek out and receives constructive criticism well, listen when others are speaking and make space for colleagues to share their thoughts.

This hybrid role offers a dynamic environment with a mix of in-office and remote work, based in Canberra, and is ideal for a seasoned professional passionate about delivering impactful AI solutions within a regulated setting. As The Selected Candidate, You Will

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Site Reliability Engineer

Team: IT

Location: Netherlands

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer based in Netherlands.

This is a senior reliability engineering role focused on defining and advancing the infrastructure standards behind a globally scaled, AI-native platform.
You will take ownership of reliability strategy across production infrastructure, with a particular focus on AWS, Kubernetes, event-driven systems, and AI agent workloads.
The role combines deep hands-on engineering with architectural leadership, incident management, observability, and technical mentorship.
You will design systems that remain resilient under increasing transaction volumes while establishing measurable standards for reliability across engineering teams.
A key part of the role will be evolving synchronous architectures toward durable asynchronous communication and strengthening the platform through resilience testing and chaos engineering.
You will also help shape how AI-assisted tools are used for automation, incident analysis, runbooks, and root-cause investigations.
Success means becoming the trusted technical authority for complex reliability decisions while creating practices that make reliability scalable across the organization.

Accountabilities

    • Define and implement the reliability strategy across the platform, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, incident practices, and reliability standards adopted by engineering teams.
    • Drive major architectural decisions as infrastructure evolves, evaluating technologies and designing systems that remain scalable, resilient, observable, and maintainable.
    • Design and own event-driven communication and messaging infrastructure, including the transition from synchronous patterns to durable asynchronous architectures.
    • Manage and evolve cloud infrastructure on AWS, using Infrastructure as Code to automate provisioning, configuration, deployment, and operational processes.
    • Ensure Kubernetes and containerized workloads scale reliably as transaction volumes and AI workloads increase.
    • Build and maintain comprehensive observability through monitoring, dashboards, alerting, application performance monitoring, and distributed tracing.
    • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex production incidents, leading incident response, root-cause investigations, and blameless postmortems.
    • Turn incident findings into permanent improvements through architectural changes, automation, operational controls, and resilience patterns.
    • Establish a continuous chaos engineering and resilience testing practice through fault injection, game days, and controlled failure experiments.
    • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers while raising the technical bar for reliability engineering and influencing engineering practices across teams.
    • Use AI-assisted tooling for automation, runbooks, incident analysis, and root-cause investigations, while helping establish effective AI-enabled engineering practices.
    • Within the first 6–12 months, establish the platform reliability strategy, lead at least one major architectural evolution, and drive adoption of the SLO and error-budget framework across engineering teams.

      • Requirements

      • Extensive experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or a closely related discipline, with demonstrated ownership of production-scale systems.
      • Deep expertise in event-driven architecture and messaging systems such as Kafka, NATS, or RabbitMQ, including at-least-once delivery, consumer groups, dead-letter queues, backpressure, and migrations from synchronous to asynchronous architectures.
      • Strong AWS expertise across services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, and RDS, combined with solid networking fundamentals.
      • Hands-on Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tools, with infrastructure managed through version-controlled workflows and code reviews.
      • Strong production experience with Kubernetes and Docker, including container lifecycle management, resource limits, health checks, and orchestration at scale.
      • Proven observability expertise using Datadog or equivalent platforms, including dashboards, monitoring, APM, distributed tracing, and alerting.
      • Demonstrated experience defining and operating SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets across multiple services.
      • Hands-on experience with chaos engineering, fault injection, game days, or resilience experiments using tools such as Gremlin, Chaos Mesh, AWS FIS, or similar technologies.
      • Strong distributed systems debugging skills, with experience diagnosing asynchronous workflows, cascading failures, and complex production incidents.
      • Ability to code for automation and engineering tooling using Go, Python, or a similar programming language.
      • Solid database knowledge across SQL and NoSQL technologies, particularly PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis, including indexing, replication, and performance optimization.
      • Proven technical leadership experience, including setting reliability standards, influencing architecture across teams, and mentoring engineers.
      • Advanced written and spoken English communication skills.
      • Experience with AI or MLOps infrastructure, including model serving, LLM inference, GPU/resource management, or AI agent observability, is highly advantageous.
      • Familiarity with multi-tenant container platforms and customer workload infrastructure is a plus.
      • Experience with data pipelines and orchestration tools such as Airflow or Prefect, and data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery, is beneficial.
      • Familiarity with incident management platforms such as PagerDuty, Opsgenie, or incident.io is an advantage.
      • Experience in the payments industry is preferred.
      • Additional experience with ECS, s6-overlay, AI agent frameworks, or Spanish proficiency is a plus.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Agentic Science/Generative Models
description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Agentic Science/Generative Models, AI for Biology & Translation (AIBT)

Location: South San Francisco

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

Advances in AI, data, and computational sciences are transforming drug discovery and development. Roche’s Research and Early Development organisations at Genentech (gRED) and Pharma (pRED) have demonstrated how these technologies accelerate R&D, leveraging data and novel computational models to drive impact. Seamless data sharing and access to models across gRED and pRED are essential to maximising these opportunities. The new Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic, unified group whose goal is to harness the transformative power of data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to assist our scientists in both pRED and gRED to deliver more innovative and transformative medicines for patients worldwide. ​

The Opportunity

The AI Biology & Translation (AIBT) department within Genentech's Computational Sciences Center of Excellence (CS-CoE) is building the next generation of AI systems for biology. Our mission is to develop AI models that learn from biological data at unprecedented scale, generating new insights into disease mechanisms, therapeutic opportunities, and human biology. We seek a highly motivated and passionate Senior ML Engineer to join our Generative Modeling team and help build and scale foundation models and agentic systems for therapeutic discovery. The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, and scaling of large-scale foundation models and AI agents, with the ultimate aim of accelerating target and drug discovery. This role spans the full stack: the agent design and orchestration logic that makes these systems scientifically useful, and the infrastructure, AgentOps, and MLOps that make them robust, reproducible, and efficient at scale. Depending on team coverage at a given time, you may own infrastructure end-to-end or partner with platform engineering on it, this role needs someone comfortable doing either. You'll join a multidisciplinary environment alongside ML scientists, ML engineers, and computational biologists. The ideal candidate combines strong software and ML engineering skills, a systems mindset, fluency in how agentic systems are actually built and evaluated, and a "get-it-done" attitude.

In this role, you will:

Agentic systems

  • Build agents that use tools, retrieve evidence, and reason across multi-step scientific workflows

  • Build reliable interfaces between agents and biological, genomic, and clinical data sources

  • Design evaluation harnesses that check agent output against scientific ground truth

  • Design and implement self-improving and autonomous loops for autoML and lab in the loop

  • Implement agent memory and context management for long-horizon workflows

Models and production systems

  • Build, finetune, deploy, and scale foundation models and LLMs in production

  • Own production Python/PyTorch (or JAX) codebases that turn fast-moving research ideas into reliable, reusable software

  • Own the MLOps/AgentOps lifecycle: experiment tracking, evaluation, monitoring, reproducibility, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes)

Collaboration

  • Work with research scientists to turn open-ended scientific problems into scoped, shippable systems

  • Raise the engineering bar across gRED and Roche

Who you are

  • BS/MS in CS, ML, engineering, or a related quantitative field

  • 5+ years building and shipping ML systems in industry

  • Excellent Python; strong software and data engineering fundamentals (Git, automated testing, CI/CD, documentation)

  • Track record leading technical projects end to end

  • Comfort with ambiguity and close collaboration with scientists

  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills

  • Interest or experience in applying ML to scientific discovery (AI for science), such as biology, chemistry, or drug discovery, including working with domain-specific data and models.

Preferred

  • Inference-time scaling and optimization: test-time compute, sampling and search strategies, model routing, batching, caching, latency/cost/quality tradeoffs

  • ML infrastructure on AWS (EC2, S3, EKS, SageMaker), including distributed training and inference on HPC

  • Evaluation systems for agentic applications where correctness is scientifically defined

  • Agent orchestration frameworks in production (LangGraph, MCP-based tool integration)

Relocation benefits are NOT available for this job posting

title: Agile Coach
description:
Agile Coach

Location: Remote – U.S.A.

Remote Type: Fully Remote

Time Type: Full time

Job Description

The Agile Coach is responsible for enabling and governing the Dynata Program Increment (PI) process and for managing Dynata’s Release Train Engineers (RTEs), who operate the Agile Release Trains. This role serves as a catalyst for organizational change, driving the adoption of SAFe principles and practices across Product, Engineering, and Operations. Rather than directing tasks, the Agile Coach acts as a servant leader and facilitator, guiding RTEs, Scrum Masters, teams, and leadership to improve flow, optimize delivery, and scale business value.

The Agile Coach ensures consistent adoption of the Dynata PI process across assigned programs and manages the RTEs who operate the Agile Release Trains. The role is accountable for quarterly synchronization between business and technology, successful execution of PI Planning events, and effective facilitation of cross‑team ceremonies throughout the increment. The Agile Coach ensures delivery predictability, continuous improvement, and alignment to business value.

The Agile Coach is directly involved in the following areas:

  • Agile coaching and SAFe framework adoption.

  • Facilitation and governance of PI Planning events.

  • Management and development of RTEs who run the ART operating rhythm.

  • Program‑level continuous improvement through Inspect & Adapt.

  • Compliance with health, safety, and work environment standards.

General Responsibilities

  • Govern and enable the Dynata PI process across assigned programs, ensuring consistent adoption of SAFe‑aligned practices and Dynata delivery standards.

  • Lead, coach, and develop Release Train Engineers responsible for operating Agile Release Trains.

  • Serve as a servant leader and transformation catalyst for Product, Engineering, and leadership teams.

  • Ensure quarterly alignment between business and technology through PI Planning readiness and execution.

  • Establish and monitor program‑level performance standards, including predictability, flow, dependency management, and delivery against PI objectives.

  • Provide advisory support to program and executive stakeholders, surfacing risks, trade‑offs, and improvement opportunities.

Process Responsibilities

PI Planning and Pre‑Planning

  • Define standards, templates, and governance for PI Planning and pre‑PI refinement.

  • Ensure RTEs prepare teams and stakeholders for PI Planning, including capacity planning, backlog readiness, and dependency identification.

  • Validate PI Planning outputs such as objectives, Program Boards, risks, and dependencies.

In‑PI Execution

  • Oversee ART execution through RTEs, ensuring cross‑team ceremonies are effective and outcome‑driven.

  • Monitor dependencies, risks, and impediments, ensuring clear escalation paths.

  • Track program‑level metrics and drive corrective actions through RTEs and leadership.

Inspect & Adapt

  • Ensure Inspect & Adapt events result in actionable improvements tied to measurable outcomes.

  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement and ensure root‑cause issues are addressed.

  • Synthesize insights across programs to identify systemic issues and recommend organizational improvements.

Cross‑Cutting Responsibilities

  • Coach leaders, Product Managers, Scrum Masters, and teams on agile principles and scaled delivery.

  • Ensure adherence to Dynata Product & Engineering processes and agile governance standards.

  • Maintain standards for program‑level artifacts such as Program Boards, PI Objectives, dashboards, and dependency tracking.

  • Support organizational change management and help teams mature in agile practices.

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and Architecture leadership to improve alignment between business priorities and execution capability.

  • Continuously refine Dynata’s agile operating model based on feedback, performance data, and evolving business needs.

  • As Dynata’s adoption of SAFe matures, the Agile Coach role will evolve from operational involvement toward systemic optimization, portfolio strategy, and business value alignment.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Backlog and Planning Tools Jira (including Jira Plans), Azure DevOps, Linear. Familiarity with Dynata’s two‑project Jira model.

  • Visualization and Program Board Tools Miro, Mural, Lucidchart, Aha! Roadmaps.

  • Documentation and Knowledge Management Confluence, Notion, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace.

  • Communication and Collaboration Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom, Google Meet.

  • Live Polling and Surveys Mentimeter, Slido, Poll Everywhere.

  • Metrics and Dashboards Tableau, Power BI, Jira Dashboards, EazyBI, Monday.

  • Spreadsheets and Modeling Excel, Google Sheets.

  • Frameworks and Methodologies SAFe 6.0, Scrum, Kanban, Lean. Working knowledge of the Dynata Product & Engineering Process

Role Requirements

  • Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. Preferred: Graduate‑level qualification in agile project management, organizational transformation, or a related area. Minimum of two active SAFe or Agile certifications (SAFe RTE preferred).

  • Experience More than five years of experience leading software teams at the program level (typically 5–8 years). Minimum two years coordinating multiple teams simultaneously. Minimum three PI Planning events facilitated or co‑facilitated.

  • Training Experience in leadership without authority, facilitation of large‑scale events (50+ participants), executive coaching, cross‑functional communication, flow and predictability metrics, dependency management, and conflict resolution. Relevant certifications such as SAFe RTE, SPC, SASM, PSM, or ICP‑ACC.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Staff RTL Verification Engineer based in the United States.

The Senior Staff RTL Verification Engineer will play a critical role in verifying next-generation RAIN RFID Reader ICs from architecture through tape-out and production.
You will help define advanced verification methodologies, infrastructure, and coverage strategies for complex digital subsystems.
The role combines hands-on SystemVerilog and UVM development with technical leadership across verification, logic, analog, test, and systems engineering.

title: Psykologer søges til opstart af behandlingstilbud i team for psykoterapeutisk dobbeltdiagnose behandling (tidligere APU) på Psykiatrisk Center Nordsjælland
description:
Har du lyst til at være med til at opstarte og bruge din psykologfaglighed til, at vi får et udviklingsorienteret psykoterapeutisk behandlerteam med godt kollegaskab og høj faglighed indenfor en veletableret behandlingsmodel?

Vil du være med til at tilbyde specialiseret og sammenhængende behandling på tværs af sektorer, i den ambulante psykiatri for mennesker med psykisk lidelse og samtidig rusmiddelbrug, der virker?

Så er du måske vores nye psykolog!

Derfor skal du søge stillingen

Du får en unik mulighed for at være med fra starten og skal være med til at udføre, udvikle og udbrede en ny behandlingsmodel med fokus på evidensbaseret psykoterapi og tværsektorielt arbejde. Derudover få du en enestående mulighed for at deltage i kompetenceudviklingsforløb inden patientforløbene går i gang, herunder:

  • Introduktion til behandlingsmodellen og standarder for behandlingstilbuddet
  • Dobbeltdiagnoser, rusmidler, skadeligt brug og afhængighed
  • Recovery
  • Motiverende Samtale
  • Dialektisk Adfærdsterapi
  • Ruminationsfokuseret kognitiv adfærdsterapi
  • Prolonged Exposure
  • Introduktion til tværsektorielt samarbejde, herunder netværksmøder
  • Behandlingseffekt
  • Fagligsparring med øvrige APU-teams i regionen
  • Lokal introduktion til Psykiatrisk Center Nordsjælland
Team for koordineret Psykoterapeutisk Dobbeltdiagnose behandling (tidligere APU)

APU blev etableret i 2017 med formålet at udvikle, afprøve, tilpasse og udbrede en model for specialiseret psykoterapeutisk behandling og systematisk koordineret tværsektorielt samarbejde mellem region og kommune for mennesker med dobbeltdiagnoser. APU-modellen har opnået flotte kliniske resultater med betydelig effekt af psykoterapi og er højaktuel på den politiske dagsorden i Danmark om at sikre behandling for mennesker med dobbeltdiagnoser i psykiatrien i en parallel og koordineret form. I 2026 etableres der teams under hvert akut-hospital i Region Hovedstaden under det nye navn Team for Koordineret Psykoterapeutisk Dobbeltdiagnose behandling (TPD) for at sikre alle patienter i regionen en lige tilgang til behandling.

Behandlingen er målrettet mennesker med angst, OCD, PTSD, depression og personlighedsforstyrrelse og en samtidig rusmiddelproblematik og samarbejder med rusmiddelcentrene i 9 kommuner.

Teamet er organiseret under Psykoterapeutisk Ambulatorium på PCN, hvorfor der vil være et tæt samarbejde både kollegialt og fagligt med afsnittets øvrige personale.

Du vil løbende have mulighed for deltagelse i diverse kurser og modtage supervision.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Visitation, udredning og behandlingsplanlægning
  • Tovholderfunktion for patienter i forløb med varetagelse af tovholdersamtaler og netværksmøder
  • Psykoterapeutisk behandling på kognitivt adfærdsterapeutisk grundlag, i gruppe og individuelt
  • Pårørendesamtaler og -undervisning
  • Tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Tværsektorielt samarbejde med koordinering af behandlingsforløb
Din profil

Du er udannet cand.psych., gerne autoriseret og evt med relevant specialistuddannelse. Du har desuden solid psykiatrisk erfaring.

Vi ser desuden gerne, at du:

  • har kompetencer inden for psykiatrisk udredning

title: Spa Attendant
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

Be You

The Spa Attendant is charge of maintain the high standard of cleanliness and hygiene in all aspects of the operation, assisting the therapist in setting & clearing up the treatment room and assist the guests in professional and helpful manner when needed. The Attendant keeps the Spa & Fitness Center clean and tidy, welcome the guest, assist the guest, serves and refreshes the water and towels.

Target Hire Date – October 2026

Knowledge and Skills

  • At least 1~2 years of relevant work experience in Luxury Hotel.

  • Able to work independently and under pressure in a fast-paced working environment.

  • Good team spirit, cooperative with good communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Reading, writing and oral proficiency in both Spanish and English language

  • Able to multitask and prioritize workload and projects simultaneously and efficiently.

*This position requires applicants to have valid work authorization in Mexico.

Master Your Craft

  • Respond to all interactions in an efficient, courteous and professional manner to achieve maximum customer satisfaction and comfort.

  • Comply with all Four Seasons’ policies and procedures.

  • Comply with all the standards stablished for the spa and sports center

  • Set-up and maintain spa including refreshments, locker rooms, work out areas, pre-treatment area and Fitness room.

  • Handle all guest interactions with the highest level of hospitality and professionalism, accommodating special requests whenever possible; resolve customer complaints; assist customers in all inquiries in connection with spa services.

  • Walk the guest through the customer journey at the spa.

  • Assist guest to their appointments as they relate to the Spa services.

  • Work harmoniously and professionally with co-workers and supervisors.

  • Assist guests with use and set-up of fitness machines.

  • Retrieve and fold towels.

  • Retrieve, deliver, and store/set-up products from purchasing.

  • Check and follow up on the repair and maintenance of the spa.

  • Clean and stock waiting area. Respond to all interactions in an efficient, courteous and professional manner to achieve maximum customer satisfaction and comfort.

  • Comply with all Four Seasons’ policies and procedures.

  • Ensure all equipment is in safe condition and in working order.

  • Other tasks assigned by the management.

What We Offer and What You Can Expect

  • You will become part of a supportive team with a genuine family spirit, where your talent will be valued and recognized.

  • Highly competitive salaries, with an attractive annual incentive plan for management and Department Head positions.

  • Transportation service from San Lucas and San José del Cabo to the resort.

  • Uniform laundry service, ensuring comfort and a professional appearance.

  • Training programs and in-house workshops to support your professional development.

  • A dynamic, diverse, and challenging work environment with close interaction with the leadership team.

  • Recognition programs that celebrate your achievements, including awards for years of service, Employee of the Month, and Employee of the Year.

About Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts opened its first hotel in 1961, and its history has been one of continuous innovation, remarkable growth, and an unwavering commitment to the highest standards. For nearly 50 years, Four Seasons has transformed the hospitality industry by combining genuine care and efficiency with the finest traditions of international hospitality. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts has been ranked EVERY YEAR as one of FORTUNE Magazine’s “100 Best Companies to Work For” since 1998 and has been named a Great Place to Work Legend, an honor currently held by only 12 companies worldwide.

Service Culture

Currently operating 120 hotels and resorts and 45 residential properties in major city centers and resort destinations across 47 countries, with more than 50 projects under planning or development, Four Seasons consistently ranks among the world’s finest hotels and most prestigious brands in reader surveys, traveler reviews, and industry awards. Our greatest asset—and the key to our success—is our people. We believe that each of us deserves a sense of dignity, pride, and satisfaction in what we do.

At Four Seasons, we guide all our actions by the Golden Rule: “Treat others as you would like to be treated.” Here, you will work on a team built on mutual respect, collaboration, exceptional service, and a passion for hospitality. As a luxury brand, your work will also be guided by the highest standards to ensure exceptional quality and service at all times. Expect to work hard while having fun and learning along the way, taking your career, experience, and skills to the next level. As an added benefit, working with Four Seasons gives you the opportunity to build an international career and travel around the world while staying at incredible properties at no cost.

Freight forwarding GSC operator is the face of DP World to the CSO (Customer Service Operations).

DPWL stakeholders.

description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer

Team: IT

Location: Mexico

Commitment: Full-time

Workplace Type: remote

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer based in Mexico.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer, you’ll champion a quality-first mindset across an agile software development environment. You’ll contribute throughout the full software development lifecycle, from requirements refinement and test strategy through release validation. The role combines hands-on testing, automation, backend validation, API testing, database testing, and exploratory testing. You’ll work closely with product, architecture, engineering, and quality teams to identify risks early and improve testability. As the automation expert within the team, you’ll help build and maintain robust automated test suites for new and existing functionality. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence engineering practices and raise software quality beyond your immediate team. This is a collaborative, remote role in a fast-moving environment where ownership, curiosity, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

Accountabilities

    • Contribute to feature refinement by challenging assumptions, clarifying requirements, identifying edge cases, and assessing system architecture and testability.
    • Develop and formalize comprehensive test strategies covering test scenarios, integration points, test data, APIs, applications, queues, databases, and result verification.
    • Deploy and configure software updates in QA environments and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and end-to-end tests.
    • Investigate defects, identify root causes where possible, and document bugs with clear, accurate reproduction steps and supporting information.
    • Validate completed functionality and provide production sign-off when quality and acceptance criteria have been met.
    • Drive test automation for both new and existing features, working closely with quality engineering leadership to maintain reliable and effective automated test suites.
    • Act as the team’s automation specialist and promote quality engineering practices across the wider development organization.
    • Perform backend testing through multiple interaction methods, including REST APIs, message queues, databases, and front-end interfaces.
    • Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, technical leads, developers, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
    • Advocate for quality, usability, testability, and continuous improvement while managing and reprioritizing multiple workstreams in a dynamic environment.
    • During the first 90 days, build a strong understanding of the products, customers, teams, tools, and processes, while establishing relationships and contributing to the team’s quality goals.
    • Participate actively in feedback, professional development, and continuous improvement initiatives.

      • Requirements

      • 5–8+ years of proven experience working as a QA tester or QA engineer within an Agile software development environment.
      • Strong experience developing test strategies, defining test scenarios, and writing detailed test cases.
      • Extensive experience testing backend systems using multiple approaches, including REST APIs, message queues, databases, and front-end interfaces.
      • Strong SQL skills and practical experience with relational database tools such as DBeaver, SQL Server, or MySQL Workbench.

      • Hands-on experience with API testing and documentation tools such as Swagger, Bruno, and Postman.

      • Knowledge of configuring mocks for isolated service testing is highly desirable.
      • Strong exploratory testing skills, with a sharp eye for functional defects, edge cases, usability concerns, and unexpected behavior.
      • Excellent troubleshooting and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate issues and communicate findings clearly and efficiently.
      • Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the flexibility to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
      • A proactive, collaborative mindset with the confidence to challenge assumptions and advocate for quality.
      • At senior level, the ability to influence software quality beyond your immediate team and contribute to broader engineering improvements.

title: Business Analyst / Data Change Manager
description:
Title:

Business Analyst / Data Change Manager

About KBR and the Project

KBR are a global technical solutions provider with 28,000 employees worldwide, with operations in 34 countries delivering to customers in 80 countries. KBR work collaboratively with their wide customer base to deliver solutions that strive to create a better, safer and more sustainable world.

KBR’s Estates Intelligence division specialise in enabling clients to make informed decisions about the operational and strategic management of their estates and asset portfolios, including the external supply chain retained to deliver asset management and maintenance services. Estates Intelligence teams utilise the ‘6 As’ Methodology to deliver business benefit by deploying their ‘Viaverse’ platform to enable each A – aggregation of data, automation of transactional processing and operational data flows, assurance of process and data integrity to promote sanctity of management information, audit of processing and data to better refine business outcomes, analytics to offer management information and insight, all to enable enhanced asset management across client’s portfolio.

About the Role

KBR are constructing a multi-disciplinary technology team to deliver KBR’s latest Viaverse solution. A critical role within this team is the Business Analyst, who will report to the Process and Data Change Manager and will have ownership of business and functional requirement capture and lifecycle traceability management in one or more of the mobilisation streams. Post mobilisation the role will be responsible for managing change and continuous improvement through to release, ensuring scope has been agreed, tested and signed off before handing to the Release Manager. This is a rare opportunity to join a large-scale KBR EI programme delivering significant benefit to a large public sector department from mobilisation into BAU handling change and continuous improvement.

Role Responsibilities:

During mobilisation this role will be responsible for:

Ensuring contractual requirements are individually captured, coded and MOSCOW’ed in a requirements catalogue.

Taking the lead with client stakeholders to ensure all requirement clarifications are resolved with client to ensure requirements can be delivered, deferred or removed.

Defining detailed process flow diagrams, either as controlled amendments to current flows, or creation of new flows, to support client requirements for transactional service delivery.

Assisting Data Lead in ensuring supporting data dictionary is defined and controlled that supports the flows and functional requirements.

Functional requirements documentation throughout lifecycle, ensuring traceability back to requirements catalogue.

Requirements traceability during development, working with developers to ensure all technical developments are demonstrable results of business and functional requirements.

Requirements traceability during testing, working with test team to ensure test coverage provides demonstrable results of business and functional requirements that can be accepted by client.

Responsible for requirements handover to BAU teams upon exit of hypercare, ensuring all artefacts are transitioned to configuration and live support.

In BAU this role will be responsible for:

Acting as a senior and strategic partner to the client on all aspects of solution design, process management, and technical service stability.

Maintaining documentation and traceability beyond mobilisation, ensuring change resulting from defects, business change or proactive improvements is captured with version control.

Ensuring data change within the system is recorded, e.g. ensuring version control and validation of change, identifying any system change required.

Work with Client and other internal teams to understand any pain points in processes, identifying potential scope for improvements of processes, technology or other ways of working.

Ensure changes are Impact Assessed across required stakeholders to understand impact and prioritisation for delivery.

Ensure changes are commercially assessed to prevent contract scope creep.

Working with wider development teams to highlight problem areas within the solution and work with developers and the business to overcome these.

Chair governance ensuring data and system alignment across business and supply chain stakeholders, acting as a key point of contact across the delivery eco system.

Assist support teams, acting as an escalation point, where queries involve process clarifications.

Experience Required

Experience delivering end-to-end Business Analysis on SaaS platform implementations.

Experience of working on large scale multi-organisational mobilisation Programmes.

Experience of developing complex contractual requirements into a traceable catalogue and managing requirements though design, development and test phases.

Experience of managing client workshops and resolving requirements ambiguity/gaps.

Experience of delivering client-side and supplier-side in public sector arena.

Experience of working in both Agile and Waterfall delivery environments.

Experience of working in a BAU environment handling change and improvements.

Experience of working in multi-discipline teams, and confident working with all roles i.e. business operations, developers, support teams.

Experience defining business, functional, non-functional, data and reporting requirements.

Knowledge of change governance, release management and transition into Business-as-Usual support models.

Experience designing and maintaining data dictionaries, business glossaries and data governance artefacts.

Knowledge of Facilities Management processes, including reactive maintenance, planned preventative maintenance (PPM), asset management, finance and supplier performance management.

Required Technical Skills & Qualifications

End-to-end process modelling (with experience of BPMN).

Requirements (functional & non-functional) gathering, traceability and prioritising (MOSCOW).

Basic understanding of SQL database software (MRI Evolution preferably but not essential).

Experience of MS Visio to create and maintain complex transactional flows.

Experience using Jira.

Recognised Business Analyst accreditation.

Degree Educated preferably in a technical subject (desirable).

Security Requirements

The successful candidate must hold or be able to successfully obtain SC and will require a 5-year UK footprint.

Location

This is a permanent, full-time position based in the United Kingdom. The role is hybrid and will require 3 days based one of our offices in either the Surrey area or Swindon.

  • har en inkluderende og anerkendende tilgang til eleverne

Skolen er tre-fire sporet med ca. 800 herlige børn fra 0.-9. klasse. Skolen består af 80 pædagogiske medarbejdere, 13 tekniske og administrative medarbejdere og fem ledere.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og inden for rammerne af lokal løndannelse.

  • Har vilje til personlig og faglig udvikling
  • Har erfaring med netværksarbejde og prioriterer det i hverdagen
  • Ser tværfaglighed som en fordel og et vigtigt supplement til egen faglighed, hvorved samarbejde bliver en naturlig del af hverdagen

  • Dokumentere i den elektroniske patientjournal (EPJ) for egne patienter


Vi tilbyder:

  • Indflydelse på arbejdstider inden for ambulatoriets åbningstider – med fokus på balance mellem arbejdsliv og privatliv.

Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatri Syddanmark er fysisk placeret på fire matrikler. Ud over ambulatorier i Vejle, Esbjerg, Odense og Aabenraa rummer afdelingen døgnafsnit i Aabenraa og Odense samt dagafsnit i Esbjerg, Aabenraa og Odense.

Der er en funktionsledelse bestående af en funktionsleder og en ledende overlæge tilknyttet hvert afsnit. I samarbejde med de faglige ressourcepersoner varetager funktionsledelsen den daglige ledelse af afsnittene. Sammen understøtter de medarbejderne i løsningen af kerneopgaven.

Den overordnede ledelse for de fire matrikler varetages af afdelingsledelsen, bestående af en cheflæge og en chefsygeplejerske.

title: Lærer søges til matematik og naturfag
description:
Bliv en del af et stærkt team og gør en forskel for unge på Tibberupskolen!

Er du en engageret og dygtig lærer med hjerte for matematik og naturfag? Brænder du for at støtte unge i deres udvikling og skabe et trygt og motiverende læringsmiljø? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i Espergærde!

Tibberupskolen søger en uddannet lærer til at undervise i matematik og naturfag i vores gruppetilbud på udskolingsniveau. Vores gruppetilbud er for elever på 7., 8. og 9. årgang, i det daglige delt i en 7.- 8. klasse og en 9. klasse, som har brug for lidt ekstra støtte til både faglighed, motivation, sociale kompetencer og trivsel.

Hvad kan du forvente?
  • Et tæt og engageret team: Du bliver en del af et dedikeret team af udskolingslærere, der prioriterer sparring, vidensdeling og et godt arbejdsmiljø. Vi løfter i flok og er altid klar til at støtte hinanden.
  • Fokus på den enkelte elev: Sammen med teamet vil du skabe et læringsmiljø, der tager udgangspunkt i den enkelte elevs behov og potentiale.
  • Udskolingsprofil med fokus på fremtiden: Tibberupskolen har en stærk udskolingsprofil, hvor vi arbejder målrettet med at styrke elevernes selvstændighed, kritiske tænkning og forberede dem til ungdomsuddannelserne.
  • En hverdag med godt humør: Vi tror på, at en positiv atmosfære er nøglen til succes, og vi prioriterer det gode humør i hverdagen.

Vi søger dig, der:
* Er uddannet lærer med linjefag i matematik og/eller naturfag.
* Har erfaring med eller interesse for at arbejde med elever, der har brug for et mindre tilbud.
* Er god til at skabe relationer og motivere unge.
* Er en holdspiller, der trives med sparring og vidensdeling.
* Har et positivt sind og en anerkendende tilgang til elever og kollegaer.

Praktiske detaljer:
* Fuldtidsstilling til besættelse pr. 1. oktober eller efter aftale, så tøv ikke med at sende os din ansøgning.
* Løn og ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst.
* Børneattest og straffeattest indhentes.

Lyder det som noget for dig? Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig. Har du spørgsmål, så kontakt Daglig Pædagogisk Leder Ulla Glædesdahl på 25 31 35 51 for at høre mere.

I Helsingør Kommune vægter vi, at medarbejdere og ledere udvikler deres faglighed. Derfor har vi fokus på at skabe sammenhæng mellem den ambitiøse udvikling af hele organisationen Helsingør Kommune og videreuddannelse af både medarbejdere og ledere – fagligt og personligt.

9 ud af 10 indbyggere bor mindre end 2 km fra vandet. Her mødes Hamlet og Kronborg med verdenskendt arkitektur og en hyggelig middelalderby på ét og samme sted. Tjek #OplevHelsingor og se selv.
