  • May be required to work where high noise hazards prevail.
  • Will be required to wear protective clothing and other safety equipment during periods of extreme hot and cold temperatures.
  • Exposure to high intensity noise levels, extreme changes in temperature, materials identified on the Material Safety Data Sheets, working on or around aircraft and machinery.
  • Aircraft flight line, hangars, and maintenance shops.
  • Able to physically operate aircraft ground servicing equipment including vehicles, tugs, tractors, and high-pressure soap and water systems.

title: Timelønnede naturglade pædagogmedhjælpere/tilkaldevikarer til dejlig Skovbørnehave

TK's skovbørnehave "Skovhytten" søger en eller flere timelønnede tilkaldevikarer.

Skovhytten er en populær skovbørnehave med plads til 30 børn i alderen fra 3 - 6 år, og er beliggende i en dejlig gammel skovridderbolig med en kæmpe naturgrund/legeplads ret op til skov, mose, å og sø.

Personalegruppen består af tre pædagoger, en medhjælper, en studerende samt en afdelingsleder. Vi har egen bus og chauffør, der hver dag bringer os frem og tilbage imellem opsamlingen på Tuborgvej 185 og Skovhytten i Uggeløse skov. Åbningstiden er fra kl. 07.00 til kl. 17.00 mandag til torsdag og fra kl. 07.00 til kl. 16.30 fredag.

Vi er en arbejdsplads med høj medarbejdertrivsel, hvilket også er meget synligt i trivselsvurderingen og institutionens APV.

Vigtige omdrejningspunkter for vores pædagogiske arbejde er: omsorg og nærvær samt at skabe udfordringer og små sikre succeser; men vi giver samtidig plads til mangfoldighed og forskellige tilgange til at løse opgaven.

Vi møder børn og forældre med et ressourceorienteret syn, hvor vi har blik for positive intentioner og hvad der lykkes.

Som tilkaldevikar hos os, må du meget gerne have institutionserfaring og eller erfaring med natur og udeliv; men det vigtigste er, at du er: glad for børn, lærenem, arbejdsom, fleksibel og mødestabil, samt har mulighed for at vikarierer med kort varsel ved sygdom, ferier og kurser. Har du en relevant baggrund, og er du studerende, NGO’er eller i deltidsbeskæftigelse m.m., er du velkommen til at søge, også selvom du kun kan stå til rådighed på dine arbejds- eller studiefrie dage.

Vi forventer, at du:

• Kan li´ børn

• Er naturinteresseret og kan lide at være ude i al slags vejr uanset årstid.

• Bidrager aktivt til et godt arbejdsfællesskab

• Mestre dansk i skrift og tale

Vi tilbyder:

• Dygtige og glade kolleger

• Faglig sparring

• Godt arbejdsmiljø

• Tillidsbaseret og synlig ledelse

title: Remote Therapist - Massachusetts
description:
Talkiatry is a virtual mental health practice built by clinicians, for clinicians. Our care model, workflows, and infrastructure are intentionally designed to support high-quality outpatient care and expand access to patients with the care they need.

This role is designed for independently licensed therapists who want:

  • Predictable, W-2 compensation and full benefits

  • Flexible scheduling within a structured outpatient model

  • Minimal administrative burden in a fully remote environment

  • Clear expectations around caseload, documentation, and pace

  • Our outpatient therapy model is intentionally built for virtual care, not retrofitted from inpatient or hospital systems, allowing you to deliver thoughtful and structured care.

What your day-to-day practice looks like:

  • 100% remote, outpatient therapy

  • Lower to moderate acuity populations (ex. anxiety, depression, trauma, ADHD, mood disorders, OCD, others)

  • Standard session lengths (60-minute intakes and follow-ups)

  • Consistent outpatient caseload with defined, transparent goals

  • No inpatient, IOP/PHP, or crisis-call responsibilities

  • In-house referral network to/from psychiatrists

  • Full operational support including scheduling, billing, intake coordination, credentialing, and licensing

Clinical autonomy & flexibility:

  • Independent treatment decision-making

  • Input into schedule and weekly availability within operational guidelines

  • Clinical approach within evidence-based standards

  • Care expectations are shaped by practicing clinicians, reinforcing professional judgment, and shared accountability for quality.

  • You practice independently, with accessible clinical leadership available for consultation and support. Our role is to remove administrative work so you can focus on patient care. This model works best for clinicians who value delivering high-quality, evidence-based care to patients.

What we're looking for:

  • Independently licensed therapists (LCSW, LMFT, LPC, LMHC or equivalent)

  • Active, unrestricted license (multi-state licensing support available)

  • Two or more independent and active state licenses (except for CA, NY and MA)

  • Comfort managing a consistent outpatient caseload

  • Strong clinical judgment, communication skills, and independent decision-making

  • Comfort practicing in a fast-paced but sustainable outpatient environment

  • (Highly desired) Experience from outpatient, community mental health, hospital, IOP, or other structured clinical settings

  • (Highly desired) Experience with structured, skills-based modalities (ex. CBT, ACT, MI, DBT-informed care)

  • Please note, this role is not designed for clinicians seeking supervision toward licensure or those looking to build a fully self-directed 1099/Private Practice. You will be a part of our team!

Compensation, Benefits & Stability:

  • Full-time and part-time W-2 employment

  • $70k with the ability to earn up to $20k in incentives

  • Tenure-based increases after 2 years

  • Employer-paid health, dental, vision insurance (up to 100% of premiums)

  • 401(k) match with employer match

  • Paid time off (PTO), paid sick time and 11 paid holidays

  • Paid parental leave and long-term retention benefits (ex. 4-week paid sabbatical after 5 years)

  • Malpractice coverage (occurrence-based, 100% employer-paid)

  • CME reimbursement and dedicated CME days

  • Licensing support with upfront coverage of costs

  • Technology package provided

Our history

Talkiatry was founded in 2020 by Dr. Georgia Gaveras, a triple board-certified psychiatrist in adult, child and adolescent psychiatry, and Robert Krayn, a patient who experienced firsthand the challenges of accessing care. Together, they set out to reimagine outpatient psychiatry by building a model that supports both patients and clinicians, while expanding access to mental healthcare.

Our culture

Our clinical community includes 700+ psychiatrists and PMHNPs and 300+ therapists practicing across 32 languages.

Learn more

Email clinicialcareers@talkiatry.com to connect with a recruiter or check out our LinkedIn Life@ pages to hear directly from clinicians who practice with Talkiatry!

title: Handling Qualities Engineer (f/m)
description:
Job Description:

Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for a Handling Qualities Engineer (f/m) to join our Stability & Control Team, based in Toulouse, France.


You will be part of a team that, throughout the aircraft's life cycle, acts as an integrator between the Aerodynamics, Performance, Loads, and Modelling domains, as well as with the various aircraft systems including engines and landing gear to ensure that the aircraft's Handling Qualities meet the required standards.


All along the aircraft (A/C) life, Handling Qualities (HQ) team plays an integrator role between flight physics and systems/Engine/Landing Gear which can be summarized through 3 main activities:

1. A/C control surfaces sizing and validation/verification to ensure the A/C manoeuvrability and stability requirements,
2. Flight domain definition and V&V (minimum speeds, angle of attack protection settings, weight/CG, etc.) in strong relation with cockpit systems and with operational people (customer support, flight test),
3. Failure cases analysis - ensuring that the consequence of any failure case on A/C control is in accordance with its probability of occurrence.

If you are not already familiar with Handling Qualities or still need to learn, a network of experts and technical referents will ensure your technical development through a learning path adapted to your profile.
You will have the opportunity to develop strong working relationships with colleagues from various teams (A/C programs, Aircraft systems, Flight test, lab/simulator test, Flight Physics, Customer support, Product Safety, etc.).

Depending on your aspirations and your profile, there will be the opportunity to evolve and develop your leadership within the team and within the group, through the treatment of multi-program topics or by switching to product leader or work package leader positions, or through the architect development path.

Being an integrator job, Handling Qualities is as well a valuable step for integrating architect paths.

Your challenges
Checking aircraft and actuator sizing for HQ needs,
Defining flight domain where aircraft safety, comfort and reliability is guaranteed (definition of speed, angle of attack, sideslip domains, and procedure in case of failure cases),
Analysing the consequences of any system failure on aircraft Stability and control,
Analysing in-service events and system behaviour during these events,
Preparing, performing and following up simulator tests and flight tests requests necessary to validate those studies.

Your boarding pass
- Degree in aeronautical engineering / mechanical engineering (or equivalent),
- Flight Dynamics knowledge,
- Test and/or Flight Physics knowledge,

- Knowledge in Automatic control of system Control feedback loop is a plus
- Knowledge in Control simulation tools : Matlab, Simulink, ...
- High interest in digitalisation (big data, etc.) would be a strong plus,
- Aircraft systems knowledge would be a plus,
- Advanced level of English and French.

This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities.

title: Guest Recognition Specialist
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

When you think about Four Seasons, we hope unparalleled luxury comes to mind. But what is luxury, really? Our answer may surprise you. To us, true luxury is a meaningful sense of belonging. It is a dedicated focus on how people want to be treated, grounded in the genuine care you experience during your stay and defined by an abundance of humanity and generosity. This starts with our passionate team, welcoming you to be the centre of our world, anywhere in the world – and always with a distinctly human touch. The views are just the beginning at Four Seasons Hotel Sydney, located at the epicentre of the historic Rocks district, sparkling Harbour and buzzing CBD. Chic rooms and suites embrace the iconic attractions just steps away, while the award-winning restaurant and street front bar are destinations unto themselves.

About the role:

The Guest Recognition Specialist plays a pivotal role in delivering personalised and intuitive service by ensuring guest profiles, preferences, and recognition details are accurately maintained and actioned throughout the guest journey. This role is responsible for supporting the hotel's guest recognition strategy by preparing detailed arrival information, maintaining profile integrity, monitoring guest recognition performance, and collaborating with departments to create meaningful and memorable guest experiences. This role is part of the Commercial Team, reporting to the Reservations Manager.

What you will do:

  • Review guest reservations and profiles daily to prepare for upcoming arrivals, ensuring guest preferences, notes, and recognition opportunities are accurately captured and communicated.
  • Maintain the integrity of guest profiles by managing duplicate profiles, updating preferences, and ensuring adherence to Four Seasons profile standards.
  • Coordinate guest profile updates through various guest feedback and operational systems, ensuring guest information remains current and actionable.
  • Partner with Front Office, Reservations, Guest Relations, Food & Beverage, Spa, and other departments to support personalised guest experiences throughout the guest journey.
  • Monitor and maintain profile data quality, including managing suspended profiles, profile clean-up activities, and compliance with brand standards.
  • Prepare and distribute daily, weekly, and monthly reports relating to guest recognition performance, profile management, and operational KPIs.
  • Identify guest preferences and develop departmental communications to ensure personalised service delivery for VIP, Special Attention, Incognito, and Public Relations guests.
  • Support ongoing guest recognition initiatives by analysing trends, identifying opportunities for improvement, and promoting best practices across the hotel.

What you will bring:

  • A passion for delivering exceptional and personalised guest experiences.
  • Previous experience in Front Office, Reservations, Guest Relations, or a similar hospitality-related role.
  • Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy in managing guest data and profiles.
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify trends and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple departments.
  • Experience working with hotel property management systems, particularly OPERA, is highly advantageous.
  • A strong understanding of guest recognition principles, profile management, and luxury hospitality standards.
  • The ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive guest information with discretion.

What we offer:

  • Competitive wages and a comprehensive benefits package.
  • Excellent Training and Development opportunities.
  • Complimentary Accommodation at other Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts.
  • Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniform.
  • Complimentary Employee Meals.

You will own the quality engineering strategy and expand an existing quality operating model across multiple product lines. The environment combines AI-assisted test generation, automated validation, human judgment, and evidence-based release governance. You will help make quality an integrated property of the engineering lifecycle rather than a final inspection step. Working closely with Product Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, and Engineering leadership, you will influence architecture, developer practices, and release discipline. Accountabilities:

    • Lead the systems and workflows through which AI agents generate, maintain, and execute API, UI, integration, contract, performance, and end-to-end test coverage, ensuring human review keeps automated output trustworthy.
    • Manage the test review and activation process, maintaining review throughput and ensuring test drafts move efficiently from creation to validated coverage.
    • Establish and enforce evidence-based release governance, including release gates, explicit exit criteria, documented waivers, accountable sign-off, and escalation processes that remain effective under delivery pressure.
    • Define which scenarios require human judgment and establish processes for progressively retiring manual tests as automation and AI capabilities improve.
    • Build an evaluation framework for AI-driven quality, including golden verdict datasets, agent calibration, escape-rate analysis, and data-driven allocation of human review effort.

      • Experience with evidence-based release governance, including release gates, exit criteria, waivers, sign-off accountability, and quality metrics.
      • Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native applications, CI/CD, microservices, and architectures designed for testability and reliability.
      • Demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring experience, with the ability to influence engineering direction without relying solely on formal authority.
      • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across multiple engineering and product teams.
      • Passion for developer experience, engineering enablement, continuous improvement, and building quality into software development processes.

      • Previous experience as a Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Quality Engineering Architect, or senior SDET is advantageous.
      • Experience delivering intelligent test generation, autonomous test maintenance, or production-grade agent-driven quality workflows is highly valued.
      • Familiarity with automation technologies such as Playwright, Selenium, REST Assured, JUnit/TestNG, Cypress, or comparable frameworks.
      • Experience with shift-left testing, developer-owned quality, testing-pyramid strategies, and engineering quality measurement.

As a Senior System Engineer, you will help build and operate the core networking layer of a large-scale cloud infrastructure platform. At Cincinnati Children's, bioinformatics plays a critical role in advancing precision medicine, accelerating scientific discovery, and improving outcomes for children and families. As a Bioinformatics Analyst I, you will contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of bioinformatics solutions that support both clinical and research initiatives. Working in close partnership with clinicians, researchers, laboratory professionals, pathologists, and technology teams, you will help curate, analyze, validate, and interpret complex biomedical and genomic data while supporting the development of next-generation sequencing (NGS) pipelines, computational workflows, and software solutions. Through collaboration, innovation, and data-driven problem solving, you will help optimize bioinformatics processes, support clinical accreditation requirements, and contribute to scientific publications and emerging technologies that drive the future of pediatric healthcare.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

Informatics

  • Curates, annotates and organizes various types of biomedical data (e.g., genomic, clinical, imaging, sequencing) in various formats (e.g., flat files, relational and non-relational databases).

  • Collects and records appropriate metadata.

  • Ensures data are securely stored yet highly accessible to authorized users.

Data Analysis

  • Executes pipelines for curating, processing and analyzing biomedical data of various types (e.g., genomic, clinical, imaging, sequencing).

  • Utilizes existing software to support complex data management tasks (e.g., sequence alignment, variant calling, inter-sample comparison, patient matching/linkage).

  • Utilizes web-based bioinformatics tools and public/proprietary relational databases.

  • Follows standard operating procedures.

title: Pressure System Integrity Engineer
description:
Job Family Group:

Engineering Group


Job Description:

The Pressure Systems Integrity (PSI) Engineer plays a critical role in safeguarding the integrity and reliability of pressure-containing assets by ensuring robust inspection, assessment, and mitigation strategies are applied throughout the asset lifecycle—from design through operation to decommissioning. This role ensures compliance with bp Group Practices, international codes and standards (e.g., API, ASME), and local regulations, supporting safe, reliable, and optimized asset performance within production facilities.

Essential Requirements

  • Proficient in inspection execution, and evaluation for pressure systems, including pressure vessels, piping, heat exchangers, and associated static equipment in LNG plant or similar operations.
  • Experienced in performing Risk Based Assessment/Risk-Based Inspection (RBI), and corrosion/damage mechanism evaluations.
  • Familiar with the selection and use of engineering tools and platforms for managing pressure equipment integrity and work management (e.g., IDMS, Nexus, RBI tools, SAP).
  • Knowledgeable in pressure systems-related codes, such as API 510, API 570, API 653, ASME Section VIII, B31.3, and relevant regulatory frameworks.

Key Accountabilities

  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Integrity Management Program, ensuring inspection strategies are risk-based, technically sound, and aligned with asset priorities.
  • Support efficient deployment of PSI engineering resources across the region, ensuring optimal support to site operations and maintenance teams.
  • Support the development and execution of regional PSI strategies, annual integrity plans, and associated budgets.
  • Participate in the management and technical oversight of contracts related to inspection, NDE services, and integrity data management systems.
  • Drive implementation of regional self-verification and assurance processes for PSI, ensuring effective controls are in place and risks are being actively managed.
  • Set and review engineering procedures and inspection work scopes to ensure consistency with industry best practice and site-specific requirements.
  • Support the deployment and standardization of PSI digital tools (e.g., IDMS, RBI platforms), and ensure data integrity and reliability across the region.
  • Continuously improve PSI program performance through monitoring of integrity KPIs, trending of anomalies, and periodic program health checks.
  • Capture and embed lessons learned from integrity-related events or near misses into engineering standards, practices, or workflows.
  • Where applicable, oversee internal staff or third-party contractors delivering PSI activities, promoting high performance, continuous improvement, and technical excellence.
  • Actively participate in regional or global PSI Communities of Practice to share knowledge, align practices, and support discipline development.

Essential Education

  • University degree in Material Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or industrial engineering with relevant experience.

Relevant Experience

  • At least 10 years of experience in a similar role
  • In-depth knowledge of a wide range of inspection techniques, methodologies and analysis
  • Excellent communication skills with fluency in both written and spoken English
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Proficient in RBA/RBI practices and well-versed in industry standards such as API 510, API 570, and API 653
  • Experienced with Inspection Data Management Systems (IDMS)

There are many aspects of our employees’ lives that are meaningful, so we offer benefits to enable your work to fit with your life. These benefits can include flexible working options, a generous paid parental leave policy, and excellent retirement benefits, among others!

title: AI Agent Developer
description:
Say hello to Hagerty

Hagerty is a company built by drivers for drivers. We put our members at the center of everything we do and are dedicated to making it easier and more enjoyable for enthusiasts to drive and celebrate the machines they love. We’re proud to be the world’s largest insurer of collectible and enthusiast vehicles and are home to the Hagerty Drivers Club, the world’s largest car club. Our Marketplace business presents live and digital sales across the U.S. and Europe, we host a number of driving events and concours, and our award-winning automotive journalists produce the most popular car magazine globally, alongside internationally awarded videos. We’re committed to Never Stop Driving. Ready to get in the driver’s seat? Join us!

As an AI Agent Developer, you will design, build, and continuously improve AI agents that handle real member interactions across the full customer lifecycle: from quoting and binding coverage, to policy service, to first notice of loss and claims. You will own the end-to-end agent development lifecycle on the Sierra platform, scoping agent behavior, designing conversation flows, integrating with Hagerty's systems, evaluating quality, and iterating relentlessly in production until each agent is the best version of itself. This is a senior individual contributor role. You are expected to operate with autonomy, partner directly with business and technology stakeholders, bring engineering discipline to everything you ship, and drive outcomes that are measurable in member satisfaction, resolution rates, and reduced manual effort.

What you’ll do

Own the Agent Development Lifecycle

  • Take agents from initial scope through conversation design, tooling, evaluation, launch, and continuous iteration in production.
  • Translate business goals and member needs into agent behaviors that handle complex, high-volume interactions across quoting, policy service, and claims.
  • Define evaluation criteria for each agent, then use those metrics to drive improvement in resolution rates and member satisfaction.
  • Coordinate across technical and non-technical stakeholders throughout the full build-and-launch process.

Design and Build High-Quality Agents

  • Design and build conversational AI agents on the Sierra platform — expressing goals, procedural knowledge, and deterministic guardrails for regulated or high-stakes interactions.
  • Develop and refine conversational flows, rewrite prompts, and run simulations to tune agent behavior against real member scenarios — edge cases, tone, brand voice, and accuracy all matter.
  • Integrate agents with Hagerty's internal systems and APIs (policy administration, quoting engines, claims platforms) using appropriate authentication patterns and service accounts.
  • Build and maintain immutable agent release snapshots — including model version dependencies, knowledge bases, and prompts — following established release and engineering standards.
  • Apply engineering discipline in a no-code/low-code and declarative platforms: practical logging, error handling, monitoring, automated testing, and regression coverage for critical agent workflows.
  • Validate data accuracy in agent outputs, build reconciliation and anomaly checks where outcomes touch financial or policy data, and raise issues early.

Drive Continuous Quality and Improvement

  • Establish and run structured quality assurance processes — regularly auditing live conversations, annotating agent behavior, and converting findings into regression tests.
  • Use annotated conversations to build a growing test suite that prevents regressions across model upgrades, prompt changes, and platform updates.
  • Monitor agent performance in production, respond to incidents, and iterate rapidly based on usage signals, member feedback, and business outcomes.
  • Participate in on-call production support, sharing responsibility for incident response and agent reliability.

Shape How Hagerty Builds with AI

  • Act as a trusted internal advisor on AI agent strategy — contributing data-driven insights on what's working, where agents can expand, and how to push the platform further.
  • Identify and champion new agent use cases across the member lifecycle as the technology and Hagerty's capabilities evolve.
  • Contribute to team engineering standards, reusable integration patterns, and secure-by-default guardrails for agent development.

This Might Describe You

AI Agent & Technical Experience

  • Hands-on experience building or deploying AI/LLM agents in production — including prompt engineering, eval frameworks, RAG, and agent tooling.
  • Strong technical aptitude: comfortable reading API documentation, understanding data models and system architecture, and engaging in engineering tradeoff discussions.
  • Experience with low-code/no-code or declarative platforms and the ability to ramp quickly on new tooling.
  • Proficiency consuming and integrating APIs, including authentication patterns and working with service accounts.

Engineering Discipline

  • A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience or comparable experience at the intersection of technology and business.
  • Experience applying engineering-quality practices to no-code/low-code development: automated testing where possible, regression coverage for workflows, monitoring and alerting for critical paths.
  • Experience with CI/CD, release management, and deployment promotion practices (dev/test/prod), including versioning and rollback awareness.
  • Strong security posture: least-privilege access, secrets management, auditability, and compliant handling of sensitive member data.
  • Ability to design solutions with clear inputs, outputs, and predictable behavior — built to be maintained and observed over time.

Delivery & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Proven ability to own complex, high-visibility projects end-to-end — from scoping and stakeholder alignment through production launch and continuous improvement.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical partners and drive alignment across teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills — able to identify risks, develop mitigation strategies, and handle unexpected challenges autonomously.
  • Experience working at the intersection of technology and business operations, with a track record of delivering measurable outcomes.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry.
  • Familiarity with telephony platforms and voice agent development.
  • Background in conversational design, customer experience, or contact center operations.

Other things to note

  • This position is open to U.S. remote work. However, team members who reside within 20 miles of the Traverse City headquarters will follow a hybrid schedule, working from the office three days per week.
  • May require travel for quarterly events.
  • Familiarity with public company requirements, including Sarbanes Oxley and key regulations, if applicable. For SOX compliant roles, responsible for designing, executing, and documenting internal controls where they have been identified as owners to prevent errors in financial reporting, processes, and business operations. Including attestation to the completeness, accuracy, and compliance of all financial reporting data, where applicable.

If you reside in the following jurisdictions: Illinois, Colorado, California, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Maryland, Minnesota, Nevada, New York, or Jersey City, New Jersey, Cincinnati or Toledo, Ohio, Rhode Island, Washington, British Columbia, Canada please email recruiting@hagerty.com for compensation, comprehensive benefits and the perks that set us apart.

At Hagerty, we share the road. We are an inclusive automotive community where all are welcomed, valued and belong regardless of race, gender, age, or car preference. We are united by our shared passion for driving, our commitment to preserve car culture for future generations and our desire to make a positive impact in the world.

description:
Site Reliability Engineer

Team: IT

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer based in Ireland.

This is a senior reliability engineering role focused on defining and advancing the infrastructure standards behind a globally scaled, AI-native platform.
You will take ownership of reliability strategy across production infrastructure, with a particular focus on AWS, Kubernetes, event-driven systems, and AI agent workloads.
The role combines deep hands-on engineering with architectural leadership, incident management, observability, and technical mentorship.
You will design systems that remain resilient under increasing transaction volumes while establishing measurable standards for reliability across engineering teams.
A key part of the role will be evolving synchronous architectures toward durable asynchronous communication and strengthening the platform through resilience testing and chaos engineering.
You will also help shape how AI-assisted tools are used for automation, incident analysis, runbooks, and root-cause investigations.
Success means becoming the trusted technical authority for complex reliability decisions while creating practices that make reliability scalable across the organization.

Accountabilities

    • Define and implement the reliability strategy across the platform, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, incident practices, and reliability standards adopted by engineering teams.
    • Drive major architectural decisions as infrastructure evolves, evaluating technologies and designing systems that remain scalable, resilient, observable, and maintainable.
    • Design and own event-driven communication and messaging infrastructure, including the transition from synchronous patterns to durable asynchronous architectures.
    • Manage and evolve cloud infrastructure on AWS, using Infrastructure as Code to automate provisioning, configuration, deployment, and operational processes.
    • Ensure Kubernetes and containerized workloads scale reliably as transaction volumes and AI workloads increase.
    • Build and maintain comprehensive observability through monitoring, dashboards, alerting, application performance monitoring, and distributed tracing.
    • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex production incidents, leading incident response, root-cause investigations, and blameless postmortems.
    • Turn incident findings into permanent improvements through architectural changes, automation, operational controls, and resilience patterns.

    • Use AI-assisted tooling for automation, runbooks, incident analysis, and root-cause investigations, while helping establish effective AI-enabled engineering practices.

      • Hands-on Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tools, with infrastructure managed through version-controlled workflows and code reviews.

      • Hands-on experience with chaos engineering, fault injection, game days, or resilience experiments using tools such as Gremlin, Chaos Mesh, AWS FIS, or similar technologies.
      • Strong distributed systems debugging skills, with experience diagnosing asynchronous workflows, cascading failures, and complex production incidents.
      • Ability to code for automation and engineering tooling using Go, Python, or a similar programming language.
      • Solid database knowledge across SQL and NoSQL technologies, particularly PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis, including indexing, replication, and performance optimization.

description:
This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for a Full-Time Early Career Structural (Buildings) Engineer to work out of Denver, CO; Seattle, WA; Tacoma, WA; Portland, OR; or Virginia Beach, VA. This position will support our Federal Programs AEC Team on structural engineering projects for federal, defense, and public-sector clients. The role is a good fit for an early-career engineer who wants broad technical exposure, direct mentorship, and experience contributing to real projects from design through construction-phase support.

Our Federal Programs Team is comprised of highly motivated engineers, architects and interior designers with a variety of technical backgrounds working in several key locations across the US and internationally. Major clients are U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, U.S. Navy, U.S. Coast Guard, U.S. Postal Service, and U.S. National Park Service. Our strength is derived from the diversity of our federal work and our staff.

Why Join Our Structural Team

Our structural team supports federal, defense, and public-sector clients on practical, technically meaningful facilities. The work is mission-focused, technically varied, and grounded in real operational needs, with constraints related to security, budgets, schedule, constructability, and multidisciplinary coordination.

For an early-career engineer, this role offers broad exposure to structural design, renovations, foundations, equipment support, seismic design, and other specialized project requirements, while developing engineering judgment through mentorship and hands-on project delivery.

Your Impact

  • Develop engineering judgment through mentorship, design reviews, interdisciplinary coordination, and exposure to multiple project phases.

  • Assist with the structural analysis and design of new and existing buildings under the supervision of experienced engineers, including gravity and lateral systems, foundations, and steel, concrete, masonry, and wood structural components.

  • Assist with developing structural drawings, specifications, calculations, and design documentation using site observations, existing-condition information, geotechnical reports, and other project data.

  • Perform routine structural calculations and use engineering software to evaluate building loads, analyze structural systems, and design members and connections in accordance with applicable codes, standards, and project criteria.

  • Assist with developing structural design concepts, selecting appropriate structural systems and materials, and coordinating structural requirements with architectural, civil, geotechnical, mechanical, electrical, and fire protection disciplines.

  • Prepare complete, accurate, and concise structural calculations, design drawings, specifications, reports, and building information models using applicable engineering and drafting software.

  • Participate in site visits and construction-phase services, including documenting existing conditions and construction progress, reviewing submittals, and assisting with responses to requests for information, while complying with applicable safety requirements and site-specific procedures.

  • Complete required company, safety, and project-specific training.
  • Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
  • Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in Structural or Civil Engineering, or equivalent.
  • 0 to 1 year of relevant structural engineering experience, including internship or co-op.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to research codes, standards, design criteria, and project requirements.

  • Basic familiarity with structural building codes and design standards.

  • Competent interpersonal and communication skills when interacting with others, expressing ideas effectively and professionally to an engineering and non-engineering audience.
  • Proficient self-leadership with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and prioritization of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment.

title: Camarista
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

Se Tú

La Encargada de Habitaciones es la responsable de la limpieza de las áreas de trabajo asignadas. Dentro de sus asignaciones está el de apoyar a los gerentes y supervisores. Es responsable del cuidado y comodidad de los huéspedes durante su estancia en el hotel cumpliendo los estándares establecidos por Four Seasons.

Fecha estimada de contratación: Octubre 2026

Conocimientos y Habilidades

  • Experiencia requerida en el puesto mínimo de 1 año
  • Experiencia en hotelería de lujo
  • Comprender y familiarizarse con los estándares de calidad y estándares de servicio del hotel
  • Habilidad para hablar, escribir y leer el idioma Español.
  • Máximo nivel de integridad y transparencia
  • Habilidades razonables para resolver problemas, tomar decisiones y resolver conflictos
  • Trabajar de manera segura, prudente y organizada

* Esta posición requiere que los candidatos cuenten con autorización vigente para trabajar en México.

Domina tu oficio

  • Limpiar las habitaciones de los huéspedes, asegurándose de retirar toda la basura y artículos reciclables, colocándolos en los contenedores apropiados dentro del área de servicio. Así como manejar los productos químicos de manera segura.
  • Asegurarse de que los vasos, amenidades, utensilios y demás elementos de la habitación, incluido el mini bar, sean reemplazados durante su servicio.
  • Reportar cualquier articulo encontrado en las habitaciones de salida al departamento de seguridad, así como los valores a la vista en las habitaciones ocupadas.
  • Reportar cualquier daño, reparación o mantenimiento al departamento de ingeniería.

Lo que Ofrecemos y lo que Puedes Esperar

  • Formar parte de un equipo colaborativo con un genuino espíritu de familia, donde tu talento será valorado y reconocido.
  • Salarios altamente competitivos, con un atractivo plan de incentivos anual para puestos gerenciales y de Jefatura de Departamento.
  • Servicio de transporte desde San Lucas y San José del Cabo hasta el resort.
  • Servicio de lavandería de uniformes, garantizando comodidad y una imagen profesional.
  • Programas de capacitación y talleres internos que apoyan tu desarrollo profesional.
  • Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico, diverso y desafiante, con interacción cercana con el equipo de liderazgo.
  • Programas de reconocimiento que celebran tus logros, incluyendo reconocimientos por años de servicio, Empleado del Mes y Empleado del Año.

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO como "Las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE desde 1998 y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

Cultura de servicio

Actualmente operando 120 hoteles y resorts, y 45 propiedades residenciales en los principales centros de las ciudades y destinos turísticos en 47 países, y con más de 50 proyectos en planificación o desarrollo, Four Seasons se ubica constantemente entre los mejores hoteles del mundo y las marcas más prestigiosas en las encuestas de lectores, críticas de viajeros y premios de la industria. Nuestro mayor activo, y la clave de nuestro éxito, es nuestra gente. Creemos que cada uno de nosotros necesita un sentido de dignidad, orgullo y satisfacción en lo que hacemos.

¿Cómo es trabajar para Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts?

En Four Seasons, guiamos todas nuestras acciones por la regla de oro: “Trata a los demás como te gustaría ser tratado”. Aquí, podrá trabajar en un equipo que se basa en el respeto mutuo, la colaboración, el excelente servicio y la pasión por el servicio. Como marca de lujo, su trabajo también se guiará por estándares muy estrictos para garantizar un alto nivel de calidad y servicio en todo momento. Espere trabajar duro pero diviértase y aprenda en el camino, llevando su carrera, experiencia y habilidades al siguiente nivel. Como beneficio adicional, trabajar con Four Seasons le brinda la oportunidad de trabajar para una empresa internacional y viajar por todo el mundo mientras se hospeda en propiedades increíbles de forma gratuita.

Derfor skal du vælge Strandlodsvej
På Strandlodsvej bliver du en del af et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor du får en grundig introduktion, en mentor og gode muligheder for faglig udvikling – blandt andet gennem autismeuddannelsen. Du får høj grad af medbestemmelse i vores tre medstyrende teams, tæt faglig sparring og en synlig ledelse, der er tæt på hverdagen.

Vi arbejder primært i 12-timers vagter med arbejde hver 3. weekend.

En meningsfuld hverdag
På Strandlodsvej bor 26 voksne med autismespektrumforstyrrelser og forskellige støttebehov.

Din vigtigste opgave bliver at skabe tryghed, struktur og forudsigelighed, samtidig med, at du understøtter den enkelte borgers udvikling, selvstændighed og livskvalitet.

Hverdagen er varieret. Nogle dage handler om aktiviteter, relationer og pædagogik. Andre dage fylder sundhedsfaglige opgaver, samarbejde med pårørende eller planlægning af borgernes hverdag. Fælles er, at vi altid tager udgangspunkt i den enkelte borger.

Du bliver en vigtig del af borgernes hverdag, og du kommer blandt andet til at

  • skabe trygge og strukturerede rammer
  • understøtte trivsel, udvikling og selvstændighed
  • arbejde med kommunikation og autismepædagogiske metoder
  • bidrage til sundhedsfaglige indsatser og dokumentation
  • samarbejde med kolleger, pårørende og samarbejdspartnere
Hvem er du?
Du er uddannet pædagog eller social- og sundhedsassistent.

Erfaring med autisme eller handicapområdet er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde med målgruppen og udvikle din faglighed.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • skaber ro og struktur
  • tager ansvar og arbejder selvstændigt
  • er nysgerrig på menneskers adfærd og udvikling
  • trives i et tæt teamsamarbejde
Du møder mennesker med respekt, nysgerrighed og en grundlæggende tro på, at mennesker gør det bedste, de kan, ud fra de forudsætninger, de har.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst og inden for rammerne af lokal løndannelse.
Arbejdstiden udgør 37 timer ugentligt.
Arbejdstiden ligger i dag- og aftentimerne og er primært tilrettelagt som 12-timers vagter med arbejde hver 3. weekend.
Vi ønsker stillingen besat den 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt.
I forbindelse med ansættelsen indhenter vi straffeattest samt referencer.

Mere information
Du er meget velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Sannie Høier på 24 82 74 12, hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen eller hverdagen på Strandlodsvej.

Strandlodsvej ligger på Amager, cirka 10 minutters gang fra metroen, og der er mulighed for gratis parkering i sidegaderne.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Søg via linket senest torsdag den 27. august 2026
Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

title: Senior Data Engineer - Product
description:
Senior Data Engineer - Product

Job Description

Exciting opportunity for a Senior Data Engineer to join Domain – CoStar in a period of great opportunity and growth. You will have a direct impact on the continued success of Domain-CoStar in the APAC region. Leveraging the largest reality data sets in the local market, to enhance Domain-CoStar’s product service offering and refine internal business practices. The purpose of this role is to build data platform capabilities for batch and streaming pipelines on our Lakehouse and develop data assets that serve as the source and authority for data-driven decisions and analytics used across the business. You will design, develop and operate a data platform and data pipelines which serve Domain’s products and internal data teams like data product, data science, data analytics and ML/AI.

What you’ll do

Solution Design: Design and build re-usable, scalable data solutions and assets on a modern Lakehouse platform across a constantly evolving landscape of products and internal data teams. Pipeline Development: Build and maintain robust, reliable pipelines using DBT, Apache Airflow, Snowflake, Databricks and AWS services. Streaming & Real-Time: Develop real-time data pipelines using Apache Kafka and Apache Flink to support low-latency, event-driven use cases. Data Integration: Connect to a wide variety of internal and external sources via multiple methods (SaaS solutions, APIs, direct connections, streaming) on cloud architecture. Cloud Data Architecture: Architect and implement data solutions on AWS, Snowflake and Databricks, applying best practices for cloud-native data warehousing and cost-efficiency. Lakehouse Architecture: Build and optimise open Lakehouse table formats such as Apache Iceberg, managing schema evolution, partitioning, and performance. Modern Data Modelling: Apply modern data modelling practices that evolve with the business in an agile environment. Performance & Cost: Write and optimise complex SQL and Spark workloads to keep solutions efficient in both time and cost. Data quality and governance Cross-functional Partnership: Work closely with data scientists, analysts, product managers, and engineers across the Domain Group to deliver data solutions that drive business value. Continuous Improvement: Challenge the status quo — proactively identify opportunities to improve data processes, reduce costs, and increase reliability.

Essential

  • At least 5+ years of hands-on commercial experience in software or data engineering.
  • 4+ years of strong development experience in SQL and Python.
  • Proven experience with data integration and orchestration tools, including Apache Airflow, DBT, and AWS Glue.
  • Expert on some of the modern cloud data platforms and architectures, such as Snowflake, Databricks, and Lakehouse architecture
  • Experience designing and building data solutions on AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience working with semi-structured and unstructured data.
  • Strong data modelling skills with the ability to evolve models in an agile environment.
  • Hands-on experience building streaming and real-time pipelines with Apache Kafka and Apache Flink.

At CoStar, we recognise the positive value of diversity and promote equality. We aim at all times to recruit the person who is most suited to the job and welcome applications from people of all backgrounds including but not limited to; people of all genders, of all ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, nationalities, religions and beliefs.

Domain is a leading property technology and services marketplace that is home to one of the largest portfolios of property brands in Australia, including the Domain, Allhomes and Commercial Real Estate (CRE) platforms. In 2025, Domain became part of CoStar Group - a global leader in commercial real estate information, analytics, online marketplaces and 3D digital twin technology. title: Socialpædagog søges til specialiseret botilbud i Hadsten
description:
Er du uddannet socialpædagog, og ønsker du at gøre en reel forskel for voksne med betydelige funktionsnedsættelser?

Vi søger en nærværende og fagligt engageret kollega, som har lyst til at blive en del af et stærkt tværfagligt arbejdsfællesskab. Hos os får du mulighed for at bringe din pædagogiske faglighed i spil i en hverdag, hvor relationer, kommunikation, udvikling og livskvalitet er omdrejningspunktet.
Vi søger en ny kollega, fordi flere borgere fremover vil modtage helhedstilbud i botilbuddet. Det giver os mulighed for at styrke bemandingen og skabe endnu bedre rammer for borgernes hverdag.
Stillingen er som udgangspunkt på 37 timer ugentligt. Ønsker du et lavere timetal, er vi åbne for dialog. Erfaring med mennesker med nedsat funktionsevne er en fordel, men ikke en forudsætning.

Om stedet og borgerne
Ellemosevej 26B er et specialiseret botilbud i Hadsten og en del af Voksenhandicap i Favrskov Kommune.
Her bor ni voksne borgere med multiple funktionsnedsættelser. Flere af borgerne er nonverbale og har omfattende støttebehov både fysisk, psykisk og sanseligt.
Borgerne har behov for støtte til personlig pleje, måltider, kommunikation, aktiviteter og deltagelse i sociale fællesskaber. Alle borgere er kørestolsbrugere, og fælles for alle er, at de har brug for medarbejdere, der møder dem med nærvær, respekt og faglig nysgerrighed.

Fagligt ståsted
Vi arbejder med afsæt i borgernes tilstræbte indefra-perspektiv og Favrskov Kommunes tilgang Mest muligt i eget liv. Det betyder, at vi tager udgangspunkt i den enkelte borgers ønsker, behov og ressourcer, og at vi har fokus på at skabe et værdigt og meningsfuldt liv for den enkelte.
Vi er nysgerrige på borgernes individuelle udtryk og forsøger at forstå deres perspektiver, behov og intentioner bag deres handlinger og kommunikation.
Vi arbejder systematisk med mål og dokumentation med udgangspunkt i SMART. Dokumentationen er en vigtig del af den faglige indsats og bidrager til at sikre kvalitet, udvikling og sammenhæng i borgernes forløb.

Når vi møder faglige dilemmaer og komplekse problemstillinger, arbejder vi aktivt med refleksion og etiske overvejelser. Vi ser refleksion som en naturlig del af den pædagogiske praksis og som et vigtigt redskab til at udvikle kvaliteten af vores indsats.
Kommunikationen med borgerne foregår ofte gennem kropssprog, mimik, lyde, tegn til tale og andre alternative kommunikationsformer. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du er nysgerrig på de små signaler og har lyst til at arbejde med forskellige kommunikationsformer og støttesystemer.
Vi prioriterer det tværfaglige samarbejde højt og har et tæt og tillidsfuldt samarbejde med pårørende, som vi ser som en vigtig del af borgernes liv.
Vi er godkendt praktiksted for socialpædagogstuderende og har samtidig flere elev- og studerendegrupper tilknyttet huset. Vi vægter et godt læringsmiljø højt og ser gerne, at du har lyst til at bidrage til dette samt indgå aktivt i det tværprofessionelle samarbejde omkring elever og studerende.

Din hverdag hos os
Som socialpædagog bliver du en del af et engageret og fagligt stærkt team, der samarbejder tæt om at skabe trygge og meningsfulde rammer for borgerne.
Din hverdag vil blandt andet veksle mellem relationsarbejde, nærvær, aktiviteter, personlig pleje samt dokumentation, planlægning og samarbejde med pårørende, dagtilbud, myndighed og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.
Du vil være med til at udarbejde materiale til opfølgningsmøder og sikre, at borgernes støtte tilrettelægges med blik for deres individuelle behov, ressourcer og udtryk.
Du vil desuden bidrage aktivt til dokumentation, evaluering og opfølgning på borgernes mål og delmål.

Vi søger ikke en medarbejder, der alene skal løse dagens opgaver. Vi søger en socialpædagog, der kan bringe sin pædagogiske faglighed i spil, omsætte refleksion til handling og være med til at skabe udvikling, trivsel og meningsfulde fællesskaber for borgerne.

Mange af vores borgere oplever gradvist tab af funktioner og færdigheder. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan se betydningen af de små fremskridt og de små tegn, der viser trivsel, livskvalitet og deltagelse.
Du skal kunne hvile i din pædagogiske faglighed, igangsætte relevante pædagogiske tiltag og samtidig være nysgerrig på, hvordan den tværfaglige indsats kan styrke borgernes muligheder og livskvalitet.

Vi arbejder med struktur og tydelighed som ramme og med nysgerrighed og respekt som tilgang. Du bliver en vigtig del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, værner om fællesskabet og har blik for de små tegn, der viser, at vores indsats gør en forskel.

Vi søger en kollega, der
  • Er uddannet socialpædagog
  • Har lyst til at arbejde med voksne med betydelige funktionsnedsættelser
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en del af et stærkt arbejdsfællesskab
  • Er nysgerrig på borgernes individuelle udtryk, kommunikation og perspektiver
  • Kan igangsætte, kvalificere og evaluere pædagogiske indsatser
  • Ser dokumentation som et vigtigt redskab i den faglige indsats
  • Kan reflektere over egen og fælles praksis og bidrage aktivt til faglige drøftelser
  • Trives i arbejdet med etiske dilemmaer og komplekse problemstillinger
  • Ser værdien i det tværprofessionelle samarbejde og bidrager aktivt med sin egen faglighed
  • Møder borgere, pårørende og kolleger med en anerkendende og respektfuld tilgang
  • Er fleksibel, ansvarlig og stabil
  • Har kørekort (kategori B) og er villig til at køre botilbuddets handicapbusser
Erfaring med målgruppen er ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at lære, engagere dig og være med til at skabe de bedst mulige rammer for borgerne.

Vi tilbyder
  • En spændende arbejdsplads med en unik borgergruppe
  • Grundig introduktion og oplæring
  • Høj faglighed og et tæt samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper
  • Engagerede og hjælpsomme kolleger
  • En nærværende ledelse, der prioriterer faglig sparring og udvikling
  • Fokus på faglig og personlig udvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med plads til humor, forskellighed og fællesskab
  • En fast mentor, som bidrager til en tryg opstart og fungerer som løbende sparringspartner i hverdagen
  • En hverdag, hvor du gør en mærkbar forskel for andre mennesker

Arbejdstid
Du indgår i en vagtplan med både dag- og aftenvagter og arbejder i gennemsnit hver 3. weekend.

Yderligere oplysninger
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, eller ønsker du at høre mere om arbejdspladsen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Stine Rose på telefon 20 31 46 17.
Ellemosevej 26B er beliggende i Hadsten med gode transportmuligheder og centralt placeret mellem Aarhus, Randers og Silkeborg.

Ansøgningsfrist og tiltrædelse
Ansøgningsfristen er den 26. august 2026. Vi afholder løbende ansættelsessamtaler.

Tiltrædelse 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest muligt.
Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og til at byde dig velkommen i en hverdag, hvor faglighed og menneskelighed går hånd i hånd.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Du bliver ansat i Voksenhandicap, Favrskov Kommune.
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst.

Favrskov Kommune kan kun modtage ansøgninger sendt elektronisk. Det er en forudsætning for ansættelsen, at den person, som vi ønsker at ansætte, ikke er straffet for forhold, som gør vedkommende uegnet til at bestride stillingen. Der vil derfor blive indhentet straffeattest på den kandidat, der tilbydes ansættelse.

title: Chief Resilience Officer- 2 Year Secondment
description:
This secondment is only opened to those who currently work for a LRF Partner Organisation within West Midlands.

We are currently living in unsettled and troubling times. There are multiple conflicts happening across the world and the wide-ranging impacts of COVID-19, the increase of severe weather events due to climate change and the evolving cyber challenges are examples of an evolving threat picture. The context of this means that crises we face will have far reaching consequences and the frequency and scale of the challenges are likely to increase over the next decade. The West Midlands Conurbation Local Resilience Forum (LRF) is a multi-agency partnership made up of representatives from local public services, including emergency services, local authorities the NHS and others. The LRF works to identify potential risks and produce plans to prevent or mitigate the impact on our local communities.

About the Role
Provide an overview of the role. Explain why the role exists, the main objectives and the impact the successful candidate will have.

As the Chief Resilience Officer of the West Midlands Forum (WMLRF), you will be a visible leader at the forefront of embedding the West Midlands Local Resilience Strategy with specific focus on acute shocks and chronic stresses. You will provide exceptional quality, cost effective services through our high impact delivery model.

You will be accountable to the West Midlands LRF Chair, WMLRF Executive Leadership Team, and WMLRF Strategic Group and have responsibility to integrate resilience into wider policy making. There is an expectation that you will take the lead on ensuring that there is multiagency agreement on resilience related policies and procedures and driving the partnership at a strategic level.

As this is a senior executive role you will work cross-systems to influence chief executive leaders, political leaders and build effective working relationships with all partners, including creating new relationships within areas of the wider West Midlands System and political landscape. This post holder will understand the resilience challenges facing all areas of public sector, including everything from health resilience to environmental resilience, to formulate a cohesive delivery plan to support a collaborative approach to help West Midlands become as prepared and resilient as possible. The post holder will be expected to work collaboratively with devolution and the Local Government Reform to develop appropriate political engagement and reporting requirements.

As a visible Leader, you will be expected to promote the West Midlands Forum’s vision, mission and priorities effectively to staff, partners, and the public and inspire others by role modelling joint organisational values. You will promote a culture of fostering innovation, value for money and outcome-based resilience focus. You will be highly influential and resilient in working with stakeholders and political leaders. Your track record of delivery and collaboration will be exemplary.

Key Responsibilities
Include a maximum of five key responsibilities taken from the role profile. Focus on the most important and engaging aspects of the role:

  • The Chief Resilience Officer of the West Midlands Resilience Forum (WMRF), is a senior executive role who will be a highly influential visible leader at the forefront of embedding the West Midlands Local Resilience Strategy with specific focus on acute shocks and chronic stresses.
  • The candidate will be able to demonstrate the provision of exceptional quality, cost effective services through a high impact delivery model through an exemplary track record of delivery and collaboration.
  • Accountable to the West Midlands LRF Chair, WMRF Executive Leadership Team, and WMRF Strategic Group, responsible to integrate resilience into wider policy making and chairing the WMRF Executive Membership group, to ensure multiagency agreement on resilience related policies and procedures, driving the partnership at a strategic level.
  • Work cross-systems to influence chief executive leaders, political leaders and build effective working relationships with all partners, including creating new relationships within areas of the wider West Midlands system and political landscape. The Chief Resilience Officer provides strategic leadership, assurance, partnership coordination and system influence.
  • Observe and understand resilience challenges facing all areas of public sector, including everything from health to environmental resilience, to formulate a cohesive delivery plan to support a collaborative approach to help West Midlands become as prepared and resilient as possible.
  • Work collaboratively with devolution and Local Government Reform to develop appropriate political engagement and reporting requirements. The postholder will champion a "resilience by design" approach, ensuring resilience considerations are embedded early in regional policy, investment and service reform decisions, including transport, housing, infrastructure, climate adaptation, economic growth and community wellbeing.
  • Promote the West Midlands Resilience Forum’s vision, mission and priorities effectively to staff, partners, and the public and inspire others by role modelling joint organisational values. You will promote a culture of fostering innovation, value for money and outcome-based resilience focus.

title: Operador de Cuartos
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On the stunning southern coast of Mexico’s Baja peninsula, experience Cabo’s Golden Corridor with Mexican chic and a cool Mediterranean vibe. In the heart of all the action, the coveted community of Cabo Del Sol is home to our modern hacienda-style village, with sparkling ocean views throughout. Create magical memories as hearts beat to the rhythm of Mexican music, art and culture – embraced by the warmth of our Four Seasons “familia.”

Se tú

El Operador de Cuartos será responsable de atender los reportes y realizar el mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo de las habitaciones, áreas comunes de huéspedes y áreas destinadas a colaboradores, contribuyendo al cumplimiento de los objetivos diarios, semanales y mensuales del Departamento de Ingeniería.

Fecha estimada de contratación: Octubre 2026

Conocimientos y Habilidades

  • Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en funciones operativas de mantenimiento de habitaciones, preferentemente dentro de la industria hotelera.

  • Capacidad comprobada para atender y solucionar de manera eficiente solicitudes, requerimientos y situaciones relacionadas con el equipamiento e instalaciones de las habitaciones.

  • Conocimientos básicos en electricidad, plomería, aire acondicionado y mantenimiento de electrodomésticos.

  • Habilidad para identificar fallas, evaluar situaciones y determinar las acciones necesarias para brindar soluciones oportunas y efectivas.

  • Precisión y destreza manual, capacidad analítica, evaluación de riesgos, pensamiento crítico, razonamiento eléctrico y numérico, resolución de problemas y gestión eficiente del tiempo.

  • Capacidad para utilizar herramientas especializadas de manera segura y eficiente, así como para realizar trabajos de mantenimiento y reparación en espacios reducidos o con obstáculos físicos.

* Esta posición requiere que los candidatos cuenten con autorización vigente para trabajar en México.

Domina tu oficio

  • Garantizar el correcto funcionamiento, seguridad y óptimas condiciones de las habitaciones y áreas asignadas.

  • Atender en tiempo y forma los reportes y solicitudes de huéspedes y departamentos, utilizando el sistema HotSOS y cumpliendo con los estándares de Four Seasons.

  • Ejecutar trabajos de mantenimiento preventivo y correctivo en habitaciones y áreas asignadas, documentando las actividades realizadas.

  • Informar oportunamente al supervisor sobre reparaciones mayores, situaciones que requieran apoyo o cualquier condición que pueda afectar la experiencia del huésped.

  • Participar en los programas de mantenimiento preventivo, inspecciones, capacitaciones y briefings departamentales.

  • Mantener en buenas condiciones el equipo, herramientas y áreas de trabajo, reportando cualquier daño, pérdida o necesidad de reemplazo.

  • Brindar un servicio profesional y cordial a huéspedes y colaboradores, buscando siempre exceder sus expectativas.

  • Cumplir en todo momento con las políticas, procedimientos y estándares de seguridad de Four Seasons, incluyendo el uso adecuado del Equipo de Protección Personal (EPP).

  • Apoyar en situaciones de contingencia y realizar otras actividades relacionadas con la operación del departamento que sean asignadas por su supervisor.

Lo que Ofrecemos y lo que Puedes Esperar

  • Formar parte de un equipo colaborativo con un genuino espíritu de familia, donde tu talento será valorado y reconocido.

  • Salarios altamente competitivos, con un atractivo plan de incentivos anual para puestos gerenciales y de Jefatura de Departamento.

  • Servicio de transporte desde San Lucas y San José del Cabo hasta el resort.

  • Servicio de lavandería de uniformes, garantizando comodidad y una imagen profesional.

  • Programas de capacitación y talleres internos que apoyan tu desarrollo profesional.

  • Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico, diverso y desafiante, con interacción cercana con el equipo de liderazgo.

  • Programas de reconocimiento que celebran tus logros, incluyendo reconocimientos por años de servicio, Empleado del Mes y Empleado del Año.

Acerca de Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts:

Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts abrió su primer hotel en 1961 y su historia es una historia de innovación continua, expansión notable y una dedicación decidida a los más altos estándares. Durante casi 50 años, Four Seasons ha transformado la industria de la hospitalidad al combinar amabilidad y eficiencia con las mejores tradiciones hoteleras internacionales. Four Seasons Hotels and Resorts ha sido clasificado CADA AÑO como "Las 100 mejores empresas para trabajar" de la revista FORTUNE desde 1998 y ha sido nombrado "Leyenda del gran lugar para trabajar", un honor que actualmente solo tienen 12 empresas en el mundo.

Cultura de servicio

Actualmente operando 120 hoteles y resorts, y 45 propiedades residenciales en los principales centros de las ciudades y destinos turísticos en 47 países, y con más de 50 proyectos en planificación o desarrollo, Four Seasons se ubica constantemente entre los mejores hoteles del mundo y las marcas más prestigiosas en las encuestas de lectores, críticas de viajeros y premios de la industria. Nuestro mayor activo, y la clave de nuestro éxito, es nuestra gente. Creemos que cada uno de nosotros necesita un sentido de dignidad, orgullo y satisfacción en lo que hacemos.

¿Cómo es trabajar para Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts?

En Four Seasons, guiamos todas nuestras acciones por la regla de oro: “Trata a los demás como te gustaría ser tratado”. Aquí, podrá trabajar en un equipo que se basa en el respeto mutuo, la colaboración, el excelente servicio y la pasión por el servicio. Como marca de lujo, su trabajo también se guiará por estándares muy estrictos para garantizar un alto nivel de calidad y servicio en todo momento. Espere trabajar duro pero diviértase y aprenda en el camino, llevando su carrera, experiencia y habilidades al siguiente nivel. Como beneficio adicional, trabajar con Four Seasons le brinda la oportunidad de trabajar para una empresa internacional y viajar por todo el mundo mientras se hospeda en propiedades increíbles de forma gratuita.

We are seeking passionate Full Stack Developers (Freshers & Experienced) to join our growing Product Development team. The ideal candidate will be involved in designing, developing, testing, and maintaining scalable web applications. Freshers with strong programming fundamentals are encouraged to apply, while experienced professionals should possess hands-on experience in full-stack application development.

  • HTML, CSS, JavaScript

  • Basic understanding of authentication, authorization, and web application security is an advantage.

  • Strong experience with modern frontend technologies such as React.js, Angular, or Vue.js.
  • Strong programming experience in one or more backend technologies such as Java, C#/.NET, Python, Node.js, or PHP.

  • Good understanding of frontend architecture, component-based development, state management, and application performance.

  • Experience integrating third-party APIs and external services.
  • Experience implementing authentication, authorization, validation, logging, and error handling.
  • Experience developing responsive and cross-browser compatible web applications.
  • Experience writing unit and integration tests.
  • Experience with Git and Agile/Scrum development practices.
  • Experience troubleshooting and resolving application and production issues.
  • Good understanding of web application security and secure coding practices.
  • Experience with Docker and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills
  • Frontend: HTML5 / CSS3 / JavaScript / TypeScript / React.js / Angular / Vue.js
  • UI: Responsive Design / Bootstrap / Tailwind CSS / Material UI
  • Backend: Java / Spring Boot / C# / .NET / Python / Django / FastAPI / Node.js / Express / PHP

  • Version Control: Git / GitHub / GitLab

  • Messaging: RabbitMQ / Kafka or similar technologies

  • Build & Package Tools: npm / Maven / Gradle or similar
  • Familiarity with healthcare applications, EHR/EMR systems, medical billing, insurance, or healthcare workflows is an added advantage.
  • Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as HL7/FHIR is an added advantage.
  • Experience working with applications requiring strong data privacy, security, reliability, and scalability is a plus.

Diversity, Equality, and Inclusion:

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Site Reliability Engineer

Team: IT

Location: Spain

Commitment: Full-time
