This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer based in Spain.

This is a senior reliability engineering role focused on defining and advancing the infrastructure standards behind a globally scaled, AI-native platform.
You will take ownership of reliability strategy across production infrastructure, with a particular focus on AWS, Kubernetes, event-driven systems, and AI agent workloads.
The role combines deep hands-on engineering with architectural leadership, incident management, observability, and technical mentorship.
You will design systems that remain resilient under increasing transaction volumes while establishing measurable standards for reliability across engineering teams.
A key part of the role will be evolving synchronous architectures toward durable asynchronous communication and strengthening the platform through resilience testing and chaos engineering.
You will also help shape how AI-assisted tools are used for automation, incident analysis, runbooks, and root-cause investigations.
Success means becoming the trusted technical authority for complex reliability decisions while creating practices that make reliability scalable across the organization.

Accountabilities

    • Define and implement the reliability strategy across the platform, including SLOs, SLIs, error budgets, incident practices, and reliability standards adopted by engineering teams.
    • Drive major architectural decisions as infrastructure evolves, evaluating technologies and designing systems that remain scalable, resilient, observable, and maintainable.
    • Design and own event-driven communication and messaging infrastructure, including the transition from synchronous patterns to durable asynchronous architectures.
    • Manage and evolve cloud infrastructure on AWS, using Infrastructure as Code to automate provisioning, configuration, deployment, and operational processes.
    • Ensure Kubernetes and containerized workloads scale reliably as transaction volumes and AI workloads increase.
    • Build and maintain comprehensive observability through monitoring, dashboards, alerting, application performance monitoring, and distributed tracing.
    • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex production incidents, leading incident response, root-cause investigations, and blameless postmortems.
    • Turn incident findings into permanent improvements through architectural changes, automation, operational controls, and resilience patterns.
    • Establish a continuous chaos engineering and resilience testing practice through fault injection, game days, and controlled failure experiments.
    • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers while raising the technical bar for reliability engineering and influencing engineering practices across teams.
    • Use AI-assisted tooling for automation, runbooks, incident analysis, and root-cause investigations, while helping establish effective AI-enabled engineering practices.
    • Within the first 6–12 months, establish the platform reliability strategy, lead at least one major architectural evolution, and drive adoption of the SLO and error-budget framework across engineering teams.

      • Requirements

      • Extensive experience in Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering, DevOps, or a closely related discipline, with demonstrated ownership of production-scale systems.
      • Deep expertise in event-driven architecture and messaging systems such as Kafka, NATS, or RabbitMQ, including at-least-once delivery, consumer groups, dead-letter queues, backpressure, and migrations from synchronous to asynchronous architectures.
      • Strong AWS expertise across services such as EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, and RDS, combined with solid networking fundamentals.
      • Hands-on Infrastructure as Code experience using Terraform, Pulumi, or similar tools, with infrastructure managed through version-controlled workflows and code reviews.
      • Strong production experience with Kubernetes and Docker, including container lifecycle management, resource limits, health checks, and orchestration at scale.
      • Proven observability expertise using Datadog or equivalent platforms, including dashboards, monitoring, APM, distributed tracing, and alerting.
      • Demonstrated experience defining and operating SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets across multiple services.
      • Hands-on experience with chaos engineering, fault injection, game days, or resilience experiments using tools such as Gremlin, Chaos Mesh, AWS FIS, or similar technologies.
      • Strong distributed systems debugging skills, with experience diagnosing asynchronous workflows, cascading failures, and complex production incidents.
      • Ability to code for automation and engineering tooling using Go, Python, or a similar programming language.
      • Solid database knowledge across SQL and NoSQL technologies, particularly PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis, including indexing, replication, and performance optimization.
      • Proven technical leadership experience, including setting reliability standards, influencing architecture across teams, and mentoring engineers.
      • Advanced written and spoken English communication skills.
      • Experience with AI or MLOps infrastructure, including model serving, LLM inference, GPU/resource management, or AI agent observability, is highly advantageous.
      • Familiarity with multi-tenant container platforms and customer workload infrastructure is a plus.
      • Experience with data pipelines and orchestration tools such as Airflow or Prefect, and data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery, is beneficial.
      • Familiarity with incident management platforms such as PagerDuty, Opsgenie, or incident.io is an advantage.
      • Experience in the payments industry is preferred.
      • Additional experience with ECS, s6-overlay, AI agent frameworks, or Spanish proficiency is a plus.

        • Benefits

        • Competitive compensation.
        • Fully remote working environment with the flexibility to work from different locations.
        • One-time home office allowance to help create an effective workspace.
        • Company-provided work equipment.
        • Stock options.
        • Health plan available wherever you are.
        • Flexible days off.
        • Access to language, professional, and personal development courses.
        • Opportunity to work on globally scaled infrastructure supporting complex payment and AI workloads.
        • Significant technical ownership and influence over reliability strategy, architecture, and engineering standards.
        • Collaborative international environment with opportunities to mentor engineers and shape organization-wide engineering practices.

title: Unik socialrådgiverstilling til bofællesskabet Østervang - en del af Nødebogård
description:
Er du en nærværende og fagligt stærk leder, som motiveres af at skabe udvikling for både borgere og medarbejdere? Har du erfaring med ledelse inden for socialområdet, og ønsker du at stå i spidsen for et specialiseret tilbud, hvor høj faglighed, relationer og fællesskab er omdrejningspunktet? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som afdelingsleder for Østervang.

Du bliver afdelingsleder for bofællesskabet Østervang i Hillerød, som er en del af Nødebogård under Den Sociale Virksomhed i Region Hovedstaden. Østervang er et botilbud med 6 pladser efter Servicelovens § 107, og tre borgere i egen bolig tilknyttet via servicelovens §§ 85 og 104. De ni voksne borgere med diagnoser inden for autismespektret, ADHD, skizofreni, OCD og andre psykiske udfordringer modtager støtte til et selvstændigt og meningsfuldt voksenliv.

Som afdelingsleder får du det faglige, personalemæssige og driftsmæssige ansvar for afdelingen. Du bliver leder for en engageret og tværfaglig medarbejdergruppe bestående af socialpædagoger, socialrådgiver, fysioterapeut og sosu-hjælper, og du får en central rolle i den fortsatte udvikling af tilbuddet.

Dine vigtigste opgaver

Du får ansvaret for at sikre høj kvalitet i både den socialfaglige og pædagogiske indsats samt skabe de bedste rammer for medarbejdernes trivsel og udvikling.

Du skal blandt andet:

  • Sikre den faglige udvikling og kvalitet i indsatsen omkring borgerne.
  • Lede, motivere og udvikle medarbejdergruppen.
  • Understøtte et godt arbejdsmiljø med fokus på trivsel, samarbejde og psykologisk tryghed.
  • Deltage i det daglige faglige arbejde med borgerne.
  • Sikre en bæredygtig drift og ansvarlig ressourceanvendelse.
  • Varetage samarbejdet med kommuner, pårørende og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.
  • Bidrage til udvikling og implementering af faglige metoder og organisatoriske indsatser.
  • Indgå aktivt i Nødebogårds samlede ledergruppe og bidrage til tværgående udviklingsopgaver.
Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en relevant socialfaglig uddannelse.
  • Har erfaring med personaleledelse, gerne fra social- eller psykiatriområdet.
  • Har indsigt i arbejdet med borgere med psykiske lidelser og autismespektrumforstyrrelser.
  • Er tydelig, tillidsvækkende og nærværende i din ledelsesstil.
  • Kan skabe følgeskab gennem dialog, retning og inddragelse.
  • Trives i en hverdag med mange samarbejdsrelationer og skiftende opgaver.
  • Har gode organisatoriske og administrative kompetencer.
  • Arbejder struktureret og kan bevare overblikket i komplekse situationer.
  • Ser værdien i tværfagligt samarbejde og fælles faglig udvikling.


Erfaring med socialfaglig dokumentation, tilsyn, kvalitetsudvikling og samarbejde med kommunale myndigheder vil være en fordel.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende lederstilling med stor selvstændighed og indflydelse.
  • Et specialiseret tilbud med høj faglighed og mange udviklingsmuligheder.
  • En engageret og kompetent medarbejdergruppe.
  • Et stærkt tværgående ledelsesfællesskab på Nødebogård.
  • Supervision, lederudvikling og relevante efteruddannelsesmuligheder.
  • En organisation med fokus på kvalitet, innovation og menneskelig udvikling.


Om Østervang

Østervang er beliggende i et stort hus med have i Hillerød Øst. Her bor seks voksne borgere i egne lejligheder, og derudover er tre andre borgere i eksterne boliger tilknyttet fællesskabet. Bofællesskabet har mere end 30 års erfaring med at støtte mennesker i overgangen til et selvstændigt voksenliv og arbejder ud fra en anerkendende, relationsorienteret og udviklingsfokuseret tilgang.

Se video om afdelingen HER

Vil du vide mere?

Du kan læse mere om os på eller forstander Tine Theker Stryhn på telefon 26369695 eller mail tine.stryhn@regionh.dk for yderligere oplysninger om stillingen.

Ansøgningsfrist og proces

Ansøgningen skal indeholde oplysninger om uddannelse, tidligere beskæftigelse samt relevante bilag. Ansøgningsfristen er den 3. september 2026.

Der afholdes tre samtalerunder, og der kan indgå personprofil eller ledelsestest mellem første og anden samtalerunde. Tredje samtale finder sted i bofællesskabet med deltagelse af beboerne.

  1. samtale 8/9-26
  2. samtale 16/9-26
  3. samtale 21/9-26
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt.

Der indhentes offentlig straffeattest og børneattest.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår sker i henhold til gældende overenskomst for pædagogisk uddannet personale indgået mellem Socialpædagogerne og Regionernes Lønnings- og Takstnævn.



Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og til at byde en ny afdelingsleder velkommen til Østervang.

title: Information Technology Multifamily P18
description:
FinOps & Cloud Architecture Engineer

Cloud & Infrastructure Team | Full-Time | Mid-Level (7 –12 years)

About the Role

We're looking for a FinOps & Cloud Architecture Engineer who can bridge the gap between engineering and finance. You'll design and maintain scalable, secure cloud infrastructure while owning the cost side of the equation — tracking spend, identifying waste, and building the tagging, budgeting, and forecasting practices that keep cloud costs predictable as we scale. This is a hybrid role for someone who's as comfortable in a cost-allocation spreadsheet as they are in a Cloud knowledge.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Architecture

  • Maintain cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP) that is secure, scalable, and cost-efficient.
  • Build and manage Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar).
  • Evaluate architecture decisions (compute, storage, networking) for both technical fit and cost impact.
  • Support migrations, right-sizing initiatives, and adoption of managed/serverless services where they reduce cost or operational overhead.
  • Knowledge of Github

FinOps

  • Own cloud cost visibility: build dashboards and reports for spend, forecasts, and budget variance across teams.
  • Implement and enforce tagging, showback/chargeback, and cost-allocation standards across cloud accounts.
  • Identify and drive cost-optimization opportunities — reserved instances/savings plans, spot usage, rightsizing, storage tiering, idle resource cleanup.
  • Partner with business and Finance leadership on budgeting, forecasting, and unit economics for cloud spend.
  • Track and report on FinOps KPIs (e.g., cost per unit, waste %, savings realized) and present findings to stakeholders.
  • Evaluate and manage cloud cost-management tooling (e.g., native cost tools, Flexera etc)

Required Qualifications

  • 6–10 years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, or a related role, with meaningful exposure to cost management.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP); working knowledge of a second is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of cloud billing models, cost drivers, and optimization levers (reserved capacity, autoscaling, storage classes, etc.).
  • Comfortable working with data — building reports/dashboards in tools like Excel, Looker, Tableau, or native cloud cost tools.
  • Strong communication skills; able to translate technical cost drivers into terms Finance and business stakeholders understand.

Preferred Qualifications

  • FinOps Certified Practitioner (FOCP) certification or equivalent.
  • Cloud architecture certification (AWS Solutions Architect etc)
  • Experience with Kubernetes cost management (e.g., Kubecost) and containerized workloads.
  • Familiarity with FinOps tooling.
  • Scripting ability (Python, Bash, or similar) for automating cost reports or cleanup tasks.

What Success Looks Like

  • Cloud spend is fully tagged, allocated, and visible by team/product within the first few months.
  • Architecture reviews consistently catch cost and reliability issues before deployment.
  • Measurable, sustained reduction in cloud waste through concrete optimization initiatives.

.
